article.articleHeadline: WHO chief: Conflict in east DRC greatest obstacle to containing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province, with Bunia a key hotspot. About 100,000 people have been displaced in the past month due to fighting, hindering containment. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain currently circulating; containment relies on treating the infected under strict safety measures and requiring contacts to isolate for three weeks. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Bunia, called the security situation the greatest obstacle to containment and urged a ceasefire and increased international funding to deliver equipment and aid. Trials for treatments are being accelerated, though results may be months away. Ongoing conflict and densely populated mining communities in Ituri raise transmission risk, while isolating contacts remains difficult. The article does not provide case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：東部DRCの紛争がエボラ封じ込めの最大の障害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中4項目該当、WPRO基準でも5項目中5項目該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の東部DRCでの爆発的流行で、紛争による100,000人の避難民発生、ワクチン/治療法なし、国際的支援が緊急に必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株のエボラ出血熱は珍しく、現在ワクチン・治療法なし。東部DRCの武装紛争が100,000人規模の人口移動を引き起こし、接触者隔離が困難。WHO事務局長が現地視察し国際支援の緊急性を強調。密集した鉱業コミュニティでの伝播リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: OMS identifica tratamentos e vacinas contra o Ebola para teste em ensaios clínicos em meio a surto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO identifies treatments and vaccines against Ebola for testing in clinical trials amid an outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, the WHO identified three experimental Ebola treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus to be tested in clinical trials amid the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) outbreak, with cases also reported in Uganda. No vaccines or therapies are approved specifically for Bundibugyo. MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), maftivimab (Regeneron), and remdesivir (Gilead) are prioritized; maftivimab is already available on-site in the DRC for immediate use or study inclusion. Obeldesivir (Gilead) is prioritized for post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts, contingent on robust contact tracing. Vaccine candidates include rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI) as the most promising but unlikely to reach testing in 7–9 months; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute) could enter testing in 2–3 months with additional animal data. Ervebo (MSD) should not be used outside research due to inconclusive protection against Bundibugyo. Trials will be conducted with DRC, Uganda authorities, and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラウイルス病の治療薬とワクチンを臨床試験用に特定、流行対応中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種）の流行がDRCおよびウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、予想外の新種での治療法確立需要、国際的対応を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダでの症例報告が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCはリスト内の対象国であり、流行の主な発生地として特定される。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は新興感染症で既存の承認治療法がないため異常性が高い。国際的臨床試験の実施予定があり、国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: આરોગ્ય તંત્રે મોટી રાહત: કોંગોથી આવેલા વેપારીનો ઇબોલા ટેસ્ટ નેગેટિવ,હજુ બીજો ટેસ્ટ કરાશે
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health authorities are relieved: The trader who arrived from Congo tests negative for Ebola; a second test will be conducted.
article.articleSummary: A 37-year-old Congo-origin textile businessman was admitted to Bankers Hospital in Vadodara with high fever amid Ebola suspicion. Initial Ebola testing returned negative, with a second test scheduled 48 hours to a week later per protocol. He arrived from Congo via Mumbai on May 18, stayed five days, then traveled to Selvas and Daman before arriving in Vadodara and staying at Express Hotel. Three foreign travel companions have been traced and quarantined at Ahmedabad’s SVP Hospital. While Ebola tests are negative so far, he tested positive for falciparum malaria and is receiving treatment; fever is compatible with malaria. If the subsequent Ebola test is also negative, discharge may be considered from Civil Hospital in Ahmedabad where he remains under care, pending ongoing follow-up testing as per guidelines. The hotel manager said he is currently out of town and unaware of the situation.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局が安堵：コンゴから到着した商人のエボラ検査が陰性、2回目の検査を実施予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的な移動（コンゴ→インド）が確認され、複数地域への拡散の可能性があるが、初期検査が陰性であり、重症度・深刻な影響の直接的な証拠が不足している。引き続き検査結果の推移を観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: コンゴ（DRC）からの渡航者が複数の初期検査で陰性の結果を得ているが、IHR基準で2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準で4つ該当している。ただし、現時点での確定患者がなく、マラリア陽性であることが熱の主原因と考えられるため、トリアージはWATCHに設定。2回目のエボラ検査結果が決定的となるため、引き続き注視が必要。インドのみがverified_locationsに含まれる（DRCはサマリーの背景地情報だが、実際の発症・診療はインドで実施）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Makin Gila! Uganda Blokade Perbatasan Kongo, Abaikan WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Is Getting Crazier! Uganda Blocks Congo Border, Ignores WHO.
article.articleSummary: Uganda unilaterally closed its land border with the Democratic Republic of Congo as Ebola cases surge, centered on the rare Bundibugyo variant that is now infecting domestic healthcare workers. The move, taken by a local task force, ignores WHO guidance against cross-border closures and is described as temporary and absolute. Entrants from Congo are subject to 21 days of mandatory isolation in designated quarantine facilities, with exemptions only for humanitarian emergencies, essential goods, security operations, and outbreak-response teams. Transmission is fueled by close contact with bodily fluids; frontline health workers are at high risk. In Congo's Kongo East, suspected cases approach 1,000 with about 220 deaths; 101 cases have been laboratory-confirmed, and investigations span more than 3,000 potential contacts. One Bundibugyo patient recovered and was discharged from Rwampara treatment center. No approved vaccine or licensed therapy exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がますます深刻に！ウガンダがコンゴ国境を封鎖、WHO の指導を無視
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱（Bundibugyo variant）の国際的拡大リスク、国境封鎖による渡航制限、死亡を含む重症例、および予想外の希少変異株の流行が認識される。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはコンゴ民主共和国のみ。記事ではウガンダの国境封鎖措置が述べられているが、エボラの実際の患者発生地はコンゴ東部（Kongo East）である。希少なBundibugyo変異株、医療従事者への感染拡大、ワクチンなし、WHO指導への不従順などが複合的に高いリスクを構成している。

article.articleHeadline: Casos confirmados de ébola en Uganda aumentan a ocho
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda rise to eight
article.articleSummary: Eight confirmed Ebola cases and one death have been reported in Uganda as of Wednesday, May 27, 2026, since the outbreak was announced on May 15. In a virtual press conference, Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya said there has been no local transmission in Uganda; all confirmed cases are linked to travelers from the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, the epicenter of the current regional outbreak. Kampala reported the figures, and Uganda, with support from Africa CDC, the World Health Organization, and other partners, is taking appropriate measures to contain the spread. The report underscores ongoing regional outbreak monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ確認症例数が8例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への重大な影響を持ち、国際的拡大リスクが高く、複数国にまたがる地域流行が進行中。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当し、高優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の地域流行が進行中。DRCが震源地で、ウガンダへの人的移動による輸入症例の確認。WHO、Africa CDC等が関与し、国際的監視対象。死亡症例も報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生危機の兆候。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO thử nghiệm các phương pháp điều trị Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO trials Ebola treatments
article.articleSummary: On May 28, 2026, the World Health Organization reported that Ebola therapeutics and vaccines warrant clinical evaluation to gather data on their use, amid a severe Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases also reported in Uganda. No vaccine or treatment is currently approved specifically for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Regeneron indicated that maftivimab monoclonal antibody stock is available in Congo for immediate use or as part of a trial. Among vaccines, a single-dose rVSV-Bundibugyo candidate developed by the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative shows promise, but 7–9 months are needed before trials. Another candidate, ChAdOx1-Bundibugyo from the University of Oxford and the Serum Institute of India, could enter testing in 2–3 months, pending further animal data. Advisers also consider evaluating a combination of monoclonal antibodies with remdesivir. WHO is coordinating with Congo, Uganda, and Africa CDC to design rigorous trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラの治療法を試験中
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの重篤なアウトブレイクがDRC及びウガンダで報告されており、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。WHOが臨床評価を進める段階にあり、シグナルとしてのピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC及びウガンダでのブンディブギョ型エボラの発生が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ記載。WHOが複数の治療候補・ワクチン候補について臨床評価を進める段階にあり、社会的・政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Urges Local Communities and Rebels to Address Ebola Outbreak Seriously - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: DRC Ituri Ebola outbreak (as of 2026-05-29) has killed at least 220 people. The outbreak is caused by Ebola Bundibugyo virus; there are no approved vaccines or treatments. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the DRC and issued an open letter to Congolese people urging a ceasefire amid ongoing conflict to enable response. He acknowledged community anger and mistrust, saying 'Trust must be earned.' Communities are reportedly at risk from locals due to strict burial protocols and movement restrictions, and at least three health centres in Ituri have been attacked. He urged unity to contain the outbreak, stressing that early supportive care at treatment centres can improve outcomes. If you fall ill, seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が地域社会と反政府勢力にエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに真摯に対応するよう促促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてが該当。220人以上の死亡者数を伴う既知のエボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ型）の大規模アウトブレイク、国際的な懸念の高まり、およびWHO事務局長による直接的な国際対応が確認されたため、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラブンディブギョ型による確認済みアウトブレイク。220人以上の死亡者、医療施設への攻撃、コミュニティの不信感、治療法なしという高リスク状況。WHO事務局長による現地訪問と公開書簡の発出は国際的な懸念の高さを示唆。紛争下での対応困難性も確認。

article.articleHeadline: Conselho de Governação Local analisa impacto das medidas de contingência contra ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Local Governance Council Analyzes the Impact of Contingency Measures Against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Angola's Local Governance Council, chaired by President João Lourenço, reviewed the National Contingency Plan against Ebola, noting no locally registered cases. Health Minister Sílvia Lutucuta described strengthened border surveillance at land crossings, ports, and international airports, with passenger information for travelers from affected or at-risk countries as conditions evolve. The proximity to the Democratic Republic of Congo’s northern region—near Uganda, Rwanda, and Tanzania—raises concern given a new Ebola strain with no vaccine, easy transmission, and high mortality. On monkeypox, four cases have been reported in Uíge and nine in Cabinda since last year, with five active cases in the northern province. The strategy includes vaccination of contacts and enhanced vigilance at border points, including Cabinda’s illicit crossing routes. Authorities also highlighted ongoing public investments and infrastructure projects accompanying health preparedness efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 地域統治評議会がエボラ熱対策の影響を分析
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規ウイルス株、国際的拡大リスク）。対象国DRCとの国境の近接性、ワクチン未開発で高い致死率を有するエボラ新規株、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: アンゴラはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無いため除外。記事の主題はDRCの北部地域（ウガンダ・ルワンダ・タンザニア近接）での新規エボラ株の脅威とアンゴラの国境対策であり、DRCが実際の発生国として特定される。ワクチン未開発の新規エボラ株、高い致死率、ヒト-ヒト感染の容易さが強調されており、WPRO全5基準に該当する重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU, México y Canadá anuncian medidas para viajeros por riesgo de ébola ante proximidad de Copa Mundial de FIFA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States, Mexico and Canada announce travel measures for travelers due to Ebola risk as the FIFA World Cup approaches.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts coordinated North American travel measures by the United States, Canada and Mexico for travelers from high-risk African regions ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026. A trilateral statement from Global Affairs Canada notes the measures aim to protect citizens and the millions of visitors, fans, athletes and tourists while keeping travel and trade flowing across borders. Canada has barred entry for 90 days to residents coming from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan, with a 21-day quarantine requirement for those travelers. The World Cup—jointly hosted by the United States, Mexico and Canada—begins on June 11, 2026, underscoring the need for public health precautions during large-scale international events. No domestic outbreak details are provided beyond the described travel safeguards.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、メキシコ、カナダがFIFAワールドカップ接近を控えエボラのリスクに対して旅行者向けの措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準において深刻な影響（死亡率）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国の旅行制限）、渡航制限を伴う異常事態に該当。大規模国際イベント（ワールドカップ）を背景とした複数国による協調対応であり、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: スーダンとウガンダもBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が主要な高リスク地域として言及されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。エボラ発生の詳細は記事本文に記載されていないため、実際の流行状況についての情報は限定的。本トリアージはWHOへの通知対象となる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: OMS intensifica combate a surto de ebola no Congo e em Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO intensifies the fight against an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization intensified its response to an Ebola outbreak spanning the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The two countries have recorded more than 230 deaths to date. In a bid to scale up care and protection, cargo aircraft delivered 100 tons of medicines and personal protective equipment to frontline teams and facilities in the affected regions. The supplies are to support patient treatment and safeguard healthcare workers amid the expanding outbreak. Health authorities warn that there is currently no vaccine developed for the current Ebola variant, heightening concerns about transmission and containment. The deployment underscores ongoing regional cooperation and the need for urgent public health measures to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。230人以上の死亡、複数国への拡大、現在のバリアントに対するワクチン非存在、国際的な対応強化が進行中。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（1269750）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを記載。エボラ出血熱、複数国での230人超の死亡報告、ワクチン未開発バリアント、WHOによる強化対応が確認され、全段階で高リスク評価。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ancient Killer Is Rapidly Gaining Resistance to Antibiotics, Study Warns
article.articleSummary: Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi (S. Typhi) shows extensive drug resistance (XDR), threatening typhoid treatment. In a Lancet Microbe study, 3,489 S. Typhi isolates from 2014–2019 in Nepal, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and India revealed rising XDR strains resistant to ampicillin, chloramphenicol, and trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole, plus resistance to fluoroquinolones and third-generation cephalosporins. Azithromycin resistance mutations are spreading, potentially leaving no effective oral antibiotics. XDR Typhi strains are spreading globally; while South Asia remains the main reservoir, almost 200 international importations have occurred since 1990, with exports to Southeast Asia, East and Southern Africa, and reports in the UK, US, and Canada. In 2024, typhoid cases surpassed 13 million; untreated mortality can reach 20%. Vaccination with typhoid conjugate vaccines (TCVs) offers major prevention, with WHO prequalifying four TCVs by 2025 and calls to expand access in endemic regions. Pakistan has led routine immunization.

triage.headline_ja: 古い感染症が急速に抗生物質耐性を獲得、研究が警告
triage.triage_reason: チフス菌の多剤耐性株が南アジア（インド、バングラデシュ、パキスタン、ネパール）で拡大し、国際的に拡散している。治療選択肢の喪失と世界的な脅威を示す研究報告であり、IHR基準複数該当および公衆衛生の深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはネパール、バングラデシュ、パキスタン、インドの研究データを示すが、対象国リストに基づき検証された発生地域はインド、バングラデシュ、パキスタンのみを列挙。ネパールは対象国に含まれないため除外。XDR Typhi株の国際的な拡散（UK、US、Canada、東南アジア、東南部アフリカへの輸入）は記事で報告されているが、記事の主題は南アジアの耐性株研究である。多剤耐性化による治療選択肢喪失は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: U.S., Mexico and Canada align Ebola travel controls ahead of World Cup
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, the United States, Canada and Mexico unveiled harmonised Ebola travel controls for passengers arriving from African countries deemed at highest risk, ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup hosted jointly by the three nations. Canada imposed a 90-day entry ban on residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan, effective from Wednesday, with travellers from those countries required to undergo a 21-day quarantine. The coordinated measures aim to safeguard residents and the millions of supporters, athletes and visitors while preserving cross-border movement and trade. Officials said the framework targets Ebola-risk travel and forms part of regional health-security efforts. The World Cup kicks off on 11 June, marking the first time the tournament is co-hosted by three countries in North America.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、メキシコ、カナダがワールドカップ前にエボラ出血熱の渡航管理を統一
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク（2つ以上該当）が明確。渡航制限実施による国際的影響は深刻。複数国の調整対応があり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでアフリカ高リスク国からの渡航管理について述べられており、具体的にはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが言及されている。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。2026 FIFA World Cupという大規模国際イベント前の調整措置であり、政治的・社会的関心は高い。実際の感染症イベント情報というより、公衆衛生対策の連携情報に該当する特殊性があり、フルRRAでは背景状況の詳細確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 乌干达病毒专家：遏制埃博拉需冷静、区域协同
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ugandan virologist: Containing Ebola requires calm and regional coordination.
article.articleSummary: Ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, currently lacks an approved vaccine or specific therapy; management relies on supportive care such as fluids and transfusions to prevent organ failure. WHO classifies Congo’s national risk as very high and regional risk as high. Ugandan virologist Pontiano Kaleebu, director of the Uganda Virus Research Institute, calls for calm, intensified cross-border surveillance, and rapid resource mobilization to reverse the rising trend. Uganda has strengthened regional capacity by reactivating the Ebola laboratory in Arua near the Congo border and deploying a mobile Ebola laboratory in Bwera, Kasese District, to accelerate screening and reduce sample transport times. On May 23, border authorities at Mpondwe registered entering travelers. Emphasis remains on public adherence to infection prevention measures and prompt reporting of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのウイルス学者：エボラ封じ込めには冷静さと地域協力が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による進行中のアウトブレイク、ワクチンなし、WHO が地域的リスクを高いと評価、国境間での拡大リスク、国際的な資源動員が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による進行中のアウトブレイク。DRCとウガンダの両国で確認。ワクチン・治療法未承認。地域的リスク評価が高い。国境警戒態勢強化。ウガンダがウイルス検査能力をArua、Beweraに配備し対応強化。

article.articleHeadline: WHO:n pääjohtaja Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa: ebolaepidemia voidaan pysäyttää
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Ebola epidemic can be stopped.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with spillover into Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the Ebola epidemic can be stopped in the DRC. There are over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and nearly 240 deaths since the epidemic was declared in mid-May. The virus is believed to have spread beyond confirmed cases; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for the circulating strain. Uganda has closed its border with the DRC; only Ebola response teams, humanitarian operations, food and freight transport, and security personnel may cross. Tedros travels to the outbreak’s eastern center on Friday, May 30, 2026; fighting between government forces and M23 rebels with Rwandan support continues, and he calls for a ceasefire to aid containment. Ebola fatalities in Africa exceed 15,000 in 50 years; the worst DRC outbreak (2018-2020) caused about 3,500 cases and 2,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国での訪問：エボラ流行は阻止可能
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。大規模致命的な流行（疑い例1,000以上、死亡240以上）、国境閉鎖措置、複数国への波及が確認され、国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）とルワンダ（49518）も記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダへの波及言及にとどまり、実際の発生確認がDRCに限定されているため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。ウガンダは国境閉鎖などの対応国として言及されるが、主な発生地は DRC。対象国リストに含まれないウガンダ・ルワンダは除外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情疑似病例破千，乌干达宣布立即关闭相邻边界_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: suspected cases surpass 1,000; Uganda announces immediate closure of neighboring borders.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri amid ongoing armed conflict that impedes control efforts. As of May 26, the country reported 1,077 suspected Ebola cases, 121 confirmed, and 238 suspected deaths, with over 3,000 contacts being traced. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is traveling to coordinate response; aid workers note that violence, weak transport networks, and community mistrust hinder isolation and delivery of care. MSF reports clinics attacked and volunteers targeted, exacerbating containment challenges. Uganda closed its border with the DRC on May 27; Uganda reports 7 outbreak-related cases and 1 death, allowing cross-border movement only for essential personnel and aid. WHO warns border closures may backfire by pushing cross-border travel to informal routes. The US has intensified screening for travelers who visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. China’s embassy in Kinshasa warns citizens to avoid Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Upper Uele and to evacuate if unsafe.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：疑似患者数が1000人を超える、ウガンダが隣接する国境を直ちに閉鎖すると発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病という極めて重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威です。複数国での確認症例、国際的な渡航・貿易制限措置、WHOの高レベル対応が認められ、シグナルとしてフルRRA進行が必須です。
triage.notes: DRC内のIturi州、South Kivu州、Kinshasa市での発生が記事の主体。ウガンダでの越境患者7例・死亡1例の報告があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていません。米国とスーダン、中国は疾病の発生地ではなく対応国のため除外。Bluedot APIが抽出した6252001(米国)、366755(スーダン)、1814991(中国)、226074(ウガンダ)は記事サマリーの文脈から実際のイベント発生地ではなく、対応・警告を行っている国です。

article.articleHeadline: Cuộc chiến chống Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Battle Against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surged to over 1,000 cases and more than 200 deaths, with spillover to neighboring Central African countries, alarming the world. The Bundibugyo strain, a relatively rare Ebola variant, currently lacks a licensed vaccine or specific therapy, and authorities fear the epidemic may be larger than detected, with community transmission ongoing. Uganda is among affected neighbors; the United States, Canada, and Europe are tightening controls to prevent cross-border spread. WHO has designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); AU and the East African Community have issued urgent warnings as health systems face pressure with reduced international aid. International commitments total nearly US$500 million to bolster response. Vaccine development faces two paths—adapting existing platforms or replacing the Bundibugyo glycoprotein—and would still take time, so traditional measures—case isolation, contact tracing, and risk communication—remain the primary defense in the near term.

triage.headline_ja: エボラとの戦い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。1,000例以上1000人以上の死亡を伴う大規模エボラ流行で、複数国への波及、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）指定、国際的な感染拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の実施が確認される。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ流行の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）であると明記されている。中央アフリカ共和国とウガンダは隣接国への波及地域として記述されているが、これらは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外した。米国、カナダはコンテナメント措置実施国であり、発生地ではない。配信日時が2026年5月となっており、将来日付である点に留意が必要。Bundibugyo株は稀なエボラ変異株で、ワクチン・特異的治療法が未承認という点は追加のリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Varian Langka Merebak, Sejumlah Negara Ini Perketat Akses Masuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of a Rare Ebola Variant Spreads, Several Countries Tighten Entry Restrictions
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Since the outbreak was declared on 15 May 2026, approximately 900 suspected Ebola cases and 220 suspected deaths have been reported in the DRC, while Uganda has 5 confirmed cases and 1 death. WHO has raised the national risk level in the DRC to very high, though global risk remains low. In response, the DRC suspended all flights to and from Bunia (eastern DRC), with humanitarian/medical flights allowed only by special authorization; Uganda halted direct flights to/from the DRC, closed border crossings by bus and boat for four weeks, and paused weekly border markets, though essential goods may transit. Several countries imposed temporary entry bans on people from affected areas: Canada (90 days) and the Bahamas (30 days, extendable); Canada also requires a 21-day quarantine for returning Canadians, permanent residents, and certain foreign nationals from May 30, 2026. The United States has previously restricted entry for non-U.S. travelers who recently visited affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 稀有なエボラウイルス変異株の流行が拡大、複数国が入境規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の変異株、国際的拡大リスク、複数国による渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準も全5項目該当。国家リスクレベル引き上げと複数国の渡航制限措置により、政府・国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、カナダ、バハマ、米国が含まれていますが、記事サマリーの主題である実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRC（ブニア）とウガンダです。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていません。カナダ・バハマ・米国の措置は対応国（secondary locations）です。2026年5月29日の配信で最新のシグナルです。

article.articleHeadline: Vacuna contra Cepa Bundibugyo del Ébola Podría Llegar a Fin de Año
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola could arrive by the end of the year.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) caused by the Bundibugyo strain could see a vaccine and drug reach deployment by late 2026, according to Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya. The outbreak has produced about 246 deaths among roughly 1,077 suspected cases (CDC figures), with the African Union's tally slightly higher and the World Health Organization listing over 1,000 suspected and confirmed cases, and 10 confirmed deaths with 223 suspected deaths. The Bundibugyo strain lacks an approved preventive vaccine, complicating containment of a conflict-affected region with fragile health infrastructure; in Ituri, patients are being transported by motorcycle due to ambulance shortages. Initial Ebola symptoms can resemble influenza or malaria, hindering early detection. Russia is reportedly developing another vaccine; authorities emphasize barrier measures and rapid case detection pending licensed vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ株エボラに対するワクチンが年末までに到着する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRC（Ituri州）における確定エボラアウトブレイク（246～223死亡、約1,077疑似症例）は、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規株）および WPROスクリーニング基準複数（異常/予想外、重症度、流行性）に該当。国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラは承認されたワクチンがない新規株。紛争地域での脆弱な医療インフラ、救急車不足（オートバイでの患者輸送）、初期症状がインフルエンザ・マラリアと類似していることが早期検出を阻害している。ロシアも独立したワクチン開発を報告。記事サマリーでRussian Federationの記載がありますが、これはワクチン開発の文脈であり、実際の発生地はDRCのIturi州のみと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Threat: Could It Spread to Australia?
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, in the Democratic Republic of Congo poses high local transmission risk due to war, displacement, and crowded camps; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. Symptoms include diarrhoea, vomiting, body aches, and in severe cases bleeding and organ failure; fatality rate cited as about 50%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated materials; outbreak containment hinges on robust contact tracing, surveillance, and isolation, coupled with community engagement to overcome distrust. Socio-cultural factors: burial practices, misinformation, and violence complicate response. Australia regards this outbreak as low risk for spread; border screening and public health measures screen and isolate arrivals from affected countries for up to 21 days. While neighboring East/Central African nations face higher risk, distant regions remain unlikely to experience sustained transmission unless containment fails.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの脅威：オーストラリアに拡大する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの発生は稀で予想外であり、致死率50%と重症度が高く、紛争・避難民キャンプなど管理困難な環境での流行拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはオーストラリアを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生が主題であり、オーストラリアはリスク評価の対象地域として言及されているのみ。verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。Bundibugyo型は稀な株であり、紛争地での接触追跡困難、社会文化的障壁（埋葬慣行、不信感）が対応を複雑化させる。東中央アフリカ域内での拡大リスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: China offers 'free screening' for travellers from Zika-hit countries
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, China will offer free Zika screenings for travellers arriving from Singapore and other countries with local Zika transmission, per the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine. Free tests will be available at international travel healthcare centres for all arrivals from affected countries, though it did not state whether checks are mandatory. Travellers displaying Zika symptoms should report to quarantine officials on entry. Singapore reports more than 240 locally transmitted Zika cases, including more than 20 Chinese nationals. Airports are equipped with thermal scanners; past outbreaks saw health declaration forms. Zika can cause microcephaly and other brain abnormalities in fetuses; Brazil has documented over 1,800 microcephaly cases. Malaysia reported its first Zika case in a pregnant woman, a 27-year-old resident of a southern city near Singapore.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ジカ熱流行国からの渡航者に無料検査を提供
triage.triage_reason: ジカ熱の複数国での局所伝播（シンガポール240例以上、マレーシア、ブラジル）、公衆衛生影響（胎児への先天異常リスク）、渡航制限措置の実施により、IHR基準2つ以上該当。国際的な検査・隔離措置の開始は社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: シンガポール、マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは過去のジカ熱流行による小頭症1,800例以上の記録あり。中国は現在の検査措置実施国として検証済み。複数国での局所伝播と国際的な防疫対応が進行中。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Report Epidemiological week: 2026-16 / Reporte semanal de Virus Respiratorios Semana epidemiológica: 2026-16 [EN/ES]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Weekly Report: Respiratory Viruses - Epidemiological Week 2026-16 [EN/ES].
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity across the Americas during Epidemiological Week 16 shows Northern America and the Caribbean at the tail end of the season with positivity rates falling toward baseline; Central America completing post-peak decline; Brazil and the Southern Cone entering austral winter with a sustained upward trend; the Andean Region exhibits overall decline with country-to-country divergence. A(H3N2) remains the dominant influenza subtype across most Southern Hemisphere subregions. RSV trends diverge by hemisphere: declines in North America, but rising in the Andean Region, Brazil, and the Southern Cone as the austral season begins. SARS-CoV-2 continues a broad, low-level decline with no resurgence. SARI and ILI indicators fall in the Northern Hemisphere, while the Southern Hemisphere bears the highest relative burden during this reporting period.

triage.headline_ja: 週次報告書：呼吸器ウイルス - 疫学週 2026-16 [EN/ES]
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザおよびRSVの定期的な疫学監視報告であり、複数地域での活動が記載されている。ただし、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や異常性は示唆されておらず、IHR基準の該当が限定的である。南米地域での上昇傾向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域にはスペイン（カナリア諸島）、米国、ブラジルが含まれている。記事サマリーの内容に基づき、アメリカ大陸全体の監視報告であるが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ（南米冬季の上昇傾向が記載）。スペイン・米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外した。定期的な疫学監視報告であるため、深刻度は低いが、南米でのRSV・インフルエンザの増加傾向に関する続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Elevan a 238 muertes sospechosas por ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola deaths rise to 238 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared on May 15, has reached 238 suspected deaths and 1,077 suspected cases per the Congolese government’s latest bulletin, with data through Tuesday. The World Health Organization (WHO) reports 222 suspected deaths as of May 27. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo virus; there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to the DRC to oversee the response. The agency notes the DRC has endured Ebola outbreaks before (16 prior, with a 17th underway). This update highlights the ongoing transmission in the eastern provinces and the urgent need for coordinated public health measures. As of May 29, 2026, the figures reflect ongoing transmission and the continuing public health challenge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い死者が238人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の新規アウトブレイクであり、死亡例を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として認識される。
triage.notes: DRC東部におけるエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo virus系統）のアウトブレイクが2026年5月15日に宣言され、5月29日時点で238名の疑い死亡例と1,077名の疑い症例が報告されている。WHO事務局長が現地対応の監督のためDRCを訪問するなど、国際的対応が展開中。DRCの過去のエボラ経験（16件の先行アウトブレイク）を踏まえ、対応能力に懸念がある可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ dự định lập trung tâm ngăn dịch Ebola tại Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States plans to establish an Ebola outbreak prevention center in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response shifts as the United States weighs establishing an on-site treatment and outbreak-control facility in Africa, with Uganda emerging as a focal partner. Washington is discussing a center to treat Ebola patients and prevent cross-border spread, instead of evacuating patients to the United States as in past outbreaks. Uganda’s government, led by Permanent Secretary Diana Atwine, says the country could support the initiative, leveraging its established Ebola treatment units, laboratories, and outbreak response teams. The move comes as the Bundibugyo strain spreads in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Kenya is also considered, while the U.S. tightens border controls for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, increasing screening and personnel. This strategy signals a shift toward treating inside Africa to bolster regional health security.

triage.headline_ja: 米国はウガンダにエボラ出血熱流行予防センターの設立を計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）を宣言した Bundibugyo 型エボラ出血熱の地域的拡大に対する米国の戦略的対応。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC と Uganda でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo 株）の流行が主題。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、米国による国境管理強化、および地域内治療施設整備の戦略転換が報告されている。Kenya も言及されているが、記事の主旨は DRC・Uganda での流行対応であるため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Rapport de la situation epidemiologique du cholera en RD Congo (Interne OMS), semaine 20, 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera Epidemiological Situation Report in the DRC (WHO Internal), Week 20, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows 899 cases and 21 deaths in Week 20, 2026, up from 847 cases in Week 19. Fourteen provinces are affected, with cases reported across 84 health zones. Overall, 12 deaths occurred (6 hospitalised, 6 community). Sud-Kivu reports 272 cases and 2 deaths in 16 health zones; Nord-Kivu reports 278 cases and 1 death in 9 health zones, together accounting for 77% of weekly notified cases. Western provinces comprise 23% of cases, mainly Kinshasa (77 cases), Equateur (43), and Sud-Ubangi (36). Response activities are effectively on standby pending a formal request from INSP. A vaccination campaign along the river corridor between the two Congos remains in preparation. The Ministry of Health is advancing a response-focused roundtable, rather than an elimination/multisectoral approach preferred by partners.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ疫学状況報告書（WHO内部）、2026年第20週
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。対象地域DRCで確認された複数省における急速な感染拡大と政府対応の遅延がシグナルとして該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にEcuadorが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみで言及されており、Ecuadorは検証されないため除外した。週ごとの症例数増加（847→899）、14省にわたる地理的拡大、河川回廊での予防接種キャンペーン計画、および政府対応が形式的な要請待機中という管理上の懸念が重要。

article.articleHeadline: خطر فيروس إيبولا يتسع.. تصريحات جديدة من الصحة العالمية.. فيديو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus threat is widening... New statements from the World Health Organization... Video - Youm7
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, coverage notes that Ebola outbreaks are widening in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with WHO statements intensifying efforts to contain a new Ebola outbreak amid unstable security in eastern DRC. The World Health Organization, in a post on X, said it is partnering with a medical research organization in the DRC to boost diagnostic capacity to rapidly detect cases and help contain the outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the initiative as strengthening the laboratory network to deliver real-time data and rapid confirmation to save lives. The report also cites a United Nations assessment warning that the outbreak is accelerating and that response teams are struggling to keep pace. The article does not provide case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの脅威が拡大...世界保健機関からの新しい声明...ビデオ - ユム7
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な感染症であり、DRCでの拡大報告、WHO警告、UN警告により国際的リスクが明確。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ拡大報告。WHO及びUN両者による警告と対応強化が報告されており、国際的な関心も高い。ただし記事に具体的な患者数・死亡数の記載がないため、詳細RRAでの情報収集が必要。東部DRCの治安不安定性も対応の障害となる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Khủng hoảng Ebola leo thang: Mỹ dự định lập trung tâm ngăn dịch tại Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crisis escalates: U.S. plans to establish an outbreak-prevention center in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Uganda is emerging as a central hub in the United States’ evolving Africa Ebola response as the outbreak spreads across Central Africa. Washington has asked Kampala to discuss establishing an Ebola treatment facility on African soil for U.S. citizens, rather than evacuating patients to the United States, signaling a shift in U.S. outbreak management. Uganda’s Ministry of Health notes readiness to back the plan, citing its skilled workforce, established diagnostic laboratories, and Ebola treatment capacity built over years of responding to past outbreaks. The plan centers on the Bundibugyo strain, which is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with no specifically approved vaccine yet. The World Health Organization has raised the level to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機が深刻化：米国がウガンダにおける感染症対策センター設立を計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク。複数国での拡大、米国の積極的介入が示唆される重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダが米国対応のハブとして言及されているが、サマリーの主要な感染拡大地域はDRCおよびウガンダ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに該当しないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（Bundibugyo株）であり、ワクチン未承認の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo gia tăng viêm phổi do RSV ở trẻ dưới 1 tuổi khi giao mùa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning of increased RSV-associated pneumonia in infants under 1 year during seasonal transitions
article.articleSummary: RSV poses a heightened risk of pneumonia and rapid respiratory failure in infants under 1 year in Vietnam during seasonal transitions. RSV is the leading cause of hospitalization among young children worldwide; the WHO estimates RSV accounts for over 60% of acute respiratory infections in newborns and young children. In the Western Pacific and Southeast Asia, Vietnam records RSV in 35.5% of pediatric respiratory infections, third highest regionally. The illness is year-round with seasonal peaks during transitions and rainy seasons when humidity favors the virus; extreme weather can strain infants’ feeding and immunity. A case from Ha Nam General Hospital in Ninh Binh Province on 19 April involved a 3-month-old with pneumonia and respiratory failure after two days of mild cough, initially mistaken for a cold. Prevention includes maternal vaccination and, for direct infant protection, monoclonal antibodies that confer immediate protection; plus hygiene, nutrition, sleep, and early medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目における1歳未満の乳幼児のRSV関連肺炎増加への警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで1歳未満乳幼児におけるRSV肺炎の増加が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ）で複数該当。同国における高い地域的RSV感染率（35.5%）と予防対策の必要性が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムにおけるRSV肺炎の季節性増加に関する警告。乳幼児集団での重症化（肺炎、急性呼吸不全）、高い地域的負担（東南アジア第3位の感染率35.5%）、予防対策（母親ワクチン接種、モノクローナル抗体）の推奨が述べられている。Bluedot APIで示された米国ミズーリ州のロケーションはノイズと判断され、記事サマリーの主題から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Estadounidenses con ébola serán llevados a Europa para recibir tratamiento y no a EE.UU.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Americans with Ebola will be taken to Europe for treatment and not to the U.S.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) has reached 1,077 cases and 246 deaths per WHO; there is no vaccine or treatment for this strain. In response, U.S. officials say Americans who contract Ebola will be transported to Europe for care rather than to the United States. A quarantine center for exposed individuals is opening at Laikipia Air Base in Kenya with 50 beds and will include isolation and biocontainment for positives, who will be moved to European facilities rather than kept in Kenya or the U.S. The only U.S. patient to date was flown to Germany. Seven exposed Americans were sent to Europe last week, including the physician treated in Germany; his wife and four children remain in quarantine in Germany, and another doctor is quarantined in the Czech Republic. The CDC has barred entry to non-citizens who were in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染のアメリカ人はアメリカではなくヨーロッパで治療を受けるため輸送される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限）。DRC発生ウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）で1,077症例246死亡、複数国への国際的拡大と渡航制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: DRCでのBundibugyo ebolavirus発生が主要シグナル。ケニアのLaikipia Air Baseは検疫・隔離施設の開設地であり、発生地ではない。複数国への患者輸送は国際的な関心と支援の必要性を示唆。CDC による渡航制限措置が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: New Drug Offers 'Functional Cure' For Dangerous Liver Virus
article.articleSummary: Bepirovirsen, a first-of-its-kind drug for hepatitis B, yielded a functional cure in about 20% of patients across two international trials involving 1,838 participants. Chronic HBV affects roughly 1.7 million people in the U.S. and more than 250 million worldwide, causing liver cancer or failure and killing about 1.1 million annually. In the trials, participants received weekly injections for six months in addition to standard daily pills; those undetectable for six months after stopping injections could discontinue pills too. About one in five achieved the functional cure, while none in the placebo group did. Responders tended to begin with lower levels of the S protein. Side effects were mild injection-site reactions and temporary liver enzyme elevations. The drug binds viral genetic material, suppresses replication and the S protein, and stimulates the immune response. FDA fast-track with a decision expected in October; regulators in Japan, China, and Europe are reviewing. Early follow-up suggests most responders remain well up to three years.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な肝臓ウイルスに対する「機能的治癒」を提供する新薬
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規治療薬の臨床試験結果に関する医学進展の報道であり、新興感染症の発生・流行イベントではない。公衆衛生上の急性的な脅威やアウトブレイクを示唆する情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はB型肝炎に対する新規医薬品（ベピロビルセン）の臨床試験成功に関する医学ニュースであり、感染症の新規発生・流行イベントではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。記事は米国、日本、中国での規制当局の審査進行状況に言及しているが、これらは地域における感染症イベント発生を示すものではなく、新薬承認プロセスの進展を報じているのみである。

article.articleHeadline: 世界杯前严防伊波拉 美墨加同步收紧入境措施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strict Ebola precautions ahead of the World Cup as U.S., Mexico, and Canada tighten entry measures in tandem.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Ebola precautions tighten ahead of the World Cup as the United States, Canada, and Mexico coordinate travel controls targeting travelers from Africa's high-risk areas. The World Health Organization had declared the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak a PHEIC on May 17, warning of cross-border spread. In the United States, non-U.S. citizens who recently visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan are barred; green-card holders with such travel in the previous 21 days are also restricted. Canada announced a 90-day entry ban from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan starting May 27; from May 30, Canadians, permanent residents, and certain foreign nationals with recent visits from affected regions must undergo 21 days of quarantine on entry. Mexico likewise enhanced airport screening and urged avoidance of Congo, with entrants from the region subject to 21-day quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: 世界杯前严防伊波拉 美墨加同步收紧入境措施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのDRC エボラアウトブレイク関連の国際的対応イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生国はDRCであることが明確。ウガンダと南スーダンは隣国で渡航制限の対象国として言及されているが、記事の主題は「DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク」とそれに対する米墨加による渡航制限措置。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、高リスク状況。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة وكندا والمكسيك تنسق إجراءات سفر مشددة لمواجهة خطر إيبولا صحراء ميديا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States, Canada and Mexico coordinate stricter travel measures to confront the Ebola threat - Sahara Media
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) prompts coordinated travel measures by the United States, Canada and Mexico ahead of the World Cup. The WHO declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, signaling international concern. In the United States, non-citizens who recently visited the DRC, Uganda or South Sudan are barred from entry, with a later expansion to permanent residents who visited those countries within the prior 21 days. Canada imposes a 90-day entry ban for travelers from the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, and requires a 21‑day quarantine for eligible travelers who recently visited affected areas as of May 30. Mexico tightens airport screening for Ebola and urges avoidance of travel to the DRC, enforcing a 21‑day quarantine for arrivals from there. No case counts are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、カナダ、メキシコがエボラの脅威に対処するため渡航措置を調整 - サハラメディア
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病はPHEIC宣言済みであり、DRCでの流行により複数国で国際的な渡航制限が実施されている。対象国DRCでの発生が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の影響が明確。
triage.notes: WHO により2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。DRCでのエボラ流行が複数国の渡航制限措置を引き起こしており、国際的関心が極めて高い。米国・カナダ・メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないが、DRCは含まれるため verified_locations に列挙。記事本文の提供がないため症例数などの詳細は不明だが、公式なPHEIC宣言と複数国での調整された対応措置により、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Quyết liệt triển khai các biện pháp phòng, chống dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vigorously implement measures to prevent and control African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreak response in Trung Thịnh Commune, with authorities banning pig transport and sales, destroying affected pigs, and tightening slaughter-and-transport inspections. Public awareness campaigns intensified to guide residents in prevention. To proactively control the outbreak, the commune allocated hundreds of millions of VND from contingency funds to assist affected pig-rearing households; purchased lime powder and disinfectants and carried out environmental sanitation; and implemented vaccination against ASF for local swine. The province mandates strict environmental disinfection, strict control of pig movement, trading, slaughter, and products, and severe actions against concealing disease, selling sick pigs, or dumping carcasses that could spread infection. It also promotes biosecure farming practices and proactive vaccination of livestock.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱病（ASF）の予防・防除対策の力強い展開
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（ASF）の局地的なアウトブレイク対応を報道しており、異常性と重症度の基準を満たすが、既に管理下にあり国際的拡大リスクの詳細記載がなく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ASFは人獣共通感染症ではなく、動物感染症であり、公衆衛生上の直接的な人的被害はない。記事は地元当局による積極的な対応・管理措置を記述しており、制御可能性は比較的高い。ただし、豚肉・豚製品の貿易制限リスクがあり、地域的な重要性は認識される。IHR基準は2つ該当しており、動物感染症のトリアージ基準を考慮するとWATCH評価が適切。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief: Conflict in east DRC greatest obstacle to containing Ebola
article.articleSummary: Conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the greatest obstacle to containing the Ebola outbreak in Ituri's Bundibugyo strain, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. About 100,000 people have been displaced in the past month, hindering efforts to trace and isolate transmission chains. Tedros visited Bunia, the region's hardest-hit city, and urged a ceasefire and increased international financial support to supply health workers with essential equipment and aid. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain circulating in the area; control relies on isolating infected individuals and keeping contacts in isolation for three weeks. Progress on new therapeutics is under way, with clinical trials being accelerated, but several months may pass before alternatives exist. The Ituri province's dense mining communities raise transmission risk amid ongoing fighting.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：東部DRCの紛争がエボラ封じ込めの最大の障害
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の発生であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（死亡リスク、治療法なし）、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援必要性が認められ、複数基準に該当。紛争による封じ込め困難という異常な状況下での流行も該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスはDRCのIturi州で流行中。治療法・ワクチンが利用不可であり、DRC国内の紛争（過去1ヶ月で10万人の避難民）が疾病制御を著しく阻害している。WHO事務局長が直接訪問し国際支援を要請しており、重大度・緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO đề xuất thử nghiệm vaccine và thuốc điều trị mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO proposes trials of a new vaccine and new treatments.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, Bunia) prompts WHO to pursue clinical trials of candidate vaccines and therapeutics against this rare strain, which has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Evaluated options include two monoclonal antibody therapies and an antiviral; an oral post‑exposure prophylaxis and two vaccines are under consideration but not yet trial‑ready. Trials will be conducted under a research framework with coordination between the DRC and Uganda to assess products. In the meantime, core public‑health measures—surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, and safe burials—remain priorities. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, the DRC has recorded 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths among over 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases as of May 24. Transmission is via direct contact with body fluids; healthcare workers and caregivers are at highest risk. Tedros visited Bunia as UNICEF delivers aid (4.6 tons at Bunia airport; 100 tons forthcoming). This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症：WHOが新しいワクチンと新しい治療法の試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。DRC東部での活動中のエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo strain）で10名の確認死亡、1000件以上の疑い例があり、ウガンダとの国際連携による対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認例は記載されておらず、DRCとの国際連携・調整の文脈のみ。そのためverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo Ebola virusは希少株で既知のワクチン・特異的治療がなく、DRC史上17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。WHOのTedros事務局長のBunia訪問や国連機関による支援体制が確認できることから、高い政治的関心と国際的対応の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: One pair of feet: women, work and TB in Mumbai
article.articleSummary: Divya, a Govandi resident, is diagnosed with multidrug-resistant TB after months of misdiagnosis and partial treatment, with wrong drugs and single-drug regimens driving MDR-TB and exposing gaps in India’s TB program that does not cover all out-of-pocket costs. In Mumbai, Rehana Shaikh, a pulmonary TB patient, commutes from Mankhurd to Shatabdi Hospital for DOTS; six months of treatment involves 40–70 visits, and clinic hours (opening at 10 a.m.) force half-days off work for two Chembur households, eroding wages. A 2024 National Time Use Survey shows women spend 305 minutes daily on unpaid domestic work and are 40% primary caregivers, magnifying treatment burdens. A 2024 PLOS Global Public Health study across four states including Maharashtra finds 30–61% face catastrophic costs (>20% annual income), with indirect costs at 93.4% of TB expenses. Amita, with extrapulmonary TB affecting lymph nodes, travels from Kanjurmarg to Sewri TB Hospital for care.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイにおける女性、労働、そしてTB：一足の靴
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性結核（MDR-TB）の事例報告とインドの結核プログラムの構造的課題が示されているが、新規発生の異常性や国際的拡大リスクが明確でなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響度が限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は個別の結核患者事例と社会経済的課題（女性の労働負担、治療費の負担）を扱っており、流行の局所的なスピルオーバーやアウトブレイクを示すものではない。MDR-TBの存在は認識されているが、新規発見やクラスター発生の報告ではない。インドの結核対策プログラムの改善が課題として提示されているため、政府レベルでの関心が推定される。続報による流行動向の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: México, Estados Unidos y Canadá anuncian medidas para evitar la propagación del ébola en el Mundial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico, the United States, and Canada announce measures to prevent the spread of Ebola at the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, near Uganda and South Sudan. By late May, Congolese authorities reported approximately 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 238 suspected deaths. Cross-border risks led Uganda to close its border with DRC after assessing movements linked to roughly 1,000 suspected cases and about 200 suspected deaths. In response, Mexico, the United States, and Canada announced measures to prevent Ebola spread during the FIFA World Cup hosted across 16 cities in North America, with opening match on June 11 in Mexico City (Mexico vs South Africa) and the final set for July 19 in New York. The Department of State described a coordinated approach to protect citizens and the millions of visitors while maintaining travel and trade; specific preventive measures were not disclosed in the brief. The World Cup involves 48 teams.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、米国、カナダがワールドカップでのエボラ感染拡大防止対策を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急性流行（DRC・Ituri州で1,077疑い例、238疑い例死亡）であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。国際的な大規模スポーツイベント（FIFAワールドカップ、北米開催）での感染拡大リスク、複数国による公式な防止措置発表など、高度の国際的関心と政治的対応がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはメキシコ、米国、カナダ、スーダン、ウガンダなども含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題である実際のエボラ流行の発生地はDRC（Ituri州）であり、他の国は感染リスクへの対応国または関連地域として言及されているのみ。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。スーダン（366755）とウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。なお、本イベントは2026年5月という将来の架空日付を含むが、医学的・公衛生学的に重要なシグナルとして評価した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya chấp thuận kế hoạch của Mỹ về việc mở cơ sở cách ly Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya approves the U.S. plan to open an Ebola isolation facility.
article.articleSummary: Kenya approved the United States’ plan to open an Ebola isolation facility at a central Kenya air base in Laikipia, to be operated by the U.S. Public Health Service. The facility will serve Americans who have been exposed to or infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). On May 28, the U.S. pledged $80 million to bolster Ebola responses in the DRC and nearby Uganda. An American doctor diagnosed with Ebola, and several exposed Americans, have been evacuated to Germany for treatment and monitoring; another exposed American was sent to the Czech Republic. The World Health Organization is coordinating regional efforts as Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits the DRC and plans to travel to Ituri, the outbreak’s northeastern hotspot. WHO: 1,077 suspected, 121 confirmed, 246 suspected deaths; real numbers may be higher. Ongoing challenges include insecurity, aid shortages, and limited community cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが米国によるエボラ出血熱隔離施設開設計画を承認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的広がり、国際渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大、複数国への患者搬送、米国による大規模資金投入が報告されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはケニア（Laikipia）、ウガンダ、米国、ドイツ、チェコが含まれるが、実際の主要な流行はDRC（Ituri州）に限定されている。記事は米国がケニアに隔離施設を設置するという対応策を述べたもので、ケニア自体が主要な発生地ではない。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。検証済み場所はDRCに限定した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO khuyến nghị thử nghiệm vaccine và thuốc điều trị Ebola tiềm năng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Recommends Trials of the Ebola Vaccine and Potential Ebola Therapeutics
article.articleSummary: WHO recommends prioritized clinical trials of three Ebola Bundibugyo therapeutics and evaluation of vaccines as the Bundibugyo outbreak in Africa accelerates. Lead therapeutics include MBP134 monoclonal antibody (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), maftivimab (Regeneron), and remdesivir (Gilead); trials should assess efficacy and safety. Regeneron has shipped maftivimab to the Democratic Republic of Congo for potential urgent use or trial enrollment if WHO proceeds. A post-exposure prophylaxis candidate, obeldesivir (Gilead), is considered, contingent on rapid contact tracing. For vaccines, rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI) is the leading candidate, but trials won't start for 7–9 months; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute of India) may enter trials in 2–3 months pending animal data. Ervebo Merck vaccine is not recommended outside research due to limited protection data for Bundibugyo. WHO envisions combining antibody therapy with remdesivir. Uganda and DRC, with Africa CDC, will design trials. As of 29 May 2026, >900 suspected cases and >200 deaths; outbreak declared PHEIC earlier this month. The U.S. is establishing a quarantine facility for at-risk Americans in Kenya (Laikipia AFB, Nanyuki) with $13.5 million support; CDC coordinating.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱ワクチンと治療薬の臨床試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、国際的対応の必要性）。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイク、900件以上の疑い患者と200人以上の死亡、PHEICの宣言、複数国での流行が確認され、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクが「Africa」で加速していると記載されており、DRC（対象国）が明示的に言及されている。ケニア（Laikipia、Nanyuki）はUS隔離施設の設置地として言及されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダも試験設計国として言及されているが対象国外のため除外。アウトブレイク宣言はPHEIC段階に達しており、緊急性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Canada, US, Mexico announce Ebola travel measures for World Cup
article.articleSummary: Canada, the United States, and Mexico announced aligned public health travel measures for travelers from African regions deemed highest risk for Ebola ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026. The trilateral plan aims to protect citizens and the millions of visitors while preserving cross-border travel and commerce. Canada imposes a 90-day entry ban on residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, with arrivals from those countries required to observe a 21-day quarantine. The United States and Mexico coordinated policies to monitor and regulate travelers from Ebola-affected zones as part of a joint effort to safeguard participants, fans, athletes, and tourists for the World Cup, which begins June 11, 2026. The measures were outlined in a joint statement by Global Affairs Canada, underscoring the health and safety priority for the North American region.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、米国、メキシコが2026年ワールドカップに向けてエボラウイルス病の渡航措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、複数国での予防措置導入、国際スポーツイベント関連の公衆衛生上の重要性からIHR基準2つ以上に該当し、かつ高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事は北米3国（カナダ、米国、メキシコ）のエボラ予防措置を主題としているが、アフリカ地域の実際の発生地としてDRCとウガンダが言及されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。南スーダン（Republic of the Sudan）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2026年FIFAワールドカップという大規模国際イベントに関連しており、社会的・政治的関心が非常に高い。ただしこれは予防措置の発表であり、現在の流行状況については記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Complicated by Conflict: WHO
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persist in eastern provinces, with over 1,000 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths. Laboratory tests identify the Bundibugyo strain, a relatively rare form of Ebola, in this the DRC's 17th outbreak. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) on May 17, and the Africa CDC followed with a continental emergency declaration. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa and indicated ground teams are operating in Bunia, Ituri province, with plans to assess the situation. Conflict, insecurity, and displacement are cited as major response barriers, prompting calls for ceasefires. Tedros warned that travel bans are not advised, as they may delay transmission and deter early reporting, urging intensified measures at the source.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は紛争により複雑化：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの公式な国際的関心事案。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（5月17日）、Africa CDC大陸非常事態宣言済み。Bundibugyo株による17回目のアウトブレイク。1,000件以上の疑似症例、238件の疑似死亡報告。紛争・不安定化が対応の主要障害。WHOディレクタージェネラルが現地到着し、キンシャサおよびイツリ州ブニアでの対応展開中。

article.articleHeadline: WHO đề xuất thử nghiệm vaccine và thuốc điều trị Ebola mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO proposes trials of a new Ebola vaccine and treatment drug
article.articleSummary: WHO proposes trials of vaccines and therapies for Ebola Bundibugyo strain amid eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Expert groups recommend clinical testing of several candidates, including two monoclonal antibodies, an antiviral drug, an oral post-exposure antiviral, and two vaccines, though none are approved yet. Trials will be conducted with the DRC and Uganda. In the meantime, priority measures include surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection control, and safe burials. The Bundibugyo strain has caused two prior Congo Basin outbreaks; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, placing healthcare workers and caregivers at high risk. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, there have been over 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases, with 10 confirmed and 223 suspected deaths as of May 24, in Bunia, Ituri province. WHO DG Tedros travels to Bunia; aid shipments include 4.6 tons at Bunia airport and UNICEF delivering 100 tons. Separately, the US discusses establishing an Ebola treatment center in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラウイルス病の新しいワクチンと治療薬の試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（1,000例以上の確定・疑い例、223人の死亡）は、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」の複数に該当し、ウガンダへの拡大も報告されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行のしやすさ」「管理可能性」が明確であり、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはIturi州Buniaが含まれ、DRCでのアウトブレイク発生が明確。記事はウガンダでの試験実施とUS支援についても言及しているが、実際のアウトブレイク発生地はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株による重大な感染症イベントで、WHO事務局長の現地訪問、大規模な援助物資搬入などから国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les autorités assurent que la riposte contre Ebola reste sous contrôle en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Authorities assure that the Ebola response remains under control in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri province remains under control as the Ebola response continues from Bunia. The latest briefing cites 1,077 suspected cases, 121 confirmed, and 238 suspected deaths since the outbreak began. A laboratory technician infected with Ebola has recovered after two negative tests. Authorities emphasise using a broad case definition to avoid missing cases, even if this inflates counts, and reject claims the outbreak is out of control. Patients in care are manageable, though the response faces misinformation, attacks on health facilities, and surveillance challenges in insecure areas. Governor Johnny Luboya calls Ebola a 'second war' for Ituri and has strengthened security around treatment centers after incidents at Rwampara and Mongbwalu. Tests and care are free; PPE shipments continue; several health workers have been infected. No general school closures; prevention in schools is reinforced. The Bundibugyo strain was declared mid-May; the 90-day plan may take months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：当局がイトゥリ州におけるエボラ対応が管理下にあることを保証
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。確認症例121件、疑い死亡238件、医療従事者感染、セキュリティ課題を伴う進行中のエボラ流行。
triage.notes: Kigali Province（ルワンダ）が発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（イトゥリ州）のエボラ流行であり、ルワンダでの感染確認は記載されていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo strain確認、医療施設への攻撃、セキュリティ課題など複合的なリスク要因を含む。

article.articleHeadline: Response to Ebola Outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda; the World Bank Group mobilizes financing and technical support to frontline responders, reinforce health systems, and strengthen surveillance and cross-border preparedness. HEPRR funds deploy Ministry of Health specialists (epidemiologists, infection prevention and control, risk communication) and diagnostic capacity in Bunia; REDISSE established the largest biosafety-level lab in Eastern DRC, now central testing hub, with equipment funded to stay operational. A separate $555 million nutrition and health project protects maternal, newborn, and immunization services across over 3,500 facilities in the DRC. Uganda is mobilizing funding and coordinating with authorities. Cross-border efforts include South Sudan surveillance at border areas; neighboring countries activating preparedness; WHO contracted under WBG projects to support response. Crisis tools: Crisis Response Toolkit and Crisis Response Window enable rapid reallocation of funds; the Pandemic Fund coordinates surveillance, diagnostics, risk communications, and community engagement in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）およびウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行への対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的流行（DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン）であり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。重篤な病原体、複数国での発生、国際支援体制構築が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにウガンダとスーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「DRCおよびウガンダ」と明示されているものの、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。サマリーの内容からウガンダでの確認も明白であるが、対象国リスト外のため除外。南スーダンも記事に言及されているが対象国リスト外。World Bank、WHO、Pandemic Fund等による国際的対応体制の構築が報告されており、重大な公衆衛生事象として認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Coronavirus: Singapore confirms 2 more cases, bringing total to 30
article.articleSummary: Two more coronavirus cases confirmed by Singapore's Ministry of Health on Feb 6, 2026, bringing the total to 30 confirmed cases, of which 11 are Singaporeans. One case is a close contact of a previously confirmed patient; the second case has no recent travel history to mainland China and appears not linked to earlier cases. The second case was confirmed late on Feb 5, and contact tracing is ongoing to identify links with past cases or travellers from China. To date, all confirmed cases have been either Chinese nationals from Hubei or individuals with links to travellers who are Chinese nationals. All cases have been isolated and ring-fenced. MOH said Singapore must be prepared for the possibility of new infection clusters among locals without recent travel to China or contact with PRC travellers.

triage.headline_ja: コロナウイルス：シンガポールが2件の追加事例を確認、総数は30件に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で該当。シンガポールと中国での確認事例であり、国際的な保健上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年2月のシンガポール保健省による発表を記載。中国（湖北省）からの旅行者との関連が確認されており、コミュニティ内での感染拡大の懸念が明示されている。シンガポールと中国が該当対象国として verified_locations に含まれる。シンガポール（発生地域に明示されていないが）も実際の発生地として確認されるため、記事サマリーに基づき両国を列挙。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief says Ebola 'can be stopped' as he lands in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo can be stopped, says WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on arrival in Kinsasha to oversee the response, centered in Ituri province. As of May 24, WHO logged 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths out of more than 1,000 confirmed/suspected cases. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, amid conflict in the eastern, mineral-rich region where the M23 fights complicate efforts, prompting calls for ceasefires. No vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak; Africa CDC head Jean Kaseya said a vaccine and medicine should be available by end-2026. Aid includes 4.6 tonnes delivered to Bunia and UNICEF planning 100 tonnes. Uganda closed its border after a confirmed Ebola death and six additional cases; the US will not admit infected individuals, and a Kenyan treatment facility plan is under discussion.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国に到着、エボラは「阻止可能」と発言
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認・疑い例が1,000件以上で、死亡者も233名に達し、複数国への波及リスク（ウガンダでの確認死亡、ケニアでの検討）がある。IHR基準では「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限」の3項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」で懸念あり。国際的な高い関心と支援ニーズが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとケニアでの波及・対応についても言及されているが、主たるイベント発生地はDRCのキンシャサおよびイトゥリ州。ウガンダとケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、検証済みロケーションはDRCのみとした。本アウトブレイクはDRC史上17番目であり、東部の紛争地域での拡大制御の困難性が報告されている。ワクチンと治療法がない Bundibugyo 株による流行であることが特記される。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: alerta sanitaria en un puerto de Santa Fe por un tripulante con síntomas a bordo de un buque extranjero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: health alert at a port in Santa Fe due to a crew member with symptoms aboard a foreign vessel.
article.articleSummary: At Santa Fe, Argentina, a crew member aboard the foreign-flagged Sirocco arriving from La Plata developed fever, skin lesions, vomiting, myalgias and cough, triggering a health alert amid the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The young man, reportedly Egyptian, was isolated aboard the vessel as border-health inspectors and provincial health authorities investigated. The ship, carrying soy to Ghana, docked at Vicentín terminal in Santa Fe; medical staff initially diagnosed suspected herpes zoster, with no signs of highly transmissible disease. After persistent fever and dehydration, the patient was transferred to a private facility under precautionary measures. Laboratory tests later confirmed herpes zoster; 36 hours after alarms, health authorities lifted the interdiction and allowed the ship to resume loading/unloading. The patient remains stable; officials stressed the clinical picture was compatible with herpes zoster and not Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: アルゼンチン・サンタフェ州の港で外国船乗組員の症状により保健警報が発令
triage.triage_reason: 記事サマリーが明確に示すとおり、疑わしい症状は帯状疱疹（herpes zoster）と確認され、エボラウイルス病の実例ではない。実際の発生地域はアルゼンチンであり対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはDRC（203312）とGhana（2300660）が含まれているが、記事サマリーを詳細に読むと、実際のイベントはアルゼンチン・サンタフェ州で発生した疑い事例であり、最終的に帯状疱疹と診断された。DRCのエボラアウトブレイク背景情報として言及されているのみ。アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。実際の感染症事例ではなく「疑い例」であり、確定診断は帯状疱疹（非感染症ではなくウイルス性皮膚疾患であるが、エボラではない）である。

article.articleHeadline: खून चूसने वाले वायरस से शेरों की मौत, 17 शावक आइसोलेट, 'बेबेसिया' के आगे जंगल का राजा बेबस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lions die from a blood-sucking virus, 17 cubs isolated, the king of the jungle helpless against Babesia.
article.articleSummary: Babesia babesiosis, a tick-borne blood parasite, is killing lion cubs in Gujarat's Gir Somnath and Amreli districts. The suspected outbreak has claimed four cubs, with 17 more cubs isolated within a 10-km radius of the affected areas to prevent spread. Samples from the deceased cubs have been sent to Junagadh Veterinary College for testing; results are awaited. Wildlife officials, aided by frontline workers, are conducting tick-control campaigns around Gir Sanctuary and surrounding zones to curb transmission. The king of the jungle's vulnerability to this blood-sucking infection underscores the need for ongoing surveillance and disease containment measures in the region. No human cases reported in the article; the response focuses on animal health and containment.

triage.headline_ja: 血液を吸う寄生虫ウイルスがライオンを殺す、17頭の子ライオンが隔離、ジャングルの王がバベシア病に無力
triage.triage_reason: インドのギール野生動物保護区でバベシア症によるライオン死亡事例が報告されているが、ヒト感染報告はなく、主に野生動物健康管理の問題。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: バベシア症は野生動物（ライオン）に限定された報告であり、ヒト感染事例は記事で明示的に否定されている。ギール野生動物保護区内のライオン保全問題として扱われており、公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。ただし、希少野生動物への感染症拡大の可能性と検査結果の待機中であるため、更新情報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में संघर्ष और असुरक्षा के बीच इबोला संक्रमण की रोकथाम मुश्‍क‍िल, डब्‍ल्‍यूएचओ चिंतित - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevention of Ebola transmission difficult in Congo amid conflict and insecurity, WHO concerned.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is described as highly complex amid conflict and insecurity. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to reinforce support, with WHO teams already operating in Bunia, capital of eastern Ituri Province. Laboratory confirmation has identified the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant. Since the outbreak began, the DRC Health Ministry reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. On May 17, WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern; Africa CDC has also declared a continental public health emergency. Authorities warn that armed conflict and attacks hamper response, and call for ceasefires and strengthened on‑the‑ground containment and public health measures rather than travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの紛争と不安定性の中でエボラ感染の予防が困難、WHO懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際保健上の懸念事項(PHEIC)を宣言した確認済みエボラ大規模流行。
triage.notes: WHO事務局長が現地入りし、2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言。Bundibugyo株（稀少な亜種）を検出。1,000人以上の疑い患者と238人の疑い死亡を報告。紛争と不安定性が対応を著しく妨害。Africa CDCも大陸的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Angst, Verdrängung und Tradition erschweren Ebola-Bekämpfung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: Fear, denial and tradition hinder Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is met with fear, denial, and myth‑making as the outbreak surpasses 1,000 suspected cases. In Lita and other communities, residents question the reality of Ebola, with beliefs that it is a hoax or that doctors lie or that one is immune when drinking strong alcohol. Door-to-door outreach by ActionAid, Red Cross volunteers, and scouts tries to explain transmission and protection, while traditional isolation and safe-burial practices clash with local customs of family involvement and a dignified farewell. Hospitals are avoided for fear of isolation, and some communities have attacked treatment centers when relatives demand the release of bodies. Analysts point to cognitive biases and colonial-era distrust as drivers, noting the Congo’s brutal history under Leopold II and ongoing violence and displacement fueling skepticism toward authorities and science.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：恐怖、否定、伝統がエボラ対策を阻害している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。1,000件超の疑い例を伴うエボラ出血熱の継続的流行であり、コミュニティの根強い否定と不信が対応困難性を示唆している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはルーマニア（Lita、Cluj）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴのIturi地域とLitaコミュニティにおけるエボラ流行を述べており、ルーマニアは記事の主題ではない。DRCのみを verified_locations に列挙。社会的・政治的関心は高く、治療センターへの攻撃や遺体奪還要求などの深刻な社会不安が記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Canada Places Temporary Travel Restriction On DRC, Uganda, South Sudan Over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Canada imposed temporary travel and immigration restrictions tied to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, centered on Bundibugyo strain. May 27, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. EDT, immigration documents for residents of these countries—temporary resident visas, electronic travel authorizations, and permanent resident visas—are suspended for 90 days, with new applications paused. A second measure from May 30 to August 29, 2026 requires a 21-day quarantine on arrival for Canadian citizens, permanent residents, persons registered under the Indian Act, and foreign nationals who have been in the affected areas within 21 days and are asymptomatic; those without safe accommodation will be housed, and symptomatic individuals will be isolated in hospital. The government says the risk to Canada remains low; there have never been imported Ebola cases in Canada and no cases in North America. WHO declared a PHEIC for DRC and Uganda and advised against border closures.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、エボラ感染症拡大を理由にDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの一時渡航制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な懸念の高まり。DRC・ウガンダでWHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国での確認と渡航制限という重大な公衆衛生対応が実施されている。IHR基準では異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の該当が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。WHOがDRCとウガンダでPHEIC宣言済みであることが確認されている。Bundibugyo株の流行という特異性もあり、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में संघर्ष और असुरक्षा के बीच इबोला संक्रमण की रोकथाम मुश्‍क‍िल, डब्‍ल्‍यूएचओ चिंतित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevention of Ebola transmission difficult in Congo amid conflict and insecurity, WHO concerned.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola outbreak near Kinshasa remains highly challenging amid ongoing conflict and insecurity. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, upon arriving in Kinshasa, said displacement, food shortages, and mistrust hinder containment and humanitarian access. WHO teams are already operating in Bunia, the capital of eastern Ituri province, with plans to assess conditions there. He urged ceasefires to protect responders and civilians. He cautioned that WHO does not recommend travel bans, noting such restrictions may only slow spread for a few days and could undermine outbreak reporting. The Ministry of Health reports over 1,000 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths in this outbreak, the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. Lab confirmation identified Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17; Africa CDC followed with a continental public health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける紛争と不安定性の中でのエボラ感染症予防は困難、WHO懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生で、238名の死亡が報告され、WHO及びアフリカCDCが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。紛争と不安定性により封じ込め困難で、国際的に非常に重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言。Bundibugyo株という稀なエボラ変異体が確認されている。17番目のDRC内エボラ発生。紛争と不安定性により人道支援アクセスと防疫措置が著しく阻害されている。当該イベントはWPRO地域外（アフリカ地域）だが、WPROスクリーニング基準は適用実施。

article.articleHeadline: 7歲男童感冒咳不停一週　母「照三餐」給退燒藥！醫一檢查嚇壞：B型流感 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 7-year-old boy with a week-long cold and persistent cough; mother gave fever-reducing medicine on a strict three-meals-a-day schedule! A doctor's examination scared the family: Influenza B | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: A 7-year-old boy with a one-week history of cold symptoms and persistent cough was diagnosed with influenza B at Dajia Li General Hospital. The illness severely affected his activity and appetite, and his sister was also infected. His mother had been administering fever-reducing medication at every meal, a dosing pattern the physician warned could mask illness and delay correct diagnosis. After evaluation, the pediatrician initiated antiviral therapy and advised that fever-reducing medicine be used only when fever is present, noting such drugs typically last 4–6 hours. The case highlights that influenza B can appear outside traditional seasons and can progress rapidly. Parents are urged to practice hand hygiene, rest at home during infection, and seek professional care promptly to ensure appropriate treatment and prevent school-based transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 7歳男児が1週間風邪と咳が止まらず、母親が「1日3食」解熱薬を投与！医師が検査して驚愕：B型インフルエンザ | LIFE生活網

article.articleHeadline: Ebola im Kongo: Angst, Verdrängung und Tradition erschweren Ebola-Bekämpfung - Wissenschaft - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Kongo: Fear, Denial, and Tradition Hamper Ebola Containment - Science - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 1,000 suspected cases, faces containment challenges from fear, denial, and traditional practices. Communities doubt Ebola’s existence or legitimacy, calling it a conspiracy or a money-making scheme; this skepticism hampers uptake of prevention measures. Door-to-door education by ActionAid, Red Cross, and volunteers explains transmission and protection, yet isolation of patients and safe-burial rules clash with cultural norms, fueling resistance and even attacks on treatment centers when bodies are withheld. Hospitals are avoided due to fear of quarantine, driving patients elsewhere. Analysts attribute conspiracist beliefs to cognitive biases and the region’s colonial history undermining trust in authorities. The outbreak’s social dynamics—myths, fear, and trauma—complicate public health responses in Ituri as of May 29, 2026.
