article.articleHeadline: India Tightens Ebola Screening At Airports For All International Travellers, Not Just Africa; Check Protocols
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening in India has been tightened at all international airports, with thermal screening and a self-declaration form mandatory for every arriving international passenger as of 29 May 2026. The Airport Health Organisation (APHO) now screens all passengers, regardless of origin, not only those from Africa or affected countries, in response to the growing global threat. Elevated temperature or reported symptoms trigger immediate isolation at the airport, with suspected cases routed to a dedicated isolation center at RML Hospital for detailed examination and laboratory testing to prevent domestic spread. A special evacuation route to the hospital is available for symptomatic travelers. The measures followed a high-level APHO meeting involving DIAL, CISF, the Bureau of Immigration, Customs, airlines, and ground handlers. Protocols include enhanced arrival-area arrangements and barriers to ensure screening is completed before exit.

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الصراع في شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية يعرقل احتواء إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The conflict in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo hampers Ebola containment - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the volatile security situation in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is the main barrier to containing the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. During a visit to Bunia, Ituri Province, he highlighted about 100,000 people displaced in the past month due to fighting, hindering containment. He urged a ceasefire and greater international funding to equip health workers and provide aid. WHO is working with partners to expedite clinical trials for Ebola therapies, though solutions may take months to become available. There is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain in the region; authorities must interrupt transmission by treating patients under strict safety protocols and isolating contacts for three weeks. Ongoing fighting and high population density in Ituri’s mining communities amplify transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：コンゴ民主共和国東部の紛争がエボラ収束を阻害している

article.articleHeadline: ВООЗ визначила три препарати для боротьби зі спалахом Еболи в Африці
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has identified three drugs to combat the Ebola outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: WHO has identified three experimental interventions against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola: MBP134, maftivimab, and remdesivir, for use in the Democratic Republic of Congo where the outbreak is ongoing and with cases reported in Uganda. The agency notes these medicines—and potential vaccines—must undergo clinical trials to assess their efficacy against Bundibugyo. Regeneron has stated that maftivimab has already been delivered to the DRC and can be used for treating patients and for future research. Separately, WHO highlighted the experimental antiviral obeldesivir by Gilead for prophylaxis among contacts of infected individuals, stressing that its effectiveness will depend on robust contact tracing. Currently, there are no approved vaccines or specialized treatments for this Ebola strain, underscoring the need for rigorous testing and containment measures.

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Says Ebola 'Can Be Stopped' As He Lands In Dr Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to oversee the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak declared May 15 has claimed over 200 lives. As of May 24, the WHO reported 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths amid more than 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases. The epicentre is in Ituri province, in the northeast, a volatile area affected by armed conflict including the Rwanda-backed M23 since 2021. Tedros urged warring parties to declare a ceasefire, warning that conflict and displacement hinder containment. He said travel bans are not supportive, promising WHO will do everything to help. No vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain; a vaccine is reportedly in development and could be ready by year-end by AU health officials. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC; ongoing global efforts aim to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国に到着、エボラは「阻止できる」と発言

triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク。確認症例10例、疑い症例223例、死亡200人以上（5月24日現在）。Ituri州が主要感染地で、武装勢力による紛争が対応を複雑化。Bundibugyo株で治療法がない。WHOが現地対応を強化中。Rwandaはサマリーで言及されているが、感染イベント発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ выступила против закрытия границ из-за вспышки Эболы в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO opposes border closures over Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO opposes border entry bans for travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an Ebola outbreak centered in DRC and affecting neighboring Uganda. Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said travel restrictions are not recommended and may only delay spread by a few days; emphasis should be on strengthening measures at the epicenter. He warned that border closures can mask the true scale of infections to avoid international isolation. The WHO had already designated the Congo–Uganda Ebola situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Current reporting indicates 221 deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo among suspected Ebola cases. The article does not detail laboratory confirmation, transmission sources, or clinical symptoms.

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ определила три препарата для борьбы со вспышкой Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Has Identified Three Drugs to Combat the Ebola Outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: WHO has identified three experimental therapeutics to combat the Ebola virus Bundibugyo strain, with the outbreak ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo and detected in Uganda. The agency prioritized MBP134, maftivimab, and the antiviral remdesivir for use under investigation, noting that these agents—and potential vaccines—must undergo clinical trials to assess their activity against Bundibugyo. Currently there are no licensed vaccines or approved treatments for this strain. Regeneron has stated that maftivimab has been delivered to the Democratic Republic of Congo and may be used for treatment or within future studies. Separately, the experimental antiviral obeldesivir from Gilead is planned for post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts of infected individuals, though its effectiveness will depend on robust contact tracing and surveillance. The outbreak’s trajectory remains a major public health concern for the region.

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief arrives in DRC promising Ebola outbreak 'can be stopped'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) centered in Ituri province in the northeast continues. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to assess response and planned travel to Ituri. Since declaration on 15 May, the WHO records 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths among more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases (data up to 24 May). No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo; WHO advisory groups urge clinical trials, and AU health agency says a vaccine could be ready by year-end. Conflict and displacement in this mineral-rich region hamper relief; calls for ceasefires. Uganda reports one death and six cases and has shut its border. The US will deny entry to infected individuals and is pursuing a treatment facility in Kenya. Aid: 4.6 tonnes at Bunia; UNICEF sending 100 tonnes to DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Le Kenya va ouvrir un centre de quarantaine pour les ressortissants américains exposés à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya to open a quarantine center for American citizens exposed to Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya agreed to host a quarantine facility for American citizens exposed to Ebola, with construction reportedly under way in Laikipia near a Kenyan Defence Forces base. The plan, confirmed May 28, 2026 to RFI by sources close to Kenyan health authorities, followed US assurances (Marco Rubio) that no Ebola case would enter the United States. Nairobi favored a center open to all nationalities, while the White House preferred restricting to Americans; no public confirmation exists yet, and authorities say discussions are ongoing. Kenyan scientists see potential to bolster outbreak response infrastructure; civil society groups fear potential introduction of Ebola into Kenya, which has not reported a case. The United States has announced an additional $80 million for Ebola response, adding to an initial $50 million already released. The context includes the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia cited as an epicenter in related coverage.

article.articleHeadline: WHO:n pääjohtaja Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa: ebolaepidemia voidaan pysäyttää
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO Director-General in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Ebola outbreak can be stopped.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the epidemic can be stopped and opposes travel bans. Since mid-May, more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and nearly 240 deaths have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the virus believed to be circulating more widely than detected. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, where authorities tightened border controls; only Ebola response teams, humanitarian operations, essential goods transport, and security personnel may cross. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for the circulating strain. Tedros will visit eastern DRC, the outbreak’s epicenter, as fighting continues between government forces and the M23 rebels; he called for a ceasefire to help control transmission. Over the past 50 years, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 in Africa; the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused about 3,500 cases and 2,300 deaths.

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में संघर्ष और असुरक्षा के बीच इबोला संक्रमण की रोकथाम मुश्‍क‍िल, डब्‍ल्‍यूएचओ चिंतित | Ituri: Ebola Outbreak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, amid conflict and insecurity, prevention of Ebola transmission is difficult, WHO concerned | Ituri: Ebola Outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains highly complex amid ongoing conflict and insecurity in the eastern provinces. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, arriving in Kinshasa, cautioned that violence, displacement, food shortages, and distrust hinder prevention efforts. UN agencies report teams already operating in Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, with Ghebreyesus planning to assess conditions there. The new outbreak has reportedly over 1,000 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths, marking the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. Laboratory tests identified the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant. On May 17, WHO declared an international Public Health Emergency of Concern, followed by Africa CDC declaring a continental public health emergency. Ghebreyesus urged against travel bans, advocating stronger at-source prevention and aid, including a renewed ceasefire to enable response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおける紛争と不安全性の中でのエボラ感染予防は困難、WHOが懸念 | イトゥリ州：コンゴのエボラ発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラウイルスは深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、1,000件以上の疑い例と238人の死亡が報告されており、国際的な公式宣言（WHO国際的懸念事項）がなされている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による第17次DRCアウトブレイク。WHO事務局長による現地視察、WHO国際的懸念事項の宣言、アフリカCDCによる大陸規模の公式宣言など、国際的な対応が既に開始されている。紛争・治安悪化による対応の複雑性が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ: Закрытие границ не остановит распространение Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: Border closures will not stop the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said at a Kinshasa press briefing that border closures will not stop the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Such measures may only slow transmission for a few days and do not resolve the problem. The WHO stressed that effective control relies on infection prevention and control, rapid medical response, and sustained on-the-ground support at the outbreak site. The remarks come as Uganda temporarily closed its border with the DRC over spillover risk, with Rwanda adopting similar steps and Zambia strengthening medical surveillance. The comments underscore that border actions are limited tools, while public health measures, laboratory confirmation, contact tracing, and patient care are central to containment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長: 国境閉鎖ではエボラの拡大は止まらないと警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行が複数国に及び、国境措置が検討されている状況。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（重篤度の高い病原体）、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施が該当。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ流行はDRC（キンシャサ）で確認・進行中であり、ウガンダ・ルワンダも国境閉鎖措置を講じている。ザンビアは医療監視を強化している。対象国の中でDRCとザンビアが明示的に該当。ウガンダはサマリー上で言及されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。WHO事務局長による公式声明であり、社会・政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rapport de Situation de la 17ème épidémie de la Maladie à Virus Ebola/RDC : SitRep MVE SitRep N°012/MVB_26/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Situation Report of the 17th Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the DRC: SitRep MVE SitRep No. 012/MVB_26/2026
article.articleSummary: Cumulative confirmed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo total 121 as of 26 May 2026: Ituri 110, Nord-Kivu 10, Sud-Kivu 1. Ituri remains the epicenter with 7 of 36 health zones affected (Aru, Bunia, Kilo, Rwampara, Mongbwalu, Nizi, Nyankunde). In Nord-Kivu, 5 of 35 health zones are affected (Goma, Butembo, Kalunguta, Katwa, Oicha). In Sud-Kivu, 1 of 34 health zones affected (Miti-Murhesa). There have been 17 confirmed deaths: 10 males (9 >15 years, 1 <15) and 7 females (5 >15, 2 <15). Six of the deaths are health workers. One EDS volunteer was stoned by the community in the Rwampara health zone. UHNAS provided availability to Points of Entry for deploying response materials and inputs across all response sites.

triage.headline_ja: DRC第17次エボラ出血熱流行の状況報告書：SitRep MVE SitRep No. 012/MVB_26/2026
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の継続的流行、複数州への拡大、死亡者および医療従事者感染が確認されている。国際的な懸念事項として、コミュニティ暴力の発生も報告されている。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行。2026年5月26日時点で確認症例121例（Ituri州110例、Nord-Kivu州10例、Sud-Kivu州1例）、死亡者17名（医療従事者6名含む）。複数州の複数保健地帯にわたる流行。コミュニティ暴力（Rwampara健康地帯でEDS志願者が石打ちされた）により対応阻害が生じている。Rwanda（49518）も発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでの流行のみが主題であり、Rwandaでの確認感染例は明記されていないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة والمكسيك وكندا تعلن عن إجراءات سفر موحدة لمواجهة خطر الإيبولا مع اقتراب كأس العالم لكرة القدم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States, Mexico, and Canada announce unified travel measures to confront the risk of Ebola as the FIFA World Cup approaches.
article.articleSummary: On May 28, 2026, the United States, Mexico, and Canada announced unified health-travel measures to counter Ebola risk for travelers from Ebola-prone African regions ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. A trilateral statement from Global Affairs Canada said the coordinated approach protects citizens, millions of visitors, fans, athletes, and tourists while preserving cross-border travel and trade. Canada imposed a 90-day entry ban on nationals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, effective immediately, with a 21-day quarantine requirement for arrivals from those countries. The measures accompany the World Cup hosting by the three nations, starting June 11, 2026. The plan emphasizes regional health security and isolation protocols to minimize potential Ebola-related risk during the international event.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、メキシコ、カナダが2026年FIFAワールドカップを控えエボラの危険に対抗するための統一された渡航措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度と国際的拡大リスクを有し、IHR基準において少なくとも3つ（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当する。国際的なスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）を背景とした対応であり、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラの実際の発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンなどのアフリカ地域であると明記されている。発生地域リストに含まれるメキシコ、カナダ、米国、スーダンについては、対象国リスト（CEPR監視対象）内に該当しないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれる。なお、本イベントは医学的には「流行中のエボラ発生への対応」を示すシグナルであり、IHR通知基準を満たすため PICKUP と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: 美國設肯亞伊波拉隔離中心　確診將送第3國治療
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US sets up Ebola isolation center in Kenya; confirmed cases will be sent to a third country for treatment.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the United States will establish an Ebola isolation facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, Kenya to quarantine exposed but asymptomatic Americans infected with Bundibugyo Ebola virus. If symptoms develop, affected individuals will be evacuated to a third country for treatment, not returned to the United States. The plan, backed by $13.5 million, marks a shift from prior outbreak practices of keeping cases abroad. The current Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has over 900 suspected cases and more than 200 suspected deaths, with no approved vaccine or therapy, and WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The CDC has imposed travel restrictions on people who have recently been in DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan, and U.S. airports conduct screening. Reports say confirmed cases could go to a European country; exact destination is not yet announced.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアにエボラ隔離センターを設置、確診者は第三国で治療
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPRO基準3つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）。WHO PHEICが既に宣言されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCでの現在の流行（900例以上の疑い例、200例以上の死亡）が主題となっており、ケニアはそれに対する米国の対応（隔離施設設置）の場所として言及されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ケニア、ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO PHEICが既に宣言済みであり、シグナルとしての優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya approves US Ebola quarantine request as WHO chief heads to Congo
article.articleSummary: Kenya approved a US plan to open a quarantine facility at an air force base in Laikipia to house Americans exposed to Ebola as the Democratic Republic of Congo battles the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment. Described as the third-largest outbreak on record, the Congo outbreak is outpacing the world’s response. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, traveling to Kinshasa and then Ituri province in the northeast where cases were first reported, has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The Kenyan facility would be staffed by the US Public Health Service, though Kenya had urged access for all nationalities. The United States has imposed strict travel measures, including banning green-card holders who have been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアが米国のエボラウイルス隔離要請を承認、WHO事務局長はコンゴへ向かう
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO事務局長が現地入りし、国際保健上の緊急事態が宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス流行。ケニア、米国、ウガンダ、スーダンは関連国として言及されているが、実際の発生地はコンゴのみ。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法なし、3番目に大きい流行と記述。WHO事務局長による宣言と国際的な対応が進行中。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 健康網》出國前建議打疫苗 醫分析流行性腦脊髓膜炎
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Network: Vaccination Recommended Before Traveling Abroad; Doctors Analyze Meningococcal Meningitis
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports eight confirmed meningococcal meningitis cases this year, with the first death—a woman in her 60s—already recorded. Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B is currently the most common pathogen. Internationally, outbreaks have occurred in the United Kingdom, Japan, Canada, and Vietnam, including two deaths among young adults in the UK. High-risk groups include infants under 1 year; adolescents and young adults in congregate settings (military camps, dormitories); the immunocompromised (cancer, splenectomy, immune disorders); travelers to outbreak areas; and smokers or those exposed to secondhand smoke. Given rising case numbers, vaccination before international travel is advised to reduce infection and severe disease, and maintaining personal hygiene in group living environments is important. For those planning travel, vaccination can boost immunity. The article notes TICRF website for vaccine-related information and Taiwan Health Network coverage.

triage.headline_ja: 健康ネットワーク：出国前のワクチン接種推奨 医師が流行性脳脊髄膜炎を分析
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目に該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での死亡例）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症性、長期曝露の可能性、流行しやすさ）。対象国内での複数事例と国際的な拡がりが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、台湾での8確定事例（死亡1名）、英国・日本・カナダ・ベトナムでのアウトブレイク報告が確認できる。対象国リストではベトナム（1562822）のみ該当。Neisseria meningitidis血清型Bが優位病原体。複数の高リスク群が特定されており、国際旅行に伴う感染リスク増加が懸念される。英国での若年成人の死亡例があり重症性が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Urzędnicy NIK pojechali do Ugandy mimo ostrzeżeń o Eboli. Bo przepadłyby bilety
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Officials from Poland's Supreme Audit Office went to Uganda despite warnings about Ebola, because the tickets would have been wasted.
article.articleSummary: Poland’s Supreme Audit Office (NIK) dispatched two expert missions to Uganda under a three-year EU-funded twinning project with Uganda’s Office of the Auditor General to strengthen institutional capacity. The activity proceeded despite Ebola warnings: Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), and South Sudan were under travel advisories, and the WHO had declared an Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak a potential international public health threat on May 16. The first mission (May 18–21) involved one NIK staffer; the second mission (May 25–June 5) involved two staffers. Uganda had reported two imported cases (citizens of DRC); DRC had about 900 cases and over 200 deaths. The United States imposed a 30-day entry ban for recent travelers from the region, and Poland’s MFA advised against travel. NIK stated staff were medically cleared and vaccinated; the Polish embassy in Nairobi monitors the situation, noting Uganda closed its border with Congo to contain the outbreak. Acknowledgments include cooperation with Ugandan authorities and participation by Estonia and Portugal experts.

triage.headline_ja: ポーランド最高監査院の職員がエボラに関する警告を無視してウガンダへ出張、チケット代を無駄にしたくなかったため
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、活動的なエボラ・ブンディブギョ感染症アウトブレイク（DRCで900例以上、200名超の死亡）が進行中であり、複数国への国際的拡大の危険性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス感染症の現在進行中のアウトブレイクを主題としており、DRC約900例、ウガンダ2例の輸入症例を報告。WHO は2026年5月16日に国際公衆衛生上の懸念事項と宣言。米国は該当地域からの最近の渡航者に対し30日間の入国禁止を実施。ポーランド外務省も渡航中止を勧告。複数国での国家レベルの関心と対応が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Waduh, Tuan Rumah Piala Dunia 2026 Perketat Aturan Perjalanan Terkait Ebola: Suporter Negara Mana Terdampak?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oh no, the 2026 World Cup host tightens travel rules related to Ebola: Which country's supporters are affected?
article.articleSummary: Three 2026 World Cup host nations—United States, Canada, and Mexico—united to tighten international travel rules amid Ebola concerns as the tournament in North America nears. The emergency policy suspends entry for 90 days from three African countries deemed high risk, effective from Wednesday, affecting travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. WHO had declared the Ebola situation in DRC a global health emergency on May 17, but also says border closures are not recommended; it favors screening rather than travel bans. Canada’s health minister Marjorie Michel defended the move as precautionary, while Africa CDC criticized the policy for punishing African countries with few or no cases. FIFA says it is coordinating with governments and WHO to keep the event safe and is considering refunds or ticket transfers for impacted fans. No case counts are cited.

triage.headline_ja: 2026ワールドカップ開催国がエボラ対策で渡航ルール厳格化：どの国のサポーターが影響を受けるか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHOが5月17日にDRCで国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。しかし本記事は政策対応（渡航制限）の報道であり、アクティブなアウトブレイク拡大の報告ではなく、具体的な患者数やDRC以外の対象国での確認症例の情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（WHOが5月17日に国際的緊急事態を宣言）に対応した北米3国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）の渡航制限政策である。記事内では、制限対象国としてDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが挙げられているが、記事サマリーは政策報道であり、ウガンダや南スーダンでの確認症例の明示がない。IHR基準では3項目が該当し、通常はPICKUPに該当するが、WPRO対象国のうち記事サマリーで実際にアウトブレイク発生が記載されているのはDRCのみである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。具体的な患者数、重症度、流行の動向に関する情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Humanitarian Coalition sounds the alarm as Ebola rapidly spreads in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak expanding rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with cross-border spread to Uganda. As of 2026-05-29, nearly 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and 220 suspected deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports seven confirmed cases and one death. The Humanitarian Coalition, including Oxfam-Québec and World Vision Canada, is scaling up response with clean water and sanitation, essential non-food items, and health services in the DRC through the Canadian Humanitarian Assistance Fund, a uniquely Canadian funding mechanism. The outbreak occurs amid a fragile humanitarian context, with about 15 million people in need of assistance in the DRC. The coalition calls for a coordinated global response to contain transmission, support affected families, and bolster infection prevention and control for frontline responders and health workers, highlighting cross-border risk and regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが急速に拡大する中、人道支援連合が警告を発令 — DRCとウガンダで拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の国際的拡大、複数国への越境拡大、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当（異常/予想外、高い重症度と死亡、継続的曝露、流行性あり、国際支援が明示的に必要）。エボラアウトブレイクは最高レベルのリスク要因。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高優先度の感染症。記事では約1,000件の疑い患者と220件の死亡報告、DRCおよびウガンダでの確認症例と越境拡大が記載されている。国際人道支援組織の関与と協調的な世界的対応の呼び出しは国際的関心と支援ニーズを強く示唆。Bundibugyo地域（ウガンダの地名）が記載されているが、発生の主体はDRCであり、ウガンダへの越境拡大と特定されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Escalating Ebola Crisis in DR Congo: WHO Raises Alarm as Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is confronting a severe 2026 Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with the first declaration May 15, 2026, marking the 17th outbreak in the DRC. By May 28, 2026, authorities had reported over 1,000 suspected or confirmed cases and at least 241 deaths. The virus has spread from Ituri Province to North Kivu and South Kivu, and has been detected in Kampala, Uganda, signaling cross-border transmission. The WHO classified the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The response is hampered by insecurity and armed conflict in eastern DRC, a lack of licensed vaccines or targeted therapies for Bundibugyo, and logistical barriers including food shortages, displacement, and community mistrust. Cross-border movement has aided regional spread. The WHO advises against general travel bans. Efforts focus on strengthened surveillance, clinical preparedness, community engagement, and evaluating candidate treatments or vaccines adaptable to Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: エスカレートするコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ危機：WHO が流行の拡大に警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO により PHEIC に指定された重大な多国籍エボラ流行。死亡数241名、疑似症例を含む1000名以上の患者、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダ確認）、国際的な懸念が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による DRC の第17番目のアウトブレイク。2026年5月15日に宣言、5月17日に WHO が PHEIC 指定。South Kivu Province から Uganda (Kampala) への国境越え伝播が確認されているが、Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州に拡大。武装紛争、ワクチン・治療薬不足、ロジスティック上の課題が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉疫情！美國借地隔離惹肯亞人不爽 自己人也懷疑成效
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contain the Ebola outbreak! The United States' quarantine on leased land angers Kenyans, and even Americans themselves doubt its effectiveness.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), concentrated in eastern DRC, has caused at least 238 deaths with over 1,000 suspected cases, driven by the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccine exists. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, while Kenya has not reported any cases. The United States is negotiating with Kenya to build quarantine facilities on leased land to isolate American citizens at risk, a plan that has sparked anger in Kenya and skepticism from US public-health experts about its effectiveness. Kenyan doctors and the Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Union (KMPDU) urge transparency and question why Kenya was chosen instead of funding local health care. CDC officials oppose sending Americans to Kenya for quarantine. USPHS officers have already departed for Kenya to care for Americans, with more training planned. Kenya’s Public Health Minister Mary Muriuki said discussions are ongoing to ensure safety.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の封じ込め！米国がケニアで借地隔離施設の建設を計画、ケニア国民の怒りを買い、米国の公衆衛生専門家からも効果に疑問の声
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確定症例と疑い症例が多数報告され、既にウガンダへの拡大を確認。国際的な隔離施設建設計画が関与し、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC でのエボラ出血熱流行が主題であり、238 人以上の死亡と 1000 人以上の疑い症例が報告されている。Uganda への拡大言及もあるが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。Kenya は患者報告なく、米国の隔離施設建設計画地であるため該当対象外。Bundibugyo 株による流行であり、ワクチン未承認との情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: EE.UU., México y Canadá coordinan medidas sanitarias por ébola rumbo al Mundial 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States, Mexico, and Canada coordinate health measures in response to Ebola ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: United States, Mexico, and Canada coordinated health measures in response to the Ebola outbreak ahead of the 2026 World Cup in North America, with emphasis on safeguarding public health while preserving travel and commerce. The U.S. State Department announced a joint package of border and travel measures for travelers from high-risk African Ebola zones. Canada began temporary border actions, including visa suspensions for residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Mexican authorities reinforced preventive Ebola controls, including airport health screening and special World Cup protocols, ahead of the tournament starting June 11 in Mexico, while stressing no cases detected and a very low risk for Mexico. International health authorities monitor the outbreak centered in East and Central Africa, notably Uganda, South Sudan, and the DRC. The African Union public health agency reported 246 suspected deaths; the WHO raised the outbreak risk from high to very high.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、メキシコ、カナダが2026ワールドカップに向けてエボラ対策を調整
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO「リスク非常に高い」、死亡例246件報告、複数国での協調対応が見られ、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事では東・中央アフリカのウガンダ・南スーダン・DRCで発生中と述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。スーダン（366755）はGeoNames IDでは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。USA・メキシコ・カナダは対応国であり発生国ではないため除外。WHOがリスクを『高い』から『非常に高い』に引き上げ、2026WC開催を控えた国際的関心が高まっている状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO:n pääjohtaja Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa: ebolaepidemia voidaan pysäyttää
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Ebola epidemic can be stopped.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) can be stopped. He arrived for a visit as the country reports over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and about 240 deaths since mid-May 2026. The virus has spread to neighboring Uganda, with additional infections identified there. WHO does not advocate travel bans to curb the outbreak, stating they offer little aid. The report notes ongoing transmission in the DRC and cross-border concerns, with international health authorities monitoring and coordinating containment measures. The article does not specify laboratory confirmation details or infection sources, but underscores the potential to halt transmission with sustained public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国で語る：エボラ流行は阻止できる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。1,000件以上の疑い患者と240人以上の死亡者を伴う活動的なエボラ流行であり、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ（Uganda）への越境感染が明記されているが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。WHO事務局長による現地訪問と「流行を阻止できる」という発言は国際的な関心と対応の高さを示唆している。疑い患者数1,000件以上、死亡240人以上は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola screening intensified at Vizag airport
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening is being intensified at Visakhapatnam International Airport, Visakhapatnam, India, following concerns about Ebola outbreaks in Africa and in line with the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare SOP. Precautionary measures were implemented for Scoot Flight TR784 from Singapore, arriving around 10:30 pm IST with 184 passengers. Health screening and surveillance were conducted in coordination with Airports Authority of India, Central Industrial Security Force, Airport Health Organisation, Immigration, Customs, airline representatives, and other departments to protect public health while maintaining airport operations. Visakhapatnam District Medical and Health Officer Dr. Jagadeeswara Rao noted arrangements with the AAI to screen passengers immediately after disembarkation from international flights.

triage.headline_ja: ビザック空港でエボラ出血熱スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラ出血熱スクリーニング強化は予防的措置であり、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。アフリカでのアウトブレイク懸念に対応した監視活動が主体であり、現段階ではシグナルとしてのPickupは不適切だが、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおけるエボラ出血熱の予防的スクリーニング強化について述べており、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。Bluedot APIが'Africa'と'Singapore'を発生地域として抽出しているが、記事サマリー上ではインドの空港における監視活動が主体である。アフリカでのアウトブレイク懸念が背景にあるが、インドでのシグナルとしては未確認段階。

article.articleHeadline: AS, Meksiko, Kanada perketat aturan terkait Ebola Jelang Piala Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S., Mexico, Canada tighten rules related to Ebola ahead of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: United States, Canada, and Mexico coordinate cross-border public health measures targeting travelers arriving from Ebola-risk areas in Africa ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026. A trilateral statement from Global Affairs Canada says the coordinated approach aims to protect fans, athletes, and visitors while safeguarding cross-border travel and trade. Canada implements a 90-day entry ban on nationals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, effective May 27, and requires a 21-day quarantine for entrants from those countries. The World Cup, hosted jointly by the U.S., Mexico, and Canada, begins June 11, 2026. The measures reflect precautionary Ebola containment strategies as countries prepare to welcome millions of visitors for the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、メキシコ、カナダがワールドカップを前にエボラ関連の規則を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスという高い公衆衛生上の影響を持つ病原体に関するイベント。国際的な渡航制限措置の実施と複数国間の調整が行われており、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限の基準に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際のエボラ流行地域はコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンと述べられている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。USA、メキシコ、カナダは対象国に含まれないため、verified_locationsには含めない。記事はアフリカでのエボラリスクに対応した予防的措置であり、現在の確定的なアウトブレイク規模は記事では明記されていない（severity評価は不明）。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: WHO đề xuất thử nghiệm vaccine và thuốc điều trị mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: WHO proposes trials of a new vaccine and treatments
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, WHO reports expert groups have proposed clinical trials of several vaccines and treatments for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which no vaccine or specific therapy exists yet in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Evaluated interventions include two monoclonal antibodies, an antiviral drug, an oral post-exposure prophylaxis, and two vaccine candidates not yet ready for trials. WHO will coordinate with the DRC and Uganda to assess these products. In the meantime, priority remains halting transmission through traditional public health measures: surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection control, and safe burials. Bundibugyo has caused two past outbreaks in the Congo River basin. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, placing healthcare workers at high risk. Treatment is supportive care. On May 28, 2026, Tedros traveled to the DRC to show support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：WHOが新しいワクチンと治療法の試験を提案
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるDRC東部の流行は医学的に新規で、複数国への拡大懸念があり、WHOが臨床試験調整を提案する重要度の高いイベント。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行は過去に治療法やワクチンが存在しないため、新規療法の緊急臨床試験提案は極めて重要。DRCが対象国のため verified_locations に含める。Ugandaは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは『DRCとウガンダとの調整』と言及される程度で、ウガンダでの具体的なケースや流行は記載されていないため、CEPR対象外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF anuncia la llegada de más de 100 toneladas de ayuda a RDC con apoyo de la UE para hacer frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF announces the arrival of more than 100 tonnes of aid to the DRC with EU support to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF announced arrival of more than 100 tonnes of humanitarian supplies to the Democratic Republic of Congo, supported by the European Union, for the Ebola outbreak in the northeast. The cargo includes personal protective equipment for frontline health workers, medicines, hygiene materials, and medical supplies to protect staff and support affected communities, including children. John Agbor, UNICEF representative in Bunia—the capital of Ituri province, the hardest-hit area—stressed the situation remains highly concerning and rapidly evolving. UNICEF regional director Gilles Fagninou highlighted risk communication and community engagement as key pillars, working with local communities, leaders, religious groups, women's groups, youth, and frontline staff. Government figures through May 26 report 121 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths, plus 1,077 suspected cases and 238 deaths, reflecting an ongoing and expanding outbreak in the northeast DRC.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEFがEU支援下でコンゴ民主共和国に100トン以上の支援物資到着を発表、エボラ対策
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定患者121名、死亡17名を含む進行中の流行であり、国際的支援（EU+UNICEF）が発動している。IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性を満たし、スクリーニング基準では重症度・流行リスク・管理可能性で複数該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国の北東部（イトゥリ州）で確認されており、確定患者数および疑い患者数が増加中。EU支援の動員、UNICEF代表による懸念表明、地域指導者との連携強化が記述されており、多くのスクリーニング基準を満たす。フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: A l'épicentre de l'épidémie en RDC, la peur d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At the epicenter of the outbreak in the DRC, the fear of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus. No treatment or vaccine exists for Bundibugyo as cited by authorities. By May 24, 2026, the health ministry reported 322 suspected infections and 88 deaths likely linked to the virus in Mongbwalu; WHO data cited 10 confirmed deaths and over 900 suspected cases with 220 suspected deaths nationwide. The epidemic has spread within weeks to two neighboring provinces and across the border into Uganda, located about 100 km from Mongbwalu, with Sudan and South Sudan within roughly 200 km. The response includes chlorine disinfection, PPE use, and handwashing stations; MSF has provided isolation tents, though testing capacity is limited and confirmation required samples to reach Kinshasa’s biomedical lab. The first suspected case died in Bunia; community fears and folk beliefs have complicated control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の流行中心地で感じるエボラ熱への恐怖
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の急速な流行拡大（322疑定患者、88死亡）、複数国への越境拡大（ウガンダ確認、スーダン・南スーダンへのリスク）、確認治療法・ワクチン欠落により、IHR基準4つすべて該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による流行。イツリ州モングワル中心に発生し、キンシャサに拡大、ウガンダへ越境。検査能力限定的（キンシャサのバイオメディカルラボへサンプル搬送必須）、治療法・ワクチン欠落が深刻。コミュニティの不信感が制御努力を複雑化させている。ウガンダ、スーダン、南スーダンの隣接国リスクは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF anuncia la llegada de más de 100 toneladas de ayuda a la República Democrática del Congo con respaldo de la Unión Europea para combatir el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF announces the arrival of more than 100 metric tons of aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo with backing from the European Union to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts a major aid response as UNICEF, backed by the European Union, reports the arrival of more than 100 metric tons of humanitarian supplies to DRC. The cargo includes personal protective equipment for frontline health workers, medicines, hygiene materials, and other medical supplies to support communities and children affected. The Ituri province's capital Bunia is central to the response. UNICEF officials underscore risk communication and community engagement as critical pillars, citing lessons from previous outbreaks and stressing collaboration with local leaders, religious groups, women’s groups, youth groups, and frontline staff to improve awareness, early detection, and safe practices. The latest government balance (through May 26) shows 121 confirmed Ebola cases with 17 deaths, and 1,077 suspected cases with 238 associated deaths. The outbreak remains dynamic.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEFはエボラに対抗するため、欧州連合の支援を受けて100トン以上の援助物資のコンゴ民主共和国への到着を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の事象、国際的拡大のリスク）。エボラは高致死性で国際的懸念疾患であり、確認例121件・死亡17件の進行中アウトブレイク。EU含む国際的支援体制の構築はシグナル識別の根拠。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイクは極めて高リスク疾患。記事サマリーは2026年5月時点での進行中アウトブレイクを示す（確認例121件、死亡17件、疑い例1077件）。UNICEF・EU主導の大規模国際支援体制の構築が報道されており、世界的関心・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 美跟肯亞借地隔離潛在伊波拉患者 專家噴爆
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US and Kenya borrow land to quarantine potential Ebola patients; experts slam.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused at least 238 deaths and over 1,000 suspected cases, driven by the Bundibugyo strain; the epidemic has crossed into Uganda, while Kenya has not reported cases. The US government is negotiating with Kenya to build facilities on Kenyan soil to quarantine Americans at risk of infection, a plan drawing opposition from Kenyan doctors, lawyers, and the Kenyan Medical Practitioners and Dentists Union, who warn it could risk introducing Ebola to Kenya and highlight long-standing funding gaps in Kenya’s healthcare system. Kenya’s Public Health Minister Mary Muthoni Muriuki says conversations with partners are underway to ensure safety. CDC sources reportedly oppose sending US citizens to Kenya for isolation, citing capacity concerns. USPHS officers have traveled to Kenya to care for Americans, with more officers to be trained.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とケニアが潜在的なエボラ患者の隔離施設をケニア領土に建設交渉；専門家は反発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクで3基準該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生脅威であり、既に複数国に拡大（DRC・ウガンダ）、国際的な対応と政治的議論を招いている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで列挙されている国のうち、記事サマリーで実際のエボラ発生地として言及されているのはDRC（震源地）とウガンダ（越境確認）のみ。ケニア・米国は発生地ではなく、隔離施設建設の政治的交渉地点。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 淡水鳖、龟血簇虫病防治-实用技术-农博数据中心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevention and Control of Freshwater Soft-Shelled Turtle Blood Fluke Disease - Practical Techniques - Nongbo Data Center
article.articleSummary: Freshwater soft-shelled turtle blood fluke disease (血簇虫病) in China, caused by a blood fluke parasite infecting turtle blood and liver cells. Chinese soft-shelled turtles (Pelodiscus sinensis) are the intermediate host; final hosts are turtle leeches (龟穆蛭). The parasite’s life cycle includes maturation in liver cells, intraerythrocytic schizonts (X- and Y-type), peripheral blood stages with merozoites, and spore formation after fertilization in leeches. A survey of 248 Chinese soft-shelled turtles, plus other species (40 turtles, 25 yellow-margined closed-shell turtles, 2 flat-bodied turtles) found an 83.9% infection rate in Chinese soft-shelled turtles and an infection intensity of 19.7 per 1,000 erythrocytes, with peaks from May–September. Symptoms are often absent; microscopy shows infected erythrocytes enlarged and deformed with numerous parasites, and leukocytes with pseudopodial projections. Diagnosis via Giemsa or hematoxylin-eosin–stained blood smears. Prevention: reduce pond mud and disinfect; remove leeches; treatment has not been studied.

triage.headline_ja: 淡水鳖、龟血簇虫病防治-实用技术-农博数据中心
triage.triage_reason: 動物寄生虫病（ウズラの血簇虫病）に関する技術情報記事であり、ヒト感染症ではない。公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は淡水産の爬虫類（ウズラ・カメ）に寄生する血簇虫病に関する農業技術情報であり、ヒト感染症イベントではない。記事サマリーに『Unknown Illness』とラベリングされているが、実質は動物寄生虫病の防治技術解説である。感染症危機管理の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: US says its Ebola quarantine center opens Friday in Kenya
article.articleSummary: US opens Ebola quarantine center for the Bundibugyo variant at Kenya's Laikipia Air Base to isolate American citizens exposed to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The facility starts with 50 isolation beds, with planned expansion to three isolation units (12 beds total) and two bio-containment units (4 beds). Patients who develop symptoms or test positive would be treated there and then transported to Europe for continued care. The arrangement aims to shorten travel time rather than evacuate to the United States. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced a $13.5 million US aid package to bolster Kenya's Ebola preparedness. Kenyan rights groups filed a court petition against the center, citing unilateral secrecy. The WHO reports 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC since the mid-May outbreak, among more than 1,000 confirmed/suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ケニアにエボラ隔離センターを金曜日にオープン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例および多数の疑い例があり、複数国にまたがる公式な国際対応が展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアのLaikipia Air Baseでの米国隔離センター設置を主題としているが、実際のエボラ発生地は「DRC and Uganda」と明記されている。対象国リストに基づき、DRCのみがverified_locationsに該当する。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。本イベントはIHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で複数項目該当し、国際的な健康危機対応が既に進行中であるため、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : le chef de l'OMS juge la flambée<i>
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the WHO chief deems the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists, centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, marking the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Lab tests identified the Bundibugyo strain. More than 1,000 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths have been reported as the eastern provinces continue to be affected. The World Health Organization declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, with Africa CDC later announcing a continental public health emergency. A first patient has recovered and been discharged from a health facility, signaling progress. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, speaking in Kinshasa, said teams are on the ground in Bunia and he will visit to assess the situation. He cited conflict and security challenges as major obstacles, urged a ceasefire, and noted that travel bans are not recommended; emphasis should be on measures at the source and enhanced support. Ongoing outbreak as of May 29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：WHO事務局長がエボラ流行を複雑と判断
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言し、1,000件以上の疑い事例と238件の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株が同定された。WHOはPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、Africa CDCは大陸規模の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。紛争・治安が主要な障害として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en el Congo: síntomas, cómo se transmite y su riesgo en Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo: symptoms, how it is transmitted, and its risk in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been declared a public health emergency of international concern by the World Health Organization, as cases rise and the virus spreads. As of now, there are 238 suspected deaths and more than 1,000 cases under investigation. The circulating variant is a less-known Ebola strain with mortality up to about 50%. The virus is not airborne; transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or infected cadavers. Early symptoms resemble influenza—fever, muscle pains, fatigue, and headache—followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and possible hemorrhage. The risk to Europe remains very low. In Spain, authorities say exposure and infection risk for travelers or residents in affected African areas is very low, and secondary transmission if imported would also be very low. Background notes that Ebola was first identified in 1976 in DRC and Sudan, with the largest 2013–2016 outbreak in West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行：症状、感染経路、ヨーロッパへのリスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO公式にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言された確認されたエボラ流行。高い死亡率（約50%）、多数の確認・疑い患者、国際的拡大リスク、国際的な関心の対象となっている。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの重大事象。記事サマリーはDRCでの確認流行に焦点。スペインはAPI検出地域に含まれるが、サマリー上はヨーロッパへのリスク評価であり流行実発生地ではないため除外。アンゴラ、スーダンも検出地域に含まれているが、サマリー上で明記されていないため検証不可。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当し記事主題と合致するため検証地域として列挙。

article.articleHeadline: 世界盃臨近 美加墨聯合推出埃博拉旅行措施 | 美加墨世界盃 | 美國 | 加拿大 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the World Cup approaches, the U.S., Canada, and Mexico jointly roll out Ebola travel measures | U.S.-Canada-Mexico World Cup | United States | Canada | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda has over 300 suspected cases and at least 88 deaths; WHO declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, with no approved vaccine (per CDC). In advance of the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America, the United States, Canada, and Mexico on May 29 announced a coordinated public-health travel framework for travelers from high-risk Ebola regions, with full details to follow. The United States tightens entry: non-U.S. citizens/residents who have visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan in the past 21 days are barred; three airports (Atlanta, Dulles, Houston) will screen arrivals. Canada suspends entry for residents from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan for 90 days and requires 21-day isolation for those recently in affected areas. Mexico strengthens Ebola screening and requires 21-day isolation; advised to avoid Congo. Congolese national team reportedly must isolate 21 days in Belgium to attend matches in Houston and Atlanta (June 11–July 19, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: 世界盃臨近 美加墨聯合推出埃博拉旅行措置（ワールドカップ開催を控え、米加墨がエボラ旅行対策を共同発表）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（300疑い例、88死亡）、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への国際的拡大、および渡航制限措置の実施により、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Defends Ebola Response as WHO Warns Contact Tracing Is Failing Amid Insecurity | Today News
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) is centered in Ituri with spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu; 13 health zones are affected, with Mongbwalu identified as the outbreak's origin. Revised surveillance shows 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, down from over 1,000 after removing non-cases and laboratory-confirmed infections. Officials project about six months to containment. WHO warns insecurity and mass displacement impede contact tracing, with just over a third of more than 2,500 identified contacts traced. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, with at least seven infections. Early Bundibugyo symptoms resemble malaria or typhoid, complicating detection; 21 confirmed cases have been identified outside Ituri. A confirmed patient fled care at a facility in Ituri. The US expanded airport screening to JFK; Congo plans about 130 isolation beds and is pursuing monoclonal antibody options and remdesivir donations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ対応を擁護、WHOは不安全情勢の中で接触者追跡が失敗していると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な多国間感染、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限措置）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は最優先病原体であり、既に隣国ウガンダへの越境感染を確認。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（Uganda）も記載されているが、記事サマリーでは「outbreak has crossed into Uganda, with at least seven infections」と述べており、越境感染として言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRC（GeoNames ID 203312）は対象国リストに含まれており、これが主発生地である。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の発症確認数223、疑いケース906、医療従事者へのアクセス困難と不安全な環境がリスクを高める。

article.articleHeadline: Miedo y negación en la República Democrática del Congo, el corazón del brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear and Denial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Heart of the Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Fear and denial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, center Mongbwalu, Ituri, where the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola has already claimed lives. Laureine Sakiya acknowledges the virus exists amid community suspicion that it is a mystical ailment. No vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugy o yet, though Africa CDC says a vaccine will be ready by the end of the year. WHO estimates about 220 suspected Ebola deaths (10 confirmed) and more than 900 cases, with the outbreak described as extremely grave given the rapid spread of a strain lacking targeted therapies. The epicenter has expanded across provinces and into Uganda, prompting European health protocols and an international emergency declaration by WHO. Longstanding neglect and conflict in Ituri fuel distrust toward the state, while miners and mobile vendors drive cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で、エボラ流行の中心地で恐怖と否定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の流行で220人の死亡が疑われ、900例以上の症例報告があり、WHOが国際緊急事態を宣言している。IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべても該当する極めて重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染の報告があるが、サマリー上の主題はDRCの流行である。Bundibugyo株エボラの治療法がまだ存在せず、ワクチンは年末までに準備予定。地域の不信感と紛争が対応を困難にしている。WHOが既に国際緊急事態を宣言しており、フルRRAへの進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 'Why Are We Allowing People From Ebola Outbreak Areas?': Health Experts Worried As Travellers From Affected Countries Enter India
article.articleSummary: Ebola, with a newly identified strain, triggers global vigilance as health experts in India question continued entry of travellers from Ebola-affected countries despite heightened surveillance. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) amid concerns about the speed of spread and containment challenges. In response, India has stepped up monitoring, with the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) and the Ministry of Civil Aviation issuing strict surveillance guidelines for airlines and airports. The piece underscores tensions between travel controls and public health safeguards during ongoing international risk. It notes India's steps to tighten surveillance at airports and with airlines as of 2026-05-29.

triage.headline_ja: 「なぜエボラ流行地域からの人々の入国を許可しているのか？」：インド入国を続ける渡航者に関して健康専門家が懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言、新規エボラ株出現、インドで多国間監視体制構築。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ新株の世界的警戒、WHO PHEIC宣言、インドの空港・航空会社監視強化を指摘。流行国からのインド入国に対する健康専門家の懸念が主題。インドが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に India のみを記載。フルリスク評価で流行地域、国際的スプレッド、インドの対応能力などについて詳細分析が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Restringen acceso a México a visitantes que vengan de países con ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Access to Mexico is restricted for visitors coming from countries with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Temporary entry restrictions for international travelers entering Mexico due to the Ebola outbreak in the equatorial region of Africa. Effective 00:00 on May 28, 2026, the policy lasts 60 days and targets passengers who have traveled in the previous 21 days to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, unless they hold a Mexican passport or valid Mexican residency. Airlines, including Viva, issued notices reflecting the measure. The move aims to reduce importation risk as the FIFA World Cup approaches, with African fans expected to travel to the United States and Mexico. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the outbreak epicenter and will host three World Cup matches: June 17 vs Portugal in Houston; June 23 vs Colombia in Guadalajara; and June 27 vs Uzbekistan in Atlanta. Players reside in Europe, with pre-tournament camps in Belgium. The World Cup runs June 11–July 19.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがエボラ流行国からの入国者の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施、国際スポーツイベント（FIFAワールドカップ）に関連した多国間の感染症対応が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアフリカのエボラ流行（赤道地域、DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）を主題としているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため、入国制限の実施国であってもverified_locationsに含めない。スーダン（366755）、ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事の発行日時が2026年5月29日で未来日付であり、シミュレーション記事の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Дюжаррик: ВОЗ оценивает вспышку Эболы как третью по величине в истории

The outbreak has spread to 13 health zones, with more than 1,000 suspected cases, including 121 laboratory-confirmed infections and 17 deaths, six of whom were healthcare workers. WHO declared the Congo and neighboring Uganda outbreaks as a public health emergency of international concern due to cross-border risk. Reuters notes at least 25 patients escaped from medical facilities during quarantine measures in Congo. As of May 29, 2026, the situation remains a major ongoing Ebola outbreak with international implications for public health.

triage.headline_ja: デュジャリック：WHOはエボラ出血熱の流行を歴史上3番目の規模と評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は歴史上3番目の規模、国際的懸念公衆衛生事象（PHEIC）宣言、国際的拡大リスク（国境越え、ウガンダへの拡大）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク全て存在。フルRRA進行必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mỹ, Mexico và Canada siết chặt kiểm soát y tế vì Ebola trước thềm World Cup 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United States, Mexico and Canada tighten health controls due to Ebola ahead of the 2026 World Cup
article.articleSummary: Ebola controls tighten across the United States, Canada, and Mexico ahead of World Cup 2026 as WHO declares the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 29, 2026, the three-nation declaration imposes health measures for entrants from high-risk African regions (DR Congo, Uganda, South Sudan) to safeguard travelers for the June 11–July 19 World Cup. The United States previously barred entry for non-citizens who have recently been in DR Congo, Uganda or South Sudan, with the CDC extending the rule to green-card holders who visited within 21 days prior to travel. Canada imposes a 90-day entry ban for travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan starting May 28, with asymptomatic residents and entrants required to quarantine 21 days from May 30. Mexico increases Ebola screening at airports and urges citizens to avoid Congo; arrivals from Congo must self-isolate 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、メキシコ、カナダが2026年ワールドカップ前にエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国での対策実施が確認され、IHR基準3項目以上該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念事象。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात: गिर में बेबेसिया संक्रमण से कई शेरों की मौत की आशंका, 17 वयस्क शेर आइसोलेट किए गए - Punjab Kesari
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gujarat: Suspected deaths of several lions due to Babesia infection in Gir, 17 adult lions isolated - Punjab Kesari.
article.articleSummary: Gujarat's Gir forest region reports suspected lion deaths linked to Babesia infection, a tick-borne protozoan that destroys red blood cells. Officials say the fatalities are localized, not a large outbreak. Seventeen adult lions have been isolated for intensive medical care and monitoring, while some other deaths are attributed to natural causes or intra-lion conflict. Junagadh Veterinary College and Forest Department teams are patrolling affected areas; over 350 lions are being health-checked to prevent transmission and eradicate ticks. A 10-kilometer zone around the affected area has been isolated to containing spread. Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel chaired a high-level review; Forest Minister Arjun Modhwadia emphasized containment measures. Babesia transmission occurs primarily via tick bites; the report does not detail laboratory confirmation. Date: 29 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：ギール森林地域でバベシア感染による複数のライオンの死亡が懸念され、17頭の成獣ライオンが隔離される

triage.notes: 本イベントは野生動物（ライオン）におけるバベシア症の集団発生であり、人間への直接的な公衆衛生上の脅威は記事では言及されていない。ただし、ダニ媒介感染症であることから、人獣共通感染症の可能性が存在する。サマリーでは診断の確認不足（laboratory confirmation の詳細な記載がない）が指摘されており、追加情報が必要。動物衛生当局による対応が進行中である点から、WATCHレベルの継続監視が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Şeful OMS ajunge în Republica Democratică Congo şi promite că focarul de Ebola "poate fi oprit".
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief arrives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and promises that the Ebola outbreak can be stopped.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, northeast) is being addressed as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives in Kinshasa. The outbreak—DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak—has more than 1,000 laboratory-confirmed or suspected cases, with 10 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths as of May 24. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain; WHO advisory groups urged clinical trials for vaccines and therapeutics, with an AU official saying a vaccine could be available by year-end. The response is hampered by ongoing conflict and displacement in a resource-rich region. Uganda reports one Ebola death and six cases and has closed its border with DRC. The United States will deny entry to infected individuals and is planning a treatment facility in Kenya for US citizens; Kenyan authorities warn of system strain amid litigation. Aid: WHO received 4.6 tonnes at Bunia; UNICEF to ship 100 tonnes.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国に到着し、エボラ出血熱の流行は「阻止できる」と約束

triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはウガンダ、ケニア、米国も含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは対応国・支援国として言及されており、エボラ流行の主要発生地はDRC（Ituri州・Kinshasa）である。DRC対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations はDRCのみ。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、ワクチン開発の急速化、国際的な支援・制限措置など、重大な国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: What to know about the Bundibugyo virus, a species of Ebola causing an outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola species, drives an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Congo River basin, with suspected deaths exceeding 130. Unlike more familiar Ebola types, Bundibugyo has caused only a few outbreaks, including two prior in the same region. Transmission occurs via close contact with the bodily fluids of the sick or deceased; healthcare workers and family caregivers face the highest risk. Mortality is around 30% or higher, though precise figures are uncertain due to limited experience. No specific treatments or vaccines exist; care hinges on early case identification, isolation, and supportive therapy (IV or oral fluids). Public health actions emphasize PPE for health workers, rigorous contact tracing, and safe burial practices. A leading vaccine candidate would be unavailable for six to nine months, underscoring reliance on non-pharmacologic containment and public education to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで発生しているエボラウイルスの一種であるブンディブギョウイルスについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は最も重篤な感染症の一つであり、死亡例130名超、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明白。フルRRAへ進むべき優先度の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョウイルスは稀なエボラウイルス種。疑い死亡者130名超、致命率30%以上。ワクチン候補は6～9ヶ月利用不可。医療従事者および家族介護者が高リスク。コンゴ川盆地での発生であり、地理的に複雑な地域での制御が課題。

article.articleHeadline: A l'épicentre de l'épidémie en RDC, la peur d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At the epicenter of the outbreak in the DRC, the fear of Ebola
article.articleSummary: At the epicenter of the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), fear dominates as the situation unfolds and denial lingers among communities. The article portrays a climate oscillating between caution and disbelief, with residents describing anxiety, rumors, and a sense of existential risk. It quotes a responder: 'If it's true, may God protect us,' illustrating how people cope as health authorities intensify surveillance and risk communication. The report emphasizes the ongoing outbreak's social toll—not only the transmission dynamics but also fear-driven behavior, stigma, and urgent calls for accurate information. The piece focuses on the human dimension at the outbreak's heart in the DRC, dated May 29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の流行震央での恐怖 - エボラウイルス病
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の継続的な流行であり、死亡リスク・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが存在する感染症イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Гендиректор ВОЗ заявил, что вспышку Эболы в Конго можно остановить
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General stated that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo can be stopped.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains controllable and stoppable, says WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus during a visit. In Congo, authorities report over 900 suspected Ebola cases and about 240 deaths through mid-May, with transmission having crossed the border to Uganda, where additional cases have been identified. Congo has requested experimental Ebola treatments after infections surpassed 1,000. Tedros urged the international community to intensify response measures to prevent further spread and emphasized that travel restrictions are not an effective or central tool for containment. The WHO highlights ongoing needs in surveillance, patient management, and access to experimental therapies to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴの エボラ感染症の流行は阻止可能と述べた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。エボラウイルスによる国際的な多国間での流行であり、死亡例を含む重症事例が発生。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief arrives in DRC promising Ebola outbreak 'can be stopped' - AOL
article.articleSummary: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) in Kinshasa, pledging that the Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province can be stopped and urging a ceasefire in conflict areas. As of 24 May, the WHO reported 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC, among more than 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases since the outbreak was declared on 15 May. No vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain causing this outbreak; advisory groups recommended clinical trials. Uganda reported one death and six additional cases and closed its border with the DRC. The US denies entry to anyone infected and seeks to establish a treatment facility in Kenya for affected Americans. Aid: 4.6 tonnes at Bunia; UNICEF to deliver 100 tonnes. The region is conflict-impacted and hard to reach.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国に到着、エボラ感染症アウトブレイク『は阻止できる』と約束
