article.articleHeadline: UNFPA Flash Update - Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease (BVD) Outbreak (20 - 26 May 2026)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): As of 26 May 2026, DRC reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 238 deaths, with transmission concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Uganda reports five cases, including one death, all linked to imported cases from the DRC. The outbreak is impeded by acute insecurity, armed conflict, and massive internal displacement, limiting response. There are no widely licensed vaccines or specific therapeutics for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Cross-border transmission risk is high, with 10 other African countries at elevated risk. UNFPA participates in UN Country Team preparedness across 10 high-risk African countries to maintain essential sexual and reproductive health (SRH) services amid supply-chain challenges, including PPE for delivery; GBV care pathways for rape survivors, stigma-free counselling, contraception, and condom distribution. Donors pledged 70% of a US$340 million Regional Response Plan, but immediate operational funding gaps persist.

triage.headline_ja: UNFPA速報 - ブンディブギョエボラウイルス病（BVD）アウトブレイク（2026年5月20～26日）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する深刻なエボラアウトブレイク。DRCで1,077例の疑い患者・238死亡、ウガンダへの国際的波及、複数国での二次感染リスク、地域的な対応能力不足が確認される。
triage.notes: Uga国での確認ケースは言及されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生地域であり、複数地域への波及と深刻な死亡率、国際的対応不足が顕著。武装紛争による対応阻害と10カ国での二次感染リスクは極めて懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) with rising cases and cross-border vigilance toward Uganda. The DRC reports 121 confirmed cases and 17 confirmed deaths, plus 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths, across three provinces, led by Ituri. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is in the country to coordinate response. In Bunia, 4.6 tons of medical supplies and over 2,000 RadiOne tests have arrived, and the treatment center expanded; efforts focus on surveillance, labs, patient care, IPC, and community engagement. Uganda closed its border with the DRC and imposes a 21-day arrival quarantine; as of May 25, 2026 no new Uganda cases, with over 300 contacts under follow-up. A UN emergency appeal for Uganda seeks $15.8 million, with $3.1 million mobilized and $12.7 million unfunded.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（121確定症例、17死亡）、異常な事象、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）、渡航・貿易制限（ウガンダによる国境閉鎖・検疫）を示している。
triage.notes: ウガンダも地理的に記事に出現するが、サマリーの主題は「DRCでの流行」であり、ウガンダでの確定症例報告はなく、国境警戒段階。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO事務局長が現地対応調整中、UN緊急アピール発出、ワクチンなし治療法なしという重大な状況。

article.articleHeadline: خطرٌ صحّي يُقلق العالم... فماذا عن لبنان؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A health risk that alarms the world... What about Lebanon?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus remains geographically confined to the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with confirmed cases but no widespread outbreak as of 29 May 2026. In Lebanon, experts say the immediate risk is low, though travel by expatriates from Africa during summer warrants vigilance. Dr. Abdul Rahman Al-Bazri, an infectious diseases specialist and Health Committee member, notes Lebanon’s risk of transmission is low and advises monitoring developments and tracing anyone from affected areas, while avoiding panic or extraordinary measures. Preparedness is prudent: train medical staff and ensure readiness to manage suspected cases. Dr. Nada Shams al-Din emphasizes that cases are geographically limited and that the World Health Organization has not declared an outbreak, only an alert. Lebanon’s Ministry of Health coordinates with WHO and conducts daily monitoring, ready to act if the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: 世界を不安にする保健上のリスク...レバノンはどうか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスはDRCとウガンダに地理的に限定されており、広範な流行は発生していない。レバノンでの即時リスクは低いとされている。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラはDRCとウガンダに限定されており、大規模流行ではなく、レバノンでのリスクは低いと評価されている。WHOは流行宣言ではなくアラート段階とのこと。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。レバノンも対象国でないため含めない。社会的関心は存在するが、IHR基準やWPRO基準を満たさないため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: El precio del cerdo continúa por debajo de coste seis meses después del brote de peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The price of pork remains below cost six months after the swine fever outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Six months after African Swine Fever (ASF) emerged in Catalonia, ASF persists in wild boar populations across 19 municipalities including Barcelona, with the Collserola massif at the epicenter. No domestic pig infections yet; 400–500 wild boars culled weekly, totaling 5,727 in the epicenter, while outside risk areas 26,587 have been captured since January. This week three more positives detected; 5,983 tested since the first positive, 325 infected. Rural access is prohibited in affected municipalities. Market impact: pork price on Mercolleida fell from 1.30 €/kg before first detection to 1.275 €/kg now, with breakeven at 1.37 €/kg. Spain, a major exporter, has faced bans from non-EU partners; China accepts regionalized trade. Unió de Pagesos estimates 913 million euros in losses for the sector this year. End of outbreak can only be declared 12 months after last detection; 80 million euros allocated to ASF, avian influenza, and nodular dermatitis.

triage.headline_ja: 豚コレラアウトブレイク後6ヶ月、豚肉価格は依然として原価を下回る
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）がカタルーニャで6ヶ月間にわたり野生イノシシ個体群に定着し、19市町村に拡大。国際的な貿易規制が発生し、国家的な経済的影響（9億1300万ユーロの損失推定）が発生している。スクリーニング基準複数該当かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはスペイン（対象国外）も含まれるが、記事の主題はスペインのASFアウトブレイク。verified_locationsにはChina（記事内で国際貿易への言及があり、スペインからの輸入制限が記載されているため）のみを含める。動物感染症であるが、国際貿易と経済的影響の規模から重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Гендиректор ВООЗ заявив, що спалах Еболи в Конго можна зупинити
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General said that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo can be stopped.
article.articleSummary: as of May 29, 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains controllable and can be stopped, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The DRC has reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases and about 240 deaths, with transmission ongoing since mid-May. The virus has crossed borders, with cases detected in neighboring Uganda. The Democratic Republic of the Congo has requested experimental Ebola treatments as infections surpassed 1,000. Tedros urged a strengthened international response to prevent further spread, while opposing international travel restrictions, which he said offer limited value for stopping transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行は抑止可能と述べた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響・予想外・国際拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた流行であり、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例検出に関する記載があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが実験的エボラ治療を要求しており、国際的な対応が強く求められている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Bắc Mỹ siết kiểm soát Ebola trước thềm World Cup
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North America tightens Ebola controls on the eve of the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: North America tightens Ebola controls ahead of World Cup 2026 as the United States, Canada, and Mexico coordinate public health measures for travelers from high-risk African regions. With WHO declaring the Ebola outbreak in Congo a global health emergency of international concern, the three governments emphasize health and safety for locals and visitors. The United States bans entry for non-citizens who have recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, and expands the restriction to permanent residents who resided in those countries within the previous 21 days. Canada imposes a 90-day entry ban on travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, and requires Canadians, permanent residents, and long-term foreign residents who have been in affected areas to undergo a 21-day quarantine starting May 30. Mexico focuses on border health screening, advises avoiding travel to Congo, and requires a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from the country.

triage.headline_ja: 北米がワールドカップ前夜にエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WHO宣言済みのエボラ（PHEIC）で複数国が入境制限を実施。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカでのエボラ発生（特にコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダン）に対する北米（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）の入境規制措置を報道。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。2026年ワールドカップ（北米開催予定）を控えた国境保健対策。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫：伊波拉疗法候选疫苗仅限临床试验中使用
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola therapeutic vaccine candidates to be used only in clinical trials.
article.articleSummary: WHO states that experimental Ebola therapies and vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus should be used only within clinical trials. With the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) outbreak ongoing and Uganda reporting cases, the WHO convened experts on May 28 to assess safety, efficacy, and trial design. Therapeutics prioritized for trials: MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceuticals), Maftivimab (Regeneron), and Remdesivir (Gilead). Vaccines showing promise include rVSV Bundibugyo from IAVI (potentially 7–9 months before trials) and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford University–Serum Institute of India (2–3 months pending animal data). Merck’s Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, is unlikely to be used outside research for Bundibugyo due to limited evidence. WHO is collaborating with Congo, Uganda, and Africa CDC to design ethically rigorous clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラ治療用ワクチン候補は臨床試験内のみで使用
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）の進行中のアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）に対し、WHOが実験的治療法とワクチン候補の臨床試験を急速に進めている状況。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、複数国への影響が認められ、IHR基準に2つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの症例報告を言及しているが、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみを該当対象国として記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は通常のザイール型エボラより稀で、複数の実験的治療・ワクチンの並行臨床試験が計画されている点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Becomes First Nation To Enforce Centralised Ebola 21-Day Quarantine
article.articleSummary: Thailand becomes the first nation to impose mandatory 21-day quarantine for travellers arriving from Ebola-risk countries, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Eleven travellers to Phuket are under 21-day health monitoring; none have Ebola symptoms. Phuket International Airport has tightened health screening, with vigilance stressed by the provincial governor. Future arrivals from risk zones are centralized via Suvarnabhumi Airport, where additional disease-control counters exist before immigration clearance. Travellers showing fever, vomiting, severe fatigue or bleeding would be moved to infectious-disease facilities for testing and treatment. Ebola is extremely dangerous, with high fatality if untreated, and typically spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids rather than airborne transmission. The measure aims to protect residents and tourism; ongoing outbreaks in Africa draw international attention; possible impacts on regional travel and medical insurance.

triage.headline_ja: タイが中央集約化されたエボラ21日間隔離を実施する最初の国となる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスという高リスク病原体の国際的な検疫・管理措置であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。確認患者はいないが、アフリカでの進行中の流行からの渡航者監視と対策実施は信号としての価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではタイが検疫措置を実施する主体であり、DRCとウガンダはリスク国として言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。現在、タイで確認されたエボラ患者はなく、11名の渡航者が監視下にあるが症状なし。この時点はシグナル検出段階であり、フルRRAでアフリカ側の流行状況も確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Piala Dunia 2026, AS-Kanada-Meksiko Bersatu Cegah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of the 2026 World Cup, the US-Canada-Mexico unite to prevent Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026, the United States, Canada, and Mexico announce coordinated health measures to prevent Ebola transmission via international travel. The trilateral statement targets travelers from African regions with high Ebola exposure risk. Canada imposes a 90-day entry ban on nationals from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, along with a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from those countries; policy took effect May 27, 2026. The aim is to safeguard public health while keeping cross-border travel and trade stable during the World Cup, which begins June 11, 2026 across three host nations. Ebola is a deadly virus spread mainly by direct contact with infected body fluids; no large outbreak has been reported in North America yet. Travelers and fans should follow updated rules as governments adjust; FIFA has not announced schedule changes.

triage.headline_ja: 2026ワールドカップを控え、米国・カナダ・メキシコがエボラ予防で団結
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国による協調対策が実施されている。しかし、記事は北米での大規模発生報告がないと明記しており、現時点では予防的措置の段階である。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には米国・カナダ・メキシコ・ウガンダ・南スーダンが含まれるが、記事サマリーは実際のエボラ発生地がアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）であることを示唆しており、北米での発生報告はないと明記されている。したがって対象国リストから該当するのはDRCのみ。記事は予防的措置と国際的な移動制限について述べているが、北米での活発な流行は報告されていないため、現段階ではシグナルとしてのピックアップを留保し、DRCおよびウガンダでの状況進展を注視する判定。

article.articleHeadline: México Aplica Restricción Temporal de Ingreso a Pasajeros Internacionales por Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico Imposes Temporary Entry Restriction on International Passengers Due to Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Mexico imposes a 60-day temporary entry restriction on international travelers amid the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The rule, effective 00:00 on May 28, 2026, targets passengers who have traveled in the past 21 days to Uganda, the DRC, and/or South Sudan and who do not hold a Mexican passport or valid residency. The measure follows coordinated actions with the United States and Canada to protect travelers during FIFA World Cup 2026. The WHO has raised the Ebola risk to very high in the DRC, indicating rapid, ongoing transmission. Ebola is not airborne; transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated surfaces, or unsafe funeral practices. Zoonotic spillover from animals (e.g., bats) and subsequent human-to-human spread through blood, saliva, urine, feces, vomit, semen, breast milk, and sweat are highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコがエボラ出血熱により国際旅客の一時的な入国制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準を複数満たす高リスク疾患であり、DRCでの急速な感染拡大（WHO評価：非常に高いリスク）、複数国での渡航制限措置実施、国際的拡大の可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ流行とそれに対するメキシコの渡航制限措置を報道しており、DRCが対象国に含まれている。USA、Canada、Mexicoは発生地域として列挙されているが、サマリー上ではこれらは発生地ではなく対応実施国であるため verified_locations には含めない。同様にSouth Sudan（対象国でない）、Uganda（対象国でない）も除外。DRCは医学的に深刻度が高く、制限措置による国際的影響が大きいため、フルRRA対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Approves US Plan for Ebola Quarantine Facility in Laikipia, US officials say
article.articleSummary: Kenya approved a US plan to set up an Ebola quarantine facility at an air force base in Laikipia County to manage Americans exposed to the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Kenyan authorities granted written access to the land; the facility would be staffed by the U.S. Public Health Service. Officials say it would primarily serve U.S. citizens but Kenya had pressed for access for people of all nationalities; final terms were not publicly disclosed. Kenyan Health Ministry confirmed ongoing discussions with the United States and partners on outbreak response, but did not comment on the quarantine site. Several Americans exposed to Ebola have been evacuated to Europe for treatment and monitoring, including an infected American doctor moved to Germany and another to the Czech Republic. The outbreak remains centered in eastern DRC, with cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、ラウキピアでのエボラ隔離施設に関する米国計画を承認、米当局者が発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（IHR基準対象疾患）の東部DRCでの進行中の流行に関連した国際的対応であり、IHR基準4項目中3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、ケニアは対応地点（隔離施設設置場所）として言及されているが、実際の患者発生地はDRCである。ドイツ、チェコは患者移送先であり、発生地ではない。ケニアはWPRO地域外であるため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCのみが対象国リスト内の確認済み発生地である。

article.articleHeadline: Oxford acelera vacina contra ebola em meio a surto na África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Oxford accelerates Ebola vaccine amid outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Oxford accelerates Ebola vaccine development for Bundibugyo strain amid a Central Africa outbreak. The outbreak spans the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with hundreds of suspected cases and dozens of deaths. The World Health Organization has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, underscoring containment challenges. The vaccine uses the same platform as the COVID-19 vaccine developed with AstraZeneca, potentially speeding development since much of the underlying science has been tested before. Research proceeds in two main phases; if results are favorable, first human trials could begin within two to three months. Bundibugyo is a less frequent but highly dangerous Ebola variant, and existing vaccines are not effective against this strain. Other teams pursue complementary approaches, but no definitive solution exists yet. The effort aims to shorten discovery-to-use timelines without compromising safety.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード、アフリカでのアウトブレイク最中にエボラワクチンを加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の中央アフリカでのアウトブレイクで、DRCとウガンダで数百の疑い症例と数十の死亡報告があり、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ（対象国外）での発生も記載しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ出血熱は極めてハイリスクな病原体であり、新しいBundibugyo株への既存ワクチン無効性も懸念要因。WHOのPHEIC宣言は最高レベルの警告。

article.articleHeadline: Trump vill placera ebolaexponerade amerikaner i Kenya | Sveriges Radio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump wants to place Ebola-exposed Americans in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, where Albert Kambale says three members of the same family have died at the outbreak epicenter. The outbreak is described as rapidly expanding in eastern DR Congo. Separately, U.S. President Donald Trump proposes placing Americans exposed to the Ebola virus in Kenya and building an Ebola treatment facility there to keep the virus away from the United States. Kenya would be used to isolate exposed individuals, with the facility intended to contain risk. The article provides no laboratory confirmation details or clear infection source, and makes no mention of imported/exported cases beyond plans to relocate exposed Americans. The report cites Kambale’s remarks to Ekot.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ大統領、エボラウイルスに曝露したアメリカ人をケニアに配置することを望む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当。エボラウイルスの流行は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、DRCで急速に拡大中。米国政府がケニアでの隔離施設構築を提案しており、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのブニア地域でのエボラ流行を主題としている。ケニアとアメリカの関与は政策提案レベルであり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。ブニアはDRCのイトゥリ州にあり、DRCの一部として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: Warga AS Kena Ebola Tidak Dipulangkan, Tapi Dikirim ke Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: American citizens infected with Ebola are not repatriated, but sent to Kenya.
article.articleSummary: American Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo are not repatriated; instead, Washington is establishing a quarantine facility in Kenya for rapid evacuation and isolation of U.S. citizens exposed to Ebola in DRC. The facility will provide high-quality care, including ICU services for severe cases, with ongoing assessment for transfer to more advanced facilities in the U.S. or Europe as needed. Policy accompanies travel bans on new U.S. green-card holders returning from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, drawing criticism from public health experts. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was officially declared in DRC and Uganda on May 15, 2026, with WHO declaring PHEIC on May 16, 2026. As of May 26–27, 2026, DRC reports 1,198 total cases (1,077 suspected, 121 confirmed) and 263 deaths (246 suspected, 17 confirmed), with confirmed cases concentrated in Ituri (110), North Kivu (10), and South Kivu (1). Uganda reports seven confirmed cases and one death as of May 27, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の米国民は本国に帰還せず、ケニアに派遣される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言した多国間エボラウイルス病の流行。米国を含む国際的な対応と渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCでのエボラ流行とそれに対する米国の対応が主題。DRCはスクリーニング対象国リストに含まれる。ウガンダでも7確定症例が報告されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ケニア・スーダンは地域的関連性はあるがイベントの主要発生地ではなく、記事では対応地域として記載されているため除外。

article.articleHeadline: DKPP Klaten Temukan Belasan Hewan Kurban Terinfeksi Cacing Hati, Satu Ekor Sapi Terindikasi PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DKPP Klaten Finds Dozens of Sacrificial Animals Infected with Liver Flukes, One Cow Suspected of Foot-and-Mouth Disease
article.articleSummary: Eid al-Adha 1447 H in Klaten Regency, Central Java, coincided with discovery of liver fluke (fascioliasis) infections in sacrificial livestock. Of about 1,500+ animals sacrificed (584 cattle and 984 goats/sheep), inspectors found liver infections in several animals across at least 12 villages; infected livers were confiscated and not fit for consumption. One cow was suspected of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK). DKPP Klaten advised replacing that animal with a healthy one. Surveillance over the two-day slaughter period involved 85 officers across 26 districts, with monitoring extending to a third day. The episode underscores ongoing post-slaughter checks to ensure meat safety during Eid al-Adha and reflects routine veterinary surveillance during large-scale sacrifices in Central Java.

triage.headline_ja: クラテン県畜産局が数十頭の犠牲動物がレバーフルーク（住血吸虫症）に感染していることを発見、1頭の牛が口蹄疫の疑い
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア中部ジャワ州で口蹄疫（FMD）の疑い症例が1頭検出されたが、確認例ではなく感染症の深刻度や拡大リスクについて情報不足。ルーチン獣医監視下での発見で管理下にある。
triage.notes: 記事主題は動物衛生（犠牲獣）の検査であり、人間への感染リスクは特に述べられていない。口蹄疫は疑い例（1頭）で確認例ではなく、当該動物は隔離・交換推奨される。ファッシオラ症も食肉安全性の観点から対応済み（感染臓器没収）。ルーチン監視体制下での発見であり、即座の情報不足による格上げは不適切。続報でFMD確認例が報告される場合は再評価。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: تفشي فيروس إيبولا يتجاوز السيطرة - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola virus outbreak is out of control.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control, with over 1,000 cases and 220 deaths in recent weeks as the virus spreads in eastern regions, including Bunia. Two suspected cases in northern Italy among humanitarian workers from Uganda tested negative. US airports have stepped up screening of travelers from affected areas after an American doctor contracted the virus. Oxford researchers are developing a vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain, which may have up to 50% fatality, but no vaccine is ready; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautions that the international response has not kept pace. This is among the fastest outbreaks since 2014, which caused about 28,000 cases and 11,000 deaths. Three Red Cross volunteers died handling infected corpses; Bunia hospital was attacked; the UK pledged £20 million to aid containment; monitoring of returning workers continues. Transmission via bats and bodily fluids; incubation up to 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルスの流行が制御不能になっている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行がDRCで1,000例以上、220死亡と急速に拡大し、国際的関心が高く、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）および複数のWPRO基準に該当。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCのエボラ流行。イタリア、米国、英国、ウガンダは関連国として言及されているが、これらの国での発生ではなく、DRCでの流行に対する各国の対応・関心を示している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。死亡率50%のBundibugyo株の可能性、医療従事者の感染、施設への攻撃など、管理可能性への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Piala Dunia, AS, Meksiko, dan Kanada Perketat Aturan terkait Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of the World Cup, the United States, Mexico, and Canada Tighten Ebola-Related Rules.
article.articleSummary: To protect World Cup 2026 travelers, the United States, Canada, and Mexico announce coordinated Ebola-related travel measures for travelers arriving from high-risk African regions. Canada imposes a 90-day entry ban on nationals from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, and requires a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from those countries. The trilateral action follows the World Health Organization’s May 17 declaration of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing high regional spread risk. The measures aim to safeguard residents and the millions expected to attend the FIFA World Cup 2026, hosted jointly by the three nations, starting June 11, while preserving travel and trade at the North American borders.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップを前に、アメリカ、メキシコ、カナダがエボラ関連の規制を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国が協調した対策を実施。対象国DRCで発生。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が確認されている。ワールドカップ2026（北米開催）を背景とした重要な国際的対応事例。国際的な渡航制限と検疫措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Jelang Piala Dunia 2026, AS-Kanada-Meksiko Perketat Antisipasi Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of the 2026 World Cup, the U.S.-Canada-Mexico tighten Ebola precautions.
article.articleSummary: US, Canada, and Mexico tighten Ebola precautions for travelers from high-risk Africa regions ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. A joint statement issued May 27, 2026, announces strengthened public health procedures for travelers arriving from areas with the highest Ebola risk, prioritizing health protection for residents and visitors as millions head to North America. The measures follow the World Health Organization’s designation of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with warnings of spillover risk to neighboring African nations. Consequently, authorities are boosting surveillance and applying travel restrictions where needed, though the joint policy did not detail all measures.

triage.headline_ja: 2026ワールドカップ前に、米国・カナダ・メキシコがエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重症公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラは重大な感染症であり、WHO が PHEIC 指定、複数国が対策を強化している状況は重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC でのエボラ PHEIC 指定が主題で、米国・カナダ・メキシコは対策実施国のため verified_locations に含めない。DRC のみが発生国である。2026年の大規模イベント（ワールドカップ）を控えての対策強化であり、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Amerika Larang Warganya yang Terjangkit Ebola Pulang, Dibiarkan di Kenya Karena Takut Menyebar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States bans its Ebola-infected citizens from returning home, leaving them in Kenya for fear of spreading it.
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, the United States bars Ebola-exposed citizens from returning home and opens a quarantine center in Kenya at Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki to prevent domestic cases. The facility will treat high-risk, exposed Americans who are asymptomatic before transfer to a tertiary facility abroad. The United States provides $13.5 million in preparedness aid to Kenya, with coordination between Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Kenyan President William Ruto. CDC has imposed travel restrictions on people from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, including green card holders, with screening at three major US airports. The policy contrasts with 2014 Ebola handling, and WHO has declared the Bundibugyo Ebola variant an international health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカがエボラ感染者の帰国を禁止、ケニアに留置し感染拡大を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の対応、国際拡大リスク）該当。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。複数国での検出と渡航制限実施。
triage.notes: 記事は米国のケニア隔離施設設置に焦点を当てているが、実際の感染症発生は DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで確認されている。対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみ。Bundibugyo Ebola variant は WHO によって国際保健上の緊急事態として宣言済み。複数国での CDC 渡航制限実施により、国際的な拡大リスクと対応の深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC Issues Guidelines for Health Workers, Cautions Against Importing Disease
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC issued a Public Health Advisory for Healthcare Workers on Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) preparedness and readiness. Nigeria has not recorded any confirmed EVD case as of Thursday, but faces a high risk of importing the virus due to increased international travel, porous borders, and heavy population movement. High-risk states include Lagos, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa, due to international airports, seaports, and border routes. The objective is for all states and the FCT to detect, contain, and respond swiftly to any suspected case. The advisory covers risk assessment, recognition of Ebola infection, transmission risks, and prevention measures; it directs healthcare workers to contact State Ministries of Health or public health authorities for guidance. As context, Uganda and DR Congo report 1,077 suspected cases and 247 deaths (case fatality rate 24.6%).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: NCDCが医療従事者向けガイドラインを発行し、疾病の輸入に対する警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアはエボラ確定患者なし（予防的警告段階）だが、隣接するウガンダ・DRCで活発な流行があり、ナイジェリアの輸入リスク評価は高い。国際的懸念ありだが、現段階では国内患者なく、情報充実を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 【地域検証の重要注記】記事の主題はナイジェリアの警告と準備段階である。確定患者はナイジェリアに存在しないが、隣接国ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれず）とDRC（対象国リスト203312に含まれる）で流行中。ナイジェリア自体は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とすべきだが、記事本体が「隣接・輸入リスク」の文脈であり、DRCの流行と連動した地域的懸念である点を勘案し、DRCのみを記載。ウガンダは対象国でないため除外。本シグナルはIHR基準2該当・WPRO基準5該当で本来PICKUPに該当するが、現地（ナイジェリア）確定患者ゼロ・予防段階であること、および検証地域の限定により WATCH とした。続報でナイジェリア国内患者確認時に PICKUP への昇格を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: बाजार की बर्फ से सावधान! टाइफाइड और पीलिया का बढ़ा खतरा, जानिए एक्सपर्ट राय!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of market ice! Increased risk of typhoid and jaundice—find out what experts say.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, health experts warn that most market ice is made from contaminated water, heightening the risk of typhoid and jaundice. People dissolve raw ice blocks in drinking water at home, potentially spreading gastrointestinal illness. In Ambala district, ice factories are criticized for poor sanitation, leading to bacteria, viruses, and pollutants in ice; E. coli and norovirus have been reported in untreated ice. Ice is intended to cool items, not to be consumed dissolved in water, to avoid vomiting, diarrhea, gastroenteritis, typhoid, and jaundice. With summer, sales of sugarcane juice, sherbet, lassi, juice, jaljeera, and chuski rise, but quality matters. The health department is fast-tracking checks of water supply and ice factories, sampling in Barara, Narayanagarh, and Ambala Cantonment, including chlorine and microbiological tests. Consumers are urged to use only clean, safe water-based ice and avoid street-vended beverages.

triage.headline_ja: 市場の氷に注意！チフスと肝炎のリスク増加—専門家の意見を知る
triage.triage_reason: 複数の下痢性疾患（ノロウイルス、E. coli、チフス）が報告され、汚染された水製氷による多数人への曝露リスク、および複数地域での公衆衛生部門の対応が確認されている。
triage.notes: 複数の下痢性疾患（ノロウイルス、E. coli、チフス）が市場の汚染製氷に関連して報告されており、Ambalaおよび複数地域で健康当局による迅速な対応が実施されている。夏季における感染リスク増加が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: What Ebola Outbreaks Mean To U.S. Businesses
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), spread to Uganda with a risk of expansion to Southern Sudan and beyond. Ebola transmits primarily through direct contact with blood or other body fluids of a sick or deceased person; the risk of a COVID-like airborne pandemic remains low. For U.S. businesses, travel advisories from the U.S. Department of State and the CDC may not be fully aligned; employers should monitor guidance and generally avoid nonessential travel to DRC, Uganda, and Southern Sudan until advisories change. Personal travel is not prohibited at present, but employees should report to their employer before returning. Upon return, employers should follow public health guidance; citizenship status affects entry risk only in policy terms, not transmission. Reinforce universal precautions for exposure to blood or body fluids, and ensure OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens Standard compliance; share CDC link and address workplace anxiety and harassment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症のアウトブレイクが米国のビジネスに意味するもの
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱はWHO基準で最重要度の疾患であり、DRCおよびウガンダでのアウトブレイク情報により即座にフルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが記述されているが、対象国リストでウガンダは含まれていないためverified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国の記事であるが、主題は中央アフリカのエボラアウトブレイクの事業への影響である。スーダンについても記事では言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "Cela coûte des vies" : en République démocratique du Congo, la lutte contre Ebola pâtit des coupes budgétaires dans l'aide internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "That costs lives": in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the fight against Ebola suffers from budget cuts in international aid.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, near Uganda) with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 suspected deaths. Approximately 1,400 exposed contacts remain untraceable, hindering containment. response is hampered by drastic cuts in international aid, with U.S. assistance to the DRC dropping from $881 million to $115 million over two years, under the Trump administration. Oxfam, once maintaining three emergency teams, now has a single team (staff down from 76 to 15). It estimates about €11 million is needed; current donations are around €500,000. Surveillance, laboratories, rapid-response teams, and early-warning mechanisms have been eroded, slowing detection and contact tracing. IRC operations in Ituri reduced from five to two health zones. Protective equipment is arriving but remains insufficient, contributing to delayed detection of this rare Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak amid conflict and funding gaps.

triage.headline_ja: 「それは命を奪う」：コンゴ民主共和国では、国際援助の予算削減がエボラ対策に支障をきたしている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の集団発生で1,000件以上の疑い患者と220件以上の疑い死亡があり、国際的な支援体制が機能不全に陥っている。IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの発生は極めて稀。記事は国際援助の削減（米国からのDRC援助が881百万ドルから115百万ドルへ削減）が疫病対応能力を著しく低下させていることを強調。約1,400人の接触者が追跡不可能状態にあり、封じ込め困難。ウガンダとの国境近接地域（Ituri州）での発生であり、地域的な拡大リスクも存在。発生地域にUSAが含まれているが、サマリーでの主題はDRCの集団発生であり、米国は援助削減の文脈でのみ言及されているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Nachrichtenpodcast: Ein Arzt berichtet: Darum gerät Ebola im Kongo gerade außer Kontrolle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News podcast: A doctor reports: That's why Ebola in the Congo is currently out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control as of May 29, 2026, with authorities reporting more than 1,000 infections and about 250 suspected deaths. The rapid spread surpasses the trajectory of the 2014 epidemic (which killed over 11,000). The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and neighboring Uganda has closed its border. Ebola transmits via body fluids, and the case fatality rate is highly variable, ranging roughly 30%–90% depending on care access. Containment faces substantial challenges in logistics, healthcare capacity, and security. A doctor on the ground provides frontline observations, while a ZEIT Health podcast host discusses why suppression is difficult and what international responses are underway.

triage.headline_ja: ニュースポッドキャスト：医師の報告：エボラウイルスがコンゴで現在制御不能になっている理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した致命的なエボラウイルス疫病で、制御不能状態が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であり、UgandaはDRCとの国境閉鎖対応国として言及されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを列挙。1,000例を超える感染、約250例の疑い死亡、2014年の流行より急速な拡大が報告されている。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、国際的な対応が進行中。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola bùng dịch quá nhanh, vượt khả năng ứng phó ở Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading too quickly, overwhelming Congo's capacity to respond.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading too quickly, overwhelming capacity to respond as of May 29, 2026, with weeks-to-month response delays. Contact tracing remains severely lagging, with only about 7% of potentially exposed individuals identified; experts say at least 70% is needed to control transmission. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus lineage, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. So far, the epidemic has generated roughly 900 cases and 220 suspected deaths, and has crossed into Uganda. Funding cuts by the United States, the United Kingdom, and Sudan are hampering efforts. Calls for massive investments in isolation and triage facilities, water and sanitation, disinfection, and frontline community outreach. Attacks on health facilities in eastern Congo reflect public mistrust, complicating containment and raising fears of a repeat of 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola, with over 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急速に拡大、対応能力を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴでのエボラ爆発流行は公衆衛生上極めて深刻で、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及既確認）があり、予想外の対応不能状態が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus lineageはワクチン・承認治療法がなく、接触者追跡が7%に留まり70%必要とされている。既にウガンダへ波及。米国・英国・スーダンの資金削減が対応を阻害しており、2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000以上死亡）の再現懸念がある。健康施設への攻撃による公的信頼喪失も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Angola Reports 13 Positive Cases of Monkeypox
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, Angola reports 13 positive monkeypox (Mpox) cases in its northern Cabinda and Uige provinces, with 9 in Cabinda and 4 in Uige. Cabinda has had Mpox cases since last year, and this year the province has reported five positive Mpox cases. Health Minister Silvia Lutucuta announced the figures at the end of the first Local Governance Council meeting chaired by President João Lourenço in Mbanza Kongo. To curb spread, authorities are supplying monkeypox vaccine doses to border provinces sharing a border with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Border measures include temperature checks for entrants and exits, along with advisories against consuming wild game and traveling to DRC-affected areas. Angola has not yet registered any suspected Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラがサル痘の13例の陽性ケースを報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外」と「国際的拡大リスク」が該当（2つ以上）。WPRO基準でも「異常・予想外」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」が該当。DRCとの国境対策が実施されており、地域的に重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な舞台はアンゴラ（対象国外）だが、DRCとの国境措置が重要な要素であり、DRCへの疾患流入リスクが示唆されている。DRCが対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。アンゴラはDRCとの国境を共有し、国境措置が実施されている点が地域的リスク増加を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ ơi: Tỷ lệ tử vong lên đến 90%, Ebola nguy hiểm như thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor, how dangerous is Ebola with a fatality rate of up to 90%?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over a new outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The circulating Bundibugyo strain represents a novel Ebola variant, with no available vaccine and no specific antiviral treatment. WHO notes rising suspected case numbers and a high risk of cross-border spread fueled by population movement and limited healthcare capacity in the outbreak region. In Vietnam, no Ebola cases have been reported to date, but health authorities have intensified surveillance at border checkpoints and airports and are urging the public to stay vigilant. The issue is featured in a Vietnamese TV program with Dr. Nguyen Thi Thuy Ngan to clarify transmission, dangerous symptoms, latest developments, and practical prevention, while addressing misconceptions and anxiety.

triage.headline_ja: 医者へのご質問：死亡率は最大90％、エボラウイルスはどのくらい危険ですか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しているエボラ新規発生。新規変異株（Bundibugyo株）で既知の治療法なく、国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでの新規エボラ発生が主題。ベトナムについては現在症例報告がないものの、サマリーに明記されており、感染リスク評価と警戒強化が述べられているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOの国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、確実にPICKUP対象。

article.articleHeadline: 疫情处于"极高风险"，外交部提醒中国公民近期谨慎前往刚果（金）
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic at 'Extremely High Risk,' the Foreign Ministry reminds Chinese citizens to exercise caution when traveling to the Congo (Kinshasa) in the near future.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Beni region) has been designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO on May 17, with risk upgraded to extremely high on May 22. The DRC reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. Chinese authorities warn against nonessential travel to Congo (Kinshasa) and advise avoiding Ebola-affected areas, wildlife contact, and exposure to suspected patients. Key symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and bleeding. Seek medical care promptly or consult Chinese medical teams; on return, report any symptoms to airline crew or border officials. MoFA emergency consular hotlines: +86-10-12308 and +86-10-65612308. The article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation or imported/exported Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: 疫情処于「極高リスク」、外交部が中国民に対しコンゴ（民）への渡航注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA進行必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEICを宣言、5月22日にリスク水準を「極高」に引き上げ。DRC内で900件超の疑い患者が報告されている。複数国への渡航制限勧告あり。社会政治的関心が極めて高い。対象国DRCは該当リスト上では記載なし（GeoNames ID 203312は確認対象外）だが、同IDが発生地域に含まれているため記録。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情复杂，防控面临多重考验_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is complex, and prevention and control face multiple challenges.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains complex and regionally impactful. As of May 26, the DRC has 1,077 suspected cases and 238 deaths, with 129 laboratory-confirmed cases; Uganda has 8 confirmed cases. Africa CDC director Kasaya described the situation as regional, with 11 other African countries deemed high risk. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; national risk in DRC is 'very high,' regional risk 'high,' global risk 'low.' WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa May 28 and will visit Bunia, the capital of Ituri province, to assess the outbreak. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus yet; vaccines and therapies are in trials and may take months to yield results. A recovered patient was reported in Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は複雑であり、予防と管理は複数の課題に直面している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、WHO公開衛生上の国際的に懸念される状況（PHEIC）として既に宣言されている。DRCおよびウガンダでの確定症例と死亡が報告され、地域的影響が深刻である。
triage.notes: 既にWHOから2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言されており、DRCでの確定症例129例、死亡238例、ウガンダでの確定症例8例が報告されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（BDBV）で、ワクチンや特異的治療は未承認。WHO事務局長がキンシャサ到着し、イトゥリ州のブニアを訪問予定。WPRO対象国リストにはDRCが含まれるが、ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Asiatic Lions In Gujarat's Gir Forest Under Serious Existential Threat After Virus Kills 7 - VIDEO
article.articleSummary: Seven Asiatic lions died in Gujarat's Gir Forest after contracting an infectious virus, the Forest Department said. Seventeen lions showing symptoms are now isolated, and eight have tested positive. With fewer than 900 Asiatic lions left, confined to Gir, the outbreak threatens the world’s only surviving population. Deaths are being explored as due to Canine Distemper Virus (CDV) or Babesia, a tick-borne parasite that attacks red blood cells; both are under investigation. More than 350 lions across Gir are undergoing preventive de-ticking and medical checks, as seasonal disease spikes occur in summer. Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel chaired a high-level review on May 27, 2026. The situation highlights the species’ vulnerability, with authorities intensifying monitoring, testing, and disease surveillance within the reserve.

triage.headline_ja: ギジャラート州ギール森のアジアライオンが深刻な実存的脅威に直面 ウイルスで7頭死亡
triage.triage_reason: バベシア症は人獣共通感染症だが、本イベントは野生動物（アジアライオン）の集団死亡であり、人への感染リスクは記事で言及されていない。動物衛生上の重要性は高いが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は不明確。
triage.notes: 本イベントは主に野生動物（絶滅危惧種アジアライオン）の感染症であり、CDVおよびバベシア症の混合感染の可能性がある。人への公衆衛生上の直接的なリスクについては記事に記載されていないため、動物衛生当局による監視継続が必要。バベシア症は人獣共通感染症であるが、本記事ではヒト感染の言及がないため、スクリーニング基準の「管理可能性」および「公衆衛生への影響」の判定は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia Eboli w Demokratycznej Republice Konga. Szef WHO wystąpił z orędziem - Forsal.pl
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The WHO chief delivered an address.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with 121 confirmed cases and 17 deaths, and about 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths reported to date. Transmission spans 15 health zones in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Mongbwalu, Rwampara and Bunia bearing the majority (96% of suspected and 79% of confirmed). The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, where seven cases are confirmed and one death; three cases are linked to travel from DRC. Uganda has closed its border with immediate effect; entrants from Congo may face a 21-day quarantine. WHO Director‑General Tedros warns conflict in eastern DRC hinders response and urges access for aid. ECDC says EU risk is very low; two Italian cases from Uganda were later ruled out. On May 15, 2026, laboratory confirmation identified Bundibugyo virus as the outbreak’s cause.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行。WHO事務局長が声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準5項目中5項目該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、死亡事例あり、WHO警告。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo virus株）の大規模アウトブレイク。DRC内15の保健地区で感染が確認され、ウガンダへの越境も報告されている。死亡事例17件（確認）、246件（疑い）。WHO事務局長が公式警告を発出。ウガンダは国境を閉鎖し21日間の隔離を実施。記事ではイタリアの2例は後に陰性と判定されたと記載されているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Update Wabah Ebola Kongo 2026: WHO Catat 1.000 Kasus, AS dan Uganda Mulai Perketat Perbatasan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Update on the 2026 Congo Ebola outbreak: WHO records 1,000 cases, the U.S. and Uganda begin tightening border controls.
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, 2026 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 1,000 cases (confirmed or suspected), with 10 deaths confirmed and 223 deaths suspected. The epicenter is Ituri Province, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arriving in Kinshasa to monitor the response and heading to Ituri. WHO warns that transmission may be broader than official tallies and undetected for some time. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, a country of over 100 million people frequently affected by the disease. By May 29, 2026, the United States and Uganda began tightening border controls to limit cross-border spread. WHO states that travel bans are not supported and that coordinated action can halt the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年コンゴエボラ流行のアップデート：WHOが1,000例を記録、米国とウガンダが国境管理を強化開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。確認死亡10例、疑い死亡223例を含む1,000例超の流行規模と、複数国での国境管理強化が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRC領内の複数州（Ituri、Kinshasa City）で確認されたエボラ流行。WHO事務局長がDRC訪問中。米国とウガンダが国境管理を強化開始したことで国際的対応段階に移行。DRCは17度目のエボラ流行で、1,000例超かつ死亡例が多数報告されており、公式統計以上の感染拡大の可能性がWHOから警告されている。ウガンダはシグナルの二次的影響地域として言及されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダ国内での症例報告はなく、検証場所にウガンダは含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 综述丨刚果（金）埃博拉疫情复杂 防控面临多重考验
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overview: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is complex, and prevention and control face multiple challenges.
article.articleSummary: Complex Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is regional and was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), with Uganda affected and 8 confirmed cases. By May 26, DRC reported 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths, with 129 lab-confirmed cases; one recovery (a laboratory worker in Bunia, Ituri) after two negative tests. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though standardized clinical care can save some patients. WHO and partners are advancing candidate vaccines and therapies, but trials will take months; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus plans to visit Bunia to assess the situation and coordinate responses. Africa CDC Director Kassaye describes the outbreak as regional; at least 11 countries are designated high risk and urged to boost surveillance, testing, and border health measures. Some countries have travel restrictions, but WHO does not recommend bans, emphasizing strengthening local control.

triage.headline_ja: 概説：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情は複雑で、予防・制御は多くの課題に直面している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みの多国間拡大エボラ疫情。DRCで129確認例・238死亡疑い例、ウガンダで8確認例を報告。国際的拡大リスク高く、既に11ヶ国が高リスク指定されている。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済みの既知疫情。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で承認ワクチン・特異的治療なし。WHO事務局長がBunia訪問予定で国際的対応強化中。ウガンダも8確認例報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。記事は5月29日配信で比較的最近のもの。

article.articleHeadline: Murió mientras salvaba vidas": el ébola golpea también a los sanitarios en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "He died while saving lives": Ebola also hits healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, two healthcare workers have died from Ebola virus disease in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, highlighting frontline transmission risk. Vladimir Maduali, 30, died after two days on oxygen at the Rwampara isolation center; two days later Tibenderana Katho Blaise, a physician at Bunia’s Evangelical Medical Center, also died. The Ituri outbreak has claimed at least 220 lives with over 900 suspected cases since the emergency began. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled to Congo to assess the response. Colleagues say both doctors contracted the virus while treating numerous patients in Mongbwalu and Rwampara before the outbreak was officially declared. The initial diagnosis was delayed because the Ituri reference lab lacked reagents for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, yielding false negatives and misclassification as malaria or typhoid. Authorities cite late detection, inadequate PPE, and frontline demotivation as key challenges; measures include prohibiting funerals and suspending Bunia flights.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼は命を救いながら死んだ」：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラがヘルスケアワーカーも襲う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡者多数、医療従事者への感染）、異常性（医療従事者の感染死）、国際的拡大リスク（WHO事務局長が現地訪問、国境を越えた感染懸念）、渡航制限リスク（フライト停止措置）を示す。フルRRA進行に値する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC(Ituri州、Bunia市、Mongbwalu市)での発生を明確に述べている。Rwandaはサマリーに直接登場しないため除外。エボラ、マラリア、チフスが複合的に報告されているが、主要なシグナルはエボラの医療従事者への感染死。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は国際的な関心と支援の必要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Botswana On Guard As Ebola Screening Starts
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening intensified in Botswana after the World Health Organization declared the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda Ebola outbreaks a global health emergency. On May 27 at Ramokgwebana Border, North East District Environmental Health Officer Joseph Senamo conducted health screening for incoming international arrivals. Botswana has heightened surveillance at all entry points, including airports and land borders, to prevent importation of the virus. All travellers undergo temperature and symptom checks, complete travel history questionnaires, and submit health declaration forms before entry. Those with symptoms or high-risk exposure are isolated and referred to designated facilities for testing and management. Public guidance urges avoiding non-essential travel to Ebola-affected countries (DRC, Uganda), maintaining strict hygiene, avoiding contact with the sick, and reporting suspected cases immediately. Measures aim to protect Botswana residents and curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ボツワナ、エボラスクリーニング開始で警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRC及びウガンダのエボラ流行がWHOにより国際的保健上の緊急事態に宣言されたことが記事の背景。ボツワナは国境での検査強化は報告されているが、ボツワナ国内での症例報告はサマリーに記載されていない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダ（対象国外）及びボツワナ（対象国外）はサマリー上での検査実施国であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Response to Ebola Outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda
article.articleSummary: World Bank Group mobilizes financing and technical support to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda as of 29 May 2026. Priorities include frontline response resources for health workers, strengthened surveillance and cross-border preparedness, and health-system reinforcement (laboratories, referral pathways, supply chains). Private sector engagement assesses impacts on operations and capacity to scale PPE, diagnostics, and treatment options. In DRC, the Health Emergency Preparedness, Response, and Resilience (HEPRR) project funds field epidemiologists, infection prevention/control experts, and risk-communication teams; expands testing capacity in Bunia. A separate $555 million nutrition and health project protects maternal, newborn, and immunization services across more than 3,500 facilities. The REDISSE project established the largest biosafety-level lab in Eastern DRC, serving as the central Ebola testing hub; Kinshasa’s Emergency Operations Center coordinates the national response with stockpiled emergency supplies. Cross-border work includes South Sudan surveillance and regional preparedness; Crisis Response Toolkit/Window and the Pandemic Fund provide rapid financing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）およびウガンダのエボラ流行への対応
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重症度高、異常な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bunia（DRC東部）およびKinshasa（DRC首都）での検査能力強化が記載されている。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー上での具体的な症例報告や流行状況の記載がなく、むしろDRCの流行に対する地域的備えとしての記載のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。World BankおよびPandemic Fundによる大規模な国際支援体制が構築されており、強い国際的関心を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Govt Approves U.S. Ebola Facility, Quarantine Site Revealed
article.articleSummary: Kenya approved a U.S. plan to establish an Ebola quarantine facility in Laikipia County, with roughly Ksh1.74 billion pledged for Ebola preparedness. The center will begin as a 50-bed field hospital, with potential expansion to 250 beds, operational within a week, staffed by the U.S. Public Health Service and trained at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland. The project is coordinated by the U.S. State, Defence, and Health and Human Services departments. It follows May 27 discussions between Kenya’s Ministry of Health and partners and a May 28 call between U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and President Ruto about the regional Ebola response amid the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has spread to Uganda. Rubio said no Ebola-infected individuals would be admitted to the U.S. Kenya initially sought access for all nationalities; it remains unclear if that was accepted. Legal petitions (May 28) by Katiba Institute and Law Society of Kenya seek to block the facility or compel disclosure of related agreements.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がU.S. エボラ施設を承認、検疫施設の場所が明かされた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、DRCでの流行が確認されている。ケニアが地域的な備え・対応体制を構築する異常事象であり、複数国への国際的な拡大リスクがある。IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアでの検疫施設設立計画が主題だが、施設建設自体は予防的措置である。実際のエボラ患者の発生確認は『DRCでの流行』『ウガンダへの拡大』と記述されている。対象国のDRCが明確に該当。ケニアの検疫施設設立により、ケニアが地域対応の中心拠点となる戦略的重要性がある。米国国務長官とケニア大統領の高官レベル協議と法的異議により、社会政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: US Ebola Quarantine Facility in Kenya to Open Friday
article.articleSummary: 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at Kenya's Laikipia Air Base near Nanyuki will become operational on Friday, May 29, 2026. The United States will not repatriate exposed Americans during the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. The site will initially house Americans deemed high-risk after exposure and include biocontainment and isolation units; patients needing advanced treatment would be transferred abroad. About 30 U.S. Public Health Service officers will staff the facility, trained for three days before deployment, with some having prior Ebola response experience from 2014-2015. The CDC and State Department are identifying overseas tertiary care facilities for potential treatment but have not named countries. This marks a policy shift from previous outbreaks when exposed individuals were flown to the U.S.; President Trump opposed repatriation. Kenya has not publicly set an official timeline, though discussions with the U.S. continue.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで米国エボラ隔離施設が金曜日に開設予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が強く、エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク管理のための重要な施設開設であり、DRCにおけるエボラ発生と関連した重大な公衆衛生対応。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアへの米国隔離施設設置について述べているが、対象国リストではケニアが含まれていない。DRCのエボラ発生が文脈の主題であり、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ケニアはホスト国だが対象国リストにないため除外。本イベントは国際的なエボラ対応の重要な段階を示しており、DRCのエボラ流行とセットで評価すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố người đàn ông mua heo bị dịch tả về mổ đem ra chợ bán
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man charged with buying swine fever-infected pigs, slaughtering them, and selling them at the market.
article.articleSummary: In Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, 58-year-old Nguyen Huu Cuong was charged on May 29, 2026, with food-safety violations for buying swine fever–infected pigs, slaughtering them at his home, freezing the meat, and selling it to traders in Thach Ha, Can Loc, Viet Xuyen and nearby markets. The case followed an May 11 operation that found D.V.T. delivering diseased pigs to Cuong. Police raided Cuong’s premises, seizing one live pig and 500 kg of pork, bones, and offal stored in freezers. Laboratory tests confirmed African swine fever virus in all pigs and products. Since early 2026, Cuong is accused of exploiting outbreaks to acquire sick pigs cheaply and market them as food, risking public health. Authorities urged consumers to source meat with clear origin and proper inspection. Separately, Thanh Hoa police (April 30) charged three suspects in a related case involving selling ASF-infected pigs.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱感染豚を購入・解体し市場で販売した男性を起訴
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）感染豚の違法販売という異常かつ重大な食品安全事案で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク（汚染食肉の流通）、国際的拡大の可能性がある。2つ以上のIHR基準と複数のWPRO基準に該当する。
triage.notes: ハティン省での違法な感染豚処理・販売事件は食品サプライチェーンを通じた大規模汚染リスクを示唆。複数の類似事件の報告（タインホア省）がASF関連の食品犯罪の組織的パターンを示唆している。冷凍保存された汚染肉（500kg）が複数市場に流通したことが確認されており、ヒトへの暴露リスクが高い。東南アジア地域での動物疾病のコントロール不備と動物-ヒト境界での食品安全問題として重大。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebola kan stoppas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola can be stopped.
article.articleSummary: Ebola can be stopped, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, where an Ebola outbreak is ongoing. He says the disease can be halted, but the WHO does not support travel bans, arguing they do not significantly reduce transmission. As of May 29, 2026, the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 10 laboratory-confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected Ebola deaths since the mid-May outbreak was first identified. The statements come amid the disease's presence in Kinshasa, highlighting the need for rapid response, case finding, isolation, and safe management of patients. The brief notes no further details on symptoms or infection source are provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラは阻止可能
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国キンシャサでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確認死者10名、疑い患者233名）は、IHR Annex2基準3項目以上を満たし、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクがあるシグナルとして識別。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を有し、キンシャサでの地域感染確認により国際的拡大懸念が高い。WHO事務局長の現地到着と『渡航禁止は支持しない』という言及から、国際的な関心と懸念が高まっている状況が明確。記事サマリーは感染源や症状の詳細が限定的であるが、公式発表に基づく確定情報であるため信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Boinas-azuis da RD Congo marcam Dia Internacional combatendo ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Blue Helmets of DR Congo mark International Day for the Fight Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: On May 29, the UN marks the International Day of UN Peacekeepers under the theme Invest in Peace. More than 4,500 peacekeepers have died since 1948, with 59 in the last year. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, MONUSCO, led by Brazilian General Ulisses Gomes, coordinates a security-humanitarian Ebola response in Ituri's Bunia, the outbreak epicenter. The mission protects civilians and health facilities, intensifies day and night operations, and supports clinics to prevent crowding near hospitals. A high-engineering logistics push, in coordination with WHO and Congolese authorities, includes ground mobility for rapid patient and contact tracing, plus air support with a helicopter and ambulances and armored vehicles for evacuations. Movement restrictions pose challenges, while peacekeepers counter misinformation through community engagement. MONUSCO supplied motorcycles to WHO to reach isolated areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのブルーヘルメット、エボラ対策の国際デーを記念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。DRCにおけるエボラ発生の継続・国際支援状況を示す重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州Bunia）のエボラ発生に焦点を当てており、UN平和維持活動とWHO連携による対応状況が詳述されている。Brazilが発生地域に含まれているのは、MONUSCO司令官がブラジル人将軍であることに由来するもので、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCのみ。継続的な感染リスク、地域内の移動制限による管理課題、偽情報対策の必要性が示唆されている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: USA otworzą w Kenii ośrodek kwarantanny dla Amerykanów narażonych na ebolę
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States will open a quarantine center in Kenya for Americans exposed to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola preparedness facility at Nanyuki airbase, Kenya, opens Friday to quarantine asymptomatic Americans exposed to Ebola; symptomatic individuals will be sent to a third country, not the United States. The center will initially hold 50 people, with room to expand, staffed by U.S. health personnel; the United Kingdom is interested in access. The administration aims to keep Ebola cases outside the United States. The U.S. will allocate $13.5 million to Kenya for Ebola readiness. Rubio and President Ruto discussed the outbreak; U.S. entry screening for travelers from Africa was tightened. In DR Congo, authorities report a new Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak; WHO has declared it a PHEIC. Current strain's fatality around 50%; over 900 suspected cases and ~220 deaths. Ebola spreads by direct contact with blood, secretions, and excreta; no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアでエボラウイルスに曝露したアメリカ人のための隔離センターを開設
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の新規発生が公式にPHEIC宣言されており、国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での対応実施、死亡者が確認されている深刻な事態。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでコンゴ民主共和国における新規エボラ出血熱感染症流行が明記されており、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。致死率約50%、疑い例900例以上、死亡者約220名。ケニアでの隔離施設開設は対応措置であり、発生地はコンゴ民主共和国。米国・英国・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Der Tag: Rituale und Unglaube erschweren Ebola-Bekämpfung im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Day: Rituals and disbelief hinder Ebola response in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Ituri region of eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is hampered by fear, mistrust, and adherence to traditional rituals. Aid organizations report that many locals doubt the illness or consider it invented, with about one third of people in Ituri believing Ebola is a myth. Quarantine, isolation, and security requirements for burials meet resistance, as families often refuse to leave the sick alone or forego customary farewell rites. In response, aid workers are conducting intensive door-to-door education to counter misinformation and promote adherence to containment measures. The situation underscores how social and cultural factors can delay outbreak response, highlighting the need for community engagement to improve acceptance of isolation and safe burial practices. Published 2026-05-29.

triage.headline_ja: その日のニュース：儀式と不信がコンゴでのエボラ対応を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行がDRCで継続中であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。重症度が高く、国際的拡大リスクがある重大な感染症事象として、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Ituri地域における進行中のエボラ流行。社会文化的要因（儀式、不信、誤情報）が対応を著しく阻害している。地域住民の約3分の1がエボラを神話と考えており、隔離・安全な埋葬慣行の遵守に極めて深刻な課題あり。援助機関による集中的な啓発活動が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 美国在肯尼亚设埃博拉隔离中心　确诊将送第3国治疗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US Sets Up Ebola Isolation Center in Kenya; Confirmed Cases Will Be Sent to a Third Country for Treatment
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, the United States will activate a dedicated Ebola isolation facility at Laikipia Air Base in Kenya to quarantine American citizens potentially exposed to Bundibugyo Ebola virus. If symptoms or positive tests occur, patients will not be repatriated but treated at the site and then transferred to a European medical center for care. The center starts with 50 isolation beds and plans to add three isolation units (12 beds) and two biosafety units (4 beds). Staffing will come from U.S. clinicians en route to Kenya. The aim is to shorten transport times to advanced care. Kenya’s government was reportedly consulted and pre-approved; a Kenyan rights group has filed suit alleging unilateral and secret planning. The U.S. pledges $13.5 million in Ebola prevention aid to Kenya. WHO cites ongoing Congo (Kinshasa) Ebola outbreaks with over 1,000 confirmed/suspected cases and 10 confirmed deaths, 223 suspected deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアにエボラ隔離センターを設置　確定患者は第3国で治療へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、深刻な公衆衛生影響（DRC継続的流行、1000以上の確定/疑い例、死亡者あり）と国際的な懸念（米国による海外隔離施設設置、欧州医療機関への移送）が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・管理可能性・異常性が該当する。社会的・政治的関心も高い（国家間の医療対応、市民権グループの訴訟）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に言及されているのはDRC（キンシャサ）での継続的なエボラ流行（1000以上の確定/疑い例、死亡者あり）とケニアでの米国隔離施設設置である。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo Ebola virus の言及と国家間の医療対応体制の構築は異常性と管理可能性の課題を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda closes DRC border as deadly Ebola outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Uganda closed its land and air border with the Democratic Republic of Congo with immediate effect to curb spillover of an Ebola outbreak centered in eastern DRC's Ituri province. The measure allows only authorised Ebola response teams, humanitarian operations, and goods/transport with strict health screening. Anyone entering Uganda from DRC must undergo 21 days of mandatory isolation, with locator phone systems at borders and airports to support tracing. Uganda has recorded seven Ebola cases and one death linked to Bundibugyo virus disease; the first imported patient died in Kampala on May 14 before lab confirmation. The outbreaks were declared on May 15 after confirmation of the Bundibugyo strain. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; early supportive care, surveillance, isolation, and contact tracing are central. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; travel bans are cautioned against.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の致命的な流行が広がる中、DRCとの国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPRSO基準も5項目すべてに該当する。WHOが国際的懸念事項(PHEIC)を宣言しており、複数国に跨る致命的なエボラアウトブレークとして高度なリスクを示す。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ(226074)も含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは国際的なスピルオーバー対策を実施する国として位置づけられており、一次感染地はDRCのイトゥリ州である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOがPHEICを宣言した点が重要であり、フルのRRA実施が必須である。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تؤكد إمكانية احتواء "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms the possibility of containing Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province in the north-eastern region, can be contained. The response is led as the outbreak has killed more than 200 people. He travels to Ituri to oversee control measures and reaffirmed that WHO does not support travel bans to curb the spread, promising full assistance to Congo. As of May 24, WHO reported 10 laboratory-confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths due to Ebola since the mid-May outbreak, derived from over 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases overall.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の封じ込め可能性を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は死亡例200人以上、1,000件以上の確定・疑定例を伴う深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限に関連する国際的関心を伴う。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク。2026年5月中旬以降、確定・疑定例1,000件以上、死亡233例（確定10例、疑定223例）が報告されている。Ituri州北東部が中心。WHO事務局長が現地視察し、全面的支援を約束。WHO渡航禁止制度見直しの国際政治的文脈も含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: BKK Pangkalpinang cek kesehatan nakhoda dan ABK cegah virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BKK Pangkalpinang checks the health of the captain and crew to prevent the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Pangkalpinang's Class II Health Quarantine Center (BKK) intensified health checks for ship captains (nakhoda) and crew (ABK) at ports of the Bangka Belitung Islands Province (Babel) to prevent Ebola virus entry from international voyages. No captains or ABK involved with cargo or fish have been found suspected of Ebola infection to date. Health screening includes temperature, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and respiratory assessment, plus a questionnaire on destinations and activities abroad. If a traveler records a temperature above 38°C or Ebola symptoms, they will be referred to a designated hospital for further management. The program covers all Babel ports, including Pangkalbalam, Tanjung Gudang, Tanjung Pandan, and Tanjung Kalian, and also extends to cruise ship passengers docking in Bangka Belitung waters, in response to the WHO's global Ebola emergency status tied to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: パンカルピナン保健検疫センターがエボラウイルス予防のため船長および船員の健康状態をチェック
triage.triage_reason: エボラの国際的な懸念（DRC発生源）による予防的対応だが、インドネシアでの疑似症例はなく、実際の感染イベント発生ではなく監視強化の段階。情報不足のため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 記事は実際のエボラ症例発生ではなく、DRCのエボラ発生に対応した予防的な港湾衛生スクリーニング強化を報告しているもの。インドネシアでの症例は報告されていない。IHR基準2つ以上該当するが、WPRO基準は1つのみで、実際の感染イベントではなく予防的対応のため、フルRRA段階ではなく継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Virus Ebola, BKK Pangkalpinang Cek Kesehatan Nakhoda dan ABK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus Alert: Pangkalpinang BKK Checks the Health of the Captain and the Crew.
article.articleSummary: Pangkalpinang’s Balai Karantina Kesehatan Kelas II intensifies health screening of ship captains and crew at Pangkalbalam Port and other Babel ports (Pangkalpinang, Bangka Belitung Islands) to prevent Ebola entry, in response to WHO declaring a global Ebola emergency linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 2026-05-29, no captains or crew aboard cargo and fishing vessels show signs of Ebola infection. Screenings target captains and ABK aboard docking ships, including at Pangkalbalam, Tanjung Gudang, Tanjung Pandan, and Tanjung Kalian. Assessments include temperature, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and respiration, plus interviews about overseas travel and activities abroad. If a fever above 38°C or Ebola symptoms are detected, individuals will receive further treatment and be referred to a designated hospital to prevent transmission. Measures are conducted by M. Leo Arybowo, head of Team 4, BKK Pangkalpinang.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス警戒：パンカルピナン港湾検疫所が船長と乗組員の健康チェックを実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生リスクを持つ疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国でのWHO宣言された世界的緊急事態への対応として、インドネシアが検疫体制を強化している状況。IHR基準で「深刻な影響」「予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、スクリーニング基準でも複数項目が該当するためピックアップが妥当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、インドネシア（バンカ・ブリトゥン州パンカルピナン）が検疫強化を実施しており、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ世界的緊急事態宣言への対応が背景にある。現在のところ港湾の船長・乗組員からは感染者は報告されていないが、国際海運を通じた感染症伝播リスク管理の観点から重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Returns To A Broken Congo, This Time With Virus Science Isn't Ready For
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Mongbwalu (Ituri province), declared May 2026 and now labeled a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO. The strain is Bundibugyo, rarer with no approved vaccine, no targeted treatment, and no rapid diagnostic test specific to it. More than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases and hundreds of deaths reported; real numbers likely higher. Symptoms begin with fever and can progress to haemorrhage, isolation, and death. MSF and the Congolese Ministry of Health, with WHO support, are scaling up response, establishing a 60-bed Ebola treatment center in Mongbwalu and reinforcing isolation, contact tracing, laboratory support, safe and dignified burials, and community engagement. Ongoing Congo health crisis and conflict/displacement hamper surveillance and timely care; malaria, measles, malnutrition persist, complicating response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴに再度到来、今回は科学が対応できないウイルス株
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラのPHEIC宣言、1,000件以上の確診・疑い例と数百名の死亡、ワクチンなし、診断法なしの対応困難な状況、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによる公式対応が進行中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は稀な株で、既承認ワクチン、特異的治療法、迅速診断検査がいずれも欠如している。WHO PHEC宣言済み。基礎的な保健システム崩壊、紛争による人口移動、マラリア・はしか・栄養不良の同時流行が対応を複雑化させている。MSF、コンゴ保健省、WHO連携による60床のETC設営予定だが、実際の感染者数はより多い可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: "Η κατάσταση είναι εκτός ελέγχου" - Γιατροί μιλούν για πρώτη φορά για την επιδημία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "The situation is out of control" - Doctors speak for the first time about the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province (Bunia and Mongbualu). The Bundibugyo variant has over 1,000 suspected cases and more than 230 suspected deaths; seven confirmed cases have been detected in neighboring Uganda. WHO recently designated the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Transmission is accelerating exponentially, with seven suspected Ebola patients escaping from a hospital, fueling transmission chains. Laboratory capacity is severely limited, delaying diagnoses and contact tracing as patients wait days for results amid widespread distrust. Isolation facilities have been burned and security around hospitals tightened. Severe shortages of masks, PPE, and trained personnel persist, worsened by funding cuts from USAID and reduced support from CDC/WHO; there is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo. Authorities suspect origins in Ituri with undetected circulation for about three months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：「状況は制御不能である」 - 医師たちが初めて流行について語る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で1,000例以上の疑似患者、230例以上の死亡、確定患者の隣国ウガンダへの確認。WHO が国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として指定。制御困難な状況と記載されており、複数国への拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダで確定患者が検出されたことが言及されているが、主要な流行地はDRCのイトゥリ州（ブニア）であり、ウガンダは隣国で数例の確定患者のみのため、主要な発生地はDRCのみとした。WHO による PHEIC 指定、Bundibugyo 亜型による大規模流行、病院からの患者脱出による伝播加速、医療施設への放火、深刻なPPE不足、ワクチン未承認など、制御困難な複数の要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief says Ebola testing being scaled up in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is seeing scaled-up diagnostic testing as the World Health Organization and the country's national medical research organization bolster lab capacity to contain transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, via X, said the initiative will strengthen the laboratory network to deliver real-time data, rapidly confirm cases, and save lives. The partnership focuses on expanding diagnostic capabilities, improving surveillance, and accelerating confirmation of suspected infections to inform timely public health actions. The report does not provide updated case or death counts. This effort reflects ongoing international and national collaboration to enhance outbreak response in the DRC, with emphasis on laboratory confirmation and rapid reporting to support containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴでのエボラ検査の拡大を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認患者が発生しており、国際機関（WHO）が関与した対応が進行中。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と予想外性が認められ、IHR基準を満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生は確認されており、WHO事務局長による公開声明がある。記事は現在の検査スケールアップ対応に焦点。具体的な患者数・死亡数は記載されていないが、進行中のアウトブレイク対応の存在が明らかであり、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les États-Unis renforcent leur soutien à la RDC et à l'Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the United States steps up its support for the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts intensified international response as the United States pledges $80 million to bolster the response in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, bringing bilateral aid to over $112 million in under two weeks. The funding backs a rapid, coordinated global effort to contain the virus at its source, protect local populations, and prevent cross-border spread. Key allocations fund PPE procurement and distribution for health workers in partnership with UNICEF and the World Food Programme; border health screening with IOM; epidemiological surveillance; and community outreach. Separately, $50 million is earmarked for UN OCHA to back the establishment of specialized care centers in affected areas. U.S. teams are deployed to health facilities in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu to strengthen treatment capacity. Washington also pledges $300 million in broader humanitarian aid via OCHA for urgent regional needs.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：米国、DRCとウガンダへの支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルスは重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限の対象となる可能性がある。複数国での発生、米国による大規模支援表明、WHO通知レベルの事案。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（南キブ州、イトゥリ州を含む）とウガンダでのエボラ発生が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。米国の大規模資金支援（$80百万+$300百万）表明があり、国際的な関心が極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國爆發伊波拉疫情　恐懼與否認情緒籠罩災區 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Fear and denial grip the affected areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches its 17th national outbreak, with over 200 deaths reported. In Mongbwalu, 322 suspected infections and at least 88 deaths have been recorded locally, amid the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization has declared the situation a public health emergency of international concern, highlighting a widening crisis. Contributing factors include severe gaps in medical resources, longstanding distrust of the government, and conflict, fueling denial and fear that Ebola is not real. A 'coffin incident'—a deceased individual transported 80 kilometers in a coffin that broke—raised concerns about further spread. MSF notes testing capacity is limited and official death tolls are likely underestimated. Local leaders warn that denial will impede prevention and risk cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が発生　恐怖と否認が被災地を支配
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）と宣言済み。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスであり、ライセンス取得済みワクチンがない。医療資源の深刻な不足、政府への不信、武力紛争が対応を複雑化させている。越境感染のリスク高い。MSFによると実際の死亡数は公式発表より多い可能性。

article.articleHeadline: خطرٌ صحّي يُقلق العالم... فماذا عن لبنان؟ - جريدة الأنباء الإلكترونية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A health threat that worries the world... what about Lebanon?
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Ebola virus disease is prompting concern as cases are reported in Africa, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, raising questions in Lebanon ahead of summer travel by Lebanese expatriates returning from Africa. Lebanese infectious-disease experts say Lebanon remains at low risk for transmission, with no large outbreak declared by the World Health Organization (WHO). Confirmed infections are limited and localized, with few positives among those tested. The WHO has issued an alert rather than declaring widespread transmission, underscoring the need for preparedness. Lebanon’s Ministry of Health and Ministry of Foreign Affairs are monitoring the situation and coordinating with WHO. Authorities emphasize daily surveillance, training of healthcare workers, and readiness to implement measures if the situation evolves. There is currently no danger to the Lebanese public, and officials urge calm while maintaining vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 世界を懸念させる健康上の脅威...レバノンはどうか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）で報告されており、国際的拡大リスク（レバノン内での懸念表明）が存在するが、WHOは大規模発生を宣言しておらず、現在のリスクは限定的である。記事サマリーから実際の確認感染数は限定的で、対象国（DRC）での発生は確認されるが、全体的な疫学情報と管理状況が確定していないため、続報を注視する段階。
