triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUgandaとLebanonが含まれているが、サマリーより実際の感染発生はDRCとUgandaに限定されている。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Lebanonは懸念・監視対象として言及されているが、実際の発生地ではなく、対象国でもないため除外。IHR基準で2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも2つ以上該当しているが、WHOが大規模発生を宣言していない点、感染数が限定的である点から、WATCH段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Nations Implement Travel Restrictions Amid Ebola Concerns; US Expands Airport Health Screenings - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo variant outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with spread to Uganda and South Sudan has about 1,000 suspected cases and 228 probable deaths. Canada imposes a 90-day entry ban and 21-day quarantine for asymptomatic travelers who recently visited affected regions, starting May 30. The Bahamas enforces a 30-day entry ban with enhanced screening and possible quarantines for residents and visitors from DRC/Uganda/South Sudan within 30 days of arrival. In the United States, JFK, Dulles, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta, and George Bush Intercontinental airports will conduct enhanced screening for travelers from Ebola-affected countries, with Americans from DRC/Uganda/South Sudan rerouted to these hubs. CDC travel advisories: Level 3 for DRC (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu) and Level 2 for Uganda and South Sudan. A confirmed Bundibugyo-case, Dr. Peter Stafford, contracted in DRC and treated in Germany; his wife is negative and the family is quarantined. WHO says this is not a pandemic emergency; this is the 17th DRC outbreak since 1976 and follows larger 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ懸念の中で各国が渡航制限を実施; 米国が空港での健康スクリーニングを拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大の証拠、複数国による渡航制限実施）し、WPRO基準も全て該当。DRCでの多数の死亡例と複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはウガンダ、スーダン、米国、カナダ、バハマ、ドイツなども含まれているが、サマリーの主題となる実際の感染症アウトブレイク発生地はDRCが中心。ウガンダとスーダンへの拡大は記述されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。米国内での確認例は輸入例（ドイツで治療）の関連者のみで、米国での一次感染アウトブレイクではない。したがって評価対象はDRCのみ。国際的な渡航制限と空港スクリーニング強化により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的関心が明確に示されている。

article.articleHeadline: ভারতে আসা ২ জনের শরীরে ইবোলার উপসর্গ! হাই অ্যালার্ট এয়ারপোর্টে, চালু হল কোয়ারেন্টাইন রাখার ব্যবস্থাও
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people who arrived in India have Ebola symptoms! Quarantine measures have been put in place at the high-alert airport.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, India tightened Ebola surveillance after suspected cases at Bengaluru and Gujarat airports. In Bengaluru, a 28-year-old Ugandan woman was isolated; her Ebola test came back negative. No confirmed Ebola cases in India, but authorities continue strict monitoring for travelers from Africa. Airport health teams (APHO) are screening arrivals and isolating even mild-symptom cases, with samples sent to NIV Pune for testing. In Gujarat, a 37-year-old man, Amuri Lokula, who traveled from Africa via Bangladesh to Mumbai and then Vadodara, developed fever, sore throat, and cough. He was moved to an Ebola ward at Ahmedabad Civil Hospital and placed in quarantine; NIV Pune is processing his sample with results expected in 24–48 hours. WHO has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, prompting heightened vigilance nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: インドに到着した2人がエボラウイルス病の症状を示す！空港で高度警戒態勢、隔離措置も開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラは国際的に懸念される疾患であり、複数国との渡航歴を持つ疑い例が確認されている。WHO がPHEICを宣言している状況での検出事例。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドにおけるエボラの疑い例検出。ウガンダとバングラデシュが渡航経路として言及されているが、検出地点と検査実施地（NIV Pune）はインド国内。複数空港（ベンガルール、グジャラート州）での監視強化が報告されており、国内的には多地点での対応が進行中。ニパとエボラの両疾患が指定されているが、記事主題はエボラに集約されている。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS advierte desde la República Democrática del Congo sobre los peligros del "conflicto de seguridad" en la lucha contra el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns from the Democratic Republic of the Congo about the dangers of the "security conflict" in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is intensified by a persistent 'security conflict' causing widespread displacement and food insecurity, notably in Ituri and surrounding provinces, hindering containment efforts. The outbreak involves Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Bunia among affected sites. As of May 26, the DRC reports at least 121 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, including 17 deaths, and about 1,077 suspected cases with 238 deaths. Research shows ongoing vaccine and therapeutic development, but no immediate availability, and the Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no vaccine yet. The WHO stresses community engagement, transparency, and protection of health workers, and does not endorse travel bans, arguing they are ineffective and harmful to public health. International support is needed to reinforce the response and health system resilience.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がコンゴ民主共和国から警告：エボラ対策への「治安紛争」の危険性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：121確定例・238死亡疑い、予想外の治安悪化、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。国際支援の必要性明記。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の発生で、治安悪化による避難民・食糧不安が対策を阻害。現在のところワクチンなし。WHO事務局長の直接警告により国際的注目度が高い。DRC対象国であり地域検証済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ruto Forms Ebola Response Committee After U.S. Commits Ksh 1.7B Funding
article.articleSummary: Kenya forms a National Response Committee to coordinate Ebola preparedness after regional outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, led by Prime Cabinet Secretary Musalia Mudavadi. The committee will execute a whole-of-government and whole-of-society strategy to boost public awareness, preparedness, and mobilise technical and financial resources for any Ebola-related emergencies. The move follows a US pledge of about Ksh 1.74 billion to support Kenya’s Ebola preparedness after a May 28 call between President Ruto and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The plan coincides with controversy over a US-funded Ebola quarantine and treatment facility at Laikipia Air Base, prompting KMPDU demands for transparency and Katiba Institute to seek court intervention. A May 28 high-level meeting with international partners reaffirmed readiness and regional containment, with 26 entry points under surveillance. Over 58,000 travellers have been screened, all suspected cases testing negative. Kenya has 17 isolation centres and works with WHO, Africa CDC, and the UN to bolster surveillance, labs, cross-border coordination, and emergency response.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領、米国の16億7000万ケニア・シリング資金支援後にエボラ対応委員会を設立
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で5項目全て該当。地域でのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）に対応する公式な国家レベルの対応委員会設立であり、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: Laikipia（ケニア）はサマリーに記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダも同様。本記事の主題は、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク対応としてのケニアの準備体制であり、実際の発生は対象国内ではDRCのみ。米国の支援表明と国際的な関心の高さは顕著であり、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Americans exposed to Ebola to be sent to Kenya for quarantine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa epicenter, Ituri province) is the third-largest on record, with WHO declaring a public health emergency of international concern as the outbreak outpaces response. Since mid-May, 1,077 suspected cases have been reported and 121 are laboratory-confirmed; 246 suspected deaths with 17 confirmed fatalities. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is traveling to Kinshasa and Ituri to bolster response efforts. Travel measures intensify: the United States has temporarily barred entry of Green Card holders who have been in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within the prior 21 days to prevent importation. Kenya has approved a US-requested quarantine facility for Americans exposed to Ebola at a Laikipia air base, staffed by the US Public Health Service; Kenya had pushed for open access to all nationals. Experts warn such measures may deter responders, underscoring that containment hinges on rapid isolation and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスに曝露したアメリカ人はケニアの隔離施設に送られる予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）がコンゴで発生し、IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、1,000例超の疑い患者と100例以上の確定患者、複数国への渡航制限実施により、フルのRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ（キンシャサ・イトゥリ州）でのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。ケニアとウガンダは隔離施設受け入れ国・接近制限対象国として言及されているが、当該エボライベントの発生地域ではないため verified_locations から除外。スーダンも旅行制限対象国として言及されているが、記事サマリーに実際の発生地域として明記されていないため除外。対象国リストに該当する発生地はコンゴのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ определила методы лечения и потенциальные вакцины от штамма Бундибугйо лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Identifies Treatments and Potential Vaccines for the Bundibugyo Strain of Ebola Fever
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization identifies priority three experimental treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola: MBP134, maftivimab, and remdesivir, urging evaluation in clinical trials. Prophylaxis post-exposure centers on the oral antiviral remdesivir (Gilead), with effectiveness contingent on robust contact tracing. Among vaccines, the most promising is the single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo candidate, though trials likely won’t start for 7–9 months; another candidate, ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford University and Serum Institute of India), could enter testing in 2–3 months pending additional data. Ervebo, the only licensed Ebola vaccine, is not recommended for use outside research facilities due to limited protection against Bundibugyo. The report also considers monoclonal antibody–remdesivir combination therapy. The Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows about 900 cases and 220 deaths, with spread to Uganda (seven cases). Response lags: only 7% of 1,261 identified contacts traced; WHO later estimates over 2,000 contacts. Challenges include attacks on facilities, supply shortages, mistrust, and funding cuts following US withdrawal from WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株の治療法とワクチン候補を特定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行で900例・220死亡、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、渡航制限のリスクがあり、WHO報告として国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC内でのエボラ流行（900例、220死亡）とウガンダへの拡大（7例）が明記されている。Bluedot APIが米国とインドを発生地域に含めているが、サマリーではこれらの国での患者発生は報告されていない（WHO本部所在地や製薬企業の所在地として言及されているのみ）。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief Calls For Congo Ceasefire Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged armed groups in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to suspend hostilities to allow health teams to reach communities affected by an Ebola outbreak in Ituri province. The outbreak is driven mainly in Ituri, with more than 90% of reported cases linked to that province; additional infections have been reported in North Kivu and South Kivu. It is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, though early supportive care can save lives. Frontline health workers operate under insecurity, displacement, and attacks on facilities. Tedros commended community resilience and urged youth to spread prevention messages, including early reporting and treatment. Plans include a visit to Bunia as efforts intensify to prevent wider regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染拡大を受け、WHO事務局長がコンゴの停戦を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された感染拡大イベント（複数州での感染、ワクチンなし、地域的な感染環境の悪化）が報告されており、IHR基準3つ以上に該当し、国際的な保健対応の重要性が明白。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain（承認されたワクチンや治療法がない）による感染拡大。複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での報告あり。武装勢力による紛争環境下での公衆衛生対応という複合的リスク要因。WHO事務局長による直接的な呼びかけがなされており、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta desde RDC de los riesgos del "conflicto de seguridad" en la respuesta frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO warns from the DRC about the risks of the 'security conflict' in the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: The WHO warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is hampered by a ongoing security conflict, especially in Ituri and North and South Kivu, with hundreds of thousands displaced and rising food insecurity. As of May 26, the DRC reports 121 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths, plus 1,077 suspected cases and 238 associated deaths. Containment is challenged by instability and displacement, underscoring the need for community engagement, transparency, and local participation; Tedros visited Kinshasa and Bunia to assess field conditions. Vaccines and therapies are being accelerated, but for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain there is currently no vaccine. The WHO reiterates that travel bans are ineffective and can worsen public health, while Uganda closed its border with DRC and Ethiopia tightened entry controls. Health workers’ deaths are acknowledged, with calls to consider Ebola in febrile illnesses and to protect responders.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがRDCからエボラ対応における「セキュリティ紛争」のリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラの確認患者121例・死亡17例、疑い例1,077例・関連死亡238例の報告があり、Bundibugyo型に対するワクチンが未開発。セキュリティ紛争による対応阻害、近隣国の国境閉鎖・入国規制実施により、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが顕在化。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの発生が主題。UgandaおよびEthiopiaは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみ対象。DRC国内の複数州（South Kivu、Ituri、Kinshasa）での発生が報告されている。セキュリティ情勢による対応困難、ワクチン未開発株の流行、近隣国での対応措置実施がすべてIHR基準を満たす主要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: 童感冒三餐吃退燒藥仍無改善確診染B流　醫：流感已不分季節　 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Child with a cold still not improved after taking fever-reducing medicine with every meal, diagnosed with Influenza B; doctor: Flu is no longer seasonal.
article.articleSummary: A 7-year-old boy in Taiwan at Dajia Li General Hospital was diagnosed with Influenza B after a week of cough, runny nose, fever, and fatigue. Laboratory testing confirmed Influenza B; antiviral therapy was started. The mother had been giving fever-reducing medication at every meal, a practice cautioned against because fever reducers relieve symptoms for 4–6 hours, can mask clinical signs, and may burden the liver and kidneys. The doctor noted that influenza is no longer strictly seasonal and can present with rapid deterioration, including afternoon fever spikes and body aches. Public health advice emphasizes regular handwashing and keeping sick children home from school to prevent transmission; the patient’s sister was also infected. Early lab confirmation and adjusted antiviral treatment led to gradual symptom improvement.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもの風邪が毎食退熱薬でも改善せず、B型インフルエンザ確診　医師：インフルエンザはもはや季節限定ではない
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での個別事例報告であり、IHR基準は2つ以上該当しない。ただしインフルエンザB型の季節外発症と二次感染が示唆されており、地域での流行傾向把握のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 台湾での事例報告。記事サマリーから中国本土での発症とは明記されておらず、発生地域リストのHeilongjiang ShengおよびDajiaは地名の一致による誤検知と推定。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、検証済み位置には Taiwan を記載したが、SOP上の対象国（GeoNames ID指定）外であることに注意。インフルエンザB型の季節外発症が医学的に強調されており、地域流行監視の観点から継続注視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak fails to halt fierce fighting in eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to spread in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo as fighting between Kinshasa’s forces and AFC/M23 rebels intensifies in Masisi, North Kivu, with the town of Katoyi a flashpoint. The outbreak has reached North Kivu and South Kivu, with the health ministry reporting 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases as of May 23. Earlier in 2025 AFC/M23 captured Goma and Bukavu, illustrating the security backdrop to the outbreak. In Kisangani, capital of Tshopo, mortar fire targeted the airport, while local reports say two drones were intercepted; both sides accuse each other of deadly strikes on civilians. The Congolese army has deployed Turkish and Chinese drones to attack rebel positions, complicating containment and access to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が東部DRCの激しい戦闘を止められない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多地域での拡大（北キブ州・南キブ州）、204件の死亡報告、予想外の武装紛争との同時発生という異常事態。国際的な懸念と管理困難性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にアルメニアが含まれているが、記事サマリーにはアルメニアへの言及がないため除外。DRCの東部地域（北キブ州、南キブ州、トシポ州）での確認事例であり、武装紛争による保健対応の阻害が管理可能性を著しく低下させている。867件の疑似症例と204件の死亡確認は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲2國伊波拉疫情未歇！旅遊警示再升級　返台須自主健康管理21天 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in two African countries is not over yet! Travel advisory upgraded again; returning to Taiwan requires 21 days of self-health management.
article.articleSummary: On May 17, the World Health Organization declared Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Taiwan’s CDC elevated travel advisories for both countries to Warning (Level 3), tightening border controls and advising against nonessential travel. As of May 24, DRC reported 112 confirmed cases with 11 deaths, 906 suspected cases, and 223 suspected related deaths; one American diagnosed after exposure in a local facility. Uganda had 7 confirmed cases with 1 death, with several linked to the DRC outbreak. WHO assigns DRC risk as very high, Uganda and surrounding areas as high, and global risk as low. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials, not airborne. Arrivals from DRC/Uganda must self-manage 21 days, monitor temperature twice daily, and report via an online system; seek care if symptoms occur; noncompliance may incur penalties; call 1922 for assistance.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ2国のエボラ疫情は未だ終焉せず！渡航警告を再び引き上げ　台湾帰国者は21日間の自主健康管理が必須
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4つ全てに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の集団発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO既にPHEIC認定、複数国での確認例、死亡例あり。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ爆発を主題としているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当（ウガンダは対象国外）。米国およびタイワン記載は、単に台湾への帰還者管理や米国人の暴露事例言及であり、実際の流行地ではない。WHO既にPHEIC宣言済み。DRC内での接触感染リスク高く、国境管理強化されている状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Έμπολα: Συμπτώματα, θεραπεία και εμβόλια - cna.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Symptoms, treatment and vaccines - cna.gr.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17 after reports of an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, though it did not meet pandemic criteria. Ebola damages blood vessels and causes severe internal bleeding; transmission occurs from animals to humans and between people via contact with blood, organs, secretions, and other bodily fluids. Some forms are vaccine-preventable and treatable with drugs. The major strains discussed are Zaire ebolavirus and Sudan ebolavirus; Bundibugyo virus was identified in 2007. The 2014–2016 outbreak across DRC, Liberia, Guinea, and Sierra Leone recorded >28,600 cases and >10,000 deaths; 2018–2020 outbreaks reached Uganda and other nations with at least 2,000 deaths. Treatments include Ebanga and Inmazeb; Ervebo is approved in the US and EU (EU: age 1+, US: 18+). A Sudan virus vaccine trial began in Uganda in 2025 using an Ervebo-like design.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：症状、治療およびワクチン - cna.gr
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが2026年5月17日に国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言したエボラ（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の発生がDRCおよびウガンダで確認されており、国際的な拡大リスク、死亡例、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生について述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。USやアフリカ西部諸国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言という公式な国際的認識があり、ワクチンと治療法の進展も記述されている。歴史的には2014-2016年の大規模流行で28,600例以上、10,000例以上の死亡が記録されている。

article.articleHeadline: مدير "الصحة العالمية" يصل الكونغو ويتعهد باحتواء تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the World Health Organization arrives in Congo and pledges to contain an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to lead containment of the EBOLA outbreak centered in Ituri (Bunia). He pledged maximal effort and opposed travel bans as not essential. As of May 24, WHO reported 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths linked to more than 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases since the outbreak was declared on May 15. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the DRC, a mineral-rich, conflict-affected region that complicates response. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain; WHO advisory committees urged clinical trials, with an experimental vaccine candidate potentially ready by year-end per Africa CDC. Uganda closed its border with DRC after cases; the United States plans to deny entry to infected individuals and is coordinating care in Kenya. UNICEF will ship 100 tons of supplies; WHO delivered 4.6 tons to Bunia airport.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着、エボラ感染症の流行封じ込めを誓約
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。死亡者・確認患者が多数存在し、国境閉鎖・渡航制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の新規流行（DRC内での第17例）。2026年5月15日宣言、5月24日時点で確認死10件・疑い死223件・確認または疑い患者1000件以上。ウガンダが国境閉鎖、米国が入国制限を実施。ワクチン・治療法が未整備（Bundibugyo株）。紛争影響下の地域での対応の複雑さがある。WHO事務局長の現地入りと国際的支援体制の構築が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Come i tagli di Trump stanno complicando la lotta contro l'epidemia di ebola in Africa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How Trump's cuts are complicating the fight against the Ebola epidemic in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Trump-era funding cuts have jeopardized Ebola preparedness in Africa. NIH-backed CREID centers in West, East, and Central Africa received $82 million over five years, renewal due 2025, but a June suspension halted activities, labeling their pandemic-preparedness research unsafe for Americans and a poor use of taxpayer funds. Kristian Andersen of Scripps Research, who led a CREID center in West Africa, says he can no longer provide diagnostics or sequencing, leaving Congo’s Bundibugyo outbreak—different from Zaire—without essential reagents. Colleague Robert Garry of Tulane notes the loss of a network for rapid detection. CREID had developed reagents and tests now scarce in Congo; local authorities struggled to identify initial infections because tests targeted Zaire. EcoHealth Alliance, linked to COVID-19 lab-leak theories, has faced funding bans since Jan 2025. Uganda’s 2022 outbreak ended in four months due to swift local response; Kariuki Njenga led East and Central Africa CREID.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ氏のカット予算がアフリカのエボラ流行との戦いを複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行がコンゴで発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPRO基準（重症度、流行性、管理可能性の課題）も複数該当。診断体制・検査の機能不全は緊急対応を要するシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴのBundibugyo outbreak（エボラ）に焦点を当てている。ウガンダは2022年の過去の事例として言及されており、現在の主要な発生地はコンゴ。資金カット による診断体制崩壊は公衆衛生上の重大リスク。NIH-CREID中断は米国政治による国際保健脅威として注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Trump instrumentalise la santé publique tandis que l'épidémie d'Ebola se propage
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump instrumentalizes public health as the Ebola outbreak spreads.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo is spreading in Central Africa, and in May 2026 Washington bypassed conventional containment by invoking Title 42 to block entry of people who have recently stayed in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days; the rule is later extended to legal permanent residents. The move echoes the COVID-19-era use of Title 42, which expelled ~400,000 migrants under Trump and ~2.3 million more under Biden before its May 2023 expiration. Public health experts condemn the policy as non-specific and xenophobic. The administration has directed that Americans exposed to Ebola be quarantined and treated abroad, first in Kenya, with reports that a Kenyan Ebola treatment center is being established by State, Defense, and HHS and that dozens of U.S. health personnel are training for deployment. Some Americans and a physician were sent to Germany and the Czech Republic for monitoring; Kenya’s consent remains a prerequisite.

triage.headline_ja: トランプがエボラ流行の拡大に伴い公衆衛生を政治利用
triage.triage_reason: Ebola Bundibugyo の中央アフリカでの流行とアメリカの渡航制限措置が報告されており、IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・管理可能性の懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月時点の架空シナリオであるが、Ebola Bundibugyo が DRC で流行し、Kenya・Uganda・South Sudan への Title 42 渡航制限が実施される状況を記述。実際の流行国は DRC が特定される。Germany・Czech Republic・Kenya は治療・監視受け入れ国であり、発生地ではない。Washington DC の言及は政策立案地であり発生地ではない。対象国リストから DRC のみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: موقف المنتخب الكونغولى من المشاركة فى كأس العالم بعد انتشار إيبولا.. فيديو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congolese national team's stance on participating in the World Cup after the Ebola outbreak... Video - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: Video coverage reports the Democratic Republic of the Congo national football team remains committed to participating in the 2026 FIFA World Cup amid fears of an Ebola outbreak. The coverage, cited by Nahal Raafat, notes that the DRC federation continues preparations for the tournament with full adherence to FIFA health and safety protocols and guidance from US authorities. The squad will observe a 21-day quarantine before entering the United States. To minimize health risks, the federation has relocated its training camp from Kinshasa to a location outside the capital, ahead of travel to the United States, which co-hosts the World Cup with Canada and Mexico from June 11 to July 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のナショナルチームがエボラ流行後のワールドカップ参加表明...ビデオ - アルアハラム紙
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はスポーツ（サッカーワールドカップ）への参加表明を主題としており、感染症イベント自体の詳細な流行情報がない。エボラの具体的な症例数、死亡者、感染状況の記載がなく、感染症の公衆衛生的インパクトが明らかでない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国、カナダ、メキシコを発生地域に含めているが、これらはワールドカップの開催国であり、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCキンシャサのみ。本記事はスポーツニュースとしての関心が高いが、感染症の流行規模、症例数、死亡者、伝播状況など公衆衛生的に重要な情報が全く記載されていない。エボラ流行の詳細なシグナル情報がないため、この記事単独ではシグナルとして識別できない。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲2國伊波拉疫情未歇！旅遊警示再升級　返台須自主健康管理21天 - 健康新聞 - PChome Online 新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in two African countries continues! Travel advisory upgraded again; returning to Taiwan requires 21 days of self-health management.
article.articleSummary: WHO declared Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17. Taiwan’s CDC raised travel advisories to Warning and tightened border controls, urging avoidance of nonessential travel to both countries. By May 24, the DRC reported 112 confirmed Ebola cases with 11 deaths, 906 suspected cases, and 223 suspected related deaths; one American contracted the virus after exposure in a local facility. Uganda had 7 confirmed cases with 1 death, many linked to the Congo outbreak. Hotspots include Ituri, and North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. No licensed vaccine or specific antiviral exists; transmission is mainly through contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects, or exposure to wildlife reservoirs. Global risk is low; DRC risk very high; Uganda region high. Travelers from DRC/Uganda must self-manage health for 21 days on arrival, with TOCC screening and immediate transport for suspected cases; report symptoms or call 1922.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ2国のエボラ出血熱疫情が継続！渡航警告が再度引き上げられ、台湾帰国者は21日間の自主的健康管理が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項として宣言済み。DRCの死亡症例を含む確定患者112例、ウガンダでも確定患者報告あり。高い重症度と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱疫情について述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみ。サマリーで確認されている疫学情報：DRC 112確定例・11死亡、ウガンダ 7確定例・1死亡。米国人感染者も報告。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。台湾を含む複数国が渡航警告を発令・強化。ワクチンや特異的抗ウイルス薬は利用不可。早急なRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情延燒！疾管署提升旅遊警示至第3級，何謂伊波拉病毒？如何預防？一次解析！ - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to spread! Taiwan CDC raises travel advisory to Level 3. What is the Ebola virus? How can it be prevented? One-stop explainer! - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda led WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Taiwan’s CDC raised Level 3 travel advisory; travelers from DRC or Uganda must undergo entry screening and 21 days of self-health management, with penalties for non-compliance. On May 24, DRC reported 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, with 906 suspected cases. Uganda reported 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. WHO cautions infections may be higher. Transmission via contact with fruit bats or wildlife, and via blood, secretions, or bodies of infected people; early symptoms include high fever, fatigue, muscle pain, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding. Incubation is not infectious; contagion rises with illness. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu hotspots; border controls tightened; avoid travel to outbreak areas; practice hygiene, wear masks, and report symptoms with travel history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が拡大！台湾CDCが渡航警告を第3級に引き上げ。エボラウイルスとは？どのように予防するか？一度にわかる解説！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHO緊急事態宣言、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限）。エボラは高い重症度と感染性を持つ優先度の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を記述しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ含める。台湾は報道主体だが対象国ではない。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。South KivuおよびIturi州は確認地域として記事に明示されている。高い社会政治的関心（台湾CDC警告Level 3）と管理可能性の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: FG weighs flight restrictions, passenger isolation over health scare - The Sun Nigeria
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, Nigeria weighs flight restrictions from Ebola-affected countries and mandatory isolation for travellers showing symptoms as part of an Ebola preparedness review following fresh cases in DR Congo and Uganda. A high-level emergency meeting in Lagos discussed restricting flights from countries of concern, isolating symptomatic passengers, strengthening screening at airports and border points, and using cargo terminals/designated facilities for high-risk travelers. President Tinubu briefed; participants included Gbajabiamila (CoS), NCDC DG Dr Jide Idris, Interior Minister Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, Lagos Health Commissioner Prof Akin Abayomi. Idris warned Ebola has no treatment or vaccine; emphasis on public health measures: isolation, rapid detection, public awareness, infection prevention. Preparedness plans activated across all 36 states; health advisories for HCWs. WHO reports 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths in DR Congo since outbreak began mid-May, with >1,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：FGが健康上の懸念についての便制限と乗客隔離を検討 - ザ・サン・ナイジェリア
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規事例、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスクを持つ重篤感染症であり、複数国での事例とナイジェリアにおける予防措置の検討がフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはナイジェリアにおける予防措置とDRC・ウガンダでの事例について述べているが、対象国リスト内で感染症イベントが実際に発生しているのはDRCのみ（1,233確認死亡・疑い例、5月中旬以降）。ナイジェリアはアフリカの対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダも対象国外。ただしナイジェリアの政府対応と国際的関心の高さから、本イベントはWHO通知相当のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Širi se rijedak i smrtonosan soj ebole, sve više zemalja uvodi karantin i zabranu putovanja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rare and deadly strain of Ebola is spreading, with more and more countries imposing quarantine and travel bans.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of a rare, highly deadly Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, triggering urgent global action. The World Health Organization reports 220 suspected Ebola-related deaths and 900 suspected cases linked to the Bundibugyo (BVD) strain in the DRC, while Uganda has confirmed its first fatalities. Consequently, national risk levels have been raised to 'very high' in Uganda, and several countries have imposed quarantine and travel bans to curb cross-border transmission. The report highlights intensified public health measures and international concern amid the cross-border spread. No further details are provided on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or exact infection sources in the article. As of 2026-05-29.

triage.headline_ja: 稀で致命的なエボラウイルスの株が拡大、ますます多くの国が検疫と渡航禁止を導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：220件の死亡と900件の疑い例、異常性：稀なBundibugyo株、国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダで確認、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Tang Plaza, Bugis Junction and ICA building added to list of places visited by COVID-19 cases while infectious
article.articleSummary: Singapore added 21 new locations to the list of places visited by COVID-19 cases during their infectious period, including OCBC Bank at City Square Mall, KFC at West Mall, Bugis Junction, Tangs department store at Tang Plaza, the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) building, Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre and Market, and Chinatown Complex and Food Centre. MOH advised close contacts would be notified; others who were at these venues during the specified times should monitor health for 14 days from the visit and seek medical attention promptly if they develop acute respiratory symptoms (cough, sore throat, runny nose), fever, or loss of taste or smell, informing the doctor of exposure. There is no need to avoid places visited by confirmed cases. NEA will coordinate cleaning guidance with premises. As of 2026-05-29, Singapore reported 170 new COVID-19 infections, including 24 community cases (15 linked to clusters), 1 imported case—work pass holder who returned from India—and the remainder being work permit holders in foreign worker dormitories.

triage.headline_ja: タン・プラザ、ブギス・ジャンクション、ICA庁舎がCOVID-19感染者の感染期間中の訪問場所リストに追加
triage.triage_reason: シンガポールでの感染者の活動履歴報告に過ぎず、新たな異常、重症度、国際的拡大のリスクなど、シグナル化するべき特徴を認めない。2026年時点で世界的にCOVID-19は通常化しており、定常的な感染症対応の報告である。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はシンガポールでの日常的な感染者追跡・公開情報の通知であり、シグナルではない。インドは1例の輸入症例の来源地として言及されているのみで、インド国内での発生ではない。2026年時点でCOVID-19の定常化を考慮すると、トリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Legisladores piden blindar sistema de salud en México ante amenaza del ébola - Siete24 Noticias con proposito y sentido humano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lawmakers Call to Fortify Mexico's Health System in the Face of the Ebola Threat - Siete24 News with Purpose and a Sense of Humanity.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu) and Uganda prompts renewed health-system preparedness. DRC reports 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths, with 121 confirmed; the Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO has raised regional risk to very high, and Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus will travel to Kinshasa to oversee the response. Mexico City lawmakers urge federal and city authorities to bolster hospital capacity, beds, medicines, and epidemiological surveillance at international airports ahead of World Cup 2026 to prevent importation amid mass tourism. US authorities tighten entry checks for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, routing them to Washington, Atlanta, and Houston for medical screening; Kenya may host a quarantine center as a preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコの議員たちがエボラ脅威に直面してメキシコの医療体制を強化するよう要求 - Siete24ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ発症の公衆衛生への深刻な影響、地域としては異常、国際的拡大リスク（米国での検疫、メキシコでの警戒）、および渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ発症（1,077疑い症例、238疑い死亡、121確診）は対象国リストに該当。米国やメキシコでの対応記事だが、実際の発症地はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo株でワクチン未承認、WHOが地域リスクを非常に高いと評価、WHO事務局長のキンシャサ訪問予定あり。2026年ワールドカップ開催地メキシコでの準備体制強化が報道焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Plecat de urgență în Republica Democratică Congo, directorul OMS afirmă că epidemia de Ebola "poate fi oprită" - Aktual24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently departed for the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the WHO director says that the Ebola outbreak 'can be stopped' - Aktual24.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, is potentially controllable, per WHO Director Tedros upon arriving in Kinshasa. As of May 24, the officially declared outbreak (May 15) has exceeded 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases, with 10 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist yet. WHO expert groups have recommended initiating clinical studies to test vaccines and experimental therapies, with a vaccine possibly available by year-end if trials progress. The conflict and population displacement in Ituri hinder surveillance and case isolation. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC; the 2018–2020 epidemic was the worst, causing nearly 2,300 deaths. Uganda closed its border; the United States is banning entry of infected individuals and weighing a Kenya treatment unit. WHO delivered 4.6 tons of aid to Bunia; UNICEF supplied 100 tons of materials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行対策のため緊急にコンゴ民主共和国へ向かったWHO事務局長「流行は抑止可能」と表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で1,000例超、政府間の対応強化、国際支援体制も始動している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した発生地域にはUSA、Uganda、Kenyaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（イトゥリ州・キンシャサ）での流行であり、これらの国は国境閉鎖や対応準備段階に過ぎないため verified_locations から除外した。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・既承認治療が存在せず、Ituri地域の紛争による監視・隔離の困難さが懸念点。DRC以外の対象国リストに該当する国は無い。

article.articleHeadline: Mumbai Dengue Malaria: मुंबईत आढळल्या डेंग्यू, मलेरिया पसरवणाऱ्या डासांच्या अळ्या!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mumbai Dengue Malaria: Larvae of dengue- and malaria-spreading mosquitoes found in Mumbai!
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, dengue and malaria vector larvae were found across Mumbai city and suburbs, with Aedes aegypti larvae detected at 37,800 sites and Anopheles stephensi larvae at 4,529 sites. Immediate larval elimination followed, including fogging and insecticide spraying across 3,017,000 households. Over about five months, the Mumbai Municipal Corporation's Pest Control Department covered all 26 administrative zones, visiting 22,080 areas. In total, 3,251,623 households were inspected. The findings underscore ongoing dengue and malaria transmission risk in urban Mumbai, necessitating sustained vector-control measures. Authorities have intensified efforts to remove larvae and carry out fumigation in affected areas. Public health authorities warned of rising risk.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイのデング熱・マラリア：デング熱およびマラリア伝播蚊の幼虫がムンバイで発見された！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常・予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」が該当（2つ以上）。WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行性」「管理可能性」の複数基準に合致。インドの主要都市での大規模なベクター検出と公衆衛生的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: ムンバイ市内でAedes aegyptiが37,800箇所、Anopheles stephensiが4,529箇所で検出。過去5ヶ月間で326万戸以上が検査されており、都市部での持続的なベクター感染リスク警告がなされている。公式当局が感染リスク上昇を警告しており、社会政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Unicef anuncia la llegada de más de 100 toneladas de ayuda a RDC con apoyo de la UE para hacer frente al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF announces the arrival of more than 100 tons of aid to the DRC with EU support to tackle Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF announced arrival of more than 100 tons of Ebola response supplies to the Democratic Republic of Congo, supported by the EU, to bolster the northeast outbreak. The cargo includes personal protective equipment for frontline health workers, medicines, hygiene materials, and medical supplies. The aid targets Ituri province, whose capital Bunia is among the hardest-hit areas. UNICEF Bunia representative John Agbor warned authorities and response partners are in a race against time to protect responders and communities, including children. Gilles Fagninou, UNICEF regional director for West and Central Africa, emphasized risk communication and community engagement as core pillars to improve awareness, early detection, and safe practices. Government figures up to 26 May report 121 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths, 1,077 suspected cases and 238 associated deaths.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEFがEU支援によりコンゴ民主共和国へ100トン以上のエボラ対策支援物資の到着を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重篤で致死的な感染症であり、DRCのイトゥリ州での継続的な発生状況は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な支援ニーズを示している。IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準（重症度、管理可能性）も該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の新規発生はIHR Annex2の全4基準に該当する。記事では確認症例121件、死亡17件、疑い症例1,077件、関連死亡238件が報告されており、重症度が高い。国際的な支援（EU、UNICEF）が既に動員されていることは管理可能性の問題を示唆している。フルRRAの実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: مدير "الصحة العالمية" يصل الكونغو ويتعهد باحتواء تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director of the World Health Organization arrives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and pledges to contain the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa and plans to travel to Ituri in the northeast, where the current outbreak is centered. He pledged to do everything possible to contain the outbreak and stated that travel restrictions are not helpful. As of May 24, 2026, WHO data report 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15, from more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, a country with over 100 million people. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is currently no licensed vaccine or treatment for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）事務局長がコンゴに到着し、エボラ出血熱の流行封じ込めを約束
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。223人の死亡者を含む1,000件以上の確認例・疑い例を伴う活発なエボラ出血熱流行。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株であり、既知のワクチンや治療法がない。WHO事務局長が直接現地に派遣されている点も深刻性を示唆。2026年5月15日の流行宣言から急速に感染例が増加している。

article.articleHeadline: Xuất hiện Ebola chủng mới bùng phát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola Strain Outbreak Emerges
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo escalates. As of May 24, 2026, the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak has reported more than 1,000 cases, 10 deaths, and 223 suspected infections, with transmission centered in Bunia, Ituri Province, a long‑running conflict zone. On May 28, the World Health Organization warned of a severe outbreak and urged urgent clinical testing of candidate countermeasures, including two monoclonal antibodies, two vaccines, and two antiviral drugs, given there is no approved specific treatment. In the meantime, core public health measures—contact tracing, isolation, rapid testing, and large-scale UN relief shipments—are being deployed to contain spread. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Bunia to demand a ceasefire to enable a more effective response.

triage.headline_ja: 新型エボラウイルス株の流行が出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、エボラ出血熱の新株による大規模流行（1,000例超、死亡例あり）が報告されている。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）での第17回エボラ流行を明確に報告。Bundibugyo株による1,000例超の報告患者数、死亡例、広範な疑い例が確認されている。WHO総長による現地訪問および国際的な対応が展開中であり、社会政治的関心も極めて高い。紛争地域での流行制御の困難性も評価対象。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയെ വിഴുങ്ങി എബോള; മുന്നണിപ്പോരാളികള്‍ കൂട്ടത്തോടെ മരണത്തിന് കീഴടങ്ങുന്നു; വിദേശസഹായം നിലച്ചതോടെ വന്‍ പ്രതിസന്ധി | news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola engulfs Congo; frontline fighters are dying in large numbers; a major crisis as foreign aid halts.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies, hitting Ituri province around Bunia. At Bunia Medical Center, four healthcare workers died in four days, including a doctor who had recently graduated; a second doctor also died soon after, with others infected. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo since 1976 and is driven by a new viral variant. Testing capacity is insufficient, complicating accurate tallies. As of May 25, 2026, authorities report more than 900 suspected cases and 220 deaths across Nord Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri. The health system, already strained by a decline in international aid, risks further collapse; WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is slated to visit to assess response. Three Congo Red Cross volunteers serving in Ituri's Bunia area have also died in the past 11 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴを飲み込むエボラ；前線で働く医療従事者が大量に死亡；外国援助が途絶えたことで深刻な危機へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性）。WPRO基準5項目すべて該当。17番目のエボラアウトブレイク、新規ウイルス変異株、既に900以上の疑い患者と220名の死亡、医療システム崩壊リスク、WHO事務局長の訪問予定により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 新規ウイルス変異株によるエボラアウトブレイク。Ituri、Nord Kivu、South Kivu州にまたがる多地域発生。医療従事者の高い致死率（Bunia Medical Centerで4日間に4名の医療従事者死亡、医師2名含む）。国際援助の減少により医療システムの崩壊リスク高い。WHO事務局長による現地視察予定。testing capacityの不足により正確な患者数把握が困難。緊急対応が必要。

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の発生がインドへの渡航勧告をトリガー
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。インドでエボラ疑い患者が検出され、DRC等アフリカの流行地域からの入国者スクリーニングが実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）でのエボラ流行に対するインドの対応を記述。インドでは確定患者なし（現在のところ）だが、ベンガルール・アーメダバードで疑い患者が報告され、検疫・監視が実施中。Bundibugyo型はワクチン未承認。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。

article.articleHeadline: Rubio, Ruto Discuss Ebola Response as US Commits Sh1.7 Billion for Kenya Preparedness
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Rubio and Ruto discussed the ongoing Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and coordinated response efforts between Kenya and the United States. They emphasized measures to strengthen Kenya's health preparedness and secure critical medical supplies as cross-border concerns rise. The United States announced an additional 13.5 million USD (about 1.7 billion Shillings) for Kenya's Ebola preparedness, joining $112 million in bilateral assistance already pledged for East Africa's wider Ebola response. Reports cite a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine and monitoring facility being established in Laikipia County for Americans exposed to the virus. Kenyan authorities have intensified surveillance and preparedness in response to the DRC-linked outbreak. The two leaders agreed to maintain close coordination and reaffirmed the importance of the long-standing U.S.-Kenya health partnership, with preventing the outbreak from reaching the United States a stated priority.

triage.headline_ja: ルビオ国務長官とルト大統領がエボラ対策について協議、米国がケニアの準備体制に17億シリング（1,350万ドル）を拠出
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での対応体制構築、米国の大規模支援表明がIHR基準を満たし、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念と社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Laikipia（ケニア）での隔離・監視施設建設やケニアの対応が記述されているが、実際の患者発生地は記事サマリーの主題がDRC中心のアウトブレイクであり、ケニアは準備体制強化・監視段階。対象国リストに米国・ケニアが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし、この地域での国際的な対応体制構築とリスクレベルの上昇は顕著。

article.articleHeadline: 'If Ebola comes, we'll be wiped out': DR Congo conflict-displaced
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC's Ituri province, centered on the Kingonze displacement camp (also spelled Kigonze) near Bunia, housing about 25,000 people. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission is by close contact; crowded camps with poor hygiene and limited water—Kingonze relies on a single borehole—greatly raise spread risk. Since the outbreak was declared May 15, WHO data through May 24 report 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths among over 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases. Ituri hosts about 61 displacement camps with roughly 970,000 people. Officials warn of a catastrophic collision of disease and conflict and urge rapid deployment of equipment, isolation tents, clean water, and qualified medical staff to avert wide spread; no infections have yet been confirmed in Kingonze.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが来たら、私たちは一掃される」：コンゴ民主共和国の紛争避難民
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラウイルス病の確認例と多数の疑い例が発生しており、ワクチンなし、治療法なし、混雑したキャンプの衛生環境悪化による拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain、ワクチン・治療法なし。Kingonzeキャンプ約25,000人、Ituri州全体で約970,000人の避難民が危険状態。5月15日の発生宣言後、5月24日時点で確定例10死亡、疑い例223死亡、総1,000症例以上。紛争と疾病の「カタストロフィック衝突」の警告あり。国際的な医療・衛生支援の早急な展開が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, l'appello di Tedros: Serve una tregua per salvare vite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, Tedros' appeal: A truce is needed to save lives.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is centered in Ituri province, which accounts for over 90% of cases, with some transmissions in North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak is caused by the Ebola Bundibugyo virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or therapies, unlike Ebola Zaire-driven outbreaks. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus appeals directly to the people of Ituri to declare a temporary ceasefire to allow safe passage for health workers amid ongoing conflict, displacement, and access challenges. He writes as a witness to prior emergencies in DR Congo, stressing that early diagnosis and timely care can save many lives. A visit to Bunia is planned, and WHO teams remain on the ground with the Congolese government and international partners to contain the outbreak and strengthen the health system beyond the emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱、テドロス事務局長が呼びかけ：命を救うためには休戦が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常な病原体・文脈、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラ・ブンディブギョ型の大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療法なし、紛争地での対応困難という高リスク状況。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ型は稀でザイール型より認可医薬品が少ない。イツリ州で90%以上の症例が発生。WHO事務局長による直接的な呼びかけ、紛争・国内避難民・アクセス困難などの複合的リスク要因により、フルRRA実施の優先度は非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dread and denial at heart of deadly DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak centered in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, northeastern DRC, has killed an estimated 200 people overall. In Mongbwalu, 322 people are suspected to have contracted Ebola as of May 24, with at least 88 deaths, according to authorities. The outbreak has spread to several provinces and crossed into Uganda, prompting the World Health Organization to declare an international emergency. Locally, fear and denial persist, with residents like Laureine Sakiya questioning the existence of the virus and blaming government neglect. There is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain involved. The outbreak highlights cross-border risk and distrust, with Mongbwalu located about 100 km from Uganda and 200 km from South Sudan, underscoring the need for rapid public health action.

triage.headline_ja: 恐怖と否定がDR コンゴの致命的エボラアウトブレイクの中心
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo strain）による大規模アウトブレイク。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。DRC国内での200名以上の死亡、ウガンダへの越境拡大、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により高いリスク評価。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUgandaとSudanも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのIturi州Mongbwaluを中心としたアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダへの「越境拡大」との記載あり。対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Keeping Ebola virus at bay
article.articleSummary: Nigeria is at high risk of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) importation as of May 24, 2026, after a Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak that killed 88 and a reportedly imported case in Uganda; the WHO has declared a global public health emergency. Nigeria currently has no confirmed cases, but international travel makes importation highly likely. The 2014 outbreak began July 20 in Lagos when Patrick Sawyer arrived, triggering 19 infections and 7 deaths, including four healthcare workers; Dr. Stella Adadevoh helped avert a larger spread. Nigeria activated an Ebola Emergency Operations Centre under Dr. Faisal Shuaib and mobilised partners for contact tracing, screening, and care. WHO declared Nigeria Ebola-free on Oct 20, 2014 after 42 days. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, bleeding; CFR 25–90%. Current response emphasizes PPE, hand hygiene, border surveillance, rapid diagnostics, community education, and sustained funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの脅威に対抗する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。WHO緊急事態宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク関連で、対象国内での輸入リスク評価のため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア（対象国リストに含まれない）のエボラウイルス輸入リスク評価が主題だが、DRCでの確認されたアウトブレイク（88名死亡）とウガンダでの輸入症例が言及されている。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地として確認される。ナイジェリアは2014年のインポーテーション事例の参照として言及されているが、現在のアウトブレイク地ではない。記事配信日2026年5月29日は未来日付であり、シミュレーション記事である可能性が高いが、感染症危機評価プロトコルに基づき処理。

article.articleHeadline: FG may isolate air travellers and restrict some flights over fresh Ebola outbreak fears
article.articleSummary: Nigeria has not confirmed an Ebola case as of 2026-05-29. The Federal Government is weighing emergency travel measures, including possible flight restrictions and isolation of passengers arriving from high‑risk countries, amid concerns over a fresh Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa. A Lagos high‑level emergency preparedness meeting with government officials, aviation authorities and health agencies discussed stricter airport screening, passenger monitoring, isolation protocols for suspected cases, and potential flight bans from heavily affected nations. Authorities say Nigeria remains vulnerable due to heavy international traffic through Lagos and Abuja airports; the Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria has intensified surveillance and preparedness. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases and over 200 suspected deaths since the outbreak was declared earlier this month. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids and can cause fever, bleeding, organ failure and death. No Nigerian cases confirmed; monitoring continues with international health agencies.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ出血熱アウトブレークの懸念を受け、ナイジェリア政府が航空旅客の隔離と一部便の運航制限を検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCで1,000件超の確認・疑い例が報告され、ナイジェリアが高リスク国からの便制限や乗客隔離など国際的対応を検討している状況はフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRCで1,000件超の確認・疑い例と200件超の死亡例が報告されている。ナイジェリアは未確認だが、高リスク国からの便制限やパッセンジャー隔離を含む緊急措置を検討中。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当；ナイジェリアは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola epidemic in India: Health experts demand stricter travel bans as travellers from outbreak zones enter country
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak spreading in DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan with 904 suspected and 101 confirmed cases in DRC (119 suspected deaths, 10 confirmed deaths); Uganda has 5 confirmed cases and 1 death as of late May 2026. WHO risk assessment: national very high, regional high; Africa CDC declares PHECS, WHO declares PHEIC. India intensifies airport screening and quarantine while debated travel bans. A notable imported exposure: a 37-year-old Congolese businessman who stayed in Mumbai and travelled to Silvassa, Daman, and Vadodara before symptom onset; a Ugandan woman in Bengaluru with suspected infection later tested negative. About 16 people in Gujarat/Maharashtra quarantined after travel from Uganda/DRC. India issued a travel advisory to avoid non-essential travel to DRC, Uganda, South Sudan; arrivals from high-risk countries must report to Airport Health Officers if fever, vomiting, bleeding, or headache. No confirmed Indian cases; no vaccine or cure for Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: インドのエボラ出血熱流行：流行地域からの旅行者の入国に対し、保健専門家がより厳格な渡航禁止を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンで確認されたブンディブギョエボラウイルスの流行により、インドへの流入リスクが顕在化しており、WHO/Africa CDCが既にPHEIC/PHECS宣言。国際的な関心と対応措置の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアフリカ諸国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はインドへのエボラ流入リスクと対応措置である。インド国内での確認症例はなく、流入リスク段階であるが、医療従事者の曝露事例と空港検査強化が報告されている。対象国リストに基づき、実際の発生地のDRCとインドのみをverified_locationsに列挙。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉疫情！美國史無前例宣布「公民須在海外隔離」爆輿論反彈-台視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To curb the Ebola outbreak! The United States, in an unprecedented move, announces that citizens must be quarantined overseas, sparking public backlash — TTV News Network.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in Africa. The United States, in an unprecedented move, requires overseas quarantine for American citizens evacuated from affected areas; those leaving Ebola zones will be isolated abroad, with symptomatic patients referred to Europe for treatment. Washington plans a 50-bed quarantine facility in Kenya, with preliminary Kenyan government consent, potentially opening by May 29. The U.S. pledges about $13.5 million for Kenya’s outbreak response, a plan that has drawn public backlash. U.S. CDC officials caution that early camps may be limited and could deter health workers. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visits to emphasize the outbreak remains controllable and to seek more international aid; he notes WHO does not advocate travel bans. On May 28, the U.S., Canada, and Mexico issued a joint statement mandating a 21-day quarantine for travelers from the affected region on arrival.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行を抑止するため、米国が史上初の措置として「国民は海外で隔離が必須」と発表、世論の反発を招く
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はアフリカで流行中であり、米国・カナダ・メキシコによる21日間隔離要件の導入、米国によるケニアでの50床隔離施設設置計画など、国際的に前例のない対応が実施されている。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限に相当する措置が確認でき、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性と管理可能性に懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はアフリカ全域でのエボラ出血熱流行を言及しているが、具体的に対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）のみ。ケニアでの隔離施設計画が言及されているがケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに追加していない。米国・カナダ・メキシコの対応は対象国リストに含まれていない。WHO事務局長による訪問やCDC警告など、国際的関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Virus Ebola, BKK Pangkalpinang Cek Kesehatan Nakhoda dan ABK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Ebola Virus, Pangkalpinang BKK Checks the Health of the Captain and the Crew.
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention measures intensified in Pangkalpinang, Bangka Belitung Islands, as the Class II Health Quarantine Office screens ship captains and crew from cargo and fishing vessels at Pangkalbalam and other ports (Pangkalbalam, Tanjung Gudang, Tanjung Pandan, Tanjung Kalian) to prevent entry of Ebola following WHO’s global emergency declaration for Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo. No captains or crew have been identified as suspected Ebola cases to date. Health checks include temperature, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and respiration, plus interviews about international travel and activities abroad. If a traveler records a fever above 38°C or Ebola symptoms, they receive further treatment and are referred to a designated hospital to prevent transmission. The program also extends to cruise ship passengers docking in Bangka Belitung. Citizens are urged to maintain health and hygiene while traveling."

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの予防、パンカルピナン BKK が船長および乗組員の健康検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのエボラ予防措置は異常・予想外の対応であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性、長期曝露の可能性）に該当する。ただし実際の患者発生例がなく、情報不足のため WATCH とする。
triage.notes: DRC のエボラ流行に対応したインドネシアの予防的スクリーニング措置である。発生地域に DRC と Indonesia が列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はインドネシア（パンカルピナン）の港湾における予防措置であり、DRC での新規発生ではなく WHO 宣言への対応である。実際の患者発生はまだ確認されていないため、シグナルは「WATCH」段階とする。

article.articleHeadline: Gir Lion Death News 2026: 7 Lions Dead, Virus Alert in Gujarat | Newstrack | Gir Lion Death News: गिर में 7 शेरों की मौत से हड़कंप, हाई अलर्ट पर पूरा वन विभाग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gir Lion Death News 2026: 7 Lions Dead, Virus Alert in Gujarat | Newstrack | Gir Lion Death News: Panic in Gir as 7 Lions Die, the entire Forest Department on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Gujarat's Gir National Park reports 7 Asiatic lions dead amid suspected canine distemper virus (CDV) outbreak. Initial findings indicate viral infection; lab samples have been sent, with results due within a week. CDV is not limited to dogs and can affect big cats, causing fever, weakness, respiratory and neurological issues, raising alarm for the last natural habitat of the Asiatic lion. Babesia infection is also under investigation as a potential contributor. 17 other lions are quarantined, with 8 confirmed infections; 12 veterinarians are monitoring and treating affected animals. The state government has deployed about 250 forest personnel, with additional officials summoned from Jamnagar, Surat, Rajkot, Kutch, and Junagadh; Junagadh Veterinary College experts are assisting. Authorities are intensifying patrols within a 10-km radius of Gir Gadra and Babaria ranges. No new confirmed cases yet, but vigilance remains high; experts call for a second, separate population to safeguard the species.

triage.headline_ja: ギル国立公園でアジアシシが7頭死亡、ウイルス警戒態勢 グジャラート州
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（ジステンパーウイルス）の野生動物集団死であり異常・予想外の事象であるが、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」が明確でなく、人間への直接的脅威が記されていない。ただし絶滅危機種の大量死と複数の調査機関の関与により経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 疾患名がBabesiosis（バベシア症）で分類されているが、記事の主要な懸念はCanine Distemper Virus（ジステンパーウイルス）の野生ライオン集団死。バベシア感染は「調査中の潜在的寄与因子」との記述。野生動物感染症イベントだが人間への直接的脅威が明記されていないため、IHR基準2以上未達でWATCHとした。絶滅危機種保全の観点から継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le gouvernement ambitionne de contenir et maîtriser la 17e épidémie dans un délai de 4 à 6 mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the government aims to contain and bring the 17th outbreak under control within four to six months.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo centers in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, the 17th outbreak. As of May 15, 2026, the strain confirmed in Ituri; WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The government aims to contain the outbreak within four to six months, acknowledging uncertainty in case and death counts but pledging intensified action. The response draws on lessons from past outbreaks; the 2018-2020 epidemic is cited as a benchmark. Frontline health workers face exposure, and authorities vow to improve their conditions. Officials promise full transparency in reporting numbers to avoid hidden caseloads. Challenges include conflict, population movements and weak state control, hindering contact tracing and raising spillover risk to other DRC regions and neighbors. More than 26 million people face acute food insecurity, worsening malnutrition and transmission risk; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this rare strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：政府は第17次流行を4～6ヶ月以内に封じ込め・制御することを目指す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)宣言、高い死亡率、複数地域での流行、国際的拡大リスク、地域紛争による管理困難性が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で発生している第17次エボラ流行。記事の主題はDRCの発生であり、南アフリカ地域スクリーニング基準をWPRO基準で評価。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。地域紛争、人口移動、弱い国家統制による接触者追跡困難、隣国への拡大リスク、食料不安が報告されている。希少株でワクチンなし。

article.articleHeadline: 2026 World Cup: US, Canada, Mexico Announce Ebola Travel Measures
article.articleSummary: US, Canada, and Mexico announced coordinated public health travel measures for travelers arriving from Africa at highest risk of exposure to Ebola, ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Canada banned citizens from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan from entering for 90 days, and requires a 21-day quarantine for travelers from these countries. The United States barred non-citizens and green-card holders who had recently traveled to the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan from entering. Mexico requires travelers arriving from the DRC to observe a 21-day quarantine and tightens Ebola screening at airports; Mexican citizens are urged to avoid travel to the DRC. These steps follow WHO declaring the Ebola outbreak in the DRC a public health emergency of international concern, with risk of spillover to neighboring states. The World Cup is co-hosted by the US, Mexico, and Canada, starting June 11, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ：米国、カナダ、メキシコがエボラ熱の渡航措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たし、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の危機と宣言されたエボラ熱アウトブレイク。複数国による協調的渡航制限措置と国際的関心の高さから、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年ワールドカップに関連したエボラ熱対策について扱っており、DRCでのアウトブレイク（WHO宣言済み）が主体。サマリーに記載されたウガンダやスーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。米国、カナダ、メキシコは渡航制限を実施している受け手国であり、感染症の発生国ではないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Amritsar: 'Early detection crucial to curb Ebola spread' - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Amritsar, 29 May 2026: Ebola outbreak has claimed over 120 lives globally. Health experts urge authorities and the public to remain vigilant to avert another infectious disease emergency. Dr. Rajesh Gera, Director of Internal Medicine at Park Hospital, says India must stay prepared due to its large population density and rising international travel. He stresses that early identification of suspected Ebola cases is the strongest defense against community transmission. Ebola is described as posing a higher fatality rate and more rapid progression than Covid-19. The piece emphasizes heightened surveillance and rapid response to suspected cases to curb spread, underscoring public health readiness to handle potential imported cases amid ongoing global fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: アムリトサル：「エボラ感染拡大を防ぐには早期発見が重要」- ザ・トリビューン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのアムリトサルでのエボラ対策に関する専門家見解を報じており、実際の流行地はインドではなく「グローバルに120人以上の死亡」と述べられている。しかし、インドにおける輸入症例への警戒と対応体制の準備に焦点を当てており、インドの公衆衛生当局にとって直接的な関心事。配信日が2026年5月という未来日付のため、シミュレーション・演習記事の可能性がある点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Kanada, Mexiko und USA stimmen wegen Ebola Reisebeschränkungen zur WM ab
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada, Mexico and the United States vote on the World Cup due to Ebola travel restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan prompts North American travel restrictions ahead of the FIFA World Cup in Canada, Mexico, and the United States. The three countries agreed on joint measures to protect citizens and visitors, though specifics were not released. In the U.S., non-citizens who recently visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan are barred; green-card holders with such recent travel are also restricted per CDC extension announced this week. Canada imposed a 90-day entry ban on residents from the three African states, with returning citizens and permanent residents required to quarantine 21 days after May 30. Mexico announced stricter airport controls and a three-week quarantine for arrivals from Congo. The WHO had recently declared a public health emergency of international concern over the Congo Ebola outbreak. World Cup runs June 11–July 19, with games in Houston, Toronto, and East Rutherford; DRC participates.

triage.headline_ja: カナダ、メキシコ、米国がエボラウイルス病により世界杯に関する渡航制限について合意
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、複数国による調整された対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は北米3国の渡航制限措置を報じているが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、国際的な公衆衛生的関心が極めて高い。大規模国際スポーツイベント（FIFA World Cup）との接点により政治的・社会的関心も急速に高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Corte de viagens, suspensão de vistos ou quarentena: Especialista admite medidas em Portugal para travar Ébola caso situação "se descontrole"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travel bans, visa suspensions or quarantine: Expert acknowledges measures in Portugal to curb Ebola if the situation gets out of control.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan drive enhanced preventive measures. The EU risk remains controlled due to vigilant traveler surveillance, with prospects of entry/exit screening if needed. Canada has imposed stricter controls, suspending travel documents for residents from affected regions and enforcing a 21-day quarantine for those who have been there. Portugal currently views the infection risk as very low and does not justify quarantines; however, it may implement targeted entry/exit screenings or traveler monitoring if the outbreak expands to countries with direct air links. The World Health Organization advocates risk-based, graduated measures rather than blanket travel bans. The Ebola virus is described as rare and without a vaccine, emphasizing ongoing surveillance, clear public information, and rapid response to any imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 渡航禁止、ビザ停止または隔離：専門家がポルトガルでのエボラ対策を認める「状況が制御不能になった場合」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は深刻な公衆衛生影響を伴う異常・予想外のイベントであり、IHR基準2つ以上該当。対象国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での活動性流行に加え、国際的な渡航制限・検疫措置が実施・検討されており、国際拡大リスクが明確である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはポルトガル・カナダが含まれているが、記事サマリーから実際の流行は DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン で発生しており、ポルトガル・カナダは対応国である。対象国リストに DRC(203312) のみ該当するため verified_locations に含める。南スーダン(Sudan)はGeoNames ID 366755 だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外、ウガンダ(Uganda)も対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラウイルスの致死性・稀少性・ワクチン不在という特性により、軽微な情報でも社会政治的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: México aplica restricciones temporales a viajeros por brote de ébola previo al Mundial 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico imposes temporary restrictions on travelers due to Ebola outbreak ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Mexico imposed temporary entry restrictions for international travelers who have recently visited Ebola-affected African countries Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan, amid an active Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo variant. The measure began on May 28, 2026, for an initial 60 days. Restrictions apply to travelers who in the last 21 days have been in those countries and do not hold Mexican citizenship or a valid Mexican residency. Mexican citizens may enter without restrictions but are advised to postpone travel if recently in affected areas. Health surveillance at airports and other entry points will be intensified to detect suspected cases. The policy forms part of a trilateral health-security effort with the United States and Canada ahead of the FIFA World Cup 2026, with coordination cited by officials. Airlines Volaris and Aeroméxico had not announced related policy changes.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップを控えエボラ出血熱流行を理由にメキシコが渡航者に一時的な制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo変種）のアフリカでの流行による国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での渡航制限措置実施、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、ウガンダ、コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダンでのエボラ流行を受けてメキシコが渡航制限を実施した内容である。実際の感染症イベント発生地はアフリカのこれら3国（いずれも対象国リストに未含）であり、メキシコは対応国であり発生国ではない。対象国にはDRC(203312)がBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はメキシコの対応措置であり、DRCでの流行の詳細は記事に記載されていない。ただし、IHR基準およびWPRO基準で高リスク判定となるため、フルRRA実施対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO秘书长谭德塞抵刚果（金） 称伊波拉疫情止得住|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus Arrives in DR Congo, Says Ebola Outbreak Can Be Contained
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to oversee the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response. He landed May 28, 2026, and was to travel to Ituri Province in eastern DRC on May 29, the outbreak’s hardest-hit area. Tedros stated the Ebola outbreak can be contained and emphasized that the World Health Organization does not support travel bans, as they are not helpful. He pledged that WHO will do everything possible to assist the response. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, WHO has logged over 1,000 confirmed and suspected Ebola cases in the DRC. The visit underscores international support and ongoing efforts to curb transmission in Ituri and across the country.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長テドロス、コンゴ民主共和国に到着、エボラ感染症は封じ込め可能と表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響を持つ、国際的な懸念事項であり、1000例以上の確認・疑い症例が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の確認症例は1,000例以上で、5月15日の発生宣言以来の大規模な流行。WHO事務局長の現地視察により国際的な関心が高く、対象国リストのDRCに該当。フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱めぐり　米政府、米国人向け隔離施設をケニアに設置（2026年5月29日掲載）｜日テレNEWS NNN
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hemorrhagic fever: U.S. government to establish a quarantine facility for Americans in Kenya (May 29, 2026) | Nippon TV News NNN
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak in Africa centers on the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with over 900 suspected cases and more than 200 suspected deaths reported. On May 28, 2026, the United States government announced the establishment of a quarantine facility in Kenya for American nationals suspected of Ebola infection, with operations to begin on May 29, 2026. The plan stipulates that individuals confirmed infected at the Kenyan facility will not be repatriated to the United States but will be relocated to a third country for treatment to prevent the virus’s entry into the United States. Kenya has not reported any confirmed Ebola cases at present. Kenyan medical associations oppose the facility, citing risk of introducing Ebola into Kenya. The measures aim to block importation of cases and manage suspected infections among Americans traveling in East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱めぐり　米政府、米国人向け隔離施設をケニアに設置（2026年5月29日掲載）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のアフリカでの大規模流行（DRCで900件以上の疑い例、200件以上の死亡）であり、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」に該当。また米国による隔離施設設置という異例の国際対応が講じられており、高い社会的・政治的関心を示す。
triage.notes: DRCはIHRおよび感染症危機管理上の重要な発生地であるが、対象国リスト（CEPR EBS対象国）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。ケニアについては、記事サマリー上で確認患者がないことが明記されており、米国の予防的措置の対象地となっているが、実際の患者発生地ではないため除外。本イベントは域外の重大な感染症流行イベントとして、その他のチャネルでの監視・報告が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Friday briefing: ​What do the cuts in aid mean for the fight against Ebola in the DRC? - AOL
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly in Ituri province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with at least 240 deaths among suspected and confirmed cases since the outbreak began earlier this month in Bunia. Declared on 15 May, the outbreak has spread to other eastern DRC regions and to Kampala, Uganda. There is no licensed vaccine; transmission occurs via contact with body fluids after spillover from wild animals. Limited laboratory capacity hampers surveillance, and many more cases are suspected than official WHO figures. Frontline workers are dying: at Bunia’s Evangelical Medical Centre, at least five clinicians have died, including Dr Vladimir Maduali (30) who died on Sunday and Dr Tibenderana Katho Blaise who died two days later. Community distrust and attacks on facilities, plus burial restrictions, complicate response. US aid cuts have weakened the system, with funding falling from $1.4B in 2024 to about $21M so far in 2026; WHO chief Tedros urged a ceasefire to aid containment. Containment will likely take months.

triage.headline_ja: Friday briefing: DRCのエボラとの戦いにおいて援助削減が何を意味するのか？ - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、国際的な拡がり（ウガンダへの波及）、深刻な死亡者数（少なくとも240人）、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC のイトゥリ州ブニアでの発生が主題。ウガンダへの波及が記述されているが、サマリーからウガンダ内での実際の症例確認は明確ではなく、カンパラでの「拡大」の記述にとどまるため、DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。医療従事者の死亡、コミュニティの不信感、施設への攻撃、埋葬制限により対応が複雑化している。米国援助削減による資金不足（2024年14億ドルから2026年に約2,100万ドルへ削減）が対応能力を大きく減弱させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Alert: NCDC Names Lagos, Rivers, FCT Among High Risk States
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in DRC and Uganda prompts Nigeria’s NCDC to designate high‑risk and moderate‑risk states. Lagos, the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Rivers, Kano, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa are listed as high‑risk for importation due to international airports, seaports, and porous borders; Ogun, Nasarawa, Kaduna, Plateau, Kogi, Niger, Jigawa, Katsina, Bauchi, Ebonyi, Abia, and Bayelsa are moderate risk. As of 2026-05-29, 1,077 suspected cases and 247 deaths reported in DRC/Uganda (case fatality rate 24.6%), with the most affected age group 14–45 years. Suspected cases have been reported in India; Canada has suspended travel applications from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, while Uganda has border closures. No licensed vaccines or targeted therapeutics exist for Bundibugyro ebolavirus; control relies on rapid public health interventions and supportive care. Nigeria has no confirmed cases; the National Emergency Operations Centre is activated, and states are urged to ensure readiness, isolation/referral pathways, and strengthened surveillance and IPC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：NCDC がラゴス、リバーズ、FCT を高リスク州として指定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC/ウガンダでのBundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイク（1,077疑似症例、死亡247例）が確認され、ナイジェリアへの輸入リスクが高く、複数州で高リスク指定されている。パンデミック潜在性が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot API の発生地域にはナイジェリアの多数の州が含まれているが、記事サマリーより、確認されたアウトブレイク自体は DRC とウガンダで発生しており、ナイジェリアは高リスク指定を受けているが確認症例はまだない。インドでも疑似症例が報告されている。対象国リストでは DRC と India のみが該当。ワクチンと標的治療法が利用不可で、急速な公衆衛生介入に頼る必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Regeneron Antibody Maftivimab Recommended By WHO For Ebola Trials
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, the World Health Organization's Therapeutics Advisory Group has recommended Maftivimab, Regeneron's lead antibody in Inmazeb, for prioritized evaluation in clinical trials responding to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. WHO has declared this Bundibugyo-driven outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, triggering coordinated research with local governments. Maftivimab is one of the three antibodies in Inmazeb and has shown broad in vitro activity against multiple Ebola species, including Bundibugyo, though it has not yet been tested in vivo as a monotherapy for this strain. Regeneron notes hundreds of patients have received Maftivimab as part of Inmazeb, with an acceptable safety profile. The company is coordinating with the U.S. HHS and WHO as trials advance; Inmazeb has been provided at no cost under compassionate-use protocols since 2018 in DRC and Guinea.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ対策でRegeneron社の抗体Maftivimabを臨床試験で推奨
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）のアウトブレイクが発生しており、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「異常・予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の3基準に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではBundibugyo ebolavirus outbreakが民主共和国（DRC）とウガンダで発生していることが明示されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる(203312)。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ギニアでの過去の患者発生記述があるが、現在のアウトブレイク主舞台はDRCとウガンダ。WHOによるPHEIC宣言と治療開発の進展は国際的に極めて重大なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Madaxa WHO oo U Safraya Congo Xilli Ebola Mar Kale Ka Dillaacay Dalka
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Ebola has reemerged in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the eastern Ituri region the hardest hit. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus will travel to the DRC to coordinate and bolster support for the government and health workers. The Congo health ministry reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases, 121 laboratory-confirmed, and 17 deaths since the outbreak was announced on 15 May. To curb transmission, authorities in Ituri have suspended public gatherings, including sports events and all community meetings. Cross-border transmission concerns are evident as Uganda reports 7 cases and 1 death, prompting tighter border measures. Congo has previously overcome Ebola 16 times; international agencies are intensifying control efforts to prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ出血熱再流行でコンゴ東部イツリ地域で国境を越えた感染拡大に警戒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の再流行、国際的な確定患者と死亡、ウガンダへの越境感染、WHOの緊急対応により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国が主な発生地であり、イツリ地域で最大の影響を受けている。ウガンダでの7症例1死亡についても言及されているが、ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。WHO事務局長による緊急視察、1,077件の疑似症例（121確定）と17死亡、越境感染、および公衆衛生措置の実施が報告されており、国際的に重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - level 3 - News in Levels
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of 29 May 2026, authorities report 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with a case-fatality rate around one third. No vaccine is available for this strain, and the outbreak is expanding rapidly across eastern, war-affected provinces, hampering containment efforts. To curb transmission, local authorities have banned traditional funeral practices that involve handling the deceased. Tensions flared when angry relatives set fire to hospital tents after health workers refused to release a contaminated body. The WHO has escalated the public health risk to level 3 and dispatched 11 tons of medical supplies and $60 million in funding. Experts caution that transmission spreads quickly via social and travel networks. Oxford researchers are pursuing a new vaccine with potential clinical trials within 2–3 months.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の流行 - レベル3
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で750疑い例・177死亡例、致命率約33%、急速拡大、国際的リスク、ワクチン未利用。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラは治療用ワクチン未利用の高リスク病原体。750疑い例・177死亡例（致命率33%）、東部紛争地帯での急速拡大。WHO公式にレベル3へ引き上げ、$60M資金投入、11トン医療物資派遣。葬儀慣習が伝播リスク増加。Oxford大学の新規ワクチン開発が2-3ヶ月以内に臨床試験予定。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - level 2 - News in Levels
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) intensifies in the eastern region. 750 sick and 177 dead as of 2026-05-29. The virus kills about one-third of those infected; no vaccine yet. Conflict and war hamper response, with hospitals undersupplied. The government halted large funerals to prevent transmission from touching bodies, sparking anger and arson of medical tents. Local distrust of foreign doctors persists, with beliefs that outsiders caused the sickness. Oxford University scientists are developing a new Ebola vaccine and plan to test it in a few months, though it will take time before broad use. The situation remains critical, requiring enhanced outbreak control and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク - レベル2
