triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。750症例、177死亡（致死率約24%、記事では約1/3と記載）。紛争・医療不足・地域の信頼欠如により対応が困難。ワクチン開発中だが実用化にはまだ時間が必要。国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: What You Need to Know About the New Ebola Outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo involves Bundibugyo strain. Genetic evidence indicates transmission for weeks to months before detection. Ebola spreads through direct contact with body fluids, entering via mucous membranes or broken skin; high viral loads in blood, saliva, urine, feces, and semen of recovered individuals exacerbate transmission. Healthcare workers and family caregivers face elevated risk. After entry, the virus replicates in lymph nodes and then disseminates, targeting immune cells and driving systemic infection; viral loads rise, making patients highly infectious. Early symptoms are nonspecific (cold/flu or malaria-like) and may improve before a hemorrhagic phase with oozing blood. Post-mortem infectiousness is high; funeral practices risk transmission. Containment is hampered by population movement, conflict, and mistrust; safe burial requires community cooperation. Vaccines for Bundibugyo are unproven; Ervebo deployment is considered despite uncertain effectiveness. Research remains restricted by biosafety constraints.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの新しいエボラアウトブレイクについて知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の新規発生で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの新規発生。検出前に数週間～数ヶ月の伝播が確認されている。医療従事者・介護者のリスク高。ワクチン効果未確定。紛争地帯での封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: VS willen Amerikaanse ebolapatiënten in Europa laten behandelen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States wants American Ebola patients treated in Europe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola exposure prompts US policy: Americans exposed to Ebola in Africa will not be allowed to return to the United States. Exposed individuals will be quarantined in Kenya and, if infected, transported to Europe for treatment, according to Axios, NBC News, and The New York Times. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the United States will not permit Ebola patients to enter the country, arguing Europe offers faster treatment. The U.S. will open a quarantine center in Kenya on Friday, and discussions continue on where in Europe patients could be treated. Previously, several Americans exposed to the virus in Congo have flown to Europe for care, including a doctor being treated in Germany whose family remains in quarantine, and another doctor in isolation in the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がアメリカ人エボラ患者のヨーロッパでの治療を希望
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは国際保健上最高リスクの病原体であり、複数国への国際的拡大、国境検疫政策の発動、アフリカからの患者輸送という異常かつ深刻な状況が報告されている。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでアフリカでのエボラ曝露が言及されており、DRCでの発生が確認される。ケニアでの隔離センター開設、ヨーロッパ（ドイツ、チェコ共和国）への患者搬送が記載されているが、これらは治療搬送地であり、感染症の発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当する。米国、ドイツ、チェコ共和国、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。エボラウイルスの高い伝播性と重症性、国際的な隔離政策の発動、複数国への患者移送など、複合的に重大な国際保健上の懸念が存在する。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo - level 1 - News in Levels
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is described by the World Health Organization as posing danger at the highest level. As of 2026-05-29, many people are ill and 177 have died. There is no medicine to stop Ebola. The virus spreads quickly because many people live in close proximity, and funerals are not allowed to reduce transmission. When a person dies from Ebola, the virus remains in the body and can infect others. Some families distrust doctors from other countries and have attacked a hospital. Doctors from the United Kingdom are willing to help. Scientists at Oxford University are developing a new vaccine, but they need several months to test it before it can be used.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ集団発生 - レベル1
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。確定死亡177名、WHOが最高リスクレベルと評価。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRCでのエボラ集団発生が主題。UKからの医師派遣やOxford Universityでのワクチン開発は支援の文脈であり、UKでの発生は記載されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOが最高リスクレベルと評価、死亡者177名、医療不信と社会的要因が感染拡大を助長している状況が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: पावसाळ्यातील साथरोग रोखण्यासाठी आरोग्य विभाग 'ॲक्शन मोड'वर; प्रशासकीय यंत्रणेला सज्ज राहण्याचे आदेश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department on 'Action Mode' to curb monsoon epidemics; orders for the administrative machinery to stay prepared.
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, Pune’s Public Health Department activated an 'action mode' to curb monsoon epidemics, directing the Additional Director for malaria, vector-borne and waterborne diseases (Dr. Sandeep Sangale) to mobilize the machinery. District and taluka micro-plans will target vector-borne and waterborne illnesses. All medical officers and staff must remain at headquarters; noncompliance may invite action. Ambulances and government vehicles must be kept ready, with attention to remote areas. A risk-village list spanning Western Maharashtra, Vidarbha and Marathwada will guide targeted surveys and water sampling, with reports to the state health department. Pre-monsoon checks include two visits to ashrams and hostels; drinking water, food hygiene and storage will be inspected. Vector-control measures include guppy fish, fogging and abet spraying; essential medicines stocked across districts, with at least three months’ supply for hard-to-reach areas. A 24/7 control room and rapid-response teams can deploy within 24 hours of an outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン流行病抑制のため保健部門が『アクション・モード』に移行；行政機構の準備態勢を指示
triage.triage_reason: インドのマラリア対策が強化された季節的な準備活動であり、現在の流行発生ではなく予防的措置である。IHR基準は該当せず、WPROスクリーニング基準も1つ以上の該当は不確実。情報の限定性により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のマラリア流行事例ではなく、インド（マハラシュトラ州プネ）における予防的な季節対応体制の強化について述べている。モンスーン期における疾病流行リスク対策の制度的準備段階であり、既発生の患者数増加や異常な流行を示唆する情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ο Τέντρος του ΠΟΥ: Μπορούμε να σταματήσουμε την επιδημία Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tedros of the WHO: Can we stop the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is centered in Ituri with spread to North and South Kivu and linked cases in neighboring Uganda. Official tallies report 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases, a figure possibly undercounted. Seven Ugandan cases have been confirmed, including one death. Uganda and Rwanda have closed their borders with Congo. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccine or therapy exists, though vaccines for the Zaïre strain exist and trials are underway for Bundibugyo. The WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern, though response is hampered by ongoing conflict and limited access from armed groups such as the ADF. The United States plans a quarantine center in Kenya for suspected or confirmed cases, mainly Americans, and Africa CDC expects vaccine and drug development by end-2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのテドロス事務局長：エボラ流行を止めることができるか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの多国間エボラアウトブレイクで、国際的拡大リスク、国境閉鎖、死亡報告などから明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが識別した発生地域にはウガンダ、ケニア、ルワンダ、米国も含まれているが、記事サマリーでは実際の流行中心はDRC（Ituri、North/South Kivu）であり、ウガンダは7確定例と関連症例、ケニアは米国による隔離センター設置予定地として言及されている。対象国リストに基づき、確認されたアウトブレイクはDRCのみに限定。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、256人の死亡報告、1,000件以上の疑似症例があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は明白。

article.articleHeadline: VS weigeren terugkeer ebolapatiënten: besmette Amerikanen moeten naar Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The US refuses the return of Ebola patients: infected Americans must go to Europe.
article.articleSummary: Ebola exposure among Americans abroad prompts a US policy to bar entry of infected individuals and to quarantine them in Kenya before possible transport to Europe for treatment. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the stance, with the United States opening a quarantine center in Kenya this Friday (May 29, 2026) and evaluating where to treat patients in Europe. The approach follows instances of Americans exposed in Congo being sent to Europe for care, including a doctor treated in Germany whose family remains in quarantine there, and another doctor isolated in the Czech Republic. The plan prioritizes rapid treatment in Europe over admission to the United States, citing safety and speed. The policy signals stricter border control and cross-continental management of Ebola exposures among Americans abroad, as authorities coordinate with Kenya and European medical facilities.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ患者の入国を拒否：感染したアメリカ人はヨーロッパへ向かわなければならない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスによる複数国での患者発生・国際的な患者転送が生じており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）を満たす。また、米国の政策対応が報道されている社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは米国の政策反応とケニア・ヨーロッパでの患者管理に言及されているが、エボラの実際の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）と記載されている。米国・ドイツ・チェコ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。シグナルレベルはIHR基準4つ全て該当することで明確に PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Gefährliche Infektionskrankheit breitet sich rasant aus: "Kann noch andere Dimensionen annehmen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous infectious disease is spreading rapidly: "It can still take on other dimensions."
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Goma (about 2 million residents) now affected. The outbreak centers in Ituri near Goma and involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola variant, complicating laboratory confirmation and early containment. Welthungerhilfe staff Ursula Langkamp and Manfred Bischofberger report unusually fast case growth and critical gaps in contact tracing: after the first Ebola death in Goma, 255 contacts were identified, yet the overall contact-to-suspected-case ratio remains just over two—far too low given large, multi-member households and widespread mobility from nearby gold mining areas. Public health measures include banning gatherings over 50, temperature checks, and handwashing; cross-border trade with Uganda and Rwanda is disrupted by closed borders. Goma is controlled by the M23 rebel group; banks are closed, forcing cash transfers via exchange offices from Rwanda and threatening staff salaries and health services. Authorities fear the outbreak could assume even larger dimensions.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な感染症が急速に拡大：「さらに大きな規模を取ることもあり得る」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4つ以上該当、高い社会政治的関心。エボラウイルスの大都市（ゴマ200万人）への波及と希少変異株の確認は国際的な重大懸念。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ルワンダは記事で国境閉鎖による波及リスクが述べられているが、サマリー上で実際の患者発生が確認されていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは希少で検査確認が困難。ゴマはM23反政府勢力支配下で保健システムが脆弱。接触者追跡の不十分性（接触者：疑い患者比 2.0超と低い）と金鉱採掘労働者の広範な移動が急速拡大の主要リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ высказался о возможности остановить смертельную вспышку Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief spoke about the possibility of stopping the deadly Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in the Democratic Republic of Congo to oversee the Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province, urging a ceasefire to enable care. The 17th DRC Ebola outbreak was declared on May 15; as of May 24, WHO reports 10 confirmed deaths and 223 probable deaths among over 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain); there are no vaccines or treatments yet, though advisory groups have recommended vaccine and therapeutic trials. Uganda has closed its border after a death and several cases; the United States will deny entry to anyone infected and is exploring a treatment facility in Kenya. UNICEF is delivering 100 tons of aid, and WHO received 4.6 tons at Bunia airport. Conflict and displacement in Ituri’s mineral-rich region complicate response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、致命的なエボラ出血熱の流行を阻止する可能性について語る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州でエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行が発生。死亡数233（確認10+推定223）、確定・疑い患者1,000名以上。ウガンダが国境を閉鎖、米国が検疫・治療体制を構築するなど、既に地域を超えた対応が開始されている。紛争・住民移動による複雑な状況にあり、フルのRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: México impone duros controles sanitarios por el ébola a semanas del Mundial 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico imposes strict health checks due to Ebola weeks ahead of the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Mexico, the United States, and Canada announced health measures for travelers from African regions amid a critical Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared a public health emergency of international concern by the WHO. The outbreak involves a dangerous variant with no vaccine or specific treatment. Mexico is strengthening epidemiological surveillance and airport screening, especially at Mexico City’s airport, and urges avoidance of travel to the DRC; travelers from the DRC, Uganda, or Sudan face a mandatory 21-day quarantine. The Congo national team’s World Cup match in Guadalajara against Colombia heightens alert. The United States will not permit entry of an Ebola case; the Congo squad must isolate 21 days before its June 17 debut against Portugal in Houston, and permanent residents who traveled to affected areas in the prior 21 days are barred. As of May 29, 2026, no cases have been reported in host countries.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、2026年ワールドカップ数週間前にエボラで厳しい衛生管理を導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（エボラ出血熱の大規模発生、国際保健上の懸念）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが複合的に認められ、4基準中3つ以上該当。複数国での予防的対応と国際スポーツイベント関連の社会・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに米国・メキシコ・カナダ・スーダン・ウガンダ・コロンビア等が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRCでのエボラ発生に対する複数国の予防的対応」であり、実際の発生国はDRCのみ。米国・メキシコ・カナダは予防措置実施国であって発生国ではない。2026年ワールドカップというメジャーイベント関連であり、国際的な関心と緊張度は高い。なお、本評価対象国の中ではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: "Μπορούμε να σταματήσουμε" την επιδημία, λέει ο γενικός διευθυντής του ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: "We can stop" the epidemic, says the WHO Director-General.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri in the northeast, with 246 deaths among more than 1,000 suspected cases. The DRC declared a new outbreak on 15 May, the 17th outbreak, involving Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu and spilling into Uganda, where seven lab-confirmed cases and one death have been reported; Uganda has closed its border with DRC. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though response is hampered by ongoing armed conflict and access constraints, notably in Ituri due to groups like the ADF and intercommunal violence. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no specific vaccine or therapy yet; vaccines/therapies are being evaluated in clinical trials. Tedros visited Ituri to assess the situation; the US considers a quarantine center in Kenya for Ebola cases. The 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused 2,300 deaths among 3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：「我々はこの流行を止めることができる」とWHO事務局長が述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、ウガンダでの確認例（7件、死亡1例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による新たな流行で、既知のワクチン/治療法がなく、武装勢力による対応阻害が懸念される。PHEICが正式に宣言されている重大事態。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ruto rallies global partners as Kenya steps up Ebola response
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, amid Ebola virus disease outbreaks in neighbouring countries, Kenya intensified preparedness and screening at 26 entry points, with over 58,000 travellers screened and all suspected cases testing negative. Seventeen isolation centres have been identified nationwide to handle potential cases. President William Ruto urged intensified international cooperation to reinforce regional health security and prevent cross-border transmission, stressing that responses must be coordinated rather than isolated. Kenya's plan centers on transparency, coordination, and rapid response, with a National Response Committee (chaired by the Prime Cabinet Secretary and Cabinet Secretary for Foreign and Diaspora Affairs) overseeing awareness campaigns, preparedness, and resource mobilisation. The response relies on partnerships with WHO, Africa CDC, and the UN system, and support from the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, France, Germany, China, Japan, India, Qatar, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Ethiopia, and Türkiye, to bolster surveillance, laboratory capacity, and cross-border coordination in East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領がグローバルパートナーを結集し、ケニアがエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（IHR指定感染症）の地域的な流行に対応する国家レベルの準備・スクリーニング活動が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高く、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアのエボラ対応体制強化であるが、サマリーに記載されている支援国（米国、英国、EU、フランス、ドイツ、日本、カタール、UAE、サウジアラビア、エチオピア、トルコ）のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはChina、Indiaのみ。エチオピアやモザンビークは「隣国での流行」との表現で提示されているが、記事の主体的発生国はケニアであるため、他のアフリカ国は verified_locations に含めない。エボラは致死率が高く、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルRRAの実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: FG releases names of 21 states, FCT at high risk of Ebola infection - FULL LIST
article.articleSummary: Nigeria's NCDC identifies 21 states and the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) as high or moderate risk for Ebola importation amid renewed outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Lagos, the FCT, Rivers, Kano, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa are high-risk due to international airports, porous land borders, and travel/trade links; Ogun, Nasarawa, Kaduna, Plateau, Kogi, Niger, Jigawa, Katsina, Bauchi, Ebonyi, Abia, and Bayelsa are moderate-risk requiring sustained surveillance. Despite no confirmed Ebola case in Nigeria, importation risk is elevated; WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. DRC/Uganda report 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 247 deaths; infections mainly aged 14–45; Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccines or targeted treatments. Transmission is via direct contact with blood/fluids, contaminated surfaces, or animals; not airborne. Nigeria urges airports/border surveillance, isolation facilities, PPE, and readiness reports within 72 hours.

triage.headline_ja: FG、エボラ感染リスク高・中程度の21州とFCTを発表 - 完全リスト
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度・致死率を有し、DRC/ウガンダからのナイジェリアへの輸入リスクが顕在化。WHOが国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）と宣言。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアの高リスク評価が主題。DRC（ID 203312）はサマリーに記載されているが、ナイジェリアの輸入リスク評価という文脈であり、実際の発生地はナイジェリアのみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、サマリーでは「DRC/ウガンダで現在発生中」と述べられており、ナイジェリアの輸入リスク評価とは別。ただし指示に従い、ナイジェリアが対象国でないため、実際には検証済みロケーション該当なしが正確だが、記事の主題がナイジェリアの感染リスク評価であるため該当国なしと判定。修正：ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていない（リストはGhana等のみ）。再評価：該当する対象国なし。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ouganda ferme temporairement sa frontière avec la RDC pour prévenir Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda temporarily closes its border with DR Congo to prevent Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Uganda on May 27, 2026, temporarily closed its border with the Democratic Republic of Congo to prevent Ebola transmission. The closure is effective immediately and applies to most cross-border movement, with exemptions only for Ebola response teams, humanitarian operations, transport of food and goods, and security services, all subjects to strict sanitary controls. The move reflects heightened precaution amid ongoing Ebola preparedness measures near the Uganda–DR Congo frontier. The report does not provide Ebola case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or identified infection sources. No information on imported or exported cases is given. The border restriction underscores public health measures aimed at containing Ebola spread across international borders while response activities continue in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが、エボラ予防のためDR コンゴとの国境を一時的に閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ側への脅威）が明確であり、国境閉鎖という行動が取られている。IHR基準で「国際的拡大リスク」と「渡航制限」に該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCは対象国（203312）に含まれる。記事はDRCでのエボラ流行に対するウガンダの対応を述べており、DRCが実際の発生地。具体的な患者数や死亡数は記事に記載されていないが、国レベルの国境閉鎖措置という重大な対応が取られており、シグナルとしての価値は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pse po përhapet Ebola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is Ebola spreading?
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak continues in Ituri and North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 900 confirmed cases and 220 deaths. The WHO warns the fevers may spread further as relief capacity remains strained; Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus calls it an extremely serious, hard-to-control outbreak. Funding cuts since the United States pulled support last year have forced the WHO to scale back Congo programs. Germany remains a major donor but has reduced contributions, affecting prevention and response. In Goma, only about 30% of needs are met amid destroyed hospitals and PPE shortages, and there is limited rapid testing and lab capacity. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant is circulating, but there is no vaccine or cure yet; vaccine development would take at least nine months. Plans include deploying expert teams to Congo, while development aid from BMZ is around €160 million for 2026–2027, down from prior years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはなぜ拡大しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準全て該当。WHO事務局長による深刻警告、資金不足による対応能力低下があり、シグナルとして識別。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola亜種の流行、900確認症例、220死亡。WHO事務局長Tedrosが「極めて深刻で制御困難」と警告。米国の支援撤回による資金不足が対応能力を大幅に低下させている。Goma市では必要な支援の30%しか提供できていない状況。ワクチン開発は最短9か月要する。記事にUSとGermanyへの言及あるが、記事主題はDRCでの発生であり verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO advises trials for experimental Ebola treatments
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with additional cases in Uganda, prompts WHO to advise that all candidate Ebola therapeutics and vaccines be used only within clinical trials. There are currently no licensed treatments or vaccines for BVD. Independent experts prioritized three treatment candidates for confirmed BVD: MBP134, Maftivimab®, and remdesivir. For post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts, the oral antiviral obeldesivir was identified as a priority. WHO, the DRC and Uganda governments, Africa CDC, ANRS Emerging Infectious Diseases and partners are developing field trial protocols and coordinating surveillance, contact tracing, isolation, testing, community engagement, and safe burials. The licensed Ebola vaccine Ervebo is not licensed for BVD and lacks conclusive cross-protection. The single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine by IAVI is under development and expected to need 7–9 months before readiness for clinical trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、実験的エボラ治療法の臨床試験を勧告
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョウイルス病（BVD）のアウトブレイクが DRC とウガンダで発生。WHO が治療法・ワクチン候補を臨床試験に限定するよう勧告し、国際的な対応と複数国での拡大が確認されている。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: サマリーではウガンダでの追加症例が言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを掲載。ブンディブギョウイルス病は高致命率の新興感染症。WHO が複数の治療候補を優先指定し、複数国での調整された対応が進行中。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: De brotes y epidemias - El Heraldo de México
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: On Outbreaks and Epidemics
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu; Uganda reports cases as Congo faces resource constraints. The WHO designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), though the outbreak is not a pandemic. Case fatality is currently about 30%, though past outbreaks reached ~90%. Transmission is by direct contact with bodily secretions, not airborne; isolation and rapid containment are essential. The crisis unfolds amid five million displaced people—half of them children—plus about 15 million others needing food and health aid due to war. A swift vaccine outcome is unlikely given limited commercial interest; this underscores the need for sustained public funding and multilateral cooperation. COVID-19 lessons stress health-system strengthening, vaccine manufacturing capacity, trained epidemiologists, and ongoing prevention campaigns for a globally connected world.

triage.headline_ja: 発生と流行について
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）の大規模流行であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に報告）、異常性が確認される。WHOによるPHEIC指定されており、複数国での確認とリソース制約下での対応が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス）の流行について述べており、DRCが主たる発生国。ウガンダでも症例報告されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行強化である。WHOによるPHEIC指定、約30%の致命率、資源制約下での対応、複数の社会的困難（難民500万人以上）が報告されている。本イベントはシグナルとしてフルRRA実施の対象。

article.articleHeadline: मुंबईत मलेरिया, डेंग्यूचा धोका; ४२ हजार ठिकाणी सापडल्या मलेरिया, डेंग्यूच्या अळ्या; ३२ लाख ५१ हजार ६२३ घरांची तपासणी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria and dengue threat in Mumbai; malaria and dengue larvae found at 42,000 locations; 3,251,623 homes surveyed.
article.articleSummary: Malaria and dengue threats in Mumbai during the monsoon fuel ongoing vector-control activity. From January to 27 May, municipal teams visited 22,080 areas and inspected 3,251,623 homes, with fumigation performed in 3,017,220 homes. During the campaign, Aedes aegypti larvae were detected at 37,800 sites and Anopheles stephensi larvae at 4,529 sites, with breeding sites promptly eliminated. The city’s vector-control workforce (>1,000 staff) is surveying residences and nearby areas for standing water in tanks, slums, plastic items, tires, plant pots, coconut shells, and similar containers. A total of 540 tires and 116,251 water-holding items were removed as potential breeding grounds. About 4,000 building redevelopment sites are receiving trained safety officers to enforce vector-control measures. Mumbai’s Public Health and Vector-Control departments are conducting regular spraying and larval-source management under Municipal Commissioner Ashwini Bhide to curb dengue and malaria transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイでマラリア、デング熱の脅威；42,000箇所でマラリア、デング熱の幼虫を発見；325万1,623軒の家屋を調査
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアは両疾患とも感染症危機監視対象であり、モンスーン時期のベクトル制御活動が行われている。ただし、記事は予防的・制御的措置の実施状況を報告する性質であり、重症例や死亡の報告がないため、現時点ではWATCHレベルでの経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はムンバイ（インド）でのデング熱とマラリアの幼虫検出と防除活動の進捗を報告。モンスーン期間中の継続的なベクトル制御は季節的に予想される活動であり、異常性は低い。症例数、重症度、死亡情報の記載がないため、公衆衛生への実際の影響程度は不明。ベクトル媒介疾患の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bontang Bantah Warga Berebas Tengah Meninggal akibat DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bontang Health Office Denies That Berebas Tengah Residents Died of Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, the Bontang City Health Office clarified that a Berebas Tengah resident did not die of dengue fever; the death was due to complications from chronic comorbidities. Laboratory findings showed no dengue indicators: platelet counts were normal for non-DBD cases, and there was no plasma leakage. Surveillance reviews confirmed the primary cause was a non-dengue illness. Although the Berebas Tengah case was not dengue, authorities released May 2026 dengue vigilance data for the area and urged the public to await official statements. In response to weather fluctuations, the Health Office instructed community health centers (Puskesmas) to strengthen early warning systems, with focused fogging only in areas with confirmed dengue cases; PSN 3M Plus campaigns (drain, cover, recycle) and free Abate powder at centers for hard-to-drain water containers. Citizens are advised to seek care for sudden high fever with joint pain or red skin spots.

triage.headline_ja: ボンタン保健局、ベレバス・テンガ住民のデング熱死亡説を否定
triage.triage_reason: 当該死亡事例はデング熱ではなく基礎疾患の合併症と確認されており、新規シグナルとしての価値がない。記事は公式否定と既知の監視データ・予防対策の発表であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事の主内容は当初報告された死亡例がデング熱ではないことの公式な否定声明である。ボンタン市が定期的な監視データと予防キャンペーン情報を発表しているが、これは既知のエンデミック地域における通常の公衆衛生活動であり、新規の感染症シグナルを構成しない。

article.articleHeadline: В Демократической Республике Конго сообщили о первом случае выздоровления от лихорадки Эбола -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the first recovery from Ebola fever has been reported — NIAT "Khovar".
article.articleSummary: May 27, 2026 — The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports its first recovery from the current Ebola outbreak. A discharged patient marks the first improvement since the epicenter in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, with officials indicating further recoveries are expected this week. Across the country, about 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and roughly 220 deaths have been recorded. In neighboring Uganda, one death and seven suspected cases have been reported, and Uganda has temporarily closed its border with the DRC to reduce cross-border transmission. The report emphasizes that recovery is possible and ongoing improvements are seen among other patients, countering views that Ebola is incurable. The information is reported by NIAT 'Khovar' citing Le Potentiel.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ熱の最初の回復事例を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の能動的な流行であり、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡220件、疑い例1,000件）と国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの死亡・症例報告）を確認。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度・流行性・管理可能性（国境閉鎖等の対応）が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに非含）での死亡・症例報告は言及されているが、記事の主題イベントはDRC内での流行であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。国境閉鎖や隣国への拡大リスクは国際スプレッド評価に反映済み。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC intensifie la riposte contre Ebola, une épidémie jugée "très complexe" par le chef de l'OMS (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC steps up its response to Ebola, an outbreak deemed 'very complex' by the WHO chief (General story).
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak in Ituri's Bunia, the Bundibugyo strain, declared May 15, has 1,077 suspected cases, 121 confirmed, and 238 suspected deaths, the 17th outbreak in the country since 1976. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to assess the response and will visit Bunia, citing conflict, insecurity, displacement, food insecurity, and community mistrust as major obstacles; he calls the outbreak 'very complex.' It is a regional event affecting at least DRC and Uganda, with Uganda reporting eight confirmed cases; CDC Africa lists Somalia and 11 other countries at risk. Many reported cases/deaths remain suspect; laboratory confirmation is limited. A first recovery is reported: a laboratory technician in Ituri recovered and tested negative twice. There is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; vaccines and treatments are being accelerated, with a goal to have them by end of 2026, while travel bans are discouraged.

triage.headline_ja: DRCがエボラ出血熱への対応を強化、WHO事務局長は「非常に複雑」と評価（総合報道）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（1,077疑い例、238死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで8例確認、他11カ国が危険）、異常性（Bundibugyo株、限定的な治療法）の3基準に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数基準に該当。DRC内での実際の発生を確認。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の宣言は2026年5月15日。地域紛争、不安定性、強制移動、食糧不安、コミュニティ不信が対応の主要な障害として指摘されている。限定的な検査確認能力により確定例と疑い例の区別が困難な状況。WHO事務局長による直接的な現地評価実施中。ウガンダとソマリアも言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCのイベントであり、他国での発生確認は記述されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya oo Mareykanka u Oggolaatay Furashada Xarun Karantiil oo Loogu Talagalay Dadka uu Ebola Ku Dhaco
article.articleSummary: Kenya has granted official permission for the United States to use a Kenyan military facility at Laikipia Air Base to establish a quarantine center for Ebola-affected people. The center would be staffed by the US Public Health Service under HHS and initially serve American citizens, but Kenya urges opening it to all Ebola-affected individuals worldwide; US acceptance of this broader scope remains unclear. The move comes as Ebola outbreaks persist in parts of the Democratic Republic of Congo. A US physician infected and several others linked to the virus have been evacuated to Germany for treatment and monitoring; another American at risk was sent to the Czech Republic for testing and surveillance. Kenyan authorities highlight international cooperation and the aim of a regional facility to provide rapid care and reduce the need to ship patients abroad as East and Central Africa heighten vigilance against re-emergence.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがアメリカに対してラキピア基地での検疫センター設置を認可—エボラ感染者向けの施設
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは重篤度が高く国際的拡大リスクが高い疾患であり、IHR基準で複数該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。実際のアウトブレイク（DRC）に加え、複数国への患者輸送・隔離体制の構築という国際的対応が示唆されており、管理可能性の懸念がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には米国、ドイツ、チェコなど複数国が含まれるが、記事サマリーはこれらを患者輸送先・治療地として記述している。実際のエボラアウトブレイク発生地はDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみがverified_locationsに該当。ケニアはアウトブレイク発生地ではなく、隔離施設の設置受け入れ国として機能している。対象国外（Kenya, US, Germany, Czech Republic）での対応についても戦略的に重要だが、IHRスクリーニングの地域検証ルールに従いDRCのみを列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Flying soon? Emirates issues urgent Ebola travel warning as countries tighten airport checks
article.articleSummary: As of May 28, Emirates warns travelers that multiple countries have implemented travel entry restrictions or enhanced screening due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The World Health Organization had earlier in May declared the DRC Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing a high risk of spread to neighbouring countries. Governments worldwide are tightening measures, particularly for passengers arriving from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The article provides no case counts or laboratory confirmation details. Travelers should consult official government channels for current entry requirements before departure, reflecting heightened airport checks and travel advisories linked to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 近日中にフライト予定？エミレーツがエボラ警告を発令、各国が空港検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（DRC発生源）について、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、複数国が国際的に渡航制限を実施している。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC発生源のエボラ流行と、複数国による渡航制限措置に焦点。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはドバイ、米国、カナダ、スーダン、ウガンダ、UAEが含まれているが、サマリーではこれらは「渡航制限を実施している国」または「スクリーニング対象地域」として記載されている。対象国リスト内でDRCのみが実際の発生地である。DRCの事例数や確認情報は記事に記載されていないが、WHOの緊急事態宣言により国際的関心が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ruto rallies global partners as Kenya steps up Ebola preparedness measures
article.articleSummary: Kenya intensified Ebola preparedness after outbreaks in neighboring countries, with President William Ruto urging international cooperation. In a May 28, 2026 statement from State House, Nairobi, Kenya said it is strengthening surveillance across 26 points of entry, screening over 58,000 travellers and reporting that all suspected cases tested so far have returned negative. Seventeen isolation centres have been identified nationwide to support emergency response. Kenya is mobilising support with WHO, Africa CDC, and UN systems to bolster laboratory capacity, cross-border coordination, emergency response, and health preparedness. The president thanked diplomatic missions and partners from the United States, United Kingdom, EU member states, China, Japan, India, Qatar, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Ethiopia, and Türkiye. Emphasized that public health threats require international solidarity and coordinated action, not isolationism, given Ebola outbreaks in neighbouring countries.

triage.headline_ja: ルト大統領がエボラ対応強化で国際協力を呼びかけ、ケニアが防疫措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い公衆衛生影響を持ち、近隣国での発生により国際的拡大リスクが明確。ケニアが積極的な防疫体制を構築していることから、スクリーニング基準複数項目に該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアのエボラ対策であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないが、近隣国での発生が背景。国際協力への言及において、China(1814991)およびIndia(1269750)が名指しで支援パートナーとして示されているため、これらを検証対象地域として列挙。エボラ出血熱は甚大な健康影響と国際的拡大懸念から、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Beyond the virus: Ebola outbreak exposes cost of conflict, aid cuts and Covid lessons unlearnt
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid record-level armed conflict displacing about 7–8 million people—90% in eastern provinces where the outbreak is concentrated. WHO Director-General Tedros warns of a 'catastrophic collision of disease and conflict' as M23 rebels in North and South Kivu and an Islamic State offshoot in Ituri disrupt containment, with overcrowded camps and attacks on health facilities hampering case and contact tracing. The outbreak involves the rarer Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with initial detection delayed after tests targeted the Zaire strain; samples were sent to Kinshasa at incorrect temperatures. US aid cuts and withdrawal of CDC/USAID personnel are cited as factors delaying recognition of the outbreak, with WHO informed only after nine days. Experts say Covid-19 lessons were not learned: need to address political instability, funding cuts, and weak cross-border surveillance; calls for stronger WHO and greater South-South support, including India.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスを超えて：エボラ出血熱の流行が紛争のコスト、援助削減、そして学ばれなかったCOVID-19の教訓を露呈
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、武装紛争による900万人の避難民、医療施設への攻撃、クロスボーダー監視の弱さにより国際拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国とインドを発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーは両国が政策的・支援の観点で言及されているだけで、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebola strainの検出遅延、米国援助削減によるCDC/USAID人員撤退、不十分な国境を越えた監視体制、および900万人の避難民の存在により、制御不能性と長期的曝露リスクが極めて高い。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ για Έμπολα: Μπορούμε να σταματήσουμε την επιδημία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO on Ebola: We can stop the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo declared a new Ebola outbreak affecting Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Uganda as a neighboring country; Ituri is the epicenter. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, arriving in Kinshasa, said the outbreak can be stopped despite access challenges from armed groups. About 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths are reported in Ituri; Uganda has seven laboratory-confirmed cases and one death near Kampala. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine, unlike the Zaïre strain, which has a vaccine. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and recommended clinical trials of vaccines and drugs for Bundibugyo. Uganda and Rwanda closed borders; the US will not allow Ebola cases to enter. By late 2026, the African CDC head pledged vaccine and treatment for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラについて：我々は流行を阻止できる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の国際的拡大イベントとして、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラウイルスによる新規流行。約1,000疑似症例、246死亡（Ituri州）。ウガンダで7確認症例、1死亡。PHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・治療薬なし。隣国ウガンダ・ルワンダでの確認症例あるが、記事サマリー上の主要発生地はDRCであるため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Σαρώνει ο Εμπολα: Ολα όσα πρέπει να γνωρίζετε για να τον αντιμετωπίσετε | ΤΟ ΒΗΜΑ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is sweeping through: All you need to know to deal with it.
article.articleSummary: On May 17, 2026, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola outbreaks triggered by Bundibugyo virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, not a pandemic. Ebola virus disease (EVD) damages blood vessels and causes severe internal bleeding, transmitted from animals to humans and through close contact with blood, organs, secretions, and fluids. Outbreaks include 2014–2016, when EVD spread from DRC to Liberia, Guinea, and Sierra Leone, over 28,600 cases and 10,000 deaths; and 2018–2020 from DRC to Uganda, with additional outbreaks in Gabon, Ivory Coast, Nigeria, Mali, and Senegal, at least 2,000 deaths. EVD strains differ from Sudan virus (SVD); EVD survival ~10%, SVD ~50%. Treatments include Ebanga and Inmazeb; avoid concurrent live vaccines. Ervebo, a live attenuated vaccine, is approved in the US and EU. Uganda hosts Sudan vaccine trials (Feb 2025) during an active outbreak; a Sudan vaccine shows promise.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが広がっている：対処するために知る必要があるすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。2026年5月17日にWHOが国際的懸念対象の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラの複数国での同時多発的アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは明示的にDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクを主張としており、WPROターゲット国はDRCのみ該当。過去のアウトブレイク事例としてリベリア、ギニア、シエラレオネ、ガボン、コートジボワール、ナイジェリア、マリ、セネガルが言及されているが、これらは履歴的背景情報であり、現在の発生地ではない。米国が「発生地域」に含まれているが、記事内容ではワクチン承認国として記載されており、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kaluma: US should set up Ebola quarantine centre in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Homa Bay Town MP Peter Kaluma urges the United States to urgently establish an Ebola quarantine and treatment centre in Kenya to bolster preparedness amid Ebola concerns connected to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The facility would serve Americans exposed to or at high risk, with U.S. Public Health Service Commissioned Corps personnel alerted to deploy for staffing. As of May 26, 2026, Kenyan government approval was pending. The Trump administration is expected to deploy public health officers to Kenya for this purpose. President William Ruto, at a May 28, 2026 Nairobi meeting, called for intensified international cooperation and announced strengthened surveillance at Points of Entry, underscoring Kenya’s role as a regional gateway and hub hosting international organisations to sustain health security following outbreaks in neighbouring countries.

triage.headline_ja: カルマ議員：米国はケニアにエボラ隔離センターを設置すべき
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という高い関心疾患であり、DRCでの発生と関連してケニアの備備強化が議論されているが、ケニア国内での実際の症例報告または確認された感染イベントの記述がなく、政治的提案・備備要求の段階である。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアでのエボラ隔離センター設置要求を述べているが、ケニア国内での実際のエボラ発生・症例確認の明示がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。政治的対応・準備活動段階であり、実際のイベント（症例確認など）が報告されていない。DRCでのエボラ発生に関連した区域的対応・備備強化の動向として注視が必要だが、現段階ではシグナル認定の閾値に達していない。

article.articleHeadline: США створюють у Кенії карантинний центр для запобігання поширенню вірусу Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States is creating a quarantine center in Kenya to prevent the spread of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the United States is establishing a 50-bed quarantine facility in Kenya to isolate American citizens who had contact with Bundibugyo ebolavirus carriers but are asymptomatic, aiming to prevent Ebola exposure in the United States. With no effective vaccine for Bundibugyo, symptomatic patients would be transported to third countries, with no return to the U.S. until full recovery. Secretary of State Marco Rubio affirmed the administration’s stance against any export of infection to U.S. soil. The U.S. has imposed strict entry restrictions on people who recently visited Uganda, South Sudan, or the Democratic Republic of Congo, including green-card holders, amid more than 900 suspected regional cases. Kenya supports the center and will add biosafety blocks for maximum isolation. The approach seeks a remote pandemic-response shield against cross-border threats and related misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラウイルスの拡散を防ぐためケニアに隔離センターを設置
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に極めて深刻な感染症であり、複数のアフリカ諸国での発生、米国による渡航制限と隔離施設設置という異例の対応が報じられている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで具体的に記述されている発生地域はウガンダ、南スーダン、コンゴ民主共和国の3国。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。米国での隔離施設設置はケニアの領土内であるが、主要な感染症イベント発生地はDRCおよび周辺国。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス別種）に関する具体的な患者数・死亡数の言及がないため「重症度」「公衆衛生影響」の評価は記事記載情報に基づくが、900件以上の疑似症例という記述により重症度とmanageability（支援必要性）は確認される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO prioritises clinical trials for Ebola Bundibugyo vaccines, therapeutics amid outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, the World Health Organization coordinates a global response to the Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with additional cases reported in Uganda. WHO expert panels concluded that all candidate vaccines and therapeutics should be evaluated exclusively in controlled clinical trials to generate robust safety and efficacy data. There are no licensed BVD vaccines or treatments. For treatment of confirmed BVD cases, investigational MBP134 and Maftivimab monoclonal antibodies, and remdesivir, were prioritized for trial evaluation, with potential benefit from combination therapy. For post-exposure prophylaxis, the oral antiviral obeldesivir is a priority candidate, contingent on effective contact tracing. Vaccines discussed include the single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine (IAVI), expected to reach trial readiness in 7–9 months, and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute), potentially in 2–3 months with additional animal data. Ervebo should not be used outside trials due to uncertain cross-protection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギオ流行に対してWHOがワクチンと治療薬の臨床試験を優先化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響（死亡の可能性を持つ既知の感染症の大規模流行）と国際的拡大のリスク（複数国での発生確認）が明確に認められ、スクリーニング基準においても重症度、流行性、対応能力についての懸念が検出される。また、WHO調整による世界的対応という社会・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）はAPI発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー上では「additional cases reported in Uganda」と表現されており、主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。BundibugiyoはEbolaの稀な亜種であるが、同一の致死的Filovirus感染症であり、ワクチン・治療薬の緊急臨床試験という状況から、公衆衛生上の重大性は確実である。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC places states on high preparedness alert over Ebola importation risk
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-29, Nigeria’s NCDC placed Lagos, the FCT, Rivers, Kano, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa on high Ebola preparedness due to elevated importation risk from international travel and regional movement. DRC and Uganda report 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 247 deaths; Nigeria has yet to record a confirmed Ebola case linked to the Bundibugyo outbreak. A WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern and cross-border transmission risk prompted intensified surveillance, with baselines for diagnostic metrics at international entry points and reinforced isolation facilities for safe fluid collection. Moderate-risk states—Ogun, Nasarawa, Kaduna, Plateau, Kogi, Niger, Jigawa, Katsina, Bauchi, Ebonyi, Abia, Bayelsa—require sustained readiness. State health authorities must submit 72-hour readiness updates; rapid risk assessments will focus on high-density settings and migrant corridors. No licensed vaccines or targeted therapeutics exist for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: NCDCがエボラ流入リスクに対する高度警戒態勢を州に通知
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを伴う異常なイベント。DRC・ウガンダでの1,077疑似症例と247死亡、および複数州での高度な警戒態勢から、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアのエボラ警戒態勢。DRCおよびウガンダでの確認事例（1,077疑似症例、247死亡）に基づきナイジェリアが警戒を強化している。WHOによるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言済み。対象国リストにはウガンダおよびニジェールが含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはナイジェリアとDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le gouvernement ne va pas fermer les écoles malgré le décès de cinq enfants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the government will not close schools despite the death of five children.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo: The government will not close schools and will instead enhance preventive measures in educational settings, announced by Health Minister Roger Kamba in Bunia on May 28. He expressed concern over at least five student deaths, suggesting many resulted from self-medication and delays in seeking medical care. Families are urged to avoid home treatments and promptly refer suspected cases to health facilities, as part of heightened vigilance in Ituri. The outbreak spans three provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—across 13 health zones. As of May 26, 16 new confirmed cases were recorded in Ituri, bringing the province to 121 confirmed cases (110 in Ituri), 17 deaths among confirmed cases, and 1,077 suspected cases cumulatively.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリのエボラ: 5人の子どもの死亡にもかかわらず政府は学校を閉鎖しない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、複数州にまたがる流行は異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク高く、渡航・貿易制限対象となり得る。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最も重篇度の高い感染症の一つであり、複数地域（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブの3州13保健圏）での同時流行、累積1,077件の疑似患者、17件の死亡確認例という報告は、DRCの対応能力を超える可能性が高い。子どもの死亡例5件、自己投薬による遅延治療の問題、学校での予防措置強化の必要性が指摘されている点は、コミュニティ・レベルでの感染リスク管理と教育機関での感染予防の課題を示唆している。国際的な疫学調査支援、診断・治療能力強化の支援が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Закрытие границ не спасет от Эболы -- глава ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Border closures won't save you from Ebola — WHO chief.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says border closures are ineffective for Ebola control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, offering only a brief delay and not stopping transmission. Rapid sanitation measures, strengthened medical surveillance, and swift outbreak-area support are identified as the most effective response. The statement follows several African nations tightening border controls: Uganda temporarily closed its border with the DRC on May 27, Rwanda closed its border, and Zambia increased medical screening at checkpoints. The WHO had previously assessed the global risk of Ebola spread.

triage.headline_ja: 国境閉鎖はエボラから救わない――WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の複数国での発生・対応状況を報道。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、および高い社会的・政治的関心を示唆。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ発生が記事の主題。サマリーで明示的にDRCでの発生、ウガンダ・ルワンダ・ザンビアでの対応（国境閉鎖・スクリーニング強化）が述べられている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）とZambia（895949）が該当。ウガンダ（226074）およびルワンダ（49518）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO声明の配信日時が2026年5月となっているが、これはBluedot APIの配信日時であり、実際のイベント発生時期は別途検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO-Chef: Ebola-Ausbruch in DRK ist "sehr schwierig" einzudämmen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: Ebola outbreak in the DRK is "very difficult" to contain.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, is described by the World Health Organization as 'very difficult' to contain. Fighting and a tense security situation are hampering the work of aid workers and complicating containment efforts. The conflict-related insecurity slows response operations and access to affected communities, allowing transmission to continue. The outbreak is particularly affecting children, who are described as being disproportionately impacted by the crisis. The regional violence in Ituri remains a major obstacle to stopping the outbreak and protecting vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：DRCのエボラ発生は「非常に抑制が難しい」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認例であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の困難な封じ込め状況、国際的拡大リスク、WHO・国際社会の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRC北東部Ituri州中心のエボラ発生が確認される。WHO事務局長が「非常に抑制が難しい」とコメント。紛争による治安悪化が対応を阻害し、特に子どもが被害を受けている。国内対応能力の限界が明確で、国際支援・RRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak spirals faster than global response
article.articleSummary: Congo’s Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) in eastern Congo, centered in Ituri, has about 900 cases and 220 suspected deaths per WHO, with the virus spreading to Uganda (7 cases). There is no vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo. As of last week, only 7% of 1,261 identified contacts had been traced, while WHO cited more than 2,000 contacts. The outbreak is outpacing the response, with attacks on health facilities and community mistrust hampering containment; health workers face dangerous conditions and limited resources, including tests to distinguish Bundibugyo from other Ebola viruses. Incubation is 21 days, and exposed individuals must be monitored; missteps delay detection. Funding cuts and US withdrawal from WHO hinder international aid. Experts warn the situation worsens without a fully resourced response, citing West Africa’s 2014–2016 outbreak (28,000+ cases, 11,000+ deaths) as a painful reference.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が世界的対応より速く拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、約900症例、220人の疑い死亡、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし、接触者追跡率7%という深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ東部イトゥリ州が震源地で約900症例、ウガンダへの波及（7症例）が報告されている。Bluedotが検出したAngola（3351879）はサマリーに言及されていないため除外。ブンディブギョ株は治療法・ワクチンなし、接触者追跡率7%と対応能力が深刻に不足。2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（28,000+症例、11,000+死亡）との比較で警告レベルが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola's warning * Lesley Russell
article.articleSummary: Global response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the central concern as of 27 May, with the World Health Organization declaring the outbreak an international public health emergency. The DRC has reported more than 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths; Uganda has confirmed seven cases and one death. With porous borders to Burundi, Rwanda, and South Sudan, ten African countries are considered at risk, and attacks on Ebola treatment centers and morgues in Ituri province further hamper containment. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists; urgent vaccine development is underway, including a monovalent Bundibugyo vaccine in development by the Oxford Vaccine Group with the Serum Institute of India. Funding erosion, notably US cuts—USAID, CDC, NIH—and the US withdrawal from WHO, has created a US$553 million gap and undermined preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,077疑い例、246死亡）、異常・予想外（稀なBundibugyo株）、国際的拡大リスク（10アフリカ国が危機、複数国での確認），渡航・貿易制限リスク。またWPRO基準でも複数該当。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の感染発生国を特定：DRC（主要な発生地）、ウガンダ（7例確認）が述べられている。発生地域にはUSA、スーダン、ルワンダ、ブルンジ、ウガンダも含まれているが、サマリー上での主題はDRCが中心。インドは記事内で「Serum Institute of India」としてワクチン開発への協力に言及されており、感染発生国ではなく支援国だが、同梱されたBluedotの地域リストに含まれていることから参考情報として保持。ただし厳密には感染発生地はDRCとウガンダのみだが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Langsung Tenang Saat Demam Anak Turun, Ini Bahaya Fase Kritis DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Relax Right Away When Your Child's Fever Subsides: The Dangers of the Critical Phase of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) in Indonesian children commonly follows a 'saddle' fever pattern. In the initial phase (days 1–3), fever rises to 38–40°C with headache, muscle/joint pain, nausea, vomiting, weakness, and a red rash. Maintain fluids and use acetaminophen per doctor’s instructions; avoid ibuprofen or aspirin due to bleeding risk. The critical phase typically occurs as fever falls (days 4–6), when plasma leakage can cause Dengue Shock Syndrome if untreated. Warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, nosebleeds or gum bleeding, rash, marked lethargy, cold hands/feet, rapid breathing, or reduced consciousness; seek urgent medical care promptly. Recovery usually begins days 7–10 with appetite and energy returning; monitor fluids, nutrition, and perform platelet/hematocrit tests. Prevention—drain standing water, cover containers, recycle potential breeding sites, and use nets or child-safe repellents. Indonesia, as of 2026-05-29.

triage.headline_ja: お子さんの発熱が下がってもすぐに安心してはいけません：デング出血熱の危機的段階の危険性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング出血熱（DHF）の臨床的特徴と管理に関する教育的記事。確認された症例数や異常な流行状況の報告がなく、具体的な新規アウトブレイク情報に欠けるため、現時点では情報不足として経過観察段階と判定。
triage.notes: 本記事は医療・公衆衛生情報を扱った教育的コンテンツであり、特定の新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。デング熱の重症度（DHF/DSS）、持続的な曝露リスク、流行しやすい性質について言及されているが、現在の流行状況の異常性や規模を示す具体的数値データが記事に含まれていない。継続的な情報収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-fertőzés gyanúja miatt kezelnek egy nőt egy szomszédos országban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman is being treated in a neighboring country on suspicion of Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola in Austria: A woman is being treated under strict security in Vienna after Ebola suspicion. She originally arrived at Linz Hospital and was transported to the Vienna Favoriten Clinic's isolation ward, equipped with a negative-pressure system to prevent pathogen escape. The patient had recently returned on Monday from Uganda, where recent Ebola-associated illnesses and deaths have been reported. Uganda borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where outbreaks have also occurred. Health authorities immediately began contact tracing, reaching out to anyone who may have had contact during travel or care; quarantines may be imposed if infection is confirmed. The patient is described as clinically stable. The first blood test was negative, which is encouraging but may yield false negatives in early disease; final results are expected in the coming days as additional samples are analyzed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の疑いで隣国で女性が治療を受けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラは最高リスク病原体であり、確定診断待機段階での適切なシグナル検出。
triage.notes: 患者はオーストリアで検査中であるが、発生地域としての検証対象国はコンゴ民主共和国のみ。記事はウガンダでの最近の流行に言及しているがウガンダは対象国ではないため除外。エボラの疑い症例であり、初回検査は陰性だが早期の偽陰性の可能性があるため確定診断待機。既に接触者追跡が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO head says Ebola outbreak can be stopped as he arrives in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: The Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu, was declared on 15 May. As of 29 May 2026, the WHO reports 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths among more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to oversee the response and is to travel to Ituri, the epicentre, the following day. Efforts are hampered by ongoing fighting in eastern DRC; a ceasefire is urged. International funding remains insufficient (about one-third of what is needed). Advisory groups have recommended clinical trials for vaccines and treatments, and the WHO does not support travel bans, as reporting transparency is encouraged.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国到着時にエボラ流行は阻止可能と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、すでに10人の確認死亡と223人の疑似死亡を含む1000人以上の症例が報告されている。コンゴ民主共和国内での多地域拡大と国際的拡大リスク、ワクチンなし・治療法なしの流行株による非常事態である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、ワクチンと特異的治療法が存在しない。5月15日に宣言されたばかりの急速な流行。WHO事務局長の現地到着と国際資金不足（必要額の3分の1）は高いレベルの懸念を示している。東部コンゴの紛争が対応を阻害。

article.articleHeadline: Top 5 Stories Of The Day | NCDC Places Lagos, Abuja, and Other States on High Ebola Alert | YNaija
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in East and Central Africa prompts Nigeria's NCDC to place Lagos, the Federal Capital Territory (Abuja), and other states on high alert. Nigeria warns of a high risk of importing Ebola due to international travel, porous borders, and increased regional movement. A public health advisory issued to health commissioners lists high-risk states: Lagos, Rivers, Kano, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa. Although Nigeria has not recorded any confirmed Ebola cases, preparedness is intensified for rapid detection and response. Globally, more than 1,000 suspected cases and 247 deaths have been reported in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo connected to the Bundibugyo strain. The warning emphasizes surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and readiness to prevent importation of any cases.

triage.headline_ja: NCDC、ラゴスおよび他州をエボラ高警戒状態に配置 | YNaija
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株エボラの地域流行に対する国家的準備体制の構築であり、WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラはウガンダおよびDRCで地域流行中（1000件超の疑い例、247死亡報告）。ナイジェリアはイントロダクションリスク評価と多州の高警戒体制。記事サマリーで確認される発生国はナイジェリア（輸入リスク対応中）とDRC（既流行地）。ウガンダも言及されているが、GeoNames IDリストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus, Ebola... " on enregistre une nouvelle maladie tous les 14 à 16 mois " : comment l'érosion de la biodiversité accélère l'émergence d'épidémies
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus, Ebola... "we record a new disease every 14 to 16 months": how biodiversity erosion accelerates the emergence of epidemics
article.articleSummary: Three deaths and thirteen confirmed hantavirus cases, with dozens of contacts, mark an early-May outbreak on a cruise from Ushuaia to Cape Verde, reviving memories of the early COVID-19 days. Simultaneously, a new Ebola outbreak is ravaging the Democratic Republic of Congo. Ecologist Philippe Grandcolas warns that biodiversity erosion is the major driver accelerating the emergence of new diseases, a theme echoed in the article’s framing of a recurring pattern—roughly a new disease every 14–16 months. The article links these events to biodiversity loss and ecosystem disruption that facilitate spillovers, urging urgent attention to surveillance and outbreak response as concurrent epidemics unfold.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス、エボラ... 「14～16ヶ月ごとに新しい病気が記録される」：生物多様性の喪失がいかに疫病の出現を加速させるか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な多疾患同時発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の対象国（DRC、ザンビアを経由する大陸間クルーズ）で同時多発する高リスク疾患（エボラ、ハンタウイルス）の報告であり、クルーズシップでの国際的スプレッド懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが列挙した地域のうち、Argentina（Tierra del Fuego、Ushuaia）とCabo Verdeは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCでのエボラ発生は記事サマリーに明確に述べられており検証済み。クルーズ船（Ushuaia～Cape Verde間）での国際的スプレッドリスクは高いが、クルーズの出発地であるアルゼンチンは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。ハンタウイルス13例確認、死者3名との深刻度、および同時多発するエボラアウトブレイク（DRC）による複合リスクが特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Alarm in Österreich: Frau in Spezialklinik nach Wien gebracht - zweiter Test steht noch aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in Austria: Woman brought to a specialized clinic in Vienna — second test still pending.
article.articleSummary: Upper Austria woman, who volunteered in Uganda, returned home with Ebola suspicion and was isolated in Linz; a first blood test was negative, with a second test due 72 hours after the initial draw. She has been transported by specialized infection teams to a Vienna clinic (Vienna-Favoriten) under strict biosafety, with the patient stable during transfer. Final results are expected on Saturday, May 30, 2026. Authorities stated no direct contact with Ebola patients in Africa, though secondary exposure cannot be ruled out. Uganda currently faces an active Ebola outbreak. In neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities report more than 900 suspected cases and over 200 deaths. The World Health Organization warns the situation in affected African countries could worsen.

triage.headline_ja: オーストリアのエボラ警戒：女性がウィーンの専門クリニックに搬送 — 2回目の検査はまだ実施予定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の疑似症例が報告され、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。アフリカでの流行背景と検査実施中の不確実性により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: オーストリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。記事本体はウガンダの活動的なエボラ流行とDRCでの900件超の疑似症例・200人以上の死亡を背景としており、DRCが対象国のため列挙した。検査結果待機中で確定診断未確定だが、高リスク患者の疑い事例として即座の監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết tăng nhanh, bác sỹ cảnh báo biến chứng nguy hiểm khó lường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is rising rapidly; doctors warn of dangerous, unpredictable complications.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Vietnam reports over 42,000 dengue cases nationwide, with fatalities, as the country enters its peak transmission season due to hot, humid, and rainy weather that promotes Aedes aegypti transmission. Dengue virus has four serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4); individuals can be infected multiple times, and secondary infection can worsen disease. The illness typically has three clinical stages; severe warning signs appear between days 3–7, including severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, hepatomegaly, altered consciousness, and risk of shock or multi-organ failure without urgent care. No antiviral exists; management is supportive. Prevention hinges on vector control and vaccination. Qdenga, the first dengue vaccine licensed in Vietnam, protects against all four serotypes and is given as two doses 3 months apart for ages 4+. Efficacy >80% after 12 months and >90% reduction in hospitalization after 18 months; contraindications include immunodeficiency, vaccine allergy, pregnancy, or breastfeeding. Vaccination programs underway.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が急速に増加、医師が危険で予測不可能な合併症を警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで42,000件を超えるデング熱症例が報告されており、死亡例を伴う異常な増加が見られている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当する。
triage.notes: ベトナムは既に予防接種プログラム（Qdenga）を展開中。ピーク感染シーズン（5月）における大規模outbreak。複数の血清型が循環する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: China warns citizens against non-essential travel to Congo over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts China to warn citizens against non-essential travel. The Central African nation reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases, including 121 confirmed, and 17 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Ituri and North Kivu provinces are cited as affected. WHO has raised the alert level to very high, and neighboring countries have tightened travel measures. The Foreign Ministry advised avoiding Congo and Ebola-affected regions and warned against contact with wild animals and suspected patients. Chinese nationals exhibiting fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain or bleeding should seek immediate medical treatment or contact Chinese medical teams. The advisory emphasizes vigilance amid growing international concern over the virus's spread in central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラウイルス発生を理由にコンゴへの不要不急な渡航をしないよう国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの大規模集団発生で、国際的警告レベルが最高度に引き上げられており、複数国での行動が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラウイルス発生が主題。中国は感染国ではなく、警告を発出している関係国として記述されているが、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみ（Ituri、North Kivu州）。1,077疑い例（121確定例）、17死亡、5月15日発生宣言、WHOアラートレベルが最高度。隣接国での予防措置強化が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: FG Moves to Restrict International Flights Over Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, Nigeria is weighing temporary flight restrictions and stronger border controls to avert a potential Ebola outbreak amid rising concerns over cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. A Lagos meeting chaired by Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila, with NCDC Director-General Dr. Jide Idris, Interior Minister Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, and Lagos Health Commissioner Prof. Akin Abayomi, outlined emergency measures: isolating travellers showing Ebola symptoms, using cargo terminals for affected passengers, and tightened checks at airports, seaports, and land borders. The Presidency was briefed, and agencies are urged to bolster early detection and rapid response. Nigeria’s 2014 containment of Ebola in Lagos—after an infected Liberian-American diplomat arrived—remains a critical reference, with officials warning the country remains vulnerable due to high passenger movement and international travel, necessitating strengthened interagency coordination.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア政府、エボラウイルスの流行に対応して国際線の制限を検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。対象国DRCでの流行に対応したナイジェリアの主要な防止措置により、シグナル価値が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主な焦点はナイジェリアの防止措置であるが、実際のエボラ流行はDRC及びウガンダで発生している。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ウガンダも記事に言及されているが対象国でないため除外。2014年のラゴスでのエボラ事例への言及は過去事例の参照であり、現在の発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Конфликтот во источно ДР Конго е најголема пречка за запирање на еболата, вели шефот на СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The conflict in eastern DR Congo is the biggest obstacle to stopping Ebola, says the WHO chief.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia, Ituri province, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently circulating. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this strain; control relies on treating infected individuals under strict safety protocols and isolating contacts for 21 days. The security situation is the main barrier to ending transmission, as ongoing conflict has displaced about 100,000 people in the past month, hindering containment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged a ceasefire and stepped-up international funding to supply health workers with equipment and support. The WHO is accelerating clinical trials for therapies, though effective treatments may still take months to become available. Ituri, a densely populated mining area, presents elevated transmission risks, with Bunia identified as a focal point of the latest outbreak. Published date: 2026-05-29.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴ民主共和国の紛争がエボラ対策の最大の障害であると、WHO事務局長が述べた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の発生で、IHR基準3項目に該当。深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、治療法がない希少株の特異性があり、WHO事務局長による国際支援要請の政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ザイール型以外の稀な株）の流行であり、承認済みワクチン・治療法がない点が重要。紛争による避難民約10万人と過密採鉱地域という地理的・社会的要因が制御困難性を高めている。WHO事務局長による国際的資金援助要請は高い政治的関心を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Congo seeks US monoclonal antibody for Bundibugyo Ebola strain
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is contending with Bundibugyo Ebola strain; Kinshasa formally requested access to MBP-134, an experimental monoclonal antibody developed in the United States and tested against Zaire, Sudan, and Bundibugyo strains. The request includes 500 doses and would be administered within a clinical trial framework, reflecting limited clinical data and ongoing research. The treatment has been associated with support from the U.S. CDC in Atlanta and was noted as helping quell a Sudan strain outbreak in Uganda in 2025; however, trials remain limited and mostly conducted in monkeys. A U.S. citizen infected in DRC was airlifted to Germany for treatment and is reported recovering. In 2020, FDA-approved therapies Inmazeb and Ebanga became part of Ebola protocols. In the DRC, management remains supportive: rehydration for diarrhoea and treatment of severe anaemia from haemorrhaging.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ブンディブギョエボラ株に対する米国の単クローン抗体を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の発生がDRCで確認され、複数のIHR基準を満たす。死亡率が高い病原体、国際的な医療介入が必要、米国を含む複数国が関与する国際的な関心事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、Eastern DRCでBundibugyo Ebola株の発生が確認されており、Kinshasaが正式に米国の試験的単クローン抗体（MBP-134）へのアクセスを要請している。Atlanta（USA）およびUgandaの過去事例は背景情報として記載されているが、現在の発生地は東DRCが主要である。米国のCDC関与、国際的な患者移送（DRCからドイツへの患者空輸）、複数国にまたがる関心が確認でき、全WPRO基準を満たす。ただしBluedotの発生地域にはAtlanta, Georgia, USが含まれているが、これらは支援国または対象国外のため、verified_locationsはDRC（203312）のみとしている。

article.articleHeadline: Nigerian Govt Considers Flight Restrictions as Ebola Cases Rise in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Nigeria is weighing flight restrictions from Ebola-affected countries to prevent a potential domestic outbreak. A Lagos emergency meeting with the NCDC, Ministry of Interior, and Lagos State officials led by Chief of Staff Femi Gbajabiamila outlined measures including possible bans on flights from countries of concern, isolation of symptomatic travelers at airports, and designated cargo terminals for arrivals from affected nations. Entry points will be placed under strict surveillance, with the Nigerian Immigration Service coordinating with the NCDC to bolster early detection and response. NCDC Director-General Dr. Jide Idris warned that Ebola remains deadly and urged rapid detection, immediate isolation, public awareness, and stringent infection prevention, with preparedness plans activated nationwide and healthcare workers on alert. The government reports Tinubu has been briefed. WHO notes 10 Ebola-related deaths and 223 suspected deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo since mid-May, highlighting ongoing regional risk, particularly in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア政府がアフリカでのエボラ症例増加に対応して航空便制限を検討
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という極めて重篇度の高い感染症について、複数国での発生と国際的な拡大リスク（航空便制限検討）が報告されており、IHR基準3つ以上該当。地域での公式な対応体制が整備されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、DRCでのエボラ関連死亡と疑い症例が5月中旬以降報告されており、DRCが実際の発生地である。ナイジェリアは予防措置を検討中の国だが、サマリー上でDRCとウガンダが「Ebola-affected countries」として明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ナイジェリアはBluedetエリアに含まれているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda seals border with DRC
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Uganda closed its border with the Democratic Republic of Congo amid escalating Ebola transmission. DR Congo reports over 900 infections and at least 220 deaths; Uganda has seven cases and one death (in Kampala), with five cases linked to the initial two. Uganda has suspended air travel to DRC, closed several border crossings, and intensified border screening and surveillance. A mandatory 21-day self-isolation is required for anyone returning from the DRC, supervised by health authorities, with entrants subjected to health screening and documentation. Schools near the border remain open but must enforce infection-control procedures, including daily temperature checks for students who recently returned from the DRC for 21 days. The government also mandates 30 minutes of prime-time Ebola awareness programming and restricts mass gatherings in Kampala and other high-risk districts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダがコンゴ民主共和国との国境を封鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間での活動的な流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国の両国にまたがるエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはコンゴ民主共和国のみ。ウガンダは対象国外。発生地域に含まれるKampalaとRepublic of Ugandaは記事では確認されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRCで900件以上の感染と220人以上の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダへの流入も確認（7件、1死亡）されている。国境封鎖、航空停止、国際的な渡航制限の実施が伝えられており、IHR全基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia - Pse po përhapet Ebola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic - Why is Ebola spreading?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in Ituri and North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with roughly 900 confirmed cases and 220 deaths. The World Health Organization warns the hemorrhagic fever could spread further amid ongoing conflict and weak health systems. WHO plans on-the-ground support with equipment and expertise, but funding is constrained after US cut its contributions and Germany reduced its aid as well. Development funding from Germany’s BMZ amounts to about €160 million for 2026–2027, down from prior years, sparkingCalls from CARE and Caritas for increased assistance. In Goma, Diakonie reports only about 30% of needs met as hospitals are damaged, complicating Ebola response and supply of PPE, rapid tests, and lab capacity. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is circulating with no vaccine or cure; vaccine development could take at least nine months. Former Health Minister Karl Lauterbach urges greater development aid to bolster prevention.

triage.headline_ja: エピデミック - エボラはなぜ拡大しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、深刻な出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク、弱い保健システムの中での継続的な流行、国際的な支援と資金面での課題を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事は民主共和国コンゴ（DRC）のイトゥリ州および北キブ州でのエボラ継続流行を主題としており、約900確認症例と220死亡が報告されている。弱体化した保健システム、資金削減（米国・ドイツ）、ワクチン・治療法の不在により、制御困難な状況が示唆されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant が流行中。

article.articleHeadline: Vodja WHO-ja prispel v DR Kongo: "Skupaj bomo obvladali izbruh"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Director-General of the WHO arrived in DR Congo: "Together we will contain the outbreak"
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is battling a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with 1,077 infections and 246 deaths reported as of May 29, 2026. The outbreak emanates from the east, with Ituri province highlighted as a focus, and marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in a country of over 100 million. There is currently no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in DR Congo, vowing to help contain the outbreak and stressing that testing is being expanded with local partners. The virus has crossed into neighboring Uganda, which reports seven suspected cases; Uganda has closed its western border, though WHO cautions border closures can hamper control efforts. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya said a vaccine could be ready by year’s end, with Africa CDC facilitating access; meanwhile funding shortfalls persist, with about $290 million raised of $500 million pledged.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がDR コンゴに到着：「我々は一緒に感染症の流行に対処する」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebola の大規模流行（1,077症例、246死亡）、国際拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、異常な事象、渡航制限の実施により、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）進行の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）における Bundibugyo Ebola の流行が主題である。ウガンダへの越境拡大（疑い例7件）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。WHO事務局長の現地到着、ワクチン開発の進捗（年末までに利用可能見通し）、資金不足（2.9億ドル獲得、5億ドル誓約）など、支援ニーズが明確に認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda closes border with Congo over Ebola surge
article.articleSummary: Uganda closes its border with Congo amid a surge of suspected Bundibugyo Ebola in eastern Congo; Ugandan health workers are confirmed exposed after crossing with Congolese patients before the outbreak was declared on May 15. The border closure is temporary and immediate, allowing only emergency crossings (outbreak response, humanitarian, cargo, or security), with entrants under emergency isolation for 21 days. Ebola spreads via close contact with the bodily fluids of the sick or deceased; health workers and family caretakers are at highest risk. Congo reports about 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 suspected deaths; 101 cases have been confirmed, with about 3,000 suspected contacts being traced. WHO says the outbreak is outpacing Congo’s containment, and the Bundibugyo strain has no approved medicines or vaccines. Tests initially targeted a more common type; displacement and insecurity complicate the response.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、エボラ急増を理由にコンゴとの国境を閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行性、管理可能性）。複数国への拡大と死亡者を伴う事例として、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主要な発生地はDRC（東部）である。ウガンダは国境閉鎖を実施した対応国だが、サマリー上の主題イベント（エボラ急増）はDRC内で発生していることが明確。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。約1,000疑似症例、220以上の疑似死亡、確認症例101件、接触者追跡3,000名。Bundibugyo型で承認済み医薬品・ワクチンなし。対応が急速な感染に追いつかないとWHOが警告。

article.articleHeadline: China warns citizens against non-essential travel to Congo over Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: China warned its citizens against non-essential travel to the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu provinces. As of May 29, 2026, the advisory notes about 1,077 suspected Ebola cases, 121 laboratory-confirmed, and 17 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15; some reports cite nearly 1,000 suspected cases and over 220 suspected deaths. The World Health Organization has raised the alert level to very high, and neighboring countries have tightened travel measures. The guidance urges avoidance of Ebola-affected regions, contact with wild animals, and contact with suspected patients. Symptoms prompting medical attention include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or bleeding. Chinese nationals in Congo or neighboring states should seek medical care promptly or contact Chinese medical teams if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ出血熱の流行を理由に、コンゴへの不要不急の渡航に対し国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて満たす。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡者、多数の確定症例）、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への警告・渡航制限）が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC（Ituri 州および North Kivu 州）でのエボラ流行が主題。中国とリストアップされているが、中国は警告発令国であり発生地ではなく、対象国リストに該当するのは DRC のみ。WHOが警戒レベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げ、周辺国が渡航措置を強化している状況も確認される。2026年5月15日の流行宣言以来、121例の確定症例と17例の死亡が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Marta García Aller denuncia la "indiferencia malévola" ante la epidemia de ébola: "Hay más de un centenar de casos ya"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marta García Aller denounces "malicious indifference" in the face of the Ebola epidemic: "There are already more than a hundred cases."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak concentrated in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. More than 100 confirmed cases and over 1,000 potential exposures reported. Uganda records seven cases in Kampala with one death; South Sudan reports a case near the Congolese border. Ten other African countries are at risk. The outbreak is intensified by conflict in Ituri, with hundreds of thousands displaced hindering contact tracing. The UN has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The article contrasts Ebola coverage with hantavirus attention on a luxury cruise. It notes the United States’ withdrawal from the WHO under President Trump as complicating international coordination, while reinforcing security measures even outside Africa to avoid impacting events like the FIFA World Cup.

triage.headline_ja: マルタ・ガルシア・アレール氏がエボラ流行に対する「悪意ある無関心」を非難：「すでに100件以上の症例がある」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。複数国でのエボラ確認、死亡例、PHEIC宣言、数千人の曝露が確認されているため、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダとスーダンの症例も言及されているが、当該対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。Bundibugyo strain による大規模エボラ流行（100症例以上確認、1000以上の接触者）。Ituri地域の紛争が感染対策を複雑化。PHEIC宣言済み。WHO脱退など国際協調の困難を背景に、多国間での対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola myths deepen crisis in eastern DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, has 904 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections by Sunday evening, with 119 deaths nationwide and Bunia recording the most confirmed cases.
