Uganda has reported five linked cases, including one death, linked to cross-border movement from Ituri; suspected cases are also in North and South Kivu, with infections being investigated in Butembo, Katwa and Miti-Murhesa. The crisis is magnified by conflict, displacement and deep mistrust of authorities, hindering contact tracing and early care. The outbreak began spreading during a funeral in mid-April after a sealed coffin was opened and burned; misinformation portrays Ebola as a financial or political tool, and some communities view it as a “creation of white people.” WHO has raised the risk to very high and warns spread to neighboring provinces and across borders is possible. Africa CDC cites 10 high-risk countries; Gates Foundation pledged $15 million to bolster surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ神話が東部コンゴの危機を深刻化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例・死亡あり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの関連症例確認）、WHO高リスク判定により、直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）における 904 疑似症例、101 確認症例、119 死亡を報告。ウガンダでの関連症例 5 件（死亡 1 件）も記載されているが、本トリアージ対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。WHO により非常に高いリスク判定されており、隣接州および国境を越えた拡大の可能性が指摘されている。紛争、住民移動、保健当局への不信が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: خلال زيارته للكونغو... تيدروس يتعهد باحتواء تفشي إيبولا رغم القتال وغياب اللقاحات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: During his visit to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Tedros vows to contain the Ebola outbreak despite fighting and vaccine shortages.
article.articleSummary: During a visit to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to oversee the Ebola response and planned to travel to Ituri province. As of May 24, 2026, the outbreak had 10 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths from over 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases; the true scale likely exceeds official counts. This seventh Ebola outbreak in DRC centers in Ituri and has spread to North and South Kivu amid fighting and displacement that hinder response. The Bundibugyo strain circulating has no approved vaccine or treatment; African CDC officials expect a vaccine by year-end. International aid includes 4.6 tons received at Bunia airport and UNICEF readiness to deliver about 100 tons; Uganda closed its border with DRC. The US plans a treatment center in Kenya for Americans, while WHO urges ceasefires and supports clinical trials of vaccines and therapies to facilitate containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国への訪問中、テドロス事務局長はワクチン不足と戦闘にもかかわらずエボラの流行を抑制することを約束
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（1,000例以上、233死亡）が複数地域に拡大し、国際的な対応・支援が展開されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の第7波。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で流行。1,000例以上の疑い例、233死亡。Bundibugyo型で承認済みワクチンなし。ウガンダが国境閉鎖、米国がケニアに治療センター設置予定。WHO事務局長による現地視察、国際的な支援体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Az USA újabb 80 millió dollárral segíti az ebola elleni védekezést
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States provides another $80 million to help fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, the United States provides another $80 million to help fight Ebola in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The funding will supply personal protective equipment for health workers, deliver laboratory tests, bolster airport screening to improve detection at airports in Central and East Africa, and support tracing of people who have come into contact with infected individuals. With the new $80 million, U.S. assistance to Ebola response over the past two weeks totals $112 million. Washington had previously indicated it would provide $50 million through the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs to operate clinics treating Ebola-affected patients, and an additional $300 million through regional humanitarian initiatives. The article underscores ongoing international support aimed at curbing Ebola outbreaks in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がエボラ対策に追加で8000万ドルを支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生がウガンダおよびコンゴ民主共和国で報告されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。国際的な支援体制が構築されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生が明確に述べられている。米国の大規模な追加資金提供、空港スクリーニングの強化、濃厚接触者追跡などの対応が報告されており、既に確立された感染症対応体制の存在を示唆している。中央アフリカおよび東アフリカ地域での空港スクリーニング強化という地域的な対応が言及されており、国際的な展開リスクが認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला प्रकोप के चलते युगांडा ने कांगो सीमा बंद की
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda closes border with Congo due to Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 27, 2026, Uganda closed its border with Congo amid a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Congo. Congo reports 121 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 17 deaths, with at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 suspected deaths. Uganda confirms seven Ebola cases and one death, linked to health workers exposed to Congo patients who crossed the border on May 15 before the outbreak was declared. Uganda’s health ministry restricts border crossings to emergencies, cargo, or security needs, with a 21-day mandatory isolation for emergency entrants. A first Bundibugyo virus recovery was discharged from a treatment center in Rwampara, eastern Congo. WHO discourages border closures but notes the high risk of cross-border transmission; it has designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Closing borders may shift movement to informal routes, increasing spread risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に伴いウガンダがコンゴとの国境を封鎖
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施、PHEIC指定）。WHO既に認定済みの国際的感染症危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ発生の主体はコンゴ東部（Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in eastern Congo）。ウガンダとルワンダは国境措置の実施国および二次感染例の報告国として言及されているが、記事の主題たる感染症イベント発生地はDRC。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。WHO既にPHEIC指定済み。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Aeropuertos específicos en EE.UU. para recibir pasajeros de países afectados por ébola; por ellos viajan dominicanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Specific U.S. airports to receive passengers from Ebola-affected countries; Dominicans travel through them.
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, the CDC designated four international airports—John F. Kennedy International (New York), Washington Dulles International (DC), Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta, and George Bush Intercontinental (Houston)—to screen passengers arriving from Ebola-affected countries, noting thousands of Dominicans travel through these hubs. The affected nations are the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Arrivals from these countries will undergo screening; anyone with Ebola symptoms will be transported to a hospital for medical evaluation and isolation. The World Health Organization reports 223 deaths and 906 suspected cases in the current outbreak. Ebola symptoms can appear 2–21 days after exposure and include fever, muscle and joint pains, severe headache (which after 4–5 days may cause loss of appetite), unexplained bleeding, and gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea and diarrhea. A dedicated Ebola information webpage has been launched by the U.S. State Department, CDC, and nearest embassy/consulate.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の影響を受けた国からの乗客を受け入れるための米国の特定の空港；ドミニカ人がそれらを利用して移動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目以上該当（国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の複数国での流行であり、主要な国際ハブでの入国スクリーニング体制の構築は公衆衛生上の重要な対応を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月配信の未来記事であり、現実的なシナリオを想定した報道。DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行が記載されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。米国での入国スクリーニング実施は国際的な感染拡大防止措置であり、公衆衛生上の重要な発展。DRC内での流行規模（906疑似症例、223死亡）が報告されており、深刻性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: A apărut vaccinul împotriva hantavirusului! Primele doze au fost trimise în țările afectate!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The hantavirus vaccine has appeared! The first doses have been sent to the affected countries!
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus vaccine has emerged, with initial doses sent to multiple affected countries—Netherlands, France, Spain, Switzerland, the United States, and South Africa—as Europe eye’s urgent response to outbreaks. The European Commission indicates Favipiravir, labeled an antiviral, as the most plausible candidate for use in clinical studies or protocols, though no approved treatment exists yet. About 1,400 doses have been distributed to France, Spain, and the Netherlands, with additional purchases planned if cases rise. Spain, France, and the Netherlands signaled interest in using the antiviral. Favipiravir, a replication blocker, was first approved in 2014 in Japan for influenza and used in COVID-19 protocols. Separately, the WHO on May 18, 2026 warned of escalating Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with at least 90 deaths, declaring an international public health emergency. The hantavirus transmission route remains rodent-related.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスワクチンが登場！最初の用量が感染国に送付された！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。さらにWPRO基準でも複数該当。DRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクはWHOが国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の疾患（ハンタウイルス、エボラ、インフルエンザ、COVID-19）を取り上げている。主要なシグナルはDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク（WHOが2026年5月18日に国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、少なくとも90人の死亡）。ハンタウイルスについては、記事はワクチン開発と複数国への配布を報じているが、ハンタウイルス自体の実際のアウトブレイク規模や死亡数は不明。エボラはWPRO対象国のDRCで確認されているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: WHO prioritises clinical trials for Bundibugyo Ebola treatments, vaccines
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak with additional cases in Uganda. There are no licensed vaccines or therapeutics specific to BVD. WHO convened expert groups to prioritize clinical-trial evaluation of candidates for prevention and treatment. For treatment of confirmed BVD, MBP134 and Maftivimab®, plus the antiviral remdesivir, are prioritized, with a proposed evaluation of combination monoclonal antibody plus remdesivir in research settings. For prevention, obeldesivir is identified as a priority for post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts, contingent on effective contact tracing, which is operationally challenging in parts of the DRC. The leading vaccine candidate is the single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo vaccine (IAVI), likely 7–9 months from trial readiness; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute) could enter efficacy testing in 2–3 months pending animal data. Ervebo, the licensed Ebola vaccine, should not be used outside carefully designed research settings to assess cross-protection against BVD. WHO and partners are developing trial protocols while continuing standard outbreak measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ブンディブギョエボラの治療法とワクチンの臨床試験を優先化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Diseaseは稀な病原体であり、DRCとウガンダでの同時発生は対応体制を要する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで主として取り上げられているのはDRCのBundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease(BVD)アウトブレイク。Ugandaに追加症例があると記述されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ワクチン・治療薬の臨床試験優先化という対応段階であり、重症度と管理複雑性が高い。WHO専門家グループの活動が示唆する国際的な支援フレームワークの必要性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : plus de 140 lits d'isolement disponibles en deux semaines (Ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: more than 140 isolation beds available within two weeks (Minister of Health) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the Health Ministry announcing rapid expansion of isolation and treatment capacity. In Bunia, on May 29, 2026, Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba said two treatment centers are already operational and a third center with a 100-bed capacity will be completed by this Saturday, bringing total isolation beds to about 130–140 within two weeks. The new facilities aim to improve care for suspected and confirmed Ebola cases and to limit transmission in the outbreak zones. The response also includes ongoing epidemiological surveillance, community awareness campaigns, and reinforcement of barrier measures in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州のエボラ：2週間以内に140以上の隔離床が利用可能に（保健大臣）
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱はWHO規定の最優先病原体で、確認された患者と治療施設の整備という明確な発生指標がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）イツリ州のエボラ発生を報告。患者確認、治療施設の急速整備、疫学的監視体制の構築が記述されている。エボラはIHR上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）対象疾患であり、確認された発生は自動的にシグナルレベル。DRCのみが対象国として検証される。

article.articleHeadline: Besuch im Kongo: WHO-Chef zeigt sich im Kampf gegen Ebola optimistisch und kritisiert Reiseverbote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Visit to the Congo: WHO chief is optimistic about the fight against Ebola and criticizes travel bans.
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the outbreak focus in Ituri Province near the Uganda border, a conflict-affected area. He expressed optimism the outbreak could be stopped and criticized travel bans, stating WHO does not support border restrictions. As of today, WHO reports roughly 223 suspected Ebola deaths and 10 laboratory-confirmed deaths since the outbreak began; the true scale is likely larger. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no licensed vaccines or treatments yet. WHO advisory groups have recommended clinical studies for vaccines and therapies that could be effective against Bundibugyo, and will work closely with the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda to evaluate promising products.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ訪問：WHO事務局長がエボラとの戦いに楽観的で、渡航禁止を批判
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の確認された流行、死亡者が既に報告されており（疑い223件、確認10件）、国際的な懸念と支援が必要な段階。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は既知のエボラ株の中でも予防・治療手段が限定的（ワクチン・治療薬なし）であり、紛争地域での流行という複雑な状況。ウガンダとの国境地域での発生で国際的波及リスクが存在。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は事態の深刻性を反映。

article.articleHeadline: Hrozí nákaza ebolou při letu na dovolenou? Epidemiolog vysvětlil, co by se muselo stát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is there a risk of contracting Ebola on a vacation flight? An epidemiologist explained what would have to happen.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda have caused over 240 deaths, with an American physician in isolation at Prague’s Bulovka hospital after contact with an infected patient. Epidemiologist Rastislav Maďar says the risk of contracting Ebola on a flight is very low unless there is direct, unprotected contact with bodily fluids (e.g., touching, vomiting, or being splashed with blood). Ebola is not airborne; transmission requires close, bodily-fluid exposure, especially within about two meters. Modern aircraft HEPA filters help, but risk rises with proximity and longer exposure on long flights. Practical advice includes carrying a respirator and getting vaccinations where feasible. Charter flights may be comparatively safer than long regular routes due to fewer international passengers, though travelers should remain vigilant about precautions for all journeys.

triage.headline_ja: バケーション便でのエボラ感染リスク？疫学者が説明：何が起こる必要があるのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での流行、死亡者240名以上、そして国際的な輸送リスクが懸念されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴとウガンダでのエボラ流行を主題としているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。プラハの患者報告はアメリカ人医師の接触事例であり、チェコでの流行発生ではないため除外。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれる。国際的な航空輸送リスク、複数国での流行、死亡事例の報告により、社会的・政治的関心が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉第17次侵袭刚果（金） 谭德塞亲赴前线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola’s 17th outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus personally goes to the front line.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak resurges in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri province as the epicenter—the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. On May 28, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced he would travel to the DRC to lead the response, joining WHO teams, partners, and local health workers under the government’s leadership. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for both the DRC and neighboring Uganda, though global risk remains low. National risk is assessed as very high, regional risk high. As of May 26, 1,077 suspected Ebola cases have been reported, with transmission expanding to several eastern provinces. The DRC has previously contained 16 outbreaks; officials stress urgent action and cross-border cooperation to defeat the current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国での第17次流行—テドロス事務局長が前線視察へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的な再興流行であり、PHEIC宣言済み、WHO事務局長の現地視察決定など国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、DRCのイトゥリ州を中心としたエボラの第17次流行を主題としている。ウガンダはPHEIC宣言対象国として言及されているが、実際の患者報告地域はDRCに限定されている。サマリーに『1,077件の疑い患者がDRCで報告』『東部州へ拡大』と明記。WHO事務局長の現地派遣決定により国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ заявила, что закрытие границ не остановит распространение Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says border closures will not stop the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Border closures will not stop the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, says WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The WHO does not recommend entry bans, noting they may slow spread by only a few days. The most effective measures are rapid sanitary actions, timely identification of cases, and sustained support to affected regions. As of May 22, the outbreak had nearly 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 suspected deaths, with 82 laboratory-confirmed cases and seven confirmed deaths. By May 25, suspected deaths had risen to 220. The article emphasizes that ongoing transmission in the DRC is best addressed through public health interventions rather than border restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが国境閉鎖はエボラの拡大を防止しないと声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限のリスク」の3項目に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当し、死亡者を含む確定症例が存在する深刻なエボラ流行として、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行事例。記事サマリーでDRCでの継続的な伝播が明記され、82件の確定症例と7件の確定死亡が報告されている。WHOの国際的見解も含まれており、国際的な関心が高い。トリアージの対象国としてはDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Madiun targetkan temuan 1.312 kasus TB hingga akhir 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madiun City Government targets 1,312 TB cases detected by the end of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Madiun City, East Java, Indonesia targets detecting 1,312 tuberculosis cases by the end of December 2026. As of 2026, 343 cases have been found (about 26%). In 2025, 1,281 TB cases were identified; 2024 saw 1,268. About half of the patients are non-residents who seek treatment in Madiun. The Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan PPKB) emphasizes cross-agency collaboration to accelerate TB response, strengthening routine screening in mapped pockets. One area, Kelurahan Banjarejo, recorded 27 TB cases in 2025, dropping to 17 in 2026. To support detection, Mantoux testing and field screening with portable X-ray, funded by the central government, are deployed at RSUD Kota Madiun. If new cases are found, targeted area screening will be conducted using portable X-ray from the Ministry of Health. TB treatment success in Madiun currently reaches 96%.

triage.headline_ja: マディウン市政府、2026年末までに1,312件の結核症例の発見を目標に設定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は、インドネシア・マディウン市における結核の検出目標と進捗状況に関する公開衛生活動の報告である。異常な集団発生、重大な死亡多発、または予想外の病原体の出現を示唆する情報が含まれていない。感染症の深刻化や国際的拡大の兆候もない。
triage.notes: 本記事は定期的な結核検出プログラムの行政報告であり、シグナル性を持たない。治療成功率が96%と高く、管理状況は良好と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 美国在肯尼亚设埃博拉隔离中心　确诊将送第3国治疗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. Sets Up Ebola Isolation Center in Kenya; Diagnosed Patients to Be Sent to a Third Country for Treatment.
article.articleSummary: US opens Ebola isolation center at Laikipia Air Base, Kenya, to quarantine U.S. citizens exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. If they develop symptoms or test positive, they will be treated in the facility and, if needed, transported to a European medical center rather than returning to the United States. Initial capacity is 50 isolation beds, with plans to add three isolation units (four patients each) and two biosafety units (two patients each). The center will be managed by U.S. medical personnel en route to Kenya, with expanded staffing to follow. The aim is to shorten transport distance to specialized care, not to reflect political motives. U.S. aid of $13.5 million will support Kenya’s Ebola prevention; Kenya’s human rights group has sued the project, while authorities say pre-approval and consultations occurred. WHO notes: since mid-May, the Congo (DRC) outbreak has over 1,000 confirmed/suspected cases, with 10 confirmed and 223 suspected deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアにエボラ隔離センターを設置　診断確定患者は第3国での治療へ送致
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生（DRC）は IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威である。米国による隔離施設の設置は異常な対応であり、国際的な展開リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: DRC（民主共和国コンゴ）でのエボラ発生が主要な感染症イベント。米国によるケニアでの隔離施設設置は、国際的な感染拡大リスク管理の一環として報告されている。ケニアはBluedet APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生とそれに対する米国の対応である。1000件以上の確認・疑い例、223件の疑い死亡が報告されており、重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, gli Usa chiudono la porta: quarantena in Kenya per gli americani esposti al virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The United States closes the door—quarantine in Kenya for Americans exposed to the virus.
article.articleSummary: The United States adopts a distant containment strategy for Ebola by establishing a Kenyan quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki to house American citizens exposed to Ebola who are asymptomatic but high-risk. The center will begin with 50 beds, biocontainment units, and advanced isolation areas; patients would not be repatriated to the United States, even if their condition worsens, but could be moved to other states. This approach aims to prevent Ebola from entering the US during the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, which the WHO has declared an international emergency and for which no licensed vaccines or specific cures exist. International data indicate over 900 suspected cases and more than 200 deaths; the Kenyan facility is part of broader US travel restrictions on DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, with $13.5 million pledged for Kenyan preparedness. Critics warn the policy could reduce patient survival in US/Germany centers and deter volunteers; a missionary infected in the DRC was reportedly moved to Germany, per the Washington Post. As frontline teams begin training in Kenya, a new US doctrine prioritizes stopping Ebola far from home.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国が隔離戦略を採用—ケニアで曝露したアメリカ人の隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO国際緊急事態宣言済みのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行に対する多国間対応が展開中。900症例以上、200死亡以上の規模で国際的な封じ込めが進行中。
triage.notes: ケニア（192950）は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーを詳細に読むと、ケニアのLaikipia Air Baseはアメリカが設置した隔離施設であり、実際の流行発生地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンである。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）、ワクチン・特異的治療法なし。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand readies Ebola testing labs for Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: Thailand is bolstering Ebola testing capacity to prepare for the Bundibugyo strain, as the World Health Organization recommends three experimental treatments for Bundibugyo amid an outbreak in Africa. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus currently has no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Thailand's Department of Medical Sciences reports two BSL-3 laboratories capable of Ebola testing: the Thai Red Cross Emerging Infectious Diseases Clinical Centre at Chulalongkorn Hospital and the National Institute of Health. Together they can process about 300 samples per day, with capacity to expand during an outbreak. For provinces lacking BSL-3 facilities, the department is coordinating with hospital networks to strengthen 32 Designated Receiving Area laboratories to handle suspected cases under enhanced biosafety standards. The effort follows increased regional screening and surveillance tied to the African outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: タイがブンディブギョエボラ株に対応するため検査施設を準備
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行に対応した準備・予防措置の記事。タイ国内での患者発生報告はなく、現在のところ地域的なシグナルとは言えないが、WHOが実験的治療法を推奨し、地域の検査体制強化が進行中であるため、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はタイ国内でのエボラ患者発生ではなく、アフリカでの流行に備えた検査能力の強化に関するもの。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。アフリカでの実際の流行状況については記事サマリーに詳細がないため、別途情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'If Ebola comes, we'll be wiped out': DR Congo conflict-displaced
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, centered on Bunia, raises fears for 25,000 displaced at Kingonze camp. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or treatment; containment relies on protective measures and rapid contact tracing. Kingonze camp has not reported infections yet, but overcrowding and poor sanitation heighten transmission risk. Residents report lack of hygiene, soap, and protective gear; only a single borehole serves the camp, with water for a few hours daily. WHO data up to May 24 show 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC, from over 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases. State response has been slow; health facilities lack isolation tents. Ituri hosts about 61 displaced camps with nearly 970,000 people. WHO Director‑General Tedros planned to visit Bunia; officials urge rapid deployment of equipment, supplies, and medical staff.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが来たら、我々は一掃されるだろう」：コンゴ民主共和国の紛争避難民
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO全基準該当。ワクチン・治療薬なしのブンディブギョ株による大規模アウトブレイク、脆弱な難民キャンプでの拡大リスク。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の確認・疑い症例1,000以上、確認死亡10例・疑い死亡223例。難民キャンプ97万人以上が曝露リスク下にある。ワクチン・治療薬なし。WHOテドロス事務局長訪問予定。国家対応が遅延し保健施設が不備。高い拡大可能性とリソース不足が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ: Закрытие границ не поможет остановить распространение лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: Border closures will not stop the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is in focus. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says border closures will not stop Ebola spread and are not recommended, offering only a short-term delay. The most effective measures are rapid sanitary restrictions, prompt case detection, and sustained support to affected regions. On May 22, about 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 suspected deaths were reported in the DRC; officially confirmed cases stood at 82 with 7 deaths, though the true scale is larger. By May 25, suspected deaths had risen to 220, signaling ongoing transmission and uncertainties in surveillance. The article underscores reliance on laboratory confirmation and regional public health response rather than travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：国境閉鎖はエボラ熱の蔓延を止めるのに役立たない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。DRC内の確認症例82例・死亡7例、疑い例750例・疑い死亡220例の報告により重症度・規模が明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模発生。DRC内で確認症例と疑い例が報告されており、死亡例も増加している。WHO事務局長が国際的発言を行っており、国際関心が高い。本情報は対象国DRCでの発生であり、フルリスク評価（RRA）への進捗が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Assam: African Swine Fever Scare Triggers 30-Day Pork Ban, Mass Culling Begins
article.articleSummary: ASF outbreak in Assam's Tinsukia district, with Uttar Rangpuria village (Kakopathar, Sadiya Co-District) identified as epicentre. A 30-day ban on sale and movement of pigs and pork products across Sadiya Co-District, closure of pork shops, and prohibition on transport to/from neighbouring districts and Arunachal Pradesh. An infected zone within 1 km and a surveillance zone within 10 km around the epicentre established. A culling operation in the infected zone scheduled for May 27–29 under the National Action Plan for Control, Containment and Eradication of ASF, supervised by the Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Department with disposal and sanitisation efforts and records maintained. Violations subject to penalties under the Disaster Management Act 2005 and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease of pigs with no human infection but severe livestock and pork-trade impact.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州：アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の懸念により30日間の豚肉禁止令発令、大量殺処分開始
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は対象国インドで確認されているが、動物疾病であり人への感染リスクはなく、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」の定義には合致しない。ただし家畜経済への影響と地域での管理措置が実施されているため、経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は人獣共通感染症ではなく、IHRの主要対象（人への公衆衛生脅威）ではないため、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」はNoと評価。ただしWPRO基準では複数基準に該当し、インドの家畜衛生当局が積極的な管理措置（殺処分、移動禁止、監視地域設定）を実施していることが確認される。動物疾病の専門部門での監視継続が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Déplacés en RDC: "Si Ebola arrive, nous serons exterminés" : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Displaced in the DRC: "If Ebola arrives, we will be exterminated" : News.
article.articleSummary: East of the Democratic Republic of Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province near Bunia. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, authorities report over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths. Nearly one million people are displaced in Ituri, with the Kigonze camp near Bunia hosting more than 25,000 occupants in congested, tarpaulin shelters. Conditions—limited clean water, poor sanitation, and overcrowding—signal a high transmission risk, though no cases have yet been reported in Kigonze. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no specific treatment or vaccine for this strain, so control hinges on barrier measures and rapid case detection. Ituri has about 61 displacement sites housing over 970,000 people. Authorities face criticism for a delayed response; the health minister’s visit and WHO warnings underscore an urgent need for swift, resourced intervention to avert a catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の避難民：「エボラが来たら、われわれは絶滅する」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で246人の死亡、1,000以上の疑い例、970,000人以上の避難民、限定的な水・衛生条件による高い伝播リスク。即座にフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月29日配信。DRCのIturi州で5月15日に宣言された第17次エボラ流行。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で、確認死亡246人、疑い例1,000以上。避難民キャンプ（Kigonze等）における水・衛生環境の劣悪化が高い伝播リスクを示唆。WHOの警告と政府対応の遅れが報道で指摘されている。国際的支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: ಡೆಂಗೀ ಹಾಗೂ ಇತರೆ ಕೀಟಜನ್ಯ ರೋಗಗಳು ಬಾರದಂತೆ ಮುನ್ನೆಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ಕ್ರಮ ವಹಿಸಿ - Sanjevani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Take preventive measures to prevent dengue and other vector-borne diseases - Sanjevani.
article.articleSummary: 29 May 2026, Gadag district: District Collector C. N. Shreedhar urged preventive measures to curb dengue and other vector-borne diseases, including malaria and chikungunya. Speaking at the District Collector’s Office during National Dengue Day and the inter-department coordination committee meeting, he called for multi-departmental collaboration to keep urban and rural areas free of vector-borne diseases. Actions include ensuring water drains properly in public areas and wells, deploying larvicidal solutions at breeding sites, and conducting school health education programs. He also stressed preventing water stagnation around homes and in tire yards, covering empty tires with tarpaulins and promptly disposing them. Public awareness on sanitation and vector-control was urged. District Surveillance Officer Dr. Venkatesh Rathod reported: malaria—2 confirmed from 12002 blood smear tests (Jan–Apr 2026); dengue—17 confirmed from 606 tests; chikungunya—7 confirmed from 109 tests.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱およびその他の媒介生物由来疾患を予防するための予防措置を講じてください - Sanjevani
triage.triage_reason: インド・カルナタカ州でデング熱、マラリア、チクングニア熱の感染が確認されており、スクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・流行可能性）の複数に該当する。ただし感染者数は限定的（デング17例、チクングニア7例、マラリア2例）であり、公開情報源での社会的関心や国際的拡大のリスクについて明確な記載がないため、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: カルナタカ州ガダグ地区でのイベント。記事は予防対策の呼びかけと検査統計（2026年1月～4月）を主内容としており、確認症例数は比較的少数。媒介生物対策の継続的実施が強調されている。デング熱・マラリア・チクングニア熱は該地域で流行しやすい疾患であり、モニタリング継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: AB deneysel hantavirüs ilaçlarını teslim aldı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EU took delivery of experimental hantavirus drugs.
article.articleSummary: 1,400 tablets of Favipiravir, an experimental antiviral with potential use against hantavirus, were delivered to France, Spain, and the Netherlands by the European Union, in coordination with Japan. The drug is not approved for hantavirus; the European Medicines Agency has designated it as a candidate for compassionate use or clinical trials under national protocols. Donations came from Fujifilm Pharmaceuticals with support from Japanese authorities and the EU Delegation in Tokyo. The European Commission stated it is in contact with member states after outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, aiming to speed access to countermeasures and coordinate shipments; emergency procurement has been launched to secure additional doses in the coming weeks. Hantavirus is primarily rodent-borne, transmitted via inhalation of dried excreta, urine, or saliva, with symptoms of fever, fatigue, and muscle aches that can progress to respiratory failure, internal bleeding, or kidney failure.

triage.headline_ja: EUが実験的ハンタウイルス薬の受け取りを完了
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのハンタウイルス集団発生（ウガンダ・DRC）が背景にあり、公衆衛生上の関心と国際的な医療対応が存在するが、具体的な患者数・死亡数・感染拡大リスクなどの詳細情報が不足している。医薬品供給の調整報道であり、実際の流行制御の進捗状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドに日本・フランス・スペイン・オランダ・ウガンダが列挙されているが、記事サマリーを仔細に検討した結果、実際のハンタウイルス集団発生が報告されているのはウガンダとDRCであることが明記されている。日本・欧州諸国は医薬品提供国として言及されており、発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダについても「outbreaks in Uganda」と明示されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト（GeoNames ID）に含まれていないため除外した。IHR基準が2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準が複数該当するが、患者の重症度・死亡数・感染拡大速度など具体的な流行パラメータが不明確なため、PICKUP判定ではなくWATCH（要経過観察）と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO sebut konflik dan kerawanan perparah situasi wabah ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says conflicts and vulnerabilities exacerbate the Ebola outbreak in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa – The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is described as highly complex, worsened by conflict, insecurity, displacement, food shortages, and public mistrust, which hinder response. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said WHO is supporting the response; field teams have been deployed to Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in eastern DRC, and he planned to assess the situation there on May 29. The outbreak—the 17th in the DRC—has spread across eastern provinces, with more than 1,000 suspected cases and 238 deaths reported as of May 27. Laboratory confirmation identified the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola. Tedros urged ceasefires in affected areas; he said travel bans are not advised and could delay detection and response. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, and Africa CDC followed with a continental health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行を悪化させる紛争と脆弱性を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO公式宣言（PHEIC）、1,000件以上の疑似患者と238名の死亡、国際的な対応体制の確立、Bundibugyo株の確認などから、深刻な感染症危機として認識される。
triage.notes: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus による公式発表。2026年5月17日にWHO、5月後日にアフリカCDCがそれぞれPHEIC／大陸健康緊急事態を宣言。Bundibugyo株の確認は過去のアウトブレイクと異なる点で重要。紛争・食糧不足・公衆衛生への不信が対応を著しく阻害している状況が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Viva Aerobus impone restricciones de viaje por brote de ébola previo al Mundial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viva Aerobus imposes travel restrictions due to Ebola outbreak ahead of the World Cup
article.articleSummary: Viva Aerobus imposes a 60-day entry restriction on international passengers due to an Ebola outbreak in Africa. Effective 00:00 on 28 May 2026, the restriction applies to travelers who have been in the past 21 days to Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, or South Sudan and who lack Mexican passport or residency. The measure follows directives from Mexican health and immigration authorities and aligns with World Cup 2026 security planning in Mexico. The United States, Mexico, and Canada are coordinating public health measures for the tournament, with Canada also suspending visas for residents of the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. Mexico has reinforced border controls, including airport health screenings and special protocols; authorities say the national risk remains very low and no cases are detected domestically. The initial restriction lasts 60 days and could be extended as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ビバ・エアバスがエボラ出血熱の流行を理由にワールドカップ前に渡航制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で国際的拡大リスク（スーダン、ウガンダ、DRC）と渡航・貿易制限リスク（複数国が制限措置実施）の2つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニングでも異常性、国際的流行可能性、管理可能性で複数基準該当。国際的な公衆衛生関心が高い。
triage.notes: 複数の北米・アフリカ国で検出されているが、対象国リストから該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ、スーダンは対象国外のため除外。記事は2026年5月の想定上の事象であるが、エボラ流行は実際に報告されている地域である。メキシコ、カナダ、米国の連携による国際的な公衆衛生対応が実施されている点で国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand imposes 21-day Ebola quarantine on travellers from Uganda, DRC - The Observer
article.articleSummary: Thailand imposes mandatory 21-day quarantine for travellers from Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to curb Ebola Virus Disease importation. The measure, effective 6:00 pm on May 27, 2026, was approved by the National Communicable Disease Committee under the Communicable Diseases Act. It targets Uganda and DRC, sites of Ebola activity amid a WHO PHEIC declaration due to Bundibugyo strain. DR Congo reports 867 suspected Ebola cases and 214 deaths; Uganda has recorded 5 cases and 1 death. Thailand intensifies surveillance, contact tracing, awareness, and border screening. Under the rules, travellers from these countries arriving or transiting through Thailand face mandatory quarantine or isolation for 21 days; asymptomatic individuals quarantine in designated facilities, symptomatic cases are isolated in state facilities. Non-compliance penalties: fines up to 20,000 baht, imprisonment up to one year, or fines up to 100,000 baht or both. No Ebola cases have been reported in Thailand.

triage.headline_ja: タイがウガンダとDRコンゴからの渡航者に対して21日間のエボラウイルス隔離措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）イベントであり、複数国での活動と国際的な防御措置が発動されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRコンゴ867疑い患者・214死亡、ウガンダ5患者・1死亡が報告されており、重症度が高い。タイの公式な検疫措置実施により国際的な防御体制が確認される。WHO PHEIC宣言済みイベント。

article.articleHeadline: เริ่มมีหวัง? WHO เปิดชื่อยา-วัคซีน น่าจับตา จ่อใช้ควบคุมแพร่ระบาดไวรัสอีโบลา
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hope on the Horizon? WHO Reveals the Names of Drugs and Vaccines to Watch as They Near Deployment to Curb the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO highlights three therapeutics for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease and calls for ongoing laboratory and field data to curb outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. No cure or vaccine specific to Bundibugyo exists yet. Investigational drugs: MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), Maftivimab (Regeneron), and Remdesivir (Gilead Sciences). Maftivimab has been shipped to the DRC and could be used for treatment or research pending WHO approval; Remdesivir is prioritized for post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts, with effectiveness depending on multiple factors. Vaccines show promise: rVSV Bundibugyo (one dose) by IAVI could reach trial readiness in 7–9 months; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute India) could begin testing in 2–3 months, though more animal data are needed. Ervebo (Merck) is under study but not recommended for non-lab use due to limited evidence for Bundibugyo in DRC and Uganda. As of 29 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 希望の兆し？WHO、エボラウイルスの流行を抑制するために配備が間近いと予想される医薬品とワクチンの名前を明かす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）の流行がDRCとウガンダで発生している状況下で、WHOが治療薬とワクチンの臨床試験進行状況を公式発表している。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）を満たしIHR基準2つ以上該当。加えてWPRO基準でも異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo型エボラウイルス病の流行に対する治療薬・ワクチン開発動向を報道。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCは対象国（203312）として含める。ウガンダは地理的に隣接するため国際的拡大リスクは明確。複数の治療選択肢が臨床段階にあり、管理可能性の向上が見込まれるが、Bundibugyo型に特異的なワクチン・治療法はまだ確立されていない点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن ترفض إعادة مواطنيها المعرضين لـ إيبولا للبلاد.. ومركز حجر صحي فى كينيا - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington refuses to repatriate its Ebola-exposed citizens back to the United States, and a quarantine center in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: A 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility will operate at a Kenyan air base near Nanyuki to isolate asymptomatic U.S. citizens exposed to Ebola. Symptomatic individuals will not be repatriated to the United States but evacuated to a third country for treatment, marking a policy shift from 2014. The United States will provide $13.5 million to Kenya to bolster readiness, following a call between Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Kenyan President William Ruto. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo Ebola strain a public health emergency, noting no licensed vaccine or treatment and reporting over 900 suspected cases and more than 200 deaths. The CDC has imposed temporary entry restrictions on travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, including some permanent residents, and will strengthen screening at three U.S. airports. Public-health experts caution that treating patients in U.S. or German facilities would be safer, and worry the Kenyan plan could deter responders; a U.S. missionary infected in the DRC was moved to Germany with five others, and a seventh person to the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントンはエボラ出血熱に曝露した米国民の本国送還を拒否、ケニアに隔離センターを設置
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo型エボラが公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言され、900件以上の疑い患者と200人以上の死亡が報告されている。複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での流行拡大リスク、国際的な患者移送、U.S.入国制限実施など、IHR基準を満たす重大な国際公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン（対象国外）で流行が発生していると記載。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ケニアは対象国外だが隔離施設の設置地として言及されている。WHOが公式に公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言した重大イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Закрытие границ неэффективно против распространения лихорадки Эбола - Гебрейесус
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Border closures are ineffective against the spread of Ebola — Ghebreyesus.
article.articleSummary: Border closures are ineffective against the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. WHO does not recommend entry bans, arguing that coordinated sanitary measures and outbreak support at the source are more effective. UN Secretary-General Spokesman Stéphane Dujarric notes the Congo-Uganda Ebola crisis is the third-largest in recorded history. The outbreak spans 13 health zones in DRC, with over 1,000 suspected cases and about 220 deaths. In Uganda, one death and seven suspected cases have been reported. A first patient recovery was recorded at a treatment center in Ituri (DRC). On May 27, Uganda temporarily closed its border with DRC to reduce spillover; Rwanda had already closed its border, and Zambia tightened medical screening. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡散に対する国境閉鎖は効果的ではない - ゲブレイエスス
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱はWHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言した最重要感染症。DRCで1,000件以上の疑い例と約220人の死亡が報告され、複数国（ウガンダ、ザンビア、ルワンダ）での事例確認と国境閉鎖措置により、明らかに国際的に重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの主要な発生を記述しており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。また明示的にザンビアの医学スクリーニング強化が述べられており、Zambiaも対象国である。ウガンダ（confirmed cases 1死亡7疑い例）およびルワンダの記載があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため含めない。WHO PHIEC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）、死亡者220名以上、複数国での事例報告により、極めて高いリスク評価が正当。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya: Public Health Arrival Restrictions and Enhanced Ebola Screening
article.articleSummary: U.S. public health measures impose enhanced Ebola screening for U.S. citizens and nationals who were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days before arrival. They must enter the United States through designated airports where CDC and CBP will conduct enhanced screening. The requirement also applies to all U.S. citizens and nationals; non-U.S. citizens should consult CDC guidance on returning from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. Travelers should expect possible flight changes or cancellations. Key actions include reviewing CDC travel information, DHS/CBP alerts on the situation, and the May 21 and May 24, 2026 modifications to the list of designated airports. Americans should review Consular Information, contact airlines, call State Department numbers, and enroll in STEP for updates.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：公衆衛生到着制限と強化されたエボラウイルス病スクリーニング
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、米国による渡航制限措置、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での感染情報に基づき、IHR基準3項目以上該当。政府レベルの対応（CDC/CBP強化スクリーニング）と国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアの見出しだが、実際のイベント主題はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラウイルス病発生に対する米国の対応である。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ、南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。記事は2026年5月29日配信で、複数国での感染発生と国際的な移動制限が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Duale summoned over plans to quarantine US citizens exposed to Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, Ebola linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts Kenya’s National Assembly Departmental Health Committee to summon Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale and other ministry officials for a briefing on Tuesday, 2026-06-02, about plans to quarantine US citizens exposed to Ebola in Kenya. Reports indicate the Donald Trump administration may deploy US public health officers to Kenya to staff a potential quarantine facility amid the DRC outbreak. Lawmakers expressed preparedness concerns for regional infectious disease threats; Khwisero MP Christopher Aseka questioned whether the Ministry is ready for Ebola. Health Committee Chair James Nyikal urged a comprehensive national response plan. The committee report notes a Ksh 700 million allocation toward the Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience Programme for procurement and installation of emergency response equipment. No Ebola case counts are reported in Kenya in connection with this article.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ氏、エボラウイルスに曝露した米国市民の隔離計画について召喚される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ爆発がケニアに波及する可能性を示唆していますが、ケニア国内での確認症例はなく、現在のところ準備・対応計画の段階です。国際的な関心と対応は存在しますが、実際の患者発生がないため情報不足のWATCH判定とします。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラ発生の主要な地域はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)です。ケニア(Khwisero, Kakamega)は発生地域APIに含まれていますが、サマリーに明記されている通り「ケニアではエボラ症例は報告されていない」ため、ケニアはverified_locationsから除外しました。米国は隔離計画に関する言及のみで、発生地ではないため除外。DRCでの実際の症例数や重症度の詳細は不明。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も3つ以上該当しますが、対象国内での実際の患者発生がないため、追加情報(症例確認、国内侵入など)を待つWATCH判定としました。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تؤكد إمكانية محاصرة تفشي فيروس "إيبولا"‏
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization confirms the possibility of containing an Ebola virus outbreak
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says containment of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is possible, urging an immediate ceasefire to facilitate response. Arriving in Kinshasa to oversee efforts, he rejects international travel restrictions and emphasizes cooperation. He will travel to Ituri province in the northeast, the outbreak’s main hotspot. WHO data up to May 24 report over 1,000 cases since the mid‑May outbreak declaration, with 10 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths; total fatalities exceed 200. This marks the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC, a nation of more than 100 million. Ongoing violence and displacement are hindering case finding and medical action, underscoring the need for an urgent ceasefire to protect civilians and accelerate outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラウイルスの流行抑制の可能性を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度、DRC内での複数地域での発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク全てが明確。
triage.notes: 2026年5月中旬のエボラ流行宣言以降、1,000症例以上が報告されている。確認死亡10例、疑い死亡223例で総死亡数が200を超える。DRCで17番目のエボラ流行。紛争と人口移動が対応を阻害しており、緊急の停戦を必要とする深刻な状況。WHOの高官が現地到着し積極的に対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola threats: FG moves to restrict flights, isolate travellers
article.articleSummary: Nigeria is considering stricter travel controls to curb Ebola spread amid renewed outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. A Lagos security and health coordination meeting discussed possible flight restrictions and isolation for incoming passengers from outbreak countries, with health screening at entry points for anyone with suspicious symptoms. The plan, aimed at strengthening preventive systems, was led by Femi Gbajabiamila and attended by the NCDC, the Ministry of Interior, and Lagos health authorities. President Tinubu has been updated on DRC and Uganda developments and directed agencies to remain on high alert. Interior Minister Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo said airports, seaports, and land borders would see enhanced surveillance and inter-agency collaboration for early detection. Ebola’s high danger level, with no approved cure, underscores reliance on rapid response, hygiene, and isolation. The NCDC activated nationwide preparedness; WHO reports multiple deaths and hundreds of suspected cases in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ脅威：ナイジェリア政府が航空便制限と旅行者隔離を検討
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは高い重症度と国際的リスクを持ち、DRC・ウガンダでの流行再発に対応してナイジェリアが渡航制限・隔離措置を検討している。WHOも多数の死亡と疑い例を報告。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアでの対応を報じているが、実際の流行発生地はDRC（多数の死亡と数百の疑い例が報告）とウガンダ。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。DRCは対象国かつ明確なシグナルであり、フルRRA進行推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya court suspends US plan for Ebola quarantine facility for...
article.articleSummary: Kenya High Court on 29 May 2026 suspended any deal to host a U.S.-run quarantine facility for Americans exposed to the Bundibugyo Ebola virus spreading in Ituri province, northeastern Congo. The plan would relocate exposed individuals to Kenya, with a U.S. commitment of $13.5 million for Ebola preparedness, but location and Kenyan approval remained unclear. The court halted the agreement until petitions challenging it are heard. Katiba Institute and Kenya Law Society warned of public health risks and insufficient public participation, noting Kenya lacks high-containment infrastructure for such a facility. A Kenyan doctors’ union issued a 48-hour strike notice if the deal proceeds, accusing the U.S. of avoiding Ebola on its soil and turning Kenya into a dumping ground. In Congo, the outbreak has >1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since May 15; Uganda reports 7 cases and 1 death. WHO has shipped emergency supplies to Congo to combat the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所がエボラ隔離施設に関する米国計画を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の3項目に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の国際的広がり、渡航制限のリスク）。コンゴでの大規模流行（>1,000疑い例、220死亡）と地域内での拡大傾向が確認され、国際的対応段階にある。
triage.notes: コンゴでのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダでも症例報告（7例、1死亡）があるが、記事サマリーではコンゴの発生地での状況とケニアでの隔離施設計画に関する議論が中心。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。米国・ケニアについても、イベントの発生地ではなく国際対応の舞台であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 防世界杯变播疫温床? 美加墨公布将管制高风险非洲旅客|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent the World Cup from turning into a hotbed of epidemics? U.S., Canada, and Mexico announce plans to regulate high-risk African travelers.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-29, the United States, Canada, and Mexico announced a joint plan to regulate high-risk Ebola travelers from Africa to prevent the World Cup hosted across North America from becoming an epidemic hotspot. The three governments will coordinate unified inbound public-health controls for travelers from Ebola-affected regions, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. US restrictions: non-U.S. citizens who have visited these countries within 21 days are barred; from May 30, green-card holders and other permanent residents are also subject to the 21-day rule. Canada: 90-day entry ban for residents from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; asymptomatic travelers who have been there must self-isolate for 21 days on entry starting May 30. Mexico: strengthen Ebola screening at airports nationwide, urge citizens to avoid travel to Congo, and require 21-day self-isolation for travelers returning from affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップの感染症ホットスポット化を防ぐ？米国・カナダ・メキシコがアフリカの高リスク渡航者を規制する計画を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラウイルス病という高病原性感染症の多国間調整制御措置であり、国際的な公衆衛生対応が既に実行されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）でのエボラ発生に対する北米3国の政府間調整対応である。発生地域リストに含まれるウガンダ（226074）とスーダン（366755）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。米国・カナダ・メキシコの措置は検出イベント（政府発表）であり、実際の患者発生地はアフリカであることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: World Cup 2026: Ba nước đồng chủ nhà phối hợp ứng phó dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: The three host nations coordinate their response to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Three host nations of the 2026 FIFA World Cup—United States, Canada, and Mexico—unveil coordinated public-health measures around Ebola-related travel. The WHO declared the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, signaling heightened cross-border risk. The United States bars entry for immigrants and lawful residents who were in DRC, Uganda or South Sudan within 21 days prior to arrival and is establishing an isolation center in Kenya; the CDC-led response includes a dedicated Ebola information site. U.S. funding for Ebola response exceeds $112 million in bilateral aid, plus $50 million to OCHA and $300 million via OCHA-managed funds for DRC and Uganda. Canada restricts entry for residents from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan for 90 days from May 27, and from May 30 requires a 21-day quarantine for travelers recently in affected areas. Mexico tightens airport screening (May 25) and advises avoiding DRC with a 21-day quarantine for arrivals from that country. World Cup 2026 runs June 11–July 19 across 16 host cities; final at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ：3つの開催国がエボラ流行への対応を調整
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのDRCエボラ流行に対し、複数国が国際的な渡航制限・隔離措置を実施し、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限が顕著。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ流行がWHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言済み。米国・カナダ・メキシコは2026年ワールドカップ開催国であり、主要感染地域（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）からの入国者に対する渡航制限・隔離措置を実施。米国の対応には112百万ドルの二国間援助、OCHA経由300百万ドルの支援が含まれる。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として評価される。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: 肯雅高院颁令 暂时中止美国设伊波拉隔离中心 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya High Court issues an order to temporarily suspend the U.S.-established Ebola isolation center
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Kenya's High Court temporarily suspended the U.S.-proposed Ebola isolation center in Nairobi, intended to quarantine U.S. citizens who had contact with Ebola. Local rights groups filed the challenge on Thursday, and the court blocked the plan pending case resolution. The order also prevents Kenya from receiving any person who has had contact with or is infected by Ebola until the matter is heard. Since mid-May, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases and over 200 suspected deaths in Africa, principally in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The United States has announced stricter safeguards to prevent Ebola cases from entering Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所がアメリカ設立のエボラ隔離センターを一時中止する命令を発行
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の重大な影響（900件以上の疑似患者、200件以上の死亡）を示しており、IHR基準で「serious_impact」と「international_spread」に該当。アフリカでの広域流行が報告されており、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはナイロビ（ケニア）が含まれているが、記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ隔離センター設立に関する司法判断であり、実際のエボラ患者発生は主にコンゴ民主共和国で報告されている。したがって、verified_locationsはDRCのみを含める。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。アメリカ（対象国外）での隔離センター計画についての言及も対象国ではないため含めない。WHOが報告している「アフリカ全体」での900件以上の疑似患者は主にDRCが中心である点を確認。

article.articleHeadline: AB'de hantavirüs hazırlığı: Deneysel ilaç devreye alındı - Dünya Gazetesi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus Preparedness in the EU: Experimental Drug Deployed
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, the European Union has mobilized against hantavirus amid rapidly spreading cases, shipping 1,400 tablets of the experimental antiviral Favipiravir to France, Spain, and the Netherlands. The drug, not yet approved for hantavirus treatment or prevention, may be used under compassionate use or clinical trials under national protocols, per the European Medicines Agency. The Japan-donated supply, facilitated by Fujifilm Pharmaceuticals and supported by Japanese authorities and the EU Delegation in Tokyo, accompanies intensified emergency measures following hantavirus outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The EU Commission is coordinating access to countermeasures and has launched emergency procurement to secure additional doses in coming weeks. Hantavirus is typically rodent-borne, transmitted via inhalation of dried urine, droppings, or saliva, and can cause fever, fatigue, muscle pains, respiratory failure, bleeding, or kidney injury.

triage.headline_ja: EU内のハンタウイルス対策：実験的医薬品が展開される
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの多地域への急速な拡大、実験的抗ウイルス薬の国際的な緊急配備、複数国での同時アウトブレイク対応により、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大、公衆衛生への深刻な影響）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）も該当。国際的な関心と対応が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはフランス、スペイン、オランダが含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに存在しないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに未記載のため除外。DRCはリスト内にあり、記事サマリーで「ハンタウイルスアウトブレイク」の発生国として明示されているため verified_locations に含める。日本はウイルス発生地ではなく医薬品供給元のため除外。記事は2026年5月29日配信で未来日時だが、評価内容に変化なし。

article.articleHeadline: Εμπολα -Στο Κονγκό ο επικεφαλής του ΠΟΥ: "Μπορούμε να σταματήσουμε την επιδημία"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - In Congo, the WHO chief: "We can stop the epidemic"
article.articleSummary: DRC declares a new Ebola outbreak on 15 May in Ituri; by 29 May, about 1,000 suspected cases with 246 deaths (official tally, likely understated) and the Ituri province as the epicenter, with the virus also present in North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports seven lab-confirmed cases and one death; Rwanda and Uganda have closed borders to prevent cross-border spread this week. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, but response is hampered by ongoing armed conflict and limited state presence in Ituri, restricting access amid clashes with groups such as the ADF. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no specific treatment or vaccine exists for this strain yet, unlike Zaire ebolavirus where vaccines exist. Africa CDC head pledged vaccine and drug availability for Bundibugyo by end-2026; WHO committees have urged clinical trials of vaccines and therapies. Past 2018–2020 DRC outbreak caused ~2,300 deaths among ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - コンゴでWHO事務局長：「流行を止めることができる」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模エボラ出血熱の発生で、DRCで約1,000疑似症例・246死亡、ウガンダで7例確認、ルワンダとウガンダが国境閉鎖、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、新型ワクチン開発中で治療法未確立のため、国際的支援と対応が急務である。
triage.notes: DRCで新規エボラアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株。ウガンダでも7例確認されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生・拡大であり、DRCを verified_locations に含める。Ituri州が震源地で、North Kivu、South Kivu州にも存在。武装勢力による衝突により対応が阻害されている。Bundibugyo株用ワクチンは2026年末まで未開発のため、リスク評価は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: USA chtěly do v Keni vozit své občany vystavené ebole: Soud nápad shodil ze stolu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States wanted to transport its citizens exposed to Ebola to Kenya: The court knocked the idea off the table.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, Kenya's High Court ordered a temporary halt to US plans to establish a quarantine center for Americans exposed to Ebola on Kenyan soil, with a further hearing set for June 2. The ruling bars Kenya from admitting exposed or infected individuals until the suit is resolved. The United States had announced the quarantine facility; two US patients outside Africa were hospitalized: one in the Czech Republic and another in Germany. Kenya's Katiba Institute raised constitutional concerns about a secret, unilateral facility lacking protections for life, health, due process, public involvement, and parliamentary oversight. The African CDC Director warned it could strain Kenyan health capacity without additional resources. WHO has declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting no approved vaccine or treatment. Congo reports 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths; 121 confirmed cases and 17 deaths; Uganda has eight confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアにエボラ曝露者の隔離施設を設立しようとしたが、裁判所がこの計画を却下
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での患者確認、WHO PHEIC宣言、国際的な隔離施設設置の議論など、IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、国際的な公衆衛生危機対応の文脈を含む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニア、チェコ、ドイツでの米国市民の隔離計画に関するものだが、実際のエボラウイルス病の発生はコンゴ（1,077疑い患者、246死亡；121確定患者、17死亡）とウガンダ（8確定患者）で報告されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはコンゴのみ（DRC=203312）。WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国での患者確認、激烈度の高い病原体、管理能力への懸念が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يهدد كأس العالم 2026.. تحذيرات صحية قبل ضربة البداية - الوطن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threatens the 2026 World Cup... Health warnings ahead of kickoff - Al-Watan
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo threatens the 2026 World Cup in North America. May 29, 2026, Missouri health authorities issued a warning in Kansas City, MO, where England will base its World Cup camp, amid fears as fans travel. The Bundibugyo strain has killed over 220 people in the DRC; WHO says the outbreak is outpacing containment. Ebola typically begins with flu-like symptoms (fever, headache, sore throat) and may progress to hemorrhagic complications and death. A U.S. physician who treated Ebola patients in Congo is infected and receiving treatment in Germany; his family are high-risk contacts. Travel restrictions and enhanced screening are in place for the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Congo could face World Cup exclusion if quarantine rules are not met. Dr. Holland Hainey warns early preparedness is essential; Argentina will also be in Kansas City amid a hantavirus outbreak there.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがワールドカップ2026を脅かす...キックオフ前の保健警告 - Al-Watan
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのBundibugyo Ebola流行がワールドカップ2026（北米開催）に関連して言及され、米国での患者確認、複数国への渡航制限が実施されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限が明確。
triage.notes: 記事では複数国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ、ドイツ、アルゼンチン）が言及されているが、実際の発生地はコンゴのBundibugyo Ebola流行であり、他は関連する渡航制限や患者治療の実施地である。ワールドカップという大規模国際スポーツイベントが影響を受けるリスクため、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ԱՀԿ ղեկավարը սահմանների փակումն անարդյունավետ է համարում Էբոլայի տարածման դեմ պայքարում
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The OSCE leader deems border closures ineffective in the fight against the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says border closures are not an effective tool to stop the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. In Kinshasa, he stated that entry bans offer little benefit and may only slow transmission by a few days, whereas rapid sanitary measures and sustained support at the outbreak sites are more effective. As of May 27, Uganda temporarily closed its border with the DRC to reduce cross-border transmission; Rwanda had previously sealed its border, and Zambia has implemented strict medical screening for arrivals from the DRC. The remarks emphasize frontline infection control, surveillance, and aid delivery over travel restrictions in containing the Ebola spread across the region. Published May 29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がエボラ対策での国境閉鎖は効果的ではないと述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域的流行がDRC・ウガンダ・ルワンダ・ザンビアに及んでおり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。複数国の国境閉鎖措置が取られており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限が現実化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラの発生地はDRC（特にキンシャサ）であることが明確。ウガンダ・ルワンダはDRCとの国境を閉鎖した隣国として言及されているが、実際の発症地としては記述されていない。ザンビアは医学スクリーニングを実施していることが記述され、DRCからの流入リスク対象国として扱われている。対象国リストではDRCとザンビアが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Travel restrictions and Ebola outbreaks: public health implications
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by WHO. WHO urges against blanket travel restrictions, advocating strengthened surveillance, rapid case isolation, contact tracing, and bolstering health systems. On 2026-05-18, the U.S. CDC imposed entry restrictions on non-U.S. citizens who recently traveled from affected countries, though evidence for effectiveness is limited and could divert attention from proven controls. Historical analyses of the 2014–16 West Africa Ebola epidemic show travel bans rarely prevented international spread and disrupted health workers and supplies; COVID-19 experience similarly found that restrictions mainly delay spread, not prevent it. No licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo virus, so control relies on surveillance, diagnostics, infection prevention, therapeutics, and international support. Authorities warn against fear and stigma; responses must be proportionate, evidence-based, and focused on reducing transmission and strengthening outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: 渡航制限とエボラウイルス感染症の流行：公衆衛生への影響
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHO PHEIC宣言による異常性、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニングでも全5項目該当。高い社会的・政治的関心を有する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus-driven Ebola outbreak in DRC および Uganda で WHO が PHEIC 宣言。記事はランセット掲載の査読済み論文であり、国際的に高い信頼性を有する。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。複数国での発生確認（DRC、Uganda、Angola への言及）と U.S. CDC による渡航制限措置が具体的に報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Video. DR Congo steps up Ebola response as cases rise and EU aid arrives
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expands in the Democratic Republic of Congo after authorities confirm a new case in Goma, North Kivu. On 28 May, medical teams screened schools in Goma to teach hygiene, symptom recognition and rapid reporting amid overcrowded living conditions and displacement that could accelerate transmission. The health ministry reports 101 confirmed cases, more than 3,000 contacts being monitored, and suspected infections nearing 1,000, with at least 220 suspected deaths. In Bunia, Ituri province, authorities received 100 tonnes of medical supplies and protective equipment under the European Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations programme to bolster treatment centres and support frontline health workers. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Kinshasa and Ituri to discuss strengthening surveillance, contact tracing and emergency health measures to contain spread of Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：ケースが増加し、EU援助が到着する中、コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認例と大量の疑い例を伴う活動的な流行が発生している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認症例（101例）、疑い例（約1,000例）、疑い死亡者（220名以上）が報告されている。Goma市での新規確認例は特に懸念される。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と国際支援（EU医療援助）が進行中。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Risk: NCDC Issues Alert, Warns Nigeria Could Import Virus Via Borders And Travel
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk alert: Nigeria’s NCDC says no confirmed EVD case in Nigeria as of 2026-05-29, but importation risk is high due to increased international travel, porous borders, and mass regional movement. A Public Health Advisory urges healthcare workers to bolster surveillance, risk assessment, national preparedness, early detection, and rapid response; workers should recognize Ebola infection and contact State Ministries of Health or designated public health authorities for guidance. High-risk Nigerian states include Lagos, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba, and Adamawa, due to international airports, seaports and border routes. Globally, 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 247 deaths are reported in Uganda and the DRC, with a 24.6% fatality rate. Objective: ensure states and the FCT can detect, contain, and respond swiftly to any suspected case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱リスク：NCDC警告、ナイジェリアが国境と渡航を経由してウイルスを輸入する可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。国際支援の必要性あり。ウガンダ・DRCでの確定症例と死亡報告により、既に流行していることが示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはナイジェリアでのエボラリスク警告について述べており、ナイジェリアはGhanaのGeoNames IDで識別される西アフリカ地域に該当する。ウガンダ・DRCでの1,077件の疑い例と247件の死亡が報告されており、既に地域内流行が進行している状況。ナイジェリアは国際空港・港湾・国境経由での輸入リスクが高いと評価。verified_locationsは対象国リストに基づいている：DRC (203312) は確定的に含まれ、ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。記事では主にナイジェリアの警告が主題だが、対象国でないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Kano, FCT, Lagos, seven others on NCDC high risk alert
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus Disease outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have prompted Nigeria’s NCDC to issue a high-alert for Kano, the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Lagos, Rivers, Enugu, Borno, Akwa Ibom, Cross River, Taraba and Adamawa, with Kaduna, Katsina, Bauchi and Plateau on moderate risk. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. No Nigerian cases have been confirmed; Nigeria remains vulnerable to possible importation due to increased international travel and porous borders. Uganda/DRC reports over 1,000 suspected infections and 247 deaths, predominantly among young and middle-aged individuals. Bundibugyo Ebola lacks approved vaccine or specific treatment; transmission is via direct contact with infected body fluids, contaminated materials, or infected animals, with symptoms including fever, weakness, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and unexplained bleeding. Nigeria’s Emergency Operations Centre is on alert; states must submit readiness reports within 72 hours and report suspected cases promptly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：カノ州、FCT、ラゴス州など10州がNCDC高リスク警報対象に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」の3基準該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行可能性」「管理可能性」に該当。ウガンダとDRCでエボラ出血熱の継続流行とWHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、ナイジェリアへの波及リスクが現実的であるため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとDRCでの流行を主題としており、ナイジェリアは波及リスク評価対象として言及されている。Bluedot APIが付与したナイジェリアの各州（Kano、Katsina、Bauchi等）は、ナイジェリアが高リスク警報対象地域として指定されているための検出であり、実イベント発生地ではない。したがって verified_locations には DRC とナイジェリア全体のみを含める。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、1,000件以上の疑い感染者と247名の死亡、治療法やワクチンの不在、ヒト-ヒト感染の確認が高リスク判定の根拠。

article.articleHeadline: Megállíthatatlanul terjed a halálos vírus a háborús övezetben - Döntést hozott Amerika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly virus is spreading uncontrollably in the war zone — America has made a decision.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Ebola outbreak spans the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda under war conditions. In the DRC, there are over 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed and 204 deaths to date; the strain involved is Bundibugyo, for which there is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy. Uganda reports seven cases and one death, all in Kampala, and is closing its shared border with the DRC for four weeks to curb spread. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged an immediate ceasefire to facilitate response efforts. U.S. aid has risen to $112 million over two weeks, including protective equipment, testing, and airport screening; previous commitments include $50 million via UN OCHA and $300 million for regional humanitarian initiatives. The CDC is recruiting volunteers for airport screenings after travel bans for those recently in Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスが戦争地帯で制御不能に拡大 — アメリカが決定を下した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間流行（DRC・ウガンダ）で900以上の疑い例、204死亡、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチンなし株によるハイリスク。IHR基準4つ全て該当し、国際支援も進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC(203312)のみ。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo株は非常にハイリスク（ワクチン・治療法なし）。戦争地帯での流行拡大、米国の大規模支援投入、CDC活動により社会政治的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 外交部：中国公民谨慎前往刚果（金） 疫情风险升级
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Chinese citizens should exercise caution when traveling to the Congo (Kinshasa) as epidemic risk rises.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization designated the Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, with the risk level later raised to very high on May 22. The Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases. Chinese authorities, including the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Chinese Embassy in Congo, advise Chinese citizens to avoid non-essential travel to the DRC. Within Congo and neighboring countries, people should avoid the Ituri and North Kivu Ebola-affected areas, minimize contact with wildlife and with suspected patients, and seek medical care if symptoms such as fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or bleeding occur. Return travelers with such symptoms should inform airline crews or border authorities and seek assistance from Chinese medical teams when available.

triage.headline_ja: 外交部：中国公民は疫情リスク上昇に伴いコンゴ（金）への渡航を慎重に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHOによるPHEIC指定、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限発令）。エボラウイルス病は高致死性の感染症であり、900件以上の疑い症例が報告されている重大なイベント。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域にChinaを含めているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内でのエボラ発生であり、中国外交部が渡航勧告を発出した警告記事である。実際のエボラ発生はDRCのみで、中国での発生は報告されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を指定（2026年5月17日）し、リスクレベルを最高レベルに引き上げた（5月22日）という重大な公式認定がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolagyanú miatt riasztották a hatóságokat a szomszédban: már folyik a kontaktkutatás
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities in the neighboring country were alerted due to suspected Ebola: contact tracing is already underway.
article.articleSummary: An Austrian patient, who recently returned from Uganda, is under isolation for suspected Ebola virus disease. The individual was hospitalized on arrival and transported by a dedicated infection-control vehicle to a Vienna specialty clinic, where they remain in stable condition under strict isolation and observation. The first blood test did not confirm infection, but officials say a repeat test is required to establish a definitive diagnosis. Contact tracing has begun to identify anyone who may have had contact with the patient since return. The case underscores ongoing Ebola activity in the region, with challenges in the Democratic Republic of Congo including delayed responses, public mistrust, and attacks on health workers, and with no vaccine available for the Bundibugyo strain. Authorities emphasize continued monitoring and containment to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 隣国での疑い事例でオーストリア当局が警戒態勢：コンタクトトレーシングが既に実施中
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い事例が国際的に拡大（ウガンダからオーストリアへの輸入例）し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクが認められる。IHR基準3つ該当、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ該当、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで検出されたWien/Viennaはオーストリア領内だが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。記事の主題は(1)ウガンダでのエボラ流行と(2)DRCにおける継続的なエボラ活動の背景にある、オーストリアへの輸入例である。医学的には極めて重大で、IHR通知基準を明らかに超えており、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Video. DR Kongo verstärkt Ebola-Einsatz: mehr Fälle, EU-Hilfe trifft ein
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: DR Congo ramps up Ebola response: more Ebola cases, EU aid arrives.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies its Ebola response after a new case is confirmed in Goma, North Kivu. As of May 29, 2026, there are 101 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, with more than 3,000 contacts under surveillance, nearly 1,000 suspected cases, and at least 220 suspected deaths. In Bunia, Ituri province, authorities received 100 tonnes of medicines and personal protective equipment through the EU Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid program to reinforce treatment centers and frontline staff. Authorities warn that crowded living conditions and displacement from conflict accelerate transmission. Schools in Goma are being visited to educate students and staff on hygiene, Ebola symptoms, and promptly reporting suspected cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled from Ituri to Kinshasa to advise on enhanced surveillance, robust contact tracing, and emergency health measures aimed at containing the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 動画：コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ対応を強化：更なる症例、EU支援が到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、WHO事務局長の現地訪問など国際的関心が高い。確認症例101例、疑い死亡220名以上という重度の状況。
triage.notes: 2026年5月29日時点での報告。確認症例101例、疑い死亡220例以上、3,000名以上の接触者監視中。Goma（北キブ州）での新規確認症例、紛争による強制移住と密集生活がウイルス伝播を加速。WHO事務局長が現地訪問し対応を指導。EU支援（医薬品・個人防護具100トン）到着。国際的な関心と支援が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un médecin dénonce des restrictions de voyage " improductives " face à l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a doctor denounces travel restrictions 'unproductive' in the face of the epidemic - ACP
article.articleSummary: Across eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda, the Ebola outbreak persists, driven by a genetically distinct Bundibugyo variant from an animal reservoir. The WHO has declared the flare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus set to visit Ituri. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya denounces Western travel bans on the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as unproductive and discriminatory, urging instead greater funding and logistics for the response. Funding promises have fallen from about $500 million to $290 million this week. Historically, Ebola began in Yambuku in 1976 (318 cases, 280 deaths) and the 2018–2020 Zaïre outbreak in Mangina, Beni and Butembo caused about 2,200 deaths. Emphasis is on community engagement and strengthening community health workers for early detection, surveillance, risk communication, hand hygiene, PPE for health workers and caregivers, and safe, specialized funeral teams.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: 医師が流行に対する「非生産的な」渡航制限を非難 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国での流行、国際的な渡航制限の実施が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているように、ウガンダとスーダンでも言及されているが、詳細な流行状況の記述はDRCに集中している。DRCはイトゥーリ州での現在の流行が確認される対象国リストに含まれる唯一の国。WHO PheICの宣言、Africa CDC局長による声明、資金減少（$500M→$290M）など、国際的な関心と支援需要が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Videók. Kongói DK: fokozzák az Ebola elleni fellépést, nő az esetszám, megérkezik az uniós segítség
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Videos. DRC: Ebola response stepped up as cases rise, EU aid arrives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies with a new case confirmed in crowded Goma, North Kivu. On May 28, health teams educated students and teachers on hygiene, Ebola symptom recognition, and rapid reporting of suspected infections amid overcrowded housing and displacement. The Ministry of Health reports 101 confirmed cases, more than 3,000 contacts under observation, nearly 1,000 suspected infections, and at least 220 suspected deaths. In Bunia, Ituri province, authorities received 100 tons of medical supplies and PPE from EU Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations to strengthen treatment centers and support health workers in the outbreak epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus traveled from Ituri to Kinshasa to reinforce surveillance, contact tracing, and emergency health measures to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ。コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対応を強化、症例数増加、EU支援到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際支援の動員、WHO事務局長の現地訪問などから国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定症例101名、疑い死亡220名以上、3,000名以上の接触者監視下にある。ゴマの都市部での確定事例は特に懸念材料。WHO事務局長による現地視察、EU支援の到着など国際的関与が高い。RRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, ministero Salute: "Nessun caso in Italia". In arrivo ordinanza e circolare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Ministry of Health: 'No cases in Italy'. An ordinance and circular on the way.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Italy reports no Ebola cases or onward transmission and no pandemic; the Health Ministry emphasizes scientific surveillance and strict protocols. Two documents—a circular and an ordinance—are being prepared to guide risk assessment for healthcare workers and regions in probable, suspected, or possible Ebola scenarios. An MSF doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is well, asymptomatic, and transferred to INMI Spallanzani in Rome under safe biocontainment, with USMAF and CRI assisting on arrival. The clinician had contact with individuals suspected of Ebola while working in RDC. Authorities warn against disinformation and stress readiness and clear public guidance via the ministry’s site.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、保健省：「イタリアに症例なし」。命令書と通達が準備中
triage.triage_reason: イタリアではエボラ症例なしと確認されているが、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国医療者が生物封じ込め施設で監視中であり、潜在的な輸入リスクが存在するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアでの症例不在の確認であるが、コンゴ民主共和国からの帰国者の監視が言及されているため、DRCが verified_locations に含まれる。イタリアは対象国でないため除外。現在のところ実際の患者発生はなく、予防的対応段階であるため PICKUP レベルには達しないが、生物安全保障上の関心から WATCH で継続監視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Βίντεο. ΛΔ Κονγκό ενισχύει την απάντηση στον Έμπολα με αύξηση κρουσμάτων και βοήθεια ΕΕ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video. DR Congo strengthens its Ebola response as cases rise, with EU aid.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies its Ebola response after a new case is confirmed in Goma, eastern DR Congo. Health authorities report 101 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, more than 3,000 contacts under monitoring, and nearly 1,000 suspected infections, with at least 220 suspected deaths.
