triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、Bundibugyo エボラはDRCで発生・確認（1,000+疑い例、220+死亡）。ウガンダでの7例と1死亡の報告もあるが、サマリーの主題はケニアへの隔離施設設立計画中止に関するもの。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تطوير لقاحات وعلاجات للإيبولا قد يستغرق شهوراً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Development of Ebola vaccines and therapies may take months.
article.articleSummary: May 29, 2026: The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, to address the Ebola outbreak. WHO and partners are accelerating clinical trials for candidate Ebola vaccines and therapies, but development is expected to take months, with no fully approved vaccines or treatments available for the current strain. In the meantime, supportive medical care is aiding some patients’ recovery. A discharged patient from a treatment center was cited as a positive sign. Health workers were urged to maintain heightened vigilance for fever cases, treating illnesses such as malaria or typhoid as suspected Ebola until confirmed. Funding and PPE shortages were highlighted, with a call for immediate international support for frontline staff. WHO does not recommend travel bans, emphasizing instead strengthening health systems at outbreak sites and supporting affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラワクチンと治療薬の開発は数ヶ月かかる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規治療薬開発遅延、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の懸念）。WPRO基準5つすべてに該当し、WHO事務局長による現地訪問という高い社会政治的関心を示す。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 複数疾患（エボラ、マラリア、腸チフス）が報告されているが、主題はエボラ流行対応。WHO事務局長の現地訪問（Ituri州）は流行の重大性を示唆。ワクチン・治療薬の承認遅延と感染者の継続発生が国際的懸念を生起。資金・PPE不足による対応能力の制約が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Насувається на Європу: вчені попередили про невиліковний вірус від комарів
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Closing in on Europe: Scientists warn about an incurable mosquito-borne virus.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus, once seen as a tropical-subtropical problem, may threaten major European cities and parts of North America as climate change expands the habitat of Aedes albopictus, the Asian tiger mosquito, with 139 countries in risk zones. Researchers from Zhejiang Chinese Medical University warn that warming temperatures enable these vectors to migrate north, increasing local outbreaks as their populations rise. Chikungunya, first detected in 1952, is often underestimated by WHO; it triggers sudden fever and severe joint pain, frequently lasting months and causing temporary or permanent disability, rarely fatal. Models project central and northern Europe and the northeast of North America as future hotspots by the end of the century. While panic is unnecessary, health systems should prepare: monitor mosquitoes, train clinicians to recognize regionally atypical symptoms, and strengthen urban insecticide measures.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパに迫る：科学者が蚊由来の治療不可能なウイルスについて警告
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの気候変動に伴う地理的拡大予測は公衆衛生上の懸念であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（流行しやすさ・長期曝露）に該当するが、現在の実際の発生報告ではなく将来予測であり、対象国（中国）での具体的な流行の証拠が不明瞭であるため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は浙江省の研究者による気候変動とチクングニア拡大予測の警告が主題。現在の中国での実際の流行報告は明記されておらず、主にヨーロッパと北米への将来的な脅威を警告する予測型の内容。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当するが、現在進行中の具体的な流行イベントとしての確実な証拠が不足しているため、WATCH段階とした。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升溫 台灣6月2日起暫停民主剛果、烏干達居民入境90天
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak intensifies; Taiwan to suspend entry for residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda for 90 days starting June 2.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, prompting Taiwan to suspend entry for residents of these countries for 90 days from 2026-06-02. Visa issuance to DRC and Uganda residents will be halted, with existing visas suspended from entry; exemptions apply for Taiwanese students with admission, diplomats, foreign spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals, and urgent or humanitarian cases. As of May 27, WHO data show the DRC outbreak expanding across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 906 reported cases and 223 deaths; 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths. Uganda has 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. Travellers with 21 days travel history to DRC or Uganda must comply with quarantine on arrival, including 21 days of self-monitoring and daily temperature checks via the public reporting system. In-flight advisories and rapid isolation of suspected cases are planned; overall risk level remains Warning (level 3).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が深刻化 台湾が2026年6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ居民の入境を90日間暫定停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてが該当。対象国DRCでのエボラアウトブレイク拡大、複数国への実施対応が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではウガンダの症例は7例に過ぎず、主な流行地はDRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivuである。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。台湾の入国制限措置は国際的な対応段階を示す重要なシグナルであり、WHO警告レベル3の発令と併せてシグナル性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／防堵伊波拉病毒！　民主剛果、烏干達居民6月2日起禁止入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Containing Ebola virus! Residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda barred from entering starting June 2.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks are intensifying in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. WHO data as of May 27 show 906 DRC cases with 223 deaths; 125 confirmed, spanning Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Uganda reports 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. Taiwan’s CDC will implement border controls from June 2, suspending visa issuance for residents of the DRC and Uganda for 90 days, with limited exceptions for Taiwanese degree-seeking students, diplomats, non-Taiwanese spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals, and urgent compassionate cases. Taiwanese nationals and holders of valid residence permits may enter if they have local travel history within 21 days, but must observe strict border quarantine. On arrival, travellers report to airport quarantine; those with fever, headache, myalgia, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding are sent to contracted hospitals; asymptomatic travellers undergo 21-day home health management with twice-daily temperature checks and online self-reporting. Noncompliance carries penalties; measures may be adjusted; travel to the DRC or Uganda is discouraged for nonessential reasons.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：エボラウイルス対策！民主共和国とウガンダ住民は6月2日から入境禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準中3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：906例223死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的な感染症危機管理体制の発動が確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはTaiwanが含まれているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれておらず、記事サマリーでは台湾はCDCの対応措置を実施する国として記載されているため、実際の感染症発生地域ではない。主たる発生地域はDRC（South Kivu州、Ituri州を含む）及びウガンダであるが、ウガンダはGeoNames IDに対応していないため verified_locations には含めない。複数国での同時流行、高い死亡率、及び複数国による渡航制限実施により、国際的な感染症危機管理が活動中である。

article.articleHeadline: 為伊波拉「封境」了！ 疾管署：6/2起剛、烏兩國居民禁入台灣
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola border closure in effect! Taiwan CDC: From June 2, residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are barred from entering Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC tightens Ebola border controls amid outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. From 2026-06-02 00:00, visa issuance for residents of DRC and Uganda is suspended for 90 days; those with existing visas may be denied entry. The DRC outbreak, centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, has 906 cases with 223 deaths; 125 confirmed cases (17 deaths). Uganda reports 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. Four entry-exemption categories apply: degree students with admission, diplomats, Taiwanese nationals’ non-national spouses and their minor children, and urgent/humanitarian cases. Travelers with recent travel to affected areas within 21 days or current residents must report at arrival to the airport quarantine station and undertake 21 days of self-health management, using the Inbound Traveler Self-Health Management notice, with daily temperature checks and 1922 hotline assistance if symptoms appear. TOCC assessment and health evaluation are required for all arrivals; travel advisories remain at Level 3 (Warning).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱「国境閉鎖」実施！台湾CDC：6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダの住民の台湾入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的なアウトブレイク対応として公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が確認されるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）とウガンダでのエボラ発生に関する台湾の国境対策を報じているが、対象国リストにはコンゴ民主共和国（203312）のみ該当するため、verified_locationsに含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC側では906症例（うち確認症例125）、223死亡が報告されており、重大性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 圍堵伊波拉！6/2起「民主剛果、烏干達居民」禁止入境 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Block Ebola! Starting June 2, residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are barred from entering.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC announces entry restrictions over Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. As of May 24, DRC reported 112 confirmed Ebola cases (11 deaths) and 906 suspected cases (223 suspected deaths); one American infected in-country. Uganda reported 7 confirmed cases (1 death), all linked to the DRC outbreak. From June 2, 00:00, visa issuance and entry for residents of DRC and Uganda will be suspended for 90 days. Exemptions cover: (a) degree-seeking students admitted to Taiwan; (b) diplomats; (c) non-citizen spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals; (d) urgent/humanitarian cases (funerals or visiting gravely ill relatives). Enhanced border measures include in-flight announcements since May 27 and mandatory quarantine reporting for travelers with 21 days’ travel history to DRC/Uganda; symptomatic individuals will be transported to contracted hospitals for TOCC assessment and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスを封じ込めよ！6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ住民の入国禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当。WHO PHEICが宣言されており、DRCで112確定例・906疑定例、ウガンダで7確定例が報告されている。台湾が渡航制限を実施するなど国際的対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによるとエボラ発生はDRCが主要な発生地域であり、ウガンダはDRC関連の輸入症例のみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。USAおよび台湾は対象国リストに含まれず。WHO PHEICが5月17日に宣言されており、大規模で深刻な状況が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Meloni scrive ai vertici Ue, su Ebola serve coordinamento e vigilanza delle frontiere - Ultima ora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meloni writes to EU leaders, on Ebola coordination and border surveillance are needed - Breaking News
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged strengthened EU-wide border surveillance amid the central African Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. In a Palazzo Chigi note, Meloni sent letters to EU Council President Nikos Christodoulides, European Council President António Costa, and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, seeking coordinated efforts that respect national health prerogatives. The aim is a reinforced vigilanza at borders with common rules for managing direct and indirect arrivals from zones impacted by the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak, reflecting concerns of an ongoing epidemiological situation in Central Africa. The communication emphasizes enhanced coordination of border controls as a preventive public health measure rather than a bilateral national response.

triage.headline_ja: メローニ首相がEU首脳に書簡、エボラ対策で調整と国境監視が必要 - 速報
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルスのDRC及びウガンダでの発生は、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（Yes）と国際的拡大リスク（Yes）を満たし、EU首脳への正式な書簡送付は著しい社会・政治的関心を示している。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに含まれないイタリアはEUレベルの対応主体として言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。DRC及びウガンダにおけるエボラ・ブンディブギョウイルスの発生が記事の主題であり、これらを検証済みロケーションとして列挙。記事本文が提供されていないため、サマリーのみに基づく評価。

article.articleHeadline: Zwei Wochen vor WM-Start: Ebola-Virus zwingt Ausrichterländer an einen Tisch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two weeks before the World Cup kickoff: The Ebola virus forces the host countries to the negotiating table.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, has caused over 200 deaths and about 900 suspected cases. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern roughly 1.5 weeks ago. With the FIFA World Cup in North America from June 11 to July 19, the United States, Canada, and Mexico tightened entry rules to limit spread: the US banned entry for foreigners who recently visited DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan, and extended the ban to Greencard holders who were there in the past 21 days. Canada blocked entry for residents of the three African states for 90 days, while returning citizens and permanent residents must quarantine 21 days. Mexico announced stricter airport controls and a three-week quarantine for entrants from Congo. The DRC national team qualified for the tournament, with matches in Houston, Zapopan, and Atlanta; the outbreak began May 15 in Ituri and may have circulated undetected for months.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ開幕2週間前：エボラウイルスが開催国を交渉テーブルに強制
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの多国間発生（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）で200人以上の死亡と約900人の疑い例があり、WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。北米ワールドカップ開催に伴う国境越え制限措置が複数国で講じられており、国際的な感染拡大リスクと渡航制限が既に顕在化している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州での発生を主題としており、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。米国テキサス、メキシコ・ハリスコ州での言及は渡航制限措置の影響を記述しているが、これらの地では二次的な感染イベントは報告されていない。PHEIC宣言済みで、WHO及び複数国政府による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Semaine en bref: les aGLP-1 remboursés ! Crise sanitaire à Cuba, boom des faux arrêts maladie, Ebola...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Week in Brief: GLP-1 receptor agonists reimbursed! Health crisis in Cuba, boom in fake sick leave certificates, Ebola....
article.articleSummary: France will reimburse obesity drugs Wegovy (semaglutide) and Mounjaro (tirzepatide) from 15 June for adults with extreme obesity, about 1 million potential beneficiaries, at roughly €300/month. EMA also approves future oral semaglutide for weight management. Heatwave-related medical activity increases, with at least 7 heat-related deaths reported by 26 May. Hantavirus outbreak linked to cruise MV Hondius reaches 13 cases, a second Spanish patient in quarantine, underscoring One Health. Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo: since mid-May, 10 laboratory-confirmed deaths, 220 suspected deaths, and 900 suspected cases since Kinshasa declared the outbreak on 15 May; two suspected Ebola cases in Milan linked to Ugandan humanitarian workers; France tightens surveillance, including Mayotte. Cuba faces a severe health crisis due to embargo-related shortages. Bangladesh reports a deadly measles surge with at least 86 child deaths and 426 symptomatic cases as of 23 May.

triage.headline_ja: 週間ブリーフ: GLP-1受容体作動薬が保険償還! キューバの衛生危機、偽りの病欠証明書の急増、エボラ...
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（エボラの公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の深刻な感染症イベント（エボラ、ハンタウイルス、麻疹）を含み、国際的な蔓延の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の感染症事象を扱うが、対象国に該当するのはDRCのエボラのみ。イタリア（ミラノ）での疑い例、スペイン、フランス、キューバ、バングラデシュでの事象も記述されているが、いずれも対象国外のため除外。DRCでのエボラは5月中旬以降、確認死亡10例、疑い死亡220例、疑い患者900例という深刻な状況。ハンタウイルスはクルーズ船関連（スペイン）、麻疹はバングラデシュ（対象国外）。DRCのエボラの国際的波及の可能性が高いため、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: 嚴防伊波拉！6／2起民主剛果、烏干達居民禁來台 管制措施一次看
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strict Ebola Prevention! From June 2, residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are banned from entering Taiwan — Control measures at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with cases concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and in Uganda; as of May 27, 2026, DRC reports 906 cases and 223 deaths, with 125 confirmed cases (including 17 deaths), while Uganda has 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. Taiwan will implement enhanced border controls from 00:00 on June 2 for 90 days, suspending visa issuance for residents of DRC and Uganda; existing visas will be paused for entry during this period. Four exceptions apply: degree students with admission, diplomatic/official personnel, Taiwanese spouses and their minor non-citizen children, and urgent/humanitarian cases; these must still undergo airport quarantine and 21‑day self‑health management, with daily temperature checks and reporting via the online system, and call 1922 if symptoms occur. Tourism risk for both countries is Level 3 “Warning”; avoid all nonessential travel. Inflight announcements started May 27.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ厳重警戒！6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダの住民の台湾入境禁止 管制措置を一覧表示
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスは最高リスク病原体であり、複数国での継続的なアウトブレイク、死亡症例の報告、及び国家レベルの境界管理措置の発動が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）におけるエボラアウトブレイクを主題としており、ウガンダでの症例はDRCとの関連での言及。台湾はWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。South Kivu、Ituri各州での継続的な発生、高い死亡率（223/906≈24.6%）、ウガンダへの国境越え拡大、及び複数国の渡航・入国制限措置の発動がある。

article.articleHeadline: Allo Spallanzani la dottoressa Msf esposta a Ebola - Sanità
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At Spallanzani, the MSF doctor exposed to Ebola - Health
article.articleSummary: An MSF doctor exposed to Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo arrived overnight at Rome's National Institute for Infectious Diseases Lazzaro Spallanzani. The physician is in good health and asymptomatic. She will remain under observation at the Spallanzani hospital until June 8, as confirmed by MSF sources. The exposure occurred while treating individuals who tested positive for Ebola in the DRC; there are no symptoms reported to date. This exposure case underscores ongoing monitoring for healthcare workers returning from outbreak zones. ANSA carried the report, providing the current status and planned observation window with no immediate indication of infection.

triage.headline_ja: スパッランツァーニ病院にMSF医師がエボラウイルスに曝露 - 衛生
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス曝露事例であり IHR 基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当するが、患者は無症状で現在健康状態であり、リスク評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは曝露の詳細が不明瞭。患者は無症状で健康状態と報告されているが、エボラウイルスの潜伏期間を考慮し、観察期間中の症状発症に注視が必要。イタリアでの確診者報告はなく、DRCでの継続的な流行リスク評価も必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تطوير علاجات ولقاحات لفيروس الإيبولا قد يستغرق عدة أشهر - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Development of treatments and vaccines for the Ebola virus may take several months - Youm7
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization officials report an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri and the North and South Kivu regions, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. While vaccine and therapeutic candidate trials are being accelerated, development is expected to take months and no vaccines or fully approved treatments exist for the current strain; supportive medical care has helped some patients, including a recent recovery. Health workers are urged to treat fever or malaria/typhoid-like illnesses as suspected Ebola until confirmed and to strictly adhere to infection prevention and control measures. Funding and PPE shortages are noted, with appeals for intensified international support. WHO does not recommend travel bans, citing limited efficacy and potential under-reporting. The outbreak’s complexity is heightened by armed conflict, displacement, and food insecurity, underscoring the need for a ceasefire, community engagement, transparency, and frontline support to guide the response.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルスの治療法とワクチン開発には数ヶ月かかる可能性 - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のDRC多地域での発生。死亡率の高さ、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、国際支援の必要性が明記されており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属の珍しい株）による発生。武力紛争、国内避難民、食糧不安が複合的に影響し、対応の複雑性が増している。WHO公式声明により公衆衛生的重要性と国際支援需要が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: توسيع نطاق فحوصات فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expansion of Ebola virus testing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO collaborates with the Democratic Republic of the Congo to expand Ebola diagnostic capacity, aiming to bolster laboratory networks for real-time data, rapid case confirmation, and saving lives. In Uganda, confirmed Ebola infections have risen to 8 cases. Kenya has approved opening a US-managed quarantine facility for people exposed to Ebola, with written authorization to access land at the Laikipia Airbase in central Kenya; Kenyan officials say the facility should be open to all nationalities, not only Americans, though it remains unclear if that will occur. Separately, the United States is funding 50 clinics in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as part of a $50 million outbreak-response package. These developments illustrate ongoing cross-border efforts to contain Ebola circulating in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス検査の拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、複数国での確認例と地域的流行の進展が見られる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ（確定例8件）とケニア（隔離施設の開設検討）での関連情報を含むが、実際の感染事例の発生地域として明確に述べられているのはDRCのみ。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれず、ケニア（GeoNames ID 192950）も対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし、地域的な流行拡大の高いリスク状況にある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Kenya court suspends planned US quarantine facility in the country
article.articleSummary: Kenyan High Court suspended the planned 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility for U.S. citizens in Kenya until a case is heard, barring any Ebola-related quarantine, isolation or treatment center by a foreign government in Kenya. Katiba Institute warned the arrangement posed 'grave and imminent risks' to public health; Justice Nyaundi granted interim orders restraining authorities from establishing or permitting such facility. The U.S. facility, to be staffed by U.S. medics, was due to begin Friday and would treat U.S. nationals exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. A U.S. official said the first group had deployed and received PPE and quarantine-training. The outbreak in DRC has caused at least 220 deaths and more than 900 infections; Uganda reports seven cases and one death. Kenya had not recorded Ebola cases as of May 28, 2026. Local doctors' unions criticized the plan as compromising national biosecurity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：ケニア裁判所が米国の検疫施設計画を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでの流行による220人超の死亡、ウガンダへの波及、米国による国際的対応の試みが示唆される。対象国DRCでの活発な流行により国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの米国検疫施設計画が主題だが、実際のエボラ流行はDRCおよびウガンダで発生中。ケニアはまだ患者報告なし。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの流行（220死、900感染以上）が主要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Allo Spallanzani la dottoressa Msf esposta a Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At Spallanzani, the MSF doctor exposed to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, a Doctors Without Borders (MSF) physician who had been exposed to Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo arrived overnight at Rome's National Institute for Infectious Diseases Lazzaro Spallanzani. The clinician is in good condition and asymptomatic. She will remain under observation at Spallanzani through June 8, 2026, according to MSF sources. The event underscores ongoing monitoring of healthcare workers with potential Ebola exposure and demonstrates Italy’s use of Spallanzani for the assessment and surveillance of such personnel.

triage.headline_ja: スパッランツァーニ病院のMSF医師、エボラに曝露
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスという高危険病原体の曝露事例だが、患者本人は無症状で経過観察中であり、DRCでの曝露後の医療従事者監視体制の一環。国際的な医療体制の適切な対応が示されているため、現時点での深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大リスクは限定的。続報を注視する必要あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、実際のエボラ曝露はDRC内で発生し、イタリアはエボラ患者そのものの発生地ではなく、曝露を受けた医療従事者の経過観察地点である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC を列挙。本事例は個別の医療従事者監視であり、流行や社会的危機に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Dump site:' Kenya erupts over US Ebola quarantine scheme
article.articleSummary: Kenya High Court blocked any US-Kenya agreement to establish an Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya, suspending it until petitions are heard. The plan would divert Americans exposed to Bundibugyo Ebola abroad to Kenyan site, whose location and endorsement remain unclear. Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced a $13.5 million commitment to Kenya's Ebola preparedness, though Nairobi says discussions are about support, not a facility. Legal challenges from Katiba Institute and Kenya Law Society oppose any Ebola-related facility, citing public health risks and lack of participation. A Kenyan doctors' union issued a 48-hour strike notice, accusing the US of turning Kenya into a 'dumping ground' and compromising national biosecurity. The Bundibugyo outbreak is active in northeastern Congo, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths; Congo confirms cases, WHO estimates larger scale; Uganda reports seven cases and one death. There is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 「ダンプサイト」：ケニアが米国のエボラ隔離スキームに激怒
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク）。スクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。対象国DRCおよびUgandaでのエボラ流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、Bundibugyo エボラの活動地はコンゴ北東部（対象国DRC）であり、ウガンダでも7例、1死亡が確認されている。ナイロビはケニアの都市だが、記事主題の感染症イベント（Bundibugyo エボラの流行）がケニア内で発生しているのではなく、DRCおよびウガンダでのSuspected/confirmed casesが対象である。米国は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 新增1宗登革熱輸入個案　患者曾訪新加坡及馬來西亞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One new imported dengue fever case; the patient had visited Singapore and Malaysia.
article.articleSummary: One imported dengue fever case was recorded in Hong Kong on 29 May 2026; the patient had visited Singapore and Malaysia during the incubation period. Hong Kong’s dengue tally for the year stands at 20, with 19 imported and 1 locally acquired. From 22 May to 28 May, no new chikungunya cases were recorded. The Centre for Health Protection warns that higher temperatures and humidity favor mosquito breeding and urges residents and travelers to affected areas to adopt anti-mosquito measures to prevent bites. Additionally, April’s average temperature and rainfall were higher than last year, facilitating mosquito growth and a rising mosquito lure index earlier in the year, with expectations of further increases as rainfall continues through May.

triage.headline_ja: 新規1件の登革熱輸入症例を確認　患者がシンガポールとマレーシアを訪問
triage.triage_reason: 登革熱の輸入症例単発報告であり、現在のところ国内での顕著な流行の証拠はない。ただし、チクングニアも同時に言及されており、ベクター媒介感染症の地域的リスク変動を示唆する点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での輸入症例1件の報告。患者がシンガポール、マレーシアを訪問歴有。香港は対象国リストではChinaに含める。記事は環境因子（気温、降雨量）がベクター（蚊）増加を助長する可能性を示唆。ただし現時点では単発輸入症例であり、顕著な流行兆候は見当たらない。スクリーニング基準では長期曝露リスク（環境因子による蚊の増殖可能性）および流行しやすさ基準（蚊媒介感染症）に該当するが、情報不足と低い重症度から WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: US says its Ebola quarantine center opens Friday in Kenya
article.articleSummary: US builds an Ebola quarantine center at Laikipia Air Base, Kenya, opening Friday to quarantine US nationals potentially exposed to Bundibugyo Ebola during a Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda outbreak. The facility will start with 50 isolation beds, staffed by US medical personnel en route, with plans for three isolation units (4 patients each) and two bio-containment units (2 patients each) later. If exposed individuals develop symptoms or test positive, they would be treated in these units until evacuated to Europe for specialized care. The move defends Washington’s criticized decision not to repatriate Americans infected with Ebola and aims to shorten travel by moving patients abroad only after initial stabilization. The arrangement addresses imported risk while awaiting timelines for additional staffing and equipment and centers on the Bundibugyo variant linked to the ongoing hemorrhagic fever outbreak in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ケニアでエボラ隔離センターを金曜日にオープンと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo variant）のDRC・ウガンダでの発生に対応する米国の隔離施設設置は、国際的な公衆衛生対応を示唆し、事態の深刻性と国際的関心の高さを示す。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの隔離センター設置であるが、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo Ebolaという稀な亜種の流行が背景にあり、国際的対応が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Viva Aerobus restringirá ingreso de pasajeros internacionales por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viva Aerobus will restrict the entry of international passengers due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Viva Aerobus imposes a 60-day temporary restriction on international passenger entry due to an Ebola outbreak, effective May 29, 2026. The measure, aligned with local health authorities, applies only to international travelers. It includes a condition for those who have traveled to Uganda within the last 21 days, as well as travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo or South Sudan. Domestic travel remains unaffected. The policy reflects heightened cross-border precautions amid the Ebola situation in the region. US Ambassador to Mexico Ronald Johnson said coordination with Canada is underway ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, to be jointly hosted with the United States on June 11.

triage.headline_ja: ビバ・エアバスが、エボラ出血熱の流行に対応して国際線乗客の入国を制限
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間での発生確認（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）、国際航空会社による渡航制限措置、および国際的スポーツイベント（FIFA World Cup）を控えた中での地域的危機管理を示唆している。IHR基準3つ該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ、南スーダン（Republic of the Sudan）、DRCでのエボラ発生が言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。USAとCanadaの言及は、対象国リストに含まれない地域での航空制限措置と国際調整であり、実際のイベント発生地ではない。2026年FIFA World Cupの開催予定に伴う国際的懸念が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Meloni a vertici Ue "Serve rafforzare vigilanza a frontiere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Meloni at EU summit: "We need to strengthen border surveillance."
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompts Italy to push for stronger EU border surveillance. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni sent letters to EU leaders urging coordinated cross-border vigilance with common rules for direct and indirect arrivals from affected zones. She proposed placing border-management on the EU Council agenda for 18-19 June 2026 and advancing coordination via a Health Ministers videoconference next week and the EPSCO Council on June 16 to set priorities. Nationally, Italy's Ministry of Health, with Civil Protection, issued circulars to activate targeted health surveillance and traveler-monitoring for arrivals from affected regions. This weekend, Italy will send a delegation of Spallanzani Institute experts to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance, deliver medical supplies, and strengthen epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、メローニがEU首脳に「国境での警戒態勢を強化する必要がある」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）がDRC・ウガンダで発生し、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、旅行制限の可能性が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上該当。高い政治的関心と国際的対応動員がみられる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIでUgandaとItalyも発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が言及されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。イタリアはウイルス域外への対応国であり主要発生地ではないため除外。DRCのみ確実に該当。

article.articleHeadline: 圍堵伊波拉！6/2起「民主剛果、烏干達居民」禁止入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Contain Ebola! From June 2, residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are prohibited from entering.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda triggered a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern and a Level 3 travel warning as of May 27, 2026. As of May 24, DRC reported 112 confirmed cases (11 deaths) and 906 suspected cases (223 suspected deaths), including one American diagnosed in-country. Uganda reported 7 confirmed cases (1 death), all closely linked to the DRC cluster. Taiwan’s health authority announced a 90-day entry suspension for residents of DRC and Uganda starting June 2, with four exemptions: degree-seeking students with admission; diplomatic officials; non-national spouses and their minor children of Taiwanese citizens; and emergency/humanitarian missions. Enhanced border measures include in-flight announcements from May 27 and mandatory TOCC health reporting on arrival for travelers with 21-day travel history to DRC/Uganda. Suspected EVD symptoms warrant immediate ambulance transport to a contracted hospital, coordinated with local health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの封じ込め！6月2日から「民主共和国コンゴ、ウガンダ居民」の入境禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の発生により WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern が宣言され、レベル3渡航警告が発出。複数国への国際的な拡大とそれに伴う各国の入境制限措置が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでのエボラウイルス病の発生が主題だが、対象国リストに Uganda が含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。台湾は対象国ではなく、米国も対象外だが、DRC と Uganda での発生自体が重要なシグナル。WHO PHEIC 宣言、複数国への国際的な拡大、各国の渡航制限措置等により、この事象は最高レベルのシグナルに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF ships emergency Ebola response supplies to Congo
article.articleSummary: Over 100 metric tons of Ebola response supplies were airlifted from UNICEF’s Copenhagen hub to the Democratic Republic of Congo, part of the emergency outbreak response supported by the European Union. The cargo includes personal protective equipment for frontline health workers, medicines, hygiene materials, and medical supplies, intended to support nearly 100,000 people in communities facing displacement, conflict, and limited access to services. UNICEF says the operation is a race against time to contain the outbreak, with WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus arriving in Congo to bolster containment efforts amid a surge of suspected Ebola cases in eastern provinces. The Health Ministry’s situation report indicates suspected cases have surpassed 1,000. The airlift uses a specialized humanitarian service supported by the European Commission’s Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations, underscoring the need for community prevention measures in a complex outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフがコンゴへエボラ対応物資の緊急輸送を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（疑い例1,000件以上）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的対応の必要性が認められ、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ爆発の対応を主題としており、コペンハーゲンはユニセフの輸送ハブとしてのみ言及されているため、発生地域として検証対象に含めない。疑い例1,000件超、WHO事務局長の現地派遣、複数国による緊急支援体制の構築など、国際的な対応が急速に進行中。対象国リスト外（DRCは対象国外）だが、グローバルな重要度を鑑みてPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: AB, Deneysel Hantavirüs İlacını Sevk Etti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU Shipped the Experimental Hantavirus Drug
article.articleSummary: France, Spain, and the Netherlands received shipments of an experimental hantavirus drug donated by Fujifilm Pharmaceuticals under a Japan-EU framework. Although not yet approved, the European Commission is evaluating emergency use, with the European Medicines Agency listing Favipiravir among candidate therapies. Emergency procurement is planned to secure additional doses in anticipation of new cases. The Commission also referenced outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo and urged member states to accelerate access to potential measures. Hantavirus, transmitted mainly via inhalation of rodent excreta, can cause fever, fatigue, and muscle pain and may progress to respiratory failure, internal bleeding, and kidney failure. The shipments illustrate international cooperation for outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: EUが実験的ハンタウイルス治療薬を出荷
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの実験的治療薬の国際配送に関する記事であり、ウガンダとDRCでの発生が言及されている。しかし、記事の主題は新たな患者報告ではなく医療対応・医薬品配送であり、具体的な患者数や重症度情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルス治療薬の国際配送を主題としており、既存の発生（ウガンダ・DRC）への対応という文脈。新規患者報告やアウトブレイク拡大の直接的な情報ではないため、DISMISS ではなく WATCH に分類。DRC のみが対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: وباء "إيبولا".. أوتاوا ترصد مساعدات بقيمة 8 ملايين دولار
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Ottawa earmarks $8 million in aid.
article.articleSummary: Canada announced 8 million USD in Ebola response aid targeting the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The funding package includes 3.5 million to the World Health Organization, 2 million to the Africa CDC, and 1.8 million to the Canadian Red Cross to assist local branches with infection screening, prevention, health services, and enhanced hygiene and sanitation. An additional 700,000 from the Canadian Humanitarian Assistance Fund, in partnership with The Humanitarian Coalition, will fund life-saving initiatives in the DRC—safe drinking water, sanitation, essential non-food items, and health services. Canada will also deploy Canadian Red Cross experts to support humanitarian relief operations led by the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. WHO reports over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and 223 deaths to date. Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades, with case fatality rates ranging 25–90%. More than needed for ongoing outbreak response."} }? (Note: The trailing sentence is a correction—please ensure the final copy ends cleanly.)

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：オタワが800万ドルの援助を計上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。アクティブな多国間エボラウイルス病の流行事案で、1,000以上の疑い患者と223人の死亡が報告されており、国際的な資金動員が行われている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンにおけるエボラウイルス病の流行に対するカナダの援助発表について述べている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。1,000以上の疑い患者と223人の死亡が報告されており、過去5十年間でアフリカでの致死率は25-90%。複数の国際機関への資金配分と人的派遣が行われており、アクティブな大規模流行事案と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Oms: Ricevuto solo un terzo dei fondi richiesti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, WHO: Only one third of the funds requested have been received.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Kinshasa reporting over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; Ituri province is the epicenter, but the virus has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, and to Uganda. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to support communities in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, and to mobilize international aid. He said only about one third of the requested funding has been received and called on the international community to increase support so health workers have the supplies and protection needed. He emphasized health worker protection to enable patient care. He also noted that transparent reporting of cases should not be met with travel bans, as such bans do not encourage reporting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、WHO：要請した資金の3分の1しか受け取られていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクは1000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡を報告しており、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: エボラは高死亡率で国際的に拡大しやすい病原体。記事では複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu、Kinshasa）での患者報告とウガンダへの拡大が述べられている。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれていますが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの具体的な症例報告は明記されていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。WHO事務局長の現地対応と資金不足の警告から、管理可能性の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, in osservazione allo Spallanzani la dottoressa di Msf esposta al virus: non ha sintomi | L'Italia invierà esperti in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the MSF doctor exposed to the virus under observation at Spallanzani has no symptoms | Italy will send experts to Congo.
article.articleSummary: An MSF doctor exposed to Ebola-positive patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo arrived in the night of May 28–29 at Rome's Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases. The clinician is well and asymptomatic, and will be monitored under observation until June 8 at the Spallanzani hospital. Prime Minister Meloni has urged the European Union to strengthen vigilance on arrivals from Ebola-affected regions, and Italy will send experts to the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、スパランツァーニで観察下に置かれたMSF医師がウイルスに曝露：症状なし | イタリアはコンゴに専門家を派遣
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス曝露事例であり国際的関心が高いが、曝露者は現在無症状で厳密な監視下にあり、実際の発症や二次感染の証拠がない。IHR基準は1つ該当、WPRO基準は複数該当するが、リスク確定に情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでのエボラ患者への曝露を主題としており、イタリア（対象国外）での監視は二次的である。曝露者は現在無症状で適切に隔離・監視されているため、現段階では確定的なアウトブレイク兆候ではない。コンゴでのエボラの流行状況の続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Allo Spallanzani il medico italiano esposto all'ebola in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At Spallanzani, the Italian doctor exposed to Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Italian doctor at Spallanzani Hospital, Rome, exposed to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, remains asymptomatic and will be monitored through June 8, with MSF confirming the status. Italy’s Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged EU leaders to strengthen border surveillance due to the central Africa Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak affecting the DRC and Uganda, seeking common rules for managing direct and indirect arrivals from affected zones. A Palazzo Chigi note proposes prioritizing border-management on the European Council agenda for June 18-19, 2026. Nationally, the Health Ministry, in coordination with Civil Protection, has issued circulars to activate targeted health surveillance and traveler-monitoring protocols for returnees from affected regions. A Health Ministers’ videoconference is planned next week, ahead of the EPSCO Council on June 16 to define operational priorities.

triage.headline_ja: スパランツァーニ病院でコンゴでエボラウイルスに曝露したイタリア人医師
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（IHR基準の特定感染症）の国際的拡大リスク、コンゴとウガンダでの複数国での発生、イタリアにおける曝露例の報告により、IHR基準2項目以上該当。国際的対応（EU首脳への提言、欧州理事会での議論予定）と政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴでのエボラ曝露事案を主題とするため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。イタリアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴとウガンダでのBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行が背景にあり、国際的な懸念と対応が喚起されている。曝露者は現在無症状だが、監視継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Koopmans: inschatten gevaar van nieuw virus heeft tijd nodig
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Koopmans: Assessing the danger of a new virus takes time.
article.articleSummary: Coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) signals emerged from Wuhan, China, in late 2019, according to virologist Marion Koopmans, who testified to a parliamentary inquiry on the corona pandemic. She noted that no one could reliably forecast in early 2020 how rapidly and extensively the virus would spread worldwide. The first signals of a new pathogen trigger ongoing uncertainty, she said, and that a similar uncertain phase recurs with each outbreak. At the time, it was not possible to determine how likely it was that the virus would reach the Netherlands. Koopmans emphasized that health services receive about 20,000 signals of this kind every year, with roughly fifty requiring action. She was a member of the Outbreak Management Team advising the cabinet, and she contributed to WHO-related research into the origins of the coronavirus that killed millions of people worldwide from 2020 to 2022.

triage.headline_ja: クープマンス：新しいウイルスの危険性を評価するには時間が必要
triage.triage_reason: 2026年配信の回顧的コメントであり、現在の新規感染症イベントではない。2019年後半のCOVID-19初期信号に関する過去の評価についての後付けコメントであるため、シグナル判定の対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年5月配信で、2019年後半のCOVID-19初期段階に関する過去の回顧的コメントである。ウイルス学者Marion Koopmansが議会での聴聞会で過去の不確実性について述べたもので、現在の新規感染症イベントではない。シグナルとしての価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: União Africana promete vacina contra estirpe Bundibugyo até ao final de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: African Union promises vaccine against Bundibugyo strain by the end of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, near the Uganda and South Sudan borders) has caused 246 deaths and 1,077 suspected cases, with the epidemic spreading to North and South Kivu and crossing into Uganda, where seven infections have been confirmed in Kampala, including one death; the fatal Ugandan case is a Congolese national and infection labeled imported. Africa CDC pledged that a vaccine and a treatment for the Bundibugyo strain will be available by the end of 2026, as international aid arrives (EU-funded plane to Bunia) and UN logistics support accelerates response. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; U.S. funding has risen to at least 112 million USD for PPE, diagnostics, border surveillance, and contact tracing. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic manifestations. Security and community resistance to funeral rites hinder control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：アフリカ連合、2026年末までにブンディブギョ株に対するワクチンを約束
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOによる国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言済み。活発なヒト-ヒト感染、複数国への拡大、高い致死率を示す重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州での進行中のエボラアウトブレークについて述べており、ウガンダへの流入も報告されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国でない。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、246人の死亡、1,077人の疑い患者、複数州への拡大、国境地帯での感染、セキュリティリスク等を勘案し、フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Tribunal Queniano suspende abertura de instalação de quarentena de Ebola nos EUA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court suspends opening of an Ebola quarantine facility in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court suspended the United States' plan to open a 50-bed Ebola quarantine center in Kenya, to be operated by U.S. clinicians and aimed at treating Americans exposed to the virus in the region. The center, slated to begin this Friday, would serve individuals exposed in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The Katiba Institute filed the challenge, arguing the arrangement posed grave public-health risks; the court barred any Ebola facility linked to foreign governments until a hearing. As of May 29, 2026, the DRC outbreak area reports about 220 deaths and over 900 infections; Uganda has confirmed cases and one death. Kenya's government did not comment; domestic medical groups criticized transparency. President William Ruto affirmed continued regional cooperation, while the U.S. pledged about $13.5 million for Kenya's preparedness as part of a broader regional aid package.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、米国によるエボラ隔離施設のケニアでの開設を停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの発生確認）と異常性（国家間の医療施設配置に関する法的紛争）が認められ、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・長期曝露リスク・管理可能性（国際支援必要）が複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはUSAとKenyaも含まれているが、記事サマリーから判断すると、実際のエボラ症例発生地は DRC とUganda。ケニアは隔離施設の設置地として関連しているが、症例発生地ではない。USAは計画中の施設受け入れ国だが症例発生地ではない。したがって verified_locations には DRC と Uganda のみ記載。本件は国境を越えた感染症対応の国際的課題を示唆する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: توصيات مدير منظمة الصحة العالمية للسيطرة على فيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General's Recommendations for the Control of the Ebola Virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri with affected areas in North and South Kivu, remains highly challenging amid ongoing armed conflict and mass displacement. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, during a visit to Ituri, urged rapid advancement of clinical trials for vaccines and candidate therapeutics, while acknowledging development will take months. He welcomed a recovered patient as a sign of hope. Health workers were advised to treat any fever or malaria- or typhoid-like symptoms as suspected Ebola until confirmed, with strict infection prevention and control. He highlighted shortages of funding and personal protective equipment and called for urgent international support for frontline workers. He stated that travel bans are not recommended, as they hinder reporting and containment; instead, ceasefire to allow access, community engagement, transparency, and culturally appropriate responses are essential. Containment is hampered by ongoing armed conflict and insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長によるエボラウイルス制御に関する勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHO事務局長による現地訪問と国際支援要請により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラウイルス流行。Ituri州を中心に North/South Kivu にも影響。武力紛争と大量難民発生により複雑化。WHO事務局長による現地訪問と具体的な支援要請（資金不足、個人防護具不足、国際支援要請）が記録されている。ワクチン臨床試験の加速とケースマネジメントが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Meloni scrive all'Ue per Ebola: rafforzare la vigilanza sanitaria alle frontiere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meloni writes to the EU about Ebola: strengthen health surveillance at the borders.
article.articleSummary: An MSF physician returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo is asymptomatic but under biocontainment observation at Rome's Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases until 8 June after contact with suspected Ebola cases in Congo. The case underscores Italy’s push for strengthened EU border health surveillance amid the Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak reported in the DRC and Uganda. Italy’s Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has written to EU leadership urging coordinated rules for managing direct and indirect arrivals from affected areas, aiming to harmonize border-control measures. She proposed placing border management on the European Council agenda for 18–19 June 2026 and sought an earlier Health Ministers’ video conference next week, plus an EPSCO Council on 16 June to set operational priorities. Keywords: Ebola, Bundibugyo, Congo, Uganda, border surveillance, Spallanzani, Meloni, EU.

triage.headline_ja: メローニ首相がEUにエボラについて書簡：国境での保健監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）かつ社会政治的関心も高い。対象国（DRC）でのエボラ発生ケースに加え、イタリアでのMSF医師の隔離観察は公開されており、EU全体での関心が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事の主要イベントはDRC及びウガンダでのBundibugyo Eボラウイルス発生。イタリアはDRCからの帰国医師の隔離観察地だが、発生地域ではなく対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているため該当。EU首脳による国境対策調整の取組みは社会政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情擴大 疾管署：6/2起民主剛果、烏干達居民暫停入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak widens; Taiwan CDC: Starting June 2, residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda will be temporarily barred from entering.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda are widening. As of May 27, 2026, DRC reports 906 cases (223 deaths) and 125 confirmed cases (17 deaths), with Uganda reporting 7 confirmed cases and 1 death; affected provinces in DRC include Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In Taiwan, from June 2, 2026, entry is suspended for DRC and Uganda residents for 90 days, with four exemptions: degree-seeking students admitted to Taiwan, diplomatic/public officials, non-TW national spouses and their minor children, and emergency/humanitarian cases such as bereavement. The WHO has raised Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease to the highest risk level, declaring it a PHEIC. Taiwan also upgrades the travel advisory to Level 3, requiring travelers with recent DRC/Uganda travel to report to quarantine on arrival and undergo a 21-day self-health management. Visa issuance for residents of those countries is suspended during the period; border controls reinforced.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情拡大 台湾疾管署：6月2日起民主剛果、ウガンダ居民暫停入境
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOがPHEICを宣言したエボラ（Bundibugyo）の国際的な拡大イベント。複数国での症例確認と国際的な入境制限措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的検証：DRCでの発生が主題で、ウガンダでも7確認症例が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCおよびウガンダからの入境制限（台湾）である。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。BundibugoyoエボラはWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。DRC報告：906症例(223死亡)、ウガンダ報告：7確認症例(1死亡)。複数州(Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu)で確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: مدير الصحة العالمية يتعهد من الكونغو الديمقراطية باحتواء تفشي إيبولا رغم القتال وغياب اللقاحات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General pledges to contain the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo despite fighting and lack of vaccines.
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Kinshasa, the capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the Ebola outbreak epicenter in Ituri. The outbreak has killed more than 200 people. Tedros pledged to contain the epidemic and said it can be controlled. He urged all armed parties in the region to halt fighting, which hampers public health response efforts. At present there is no vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain circulating, with vaccines and therapies expected to be ready by the end of the year. The visit highlights the challenges of outbreak control amid ongoing conflict and the need for safe access, rapid response, and protection of affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、ワクチン不足と戦闘下でもコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染拡大を抑制することを誓約
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の感染拡大は公衆衛生に対して重大な影響を与え、高い致死率と国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の急要性を示しており、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必須である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による活動的な感染拡大。200人以上の死亡者を記録し、ワクチン・治療法がない状況での対応。武装勢力の戦闘が公衆衛生対応を阻害。WHO事務局長の現地訪問と高レベルの政治的関与が確認される。国際的サポート体制の構築が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Diretor-geral da OMS chegou à República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Director-General arrived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa amid a severe Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri, declared May 15 as the DRC's 17th. The virus has spread to neighboring provinces and into Uganda, where seven confirmed cases (one fatal) have been reported. Over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths have been recorded. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, for which there is no specific treatment or vaccine; the Zaire strain previously linked to outbreaks has an approved vaccine. Africa CDC pledged a Bundibugyo vaccine and drug by end-2026. Tedros will travel to Ituri on Friday as the response intensifies. UNICEF is airlifting over 100 tons of relief; WHO received 4.6 tons of medical supplies at Bunia. Kampala closed its border with DRC; the U.S. vows to deny entry of Ebola cases. WHO raised regional risk to high, global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国に到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行で1,000件以上の疑い患者と246人の死亡があり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、国境閉鎖などの渡航制限も発生している。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ（226074）も含まれており、記事サマリーでウガンダへの7症例の拡大が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙した。Bundibugyo株による稀な大規模流行で、ワクチン・治療法がない特殊性がある。WHO事務局長の現地入りなど国際的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تطوير علاجات ولقاحات لفيروس الإيبولا قد يستغرق عدة أشهر - صوت الأمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Developing treatments and vaccines for the Ebola virus may take several months.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, visiting Ituri and North and South Kivu in Democratic Republic of Congo to contain Ebola, said WHO and partners are accelerating clinical trials for vaccines and candidate therapies, though development will take several months. For the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, there are no fully approved vaccines or treatments yet; supportive medical care can help some patients recover. He welcomed a reported recovery and discharge from a treatment center as a hopeful sign. Health workers were urged to treat any fever or malaria- or typhoid-like symptoms as suspected Ebola until confirmed, with strict infection prevention. Persistent funding and PPE shortages were noted, with a call for increased international support to frontline staff. Travel bans are not recommended; containment should focus on strengthening response at the outbreak source. A ceasefire is urged to enable access amid conflict, displacement, distrust, and to involve communities in the response.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）：エボラウイルスの治療法とワクチンの開発には数ヶ月要する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の検証済み発生地域（DRC）での確実な流行を示唆。治療法・ワクチン開発の進行中、公衆衛生的影響が深刻で国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、DRCのIteriおよびNorth/South Kivu州でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo strain）の流行が確認される。WHOによる現地視察とワクチン・治療薬開発の加速が報道されている。疑い症例の医療体制、感染予防資源不足、国際支援要望が強調されている。複数の感染症（マラリア・チフス）併発の懸念も記述されているが、主題はエボラである。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情擴散！疾管署急防堵：6/2起2國居民暫緩入境│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading! Taiwan CDC urgently blocks entry: Starting June 2, residents of two countries temporarily barred from entering | TVBS News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks are underway in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)—centering in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—and Uganda. Taiwan’s CDC will suspend visa issuance to residents of DRC and Uganda from June 2, 00:00, for 90 days; visas already issued will not be eligible for entry during the period. DRC has 906 cases (223 deaths) with 125 confirmed (17 deaths); Uganda reports 7 confirmed cases, 1 death. Exemptions to the visa suspension include degree-seeking students, diplomats, non-national spouses and their minor children, and emergency/humanitarian cases. People with travel history to affected areas within 21 days and valid residents must report upon arrival, undergo 21 days of self-health management, monitor temperature twice daily, and use the Public Health Reporting system; contact 1922 if symptoms appear. Travelers are advised to avoid nonessential travel to DRC and Uganda; border measures may be adjusted as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大！台湾CDC緊急対策：6月2日から2国の住民の入境を一時制限│TVBS NEWS
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での確認、渡航制限措置）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患であり、国境措置と国際的対応が発動されている。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱流行に関するもので、台湾が対応措置を実施する内容である。発生地域にはUganda（対象国リストに未含）、Taiwanが含まれるが、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする（対象国リストの基準に基づく）。DRCは906症例（死亡223例）、ウガンダは確定症例7例（死亡1例）との報告。複数の州（Ituri, South Kivu, North Kivu）での発生が確認されており、明らかなクラスター形成が存在する。エボラ出血熱は致死率が高く（DRC：24.6%）、国際的な保健上の脅威となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 'Dump site:' Kenya erupts over US Ebola quarantine scheme
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, Kenya’s High Court in Nairobi temporarily blocked a U.S.-proposed Ebola quarantine facility, suspending any agreement until petitions are heard. The plan would relocate Americans exposed to a rare Ebola strain abroad to a Kenyan site rather than repatriating them; its location and endorsement remain unclear. Nairobi says only discussions about support have taken place; the U.S. has earmarked $13.5 million for Kenya’s Ebola preparedness. Katiba Institute and the Kenya Law Society challenge the facility, citing public health risks, lack of participation, and Kenya’s insufficient high-containment infrastructure; a doctors’ union issued a 48-hour strike notice against the plan. Separately, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in northeastern Congo remains ongoing, with over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since May 15, and seven cases with one death in Uganda; WHO warns the true scale may be larger; there is no approved treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、米国のエボラ隔離施設計画に激怒、高等裁判所が一時的に差し止め
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのBundibugyo Ebola outbreak（1000件以上の疑い例、220人以上の死亡）、ウガンダへの波及（7件、1死亡）が確認され、国際的拡大リスク、重症度、長期曝露の懸念がある。また米国のケニア隔離施設計画という新たな国際的管理課題が加わっており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的分析：主要なエボラ感染事象（Bundibugyo outbreak）はコンゴの northeastern Congo で発生している。ウガンダでも7件の症例と1死亡が確認されているが、「Separately」という表現と流行の主体性からコンゴが主たる発生地。ケニアは米国の隔離施設計画の対象地だが、実際のアウトブレイク発生地ではない。対象国リストでは DRC（203312）のみが該当。Bundibugyo は新興株で治療法・ワクチンがないという病原体特性、1000以上の疑い例と高い死亡率（220+/1000+）、ウガンダへの越境波及が IHR 4基準すべてと WPRO 5基準すべてを満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Mèo con cắn chủ rồi chết, chủ nuôi mới chịu đi tiêm phòng dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kitten bites its owner, then dies; the owner finally agrees to get rabies vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk rises in Hanoi, Vietnam, during hot summers as dog and cat bites surge. By May 29, 2026, the National Center for Tropical Diseases vaccination unit reported over 51 post-exposure prophylaxis cases (rabies immunoglobulin and vaccine) in two weeks, including three emergencies in one morning. Case highlights: Mr. B, 67, of Soc Son, was bitten by a household dog on the hand; the dog died two weeks later, and a 14-day delay heightened fatal risk. Mr. A, 23, of Dong Anh, was bitten by a 2‑month‑old kitten; the kitten died shortly after, and care was sought only on day 6. In contrast, Mrs. H, 65, of Dong Anh, promptly sought care after a neighbor’s dog bite to her toe and received immediate rabies vaccination. Experts warn rabies is 100% fatal once symptoms appear; practice wound washing, disinfection, and urgent PEP; ensure annual vaccination for pets aged 2 months and older.

triage.headline_ja: 子猫が飼い主を咬んで死亡、飼い主ようやく狂犬病予防接種を受ける
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム（ハノイ）での狂犬病の動物咬傷事例が報告されており、スクリーニング基準「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、情報が限定的であり、国家規模の公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは明確でない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 夏季におけるハノイでの動物咬傷による狂犬病リスク増加が報告されており、2週間で51件の暴露後予防接種（PEP）が実施されている。狂犬病は発症後100%致命的であり、複数の事例で初期対応の遅延が確認されている。ベトナムは対象国に含まれており、動物由来感染症の管理上の懸念がある。ただし、国家的な流行宣言や国際的な懸念レベルは記事から判断できない。

article.articleHeadline: Video. R.D. Congo rafforza risposta all'Ebola: casi in aumento, arrivano gli aiuti UE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video. DRC strengthens Ebola response: cases on the rise, EU aid is arriving.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies after a new case is confirmed in Goma, a dense eastern city. As of May 28, 2026, authorities report 101 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and more than 3,000 contacts under observation; suspected infections approach 1,000 with at least 220 deaths among suspected cases. Public health actions include school visits in Goma to promote hygiene, symptom recognition, and rapid reporting, underscoring how overcrowding and displacement fuel transmission. In Bunia, Ituri province, 100 tonnes of medical supplies and PPE arrived under EU Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations to reinforce treatment centers and frontline health workers. The response is backed by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, who is strengthening surveillance and contact tracing and urging emergency health measures to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: 動画: DRコンゴがエボラ対応を強化、感染数増加、EUの支援が到着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て満たす。進行中のエボラ流行で確認患者101名、死亡者220名以上、国際的支援が動員されており、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRコンゴ（北キブ州、イトゥリ州）でのエボラウイルス病の進行中の流行。確認患者101名、疑い患者約1,000名、死亡者220名以上。Gomaなど人口密集地での感染確認により国際的懸念が高まっている。EU、WHO等による国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan court temporarily halts proposed US Ebola quarantine facility
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court on 2026-05-29 temporarily barred the government from establishing or operating any Ebola quarantine or treatment facility in Kenya linked to the United States or any foreign government, pending trial. Justice Patricia Nyaundi issued conservatory orders after certifying a petition by Katiba Institute. Authorities are restrained from admitting into Kenya anyone exposed to or infected with Ebola. The petition argues the proposed arrangement would allow monitoring or quarantine of exposed individuals in Kenya, a move requiring closer legal scrutiny. The case follows reports that Kenya agreed to host a US-backed Ebola quarantine facility during the ongoing eastern DR Congo outbreak. Kenya has not reported confirmed Ebola cases linked to the outbreak, but health authorities keep screening and preparedness due to regional travel links and its status as a major East African travel hub. The High Court will hear arguments before deciding whether the plan can proceed under constitutional/public health law.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高裁が米国支援のエボラ隔離施設の設置を一時的に停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ病は極めて高リスク疾患だが、本記事は東部DRC発生中の既知アウトブレイクに関連する施設設置の法的争点であり、新規感染事例発生ではない。ケニアでの確認症例なし。国際的懸念と地域準備態勢は認められるが、現在のシグナル強度は不確定。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は東部DRC発生中のエボラアウトブレイク対応としてのケニア隔離施設設置に関する法的問題。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC は対象国(203312)として含める。現在、ケニア内での確認症例はなく、地域スクリーニング・準備態勢段階。IHR基準は2つ以上該当しWPRO基準も複数該当するが、既知アウトブレイク関連の施設設置論争であるため、新規シグナルとしての直接的なピックアップ基準には若干留保。継続的な注視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Svenska familjen bor mitt i Kongos ebolautbrott
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Swedish family lives in the midst of Congo's Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Kongo-Kinshasa region. Since the outbreak began, the World Health Organization reports about 1,100 cases, with just over 120 laboratory-confirmed. Deaths include 10 confirmed and 223 suspected. The response includes aid staff such as Alfred Ottosson, a pilot for Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF), supporting the Ebola operation underway. A Swedish family with four children lives amid the crisis, illustrating daily uncertainties and impacts of the outbreak. The article highlights the ongoing response and features footage reflecting life inside a family living through an active Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: スウェーデン人家族がコンゴのエボラ流行の真っただ中に住んでいる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の能動的流行であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO報告による1,100例以上の症例（120例以上が確定診断）と223例の疑い死亡を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的な懸念が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国Kongo-Kinshasa地域における能動的エボラ流行を報道しており、WHOの公式報告による症例数と死亡データが含まれている。スウェーデン人国際支援職員および家族の存在が国際的な関心を喚起している。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO prioritises clinical trials for Bundibugyo Ebola treatments, vaccines
article.articleSummary: WHO prioritizes clinical trials for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BVD) amid the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with additional cases in Uganda. Experts say candidate therapeutics and vaccines should be used only within research settings to ensure safety and efficacy. For treatment, MBP134 and Maftivimab monoclonal antibodies, and the antiviral remdesivir are prioritized; combination therapy with a monoclonal antibody and remdesivir is also to be evaluated. For prevention, obeldesivir is identified as a priority for post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts, dependent on effective tracing, which remains challenging in parts of the DRC. The leading vaccine candidate is the single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo by IAVI; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute) could begin efficacy testing in 2–3 months, pending data. Ervebo should not be used outside carefully designed research. Protocols for field trials are being developed; standard measures—surveillance, contact tracing, isolation, testing, and safe burials—continue.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ブンディブギョエボラの治療法とワクチンの臨床試験を優先
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCでの流行に加えウガンダへの国際的拡大、治療・ワクチン開発の世界的関心、渡航制限の可能性が確認される。
triage.notes: DRCでの進行中の流行が主題。ウガンダは記事で言及されているが、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため優先対象。エボラウイルス病（特にブンディブギョ亜種）は極めて高リスク。WHO主導による治療・ワクチン開発は国際的な関心事であり、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's ministers of health and communications arrive in Bunia to oversee Ebola response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia epicentre) escalates as health and communications ministers arrive to oversee the response. Health Minister Samuel Kamba says the visit aims to support frontline staff amid losses of doctors and qualified personnel. Suspected cases in eastern Congo near 1,000 with at least 220 suspected deaths; 101 confirmed cases and over 3,000 potential contacts being traced. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is due in Ituri to assist and urges a ceasefire to reduce displacement that hinders control efforts. The outbreak is triggering cross-border actions, with Uganda closing its border with Congo after suspected Ebola cases surge and infections are confirmed inside Uganda. The situation underscores the rapid spread of a rare Ebola type and the ongoing need for intensified surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCの保健・通信大臣がブニアに到着、エボラ対応を監督
triage.triage_reason: エボラアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。確認症例101件、死亡220件以上、ウガンダへの越境感染、国境閉鎖など国際的拡大の明確な証拠がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラアウトブレイクです。ウガンダについても国境閉鎖と越境感染が言及されていますが、記事の主なフォーカスはDRCの対応体制強化にあり、ウガンダ自体での本格的なアウトブレイク記載は限定的です。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加します。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外します。

article.articleHeadline: Eight Asiatic lion cubs dead, 22 lions isolated amid virus scare; Gujarat launches emergency response
article.articleSummary: Eight Asiatic lion cubs have died in Gujarat's Gir National Park (Gir East and Gir West) amid fears of a Babesia virus outbreak; 22 lions have been isolated after showing symptoms. The government launched a full-scale emergency response and placed sensitive ranges—Babariya, Jamwala, Jasadhar—on high alert, with intensified medical surveillance and inspections at animal care centers including Jasadhar. Babesia, a tick-borne infection, is the primary suspect, though Canine Distemper Virus (CDV) is also under investigation. The Gujarat Forest Department is awaiting laboratory confirmation from Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre to determine the exact cause; officials note some deaths could be due to territorial conflict, old age, or other natural causes. The crisis prompts a wildlife health zone status and ongoing monitoring in Gir East and Gir West regions.

triage.headline_ja: アジアライオンの子ども8頭が死亡、22頭が隔離 ウイルス懸念の中グジャラート州が緊急対応を展開
triage.triage_reason: 動物における節足動物媒介感染症（バベシア症）の疑い事例であり、異常・予想外（野生動物における集団発症）および管理可能性に関する懸念が認められるが、ヒト感染の具体的な報告がなく、国際的拡大リスク評価に情報不足。
triage.notes: 本事例は野生動物（アジアライオン）における節足動物媒介感染症の疑い集団発症であり、ヒト感染事例の報告がない。バベシア症はティック媒介感染症として既知であるが、記事ではヒト群集への影響は記載されていない。グジャラート州森林局により緊急対応が実施され政治的関心は高い。ただしヒト公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響が未確定であり、IHR基準2項目以上には至らないため、WATCH段階での情報精査が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 我驻乌干达大使馆提醒中国公民近期谨慎前往刚果（金）_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Chinese Embassy in Uganda reminds Chinese citizens to exercise caution when traveling to the Congo (Kinshasa) in the near term
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, the Chinese Embassy in Uganda issued a notice advising Chinese citizens to exercise caution when traveling to the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) in the near term and to avoid nonessential trips. The warning highlights Ebola-affected areas, specifically Ituri Province and North Kivu Province, and urges avoidance of contact with wildlife and suspected patients to reduce infection risk. Travelers who develop fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or bleeding should seek medical care promptly or contact the Chinese medical team available locally. If returning home with symptoms, individuals should report to flight crew or border authorities. Contact options include the Ministry of Foreign Affairs Global Consular Protection hotlines (+86-10-12308, +86-10-65612308) and the Congo (Kinshasa) embassy consular protection number (+243-851474669). Source: CCTV News via Beijing Daily App.

triage.headline_ja: 中国駐ウガンダ大使館、中国国民に対しコンゴ（キンシャサ）への渡航に注意呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の感染地域（DRC）における渡航警告であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。感染症危機管理の観点から国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は中国駐ウガンダ大使館によるDRC（Ituri州とNorth Kivu州）へのエボラ警告であり、実際の発生地はDRCである。Chinaはニュース配信国（大使館が警告を発出した国）であり、感染症の発生地そのものではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。Uganda（ウガンダ）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda: until when?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in DR Congo's Ituri and imported cases in Kampala, Uganda, prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. By May 15, 2026, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths (including four deaths among confirmed cases) were reported in Ituri, with imported cases confirmed in Uganda’s capital. Rapid transmission among health-care workers and communities highlights weaknesses in infection prevention and control, laboratory capacity, and delayed case recognition in overwhelmed systems. Ituri sits along a mobile commercial/mining corridor bordering Uganda and South Sudan, increasing regional spread risk; Angola, Rwanda, Tanzania, and Zambia are vulnerable due to porous borders, limited genomic surveillance, PPE shortages, and underinvestment in public health. Bundibugyo virus has no licensed vaccine or specific antiviral therapy; vaccine/therapeutic candidates exist, but no approved countermeasures yet. Ituri hosts over 273,000 displaced people amid conflict, hindering tracing and response. Calls for sustained investments in labs, genomic surveillance, cross-border preparedness, vaccine manufacturing, and health workforce training frame epidemic preparedness as global health security.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行：いつまで続くのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。ブンディブギョウイルスエボラの国際的な拡大、死亡が発生、複数国への波及、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）を宣言。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年5月15日時点の情報を記載。Ituri州（DRC）での246件の疑似症例と80件の死亡、ウガンダの首都Kampalへの輸入症例確認。PHEIC宣言済み。対象国リストからは、DRCとZambiaが実際の発生地域として検証された。ウガンダ、スーダン、ルワンダ、タンザニア、アンゴラは脆弱性言及だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Meloni scrive all'UE per coordinamento gestione Ebola e frontiere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meloni writes to the EU to coordinate Ebola management and border controls.
article.articleSummary: Italy's government has urged the European Union to advance coordinated Ebola management and border controls amid the Central Africa outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote to EU leaders seeking strengthened border surveillance and common rules for arrivals—direct and indirect—from affected zones, to be discussed at the European Council on 18–19 June 2026 and in EPSCO on 16 June. Nationally, the Health Ministry and Civil Protection issued circulars to implement targeted health surveillance and traveler-vigilance protocols for arrivals from affected regions. This weekend, Italy, with support from the Farnesina, Health Ministry, Civil Protection, and Aise, will dispatch a team from the Spallanzani Institute to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance, deliver medical supplies, and bolster epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: メローニがEUに書簡：エボラ対策と国境管理の調整を求める
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の中央アフリカ地域での流行（DRC・ウガンダ）において、イタリアがEU全体での協調対応を求めており、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限が該当。また異常性・重症度・管理可能性の課題から複数のWPRO基準に合致し、欧州政治的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda・Italy・Central Africaも含まれているが、記事サマリーにおいて主題の感染症イベントの実際の発生地はDRCおよびウガンダ（対象国外）である。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。Italyは対応国として登場するが、発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。イタリア政府の対応と技術支援派遣は高い国際的関心を示すが、流行の実発生は対象国内に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Meloni a vertici Ue "Serve rafforzare vigilanza a frontiere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Meloni at EU leaders' summit: "We must strengthen border surveillance."
article.articleSummary: Italy calls for stronger border surveillance amid Ebola Bundibugyo virus (BVD) outbreak linked to Central Africa, with flare-ups in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni sent a letter to EU leaders requesting coordinated border controls and uniform rules for managing direct and indirect arrivals from affected areas. She proposed adding border management to the European Council agenda for 18–19 June 2026, and suggested an earlier health-ministers videoconference and EPSCO meeting on 16 June to set operational priorities. Nationally, the Health Ministry, in coordination with Civil Protection, issued circulars to activate targeted health surveillance and traveler-vigilance protocols for arrivals from affected regions. This weekend, Italy will dispatch a team from the Spallanzani Institute to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance, deliver medical supplies, and bolster epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、メローニがEU首脳会議で「国境での警備を強化する必要がある」と述べる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス流行がDRCとウガンダで発生し、イタリアを含む国際的な対応が開始されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）し、政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的に「Kinshasa」（DRC）と「Uganda」でのエボラ流行が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。イタリアは経由地・対応実施国であり、発生地ではないため除外。DRCでの流行確認とイタリア政府による国際的対応、EU調整の要請が確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに完全に満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: L'Angola signale 13 cas positifs de variole du singe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: Angola reports 13 positive cases of monkeypox.
article.articleSummary: 13 monkeypox cases in Angola: 9 in Cabinda and 4 in Uíge, as of May 29, 2026. Health Minister Sílvia Lutucuta announced in Mbanza Kongo, Zaire Province, after the first Local Governance Council meeting chaired by President João Lourenço. Cabinda has reported monkeypox since last year, with five new positives in 2026. Vaccination doses for monkeypox are being supplied to border provinces neighboring the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a preventive measure. No suspected Ebola cases have been recorded in Angola. Cross-border controls include temperature screening at entry/exit points; authorities discourage bushmeat consumption and travel to Ebola-affected areas in the DRC to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ：サル痘の陽性症例13件を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の多数例発生、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、DRCとの国境を越えた対策が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、アンゴラでサル痘13例（カビンダ9例、ウイジェ4例）が確認されており、DRCとの国境対策として予防的ワクチン供給とスクリーニング実施中。Ebolaは未確認だがDRCでの発生に伴う対策が講じられている。複数のWPRO基準が満たされ、国際的な懸念があるため PICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: التفشى الحالى للإيبولا يتركز فى إيتورى بـ90% من الحالات - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The current Ebola outbreak is concentrated in Ituri with 90% of cases - The Seventh Day.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 90% of cases reported there; North Kivu and South Kivu have a limited number of infections. As of May 29, 2026, WHO and the DRC government are coordinating the response; there are currently no vaccines or therapeutics approved for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Early detection and supportive care can save lives and reduce transmission. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus addressed Ituri residents, calling for solidarity and a temporary ceasefire by armed groups to allow health workers access to affected communities. The outbreak is driven by human-to-human transmission; the region faces malaria, hunger, insecurity, and displacement. Ituri has previously contained 16 Ebola outbreaks, and authorities aim to contain a 17th. The DRC plans to visit Bunia to meet local leaders and address concerns.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラ出血熱の現在の流行はイトゥリ州に集中し、症例の90%が報告されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡・重症）と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、WPRO基準では異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の複数基準に該当。DRC政府とWHOの調整対応が進行中であり、国際支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス）の流行事案。イトゥリ州が流行の90%を占める地域的集中があるも、南キブ州・北キブ州でも症例報告あり。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、ヒト-ヒト感染駆動型、武装勢力による混乱が対応を複雑化させている。WHOトップが関与し国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉升溫！台灣6月2日起暫停剛果、烏干達居民入境90天
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak heats up! Taiwan to suspend entry of residents from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda for 90 days starting June 2.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak expanding in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Taiwan’s CDC will suspend issuing visas for DRC and Uganda residents from 00:00 on 2026-06-02 for 90 days, with four exemptions (university-accepted students, diplomatic/public officials, spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals who are non-citizens, and urgent/humanitarian cases such as funerals). WHO data up to 2026-05-27 show DRC outbreaks mainly in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, totaling 906 cases and 223 deaths; 125 confirmed cases with 17 deaths. Uganda has 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. Border measures require entry restrictions with exceptions; travelers from affected areas must report to airport quarantine on arrival, engage in 21 days of self-health management, and perform twice-daily temperature checks via the e-health system. In-flight alerts since 2026-05-27 advise travelers with DRC/Uganda history to report at arrival. Symptoms (fever, headache, myalgia, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, bleeding) trigger medical evaluation; asymptomatic travelers receive a self-management notice and should call 1922 if symptoms appear. Travel advisory: Level 3 Warning; avoid nonessential travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱が拡大！台湾は2026年6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ居民の入境を90日間暫停
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の拡大がDRC及びウガンダで報告され、IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡例を含む224例）、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及確認）、渡航制限措置が該当。複数国での政府レベルの対応（台湾CDC、WHO警戒）が確認されており、シグナルとしてフルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加していない。DRCはサマリーで906例・223例の死亡と明記されており、Ituri及びNorth Kivu、South Kivu州で確認。WHO基準で4項目全て該当、WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。台湾を含む複数国での政府レベルの対応確認済み。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Meloni scrive a vertici Ue: "Coordinare vigilanza frontiere". In arrivo circolare ministero - Sassari Notizie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Meloni writes to EU leaders: "Coordinate border surveillance." Ministry circular on the way.
article.articleSummary: Italy calls for strengthened border surveillance for the Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, citing elevated epidemiological risk.
