Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has written to EU leaders to push for common rules governing direct and indirect arrivals from affected zones and to place border management on the EU Council agenda for 18–19 June 2026, with preparatory video-conferences of Health Ministers and EPSCO on 16 June. Nationally, the Health Ministry, with Civil Protection, issued circulars to activate targeted health surveillance and traveler-monitoring protocols for arrivals from affected regions. Italy will send a Spallanzani Institute team to Kinshasa this weekend to provide technical assistance, deliver supplies, and strengthen surveillance. No Ebola cases or pandemic in Italy; two forthcoming documents — a circular and an ordinance — will guide risk assessment for probable, suspected, or confirmed cases and inform healthcare workers and regions. An MSF doctor returning from DRC is in biocontainment at Spallanzani after contact with suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、メローニ首相がEU首脳に書簡：「国境警視の調整を」。保健省通達が予定されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。アフリカでの致死的なエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクに対し、イタリアとEUが国境警視と国際的な対応を実施しており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病（Ebola Bundibugyo）のアウトブレイクがDRCおよびウガンダで発生しており、記事の主題はDRCでの発生。イタリアは直接的な患者発生はなく、国境警視強化と技術支援活動を実施中。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。イタリアも対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını hızla yayılıyor! Batı ülkeleri yardım bütçelerini kesti, küresel risk kapıda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is spreading rapidly! Western countries have cut their aid budgets, global risk looms.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak originating in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is spreading toward Uganda's capital Kampala. At least 240 people have died, with roughly half of those infected succumbing to the disease, and the outbreak is expanding beyond Ituri into other DRC regions. The crisis is being exacerbated by severe funding cuts to Western aid agencies, notably USAID, whose 2024 aid was about $1.4 billion and has fallen to around $21 million in 2026, weakening rapid-response capacity and lab infrastructure. Bunia, Ituri's capital, hosts Ebola response efforts; healthcare workers are at high risk, with at least five clinicians killed at Bunia Evangelical Medical Center and many others infected. Diagnostic challenges arise because Ebola symptoms mimic malaria and typhoid, compounded by limited laboratory facilities and community mistrust of aid workers. An incident in Rwampara, Uganda, saw a crowd burn an Ebola center during a funeral for a suspected case.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が急速に拡大！西欧諸国が援助予算を削減、世界的リスクが迫りくる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、死亡者240人以上、複数国への拡大リスク、医療システムへの深刻な影響、国際支援体制の著しい弱体化が認められる。緊急のRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのEbola症例及び社会的不安（火葬場での暴動）に言及しているが、検証済み発生地は対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。死亡率50%、医療従事者への高リスク、診断困難性（マラリア・チフスとの鑑別）、資金不足による対応力低下、コミュニティの不信感などが相まって、非常に高いリスク状況を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Western Equatoria warns of rising Mpox cases - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: Mpox outbreaks in Western Equatoria state, with 157 suspected cases since February; confirmed Mpox in Yambio County 35 (up from 24), Nzara 2, and Tambura 5; Ezo was the outbreak’s origin. Symptoms include fever, body aches and skin rashes. Isolation capacity is severely constrained: Ezo County Hospital has one isolation tent with five beds; Tambura Hospital lacks a dedicated isolation facility; no Mpox deaths reported in Ezo and most patients have recovered. Limited infection prevention and control materials worsen the response, with shortages of face masks, sanitizers, gumboots and protective kits, and a shortage of ambulances. Border risks loom due to Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda; informal trade routes along the South Sudan–Congo border raise cross-border transmission risks. Authorities urge stronger border monitoring and temporary movement restrictions in coordination with security forces; public awareness efforts are under training in Juba; appeals for urgent support from WHO, UNICEF and partners.

triage.headline_ja: 西エクアトリア州がMpox症例の増加に警告 - ラジオ・タマズジ
triage.triage_reason: Mpox及びEbolaの2つの深刻な感染症が同時に報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、国境を越えた感染のリスク）を複数満たす。隔離施設の不足、国境リスク、複数地域での確認症例など、管理困難性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRC、South Sudan、Uganda、Burundi、Japanが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は南スーダン西エクアトリア州でのMpox発生である。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれており、サマリーではDRCのEbola発生が国境リスク要因として言及されている。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Japanのホッカイドでの言及は位置情報エラーと推定されるため除外。複数地域での確認症例、隔離施設の深刻な不足、DRC/Ugandaでのエボラ発生に伴う国境リスク、WHO/UNICEF等からの支援要請が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升溫！6/2起暫停剛果、烏干達居民入境90天
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak intensifies! Starting June 2, entry of residents from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda will be suspended for 90 days.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. WHO data as of May 27, 2026: DRC 906 cases, 223 deaths; Uganda 7 cases, 1 death. To curb cross-border risk, Taiwan’s CDC will suspend entry visas for residents of DRC and Uganda for 90 days from June 2, 2026, with existing visas suspended. Exemptions cover four groups: degree students admitted to Taiwan; diplomats; Taiwanese nationals’ foreign spouses and minor children; and urgent/humanitarian cases (funerals or visiting seriously ill relatives). Arrivals with 21-day travel history must report at the airport and undergo 21 days of self-health management. Travel advisory for DRC/Uganda is Level 3; all international flights to Taiwan will issue in-flight notices. Suspected Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, or bleeding; suspected cases are transported to contracted hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の感染者数が増加！6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダの住民の入境を90日間禁止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大リスク（DRC 906例、ウガンダ 7例）、複数国での確認、台湾が渡航禁止措置を実施するなど、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の発生を述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。台湾の渡航禁止措置は国際的関心を示しており、この地域での感染拡大リスクが公式に認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Meloni all'Ue: serve vigilanza alle frontiere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, Meloni to the EU: border surveillance is needed.
article.articleSummary: May 29, 2026: Italy calls for strengthened EU border surveillance to curb the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has sent a letter to EU Council President Nikos Christodoulides, European Council President António Costa, and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, requesting coordinated frontier vigilance and common rules for direct and indirect arrivals from affected zones. Italy's Health Minister Maria Rosaria Campitiello announced an ordinance and a circular to clarify risk assessment and guide healthcare providers and regional authorities in suspected Ebola cases, aiming to protect citizens without inducing alarm. The Health Ministry emphasizes a rigorous surveillance system; no Hantavirus cases in Italy, with travelers who had contact under quarantine completing. A Medecins Sans Frontieres doctor exposed to Ebola patients in the DRC arrived at Rome’s Spallanzani Institute, well and under observation until June 8."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、メローニ欧州連合へ：国境監視が必要
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）のDRC・ウガンダでの流行が進行中であり、国際的な拡大リスク（EU諸国への拡散）が顕著。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、政治指導者による公式な対応要請があるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行を主題としている。イタリアはEU域外で事例が報告されていないが、国境監視強化を求める公式声明を発出。ローマのSpallanzani研究所での患者受け入れは国際的対応の一環。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ハンタウイルスはイタリア国内で患者なし、付与地域のため記事の主題外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, nessun caso in Italia. Meloni scrive all'Ue: "Controlli coordinati e rafforzati alle frontiere"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: No cases in Italy. Meloni writes to the EU: "Coordinated and strengthened border controls."
article.articleSummary: No Ebola virus disease cases in Italy as of 29 May 2026. Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompt heightened border vigilance. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has written to EU leaders urging coordinated border surveillance with common rules for arrivals from affected zones, seeking to place border management on the EU Council agenda for 18–19 June 2026, with a Health Ministers’ videoconference and EPSCO on 16 June to set priorities. Nationally, the Health Ministry, with Civil Protection, issued surveillance protocols for travelers from affected regions. A Spallanzani Institute team will travel to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance, deliver supplies, and reinforce epidemiological surveillance, supported by Farnesina, Health Ministry, Civil Protection, USMAF, and CRI. A Doctors Without Borders doctor returning from DRC is asymptomatic and quarantined at Spallanzani; authorities reiterate no cases or pandemic, and two documents—a circular and an ordinance—will guide clinicians and regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：イタリアで症例なし。メローニがEUに書簡「国境での統制的で強化された管理」
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)がDRCおよびウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスク（Yes）および渡航・貿易制限リスク（Yes）が該当。WPRO基準ではスクリーニング異常性（Yes）が確認され、イタリアの首相が国境管理強化をEU議題に提出するなど政治的・国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでBundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)の流行が発生しており、イタリア首相の直接的な国際対応、EU議題への提出、イタリア国防衛生省による国境監視プロトコル実施が確認される。Spallanzani研究所のキンシャサ派遣、DRCから帰国した医師の隔離など、多国間対応が進行中。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情》全台2人進行21天自主健康管理中 疾管署統計：去年入境近百例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Two people in Taiwan under 21-day self-health management; Taiwan CDC reports nearly 100 inbound cases last year.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan activates border quarantine as Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda widen. On May 27, 2026, two asymptomatic travelers are placed under 21-day self-health management. The DRC has 906 cases and 223 deaths; 125 confirmed including 17 deaths. Uganda has 7 confirmed cases with 1 death. From June 2, 2026, Taiwan suspends visa issuance for residents of both countries for 90 days; four exceptions apply: degree-seeking students, diplomats, Taiwanese non-national spouses and their minor children, and urgent/humanitarian cases such as bereavement. About 100 travelers from these countries entered Taiwan last year; average 2–3 days per inbound traveler. To reinforce border control, on-board announcements started May 27; asymptomatic travelers must report to the quarantine station and undertake 21 days of self-monitoring with daily temperature checks and E-reporting. Suspected Ebola symptoms trigger ambulance transport to a contracted hospital; non-compliance may be penalized under law.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱情勢：台湾で2人が21日間の自主健康管理中；疾病管理庁統計：昨年の入国者は約100例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に4項目すべて該当。DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の拡大に対し、台湾が国境検疫を発動し、ビザ発給停止措置を取るなど公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的対応が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはUgandaも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Taiwanは対象国リストに含まれないため、発生地域から除外。DRCでの906症例、223死亡、ウガンダでの7症例、1死亡という重大な疫学データが記載されており、台湾の国境検疫強化（ビザ発給停止90日間、21日間の自主健康管理）により国際的影響は明白。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 抵刚果（金）监督抗疫　世卫总干事：埃博拉可被阻断
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General Arrives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Oversee the Epidemic Response; Ebola Can Be Contained.
article.articleSummary: Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak. As of May 24, 2026 (since the May 15 declaration), 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths, with total cases exceeding 1,000. WHO warns the virus may have circulated undetected. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa and then Bunia to coordinate the response, urging ceasefires to enable control and opposing travel bans. The outbreak centers in a conflict-affected, mineral-rich area where M23 violence displaces civilians. There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo strain yet, though Africa CDC says vaccines and drugs could be ready by end-2026 after trials. Relief: 4.6 tons arrived at Bunia Airport; UNICEF is delivering 100 tons. Uganda closed its border; the United States will not allow entry of infected individuals and has opened a quarantine center in Kenya; Kenyan rights groups seek to curb such facilities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国に到着して疫病対策を監督。エボラは阻止可能と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラ出血熱）の新規アウトブレイク、1,000例を超える患者、10例の確認死亡、223例の疑い死亡があり、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダが国境を閉鎖、米国が検疫センター設置）と渡航制限リスクが存在。WHO事務局長の現地対応、ワクチン・治療薬不在など管理の複雑性から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri Province）でのBundibugyo ebolavirus アウトブレイクであり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に記載した。米国、ウガンダ、ケニアは対応国として言及されているが、記事の主たる感染症発生地ではないため除外した。ワクチン・治療薬不在、紛争地域での発生という複雑な管理環境、WHO事務局長の緊急訪問など、全てのリスク要因が揃っている。

article.articleHeadline: 為伊波拉封境！6/2起「民主剛果、烏干達」居民禁入台灣　「4類人」除外
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola border closure: Starting June 2, residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda barred from entering Taiwan, four categories exempt.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan tightens Ebola border controls amid expanding outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. From June 2 at 00:00, entry by residents of DRC and Uganda is suspended for 90 days, with four exemptions: (1) degree‑seeking students admitted to Taiwan; (2) diplomats; (3) Taiwanese nationals’ non‑citizen spouses and their minor children; (4) emergency or humanitarian projects (funerals or visiting seriously ill relatives). Those with recent travel to affected areas and valid residence permit holders still must report at arrival, undergo a 21‑day self‑health management, and use the “Inbound Traveler Health Management Notice” with daily self‑reports; contact 1922 for medical help if symptoms appear. WHO data as of May 27 show DRC with 906 cases (223 deaths) and 125 confirmed (17 deaths), and Uganda with 7 confirmed cases and 1 death. The measures reflect a WHO Level 3 “Warning” and may be adjusted as outbreaks evolve.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱国境閉鎖：6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ居民の台湾入国禁止、4類型は除外
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、実際の症例・死亡報告に基づく正当な対応であるため、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 台湾はBluedot APIで発生地域として報告されているが、実際の流行発生地はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダであり、台湾は対応・規制を実施している国のため、verified_locationsには対象国リストに該当する実際の発生国のみを記載。エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク疾患であり、DRCで906例（223死亡）、ウガンダで7確認例（1死亡）という具体的な患者数が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Botswana tightens border screening amid Ebola scare
article.articleSummary: Botswana tightened border screening on 29 May 2026 due to new Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Health authorities intensified measures at airports and land borders to enable early detection and rapid containment. Incoming travelers are subject to temperature checks and Ebola symptom screening (fever, vomiting, diarrhoea, muscle pain, unexplained bleeding), must complete health declaration forms, and provide detailed travel histories, especially if visited affected areas in the past 21 days. Anyone with symptoms or high-risk exposure will be isolated and referred to designated facilities for testing and management. Public guidance urged avoiding non-essential travel to DRC and Uganda, maintaining strict hygiene, and reporting suspicious illness. The move underscores regional concern over Ebola's high fatality rate and cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ボツワナ、エボラ流行懸念の中で国境スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国でのエボラアウトブレイク確認に基づく区域的な対応が報告されており、シグナルとして優先評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC及びウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク発生が記述されている。ボツワナは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRC（対象国203312）のみ。ウガンダ（226074）およびボツワナ（933860）も発生地域として提示されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、ボツワナは対象国リストに含まれないため、記事の主題となる実際のアウトブレイク発生地域はDRCのみ。なお、複数国での流行報告と国際的な防御措置の実施により、区域的な感染症危機管理上の重要度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: May 29: Airlines to cut 250 daily flights; Asaram surrenders after HC order; WHO backs experimental Ebola treatment tests
article.articleSummary: May 29, 2026: WHO backs testing of experimental Ebola treatments amid outbreaks in Congo and Uganda. The article notes the World Health Organization's recommendation to evaluate experimental therapies as Ebola outbreaks are reported in Congo and Uganda. It does not provide case or death counts. The summary highlights the disease name Ebola and locations Congo and Uganda, with a focus on the treatment-testing stance and the ongoing outbreak context. No laboratory confirmation details or infection sources are given in the article. The report situates this guidance within a daily news roundup; no specific imported or exported case details are provided. Overall, the key takeaway is WHO endorsement of testing experimental Ebola treatments in response to the outbreaks in Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 5月29日：航空会社が1日250便を削減；アサラムが高裁命令後に投降；WHO、エボラ出血熱の実験的治療テストを支持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、複数国での同時流行はシグナルとして認識すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでCongoとUgandaでのエボラ流行が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていない。WHO（世界保健機関）が実験的治療のテストを支持しており、国際的な公衆衛生対応が進行中。航空便削減は国際的な渡航・貿易影響の証拠。

article.articleHeadline: Mudavadi to lead Kenya's Ebola preparedness efforts
article.articleSummary: Kenya steps up Ebola preparedness as President William Ruto chairs the national response; a National Response Committee led by Prime Cabinet Secretary Musalia Mudavadi will coordinate whole-of-government and society efforts to strengthen awareness, preparedness, and mobilize technical and financial resources to contain the Ebola Virus Disease. Surveillance and screening at 26 Points of Entry have intensified, with over 58,000 travellers screened and all suspected cases tested so far returning negative. Seventeen isolation centres have been identified nationwide. Kenya’s interventions encompass enhanced surveillance, laboratory testing, border health services, case management, logistics, and public awareness. The renewed drive follows WHO’s Public Health Emergency of International Concern declaration for Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Africa CDC’s designation of it as a continental public health event. As of 29 May 2026, cross-border transmission remains the focus of regional health security coordination.

triage.headline_ja: ムダバディがケニアのエボラ準備態勢を主導
triage.triage_reason: ケニアは準備態勢強化を進めており、UgandaとDRCでのWHO PHEIC宣言があるが、ケニア国内での確定患者報告はなく、現時点では予防的対応段階。情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアの準備態勢強化を扱っており、UgandaとDRCでのエボラ患者発生が背景にあるが、サマリーではケニア国内の確定患者報告はない。対象国リストにケニアは含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列。UgandaもDRCも対象国リストに含まれていない（DRCはGeoNames ID 203312で発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではケニアが主題）。

article.articleHeadline: SA's Ebola risk low despite spiralling outbreak in DRC, Uganda - NICD
article.articleSummary: South Africa’s Ebola risk remains low despite spiralling outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, according to NICD on 2026-05-29. Appropriate infection prevention measures and supportive treatment plans are available for those at risk or infected. Containment hinges on community education and culturally sensitive communication to halt transmission. While there is always a risk of importing cases from travellers, the current risk to South Africa is low, and no cases were imported into SA during previous outbreaks; if an importation occurs, a widespread outbreak is unlikely. Ebola virus transmission does not occur via air or casual contact; it requires close contact with the bodily fluids of a sick person, a transmission dynamic distinct from Covid-19.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカのエボラ出血熱リスクは低い、DRCとウガンダでの急増する流行にもかかわらず - NICD
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国でのエボラ出血熱流行という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の「spiralling outbreak（急増する流行）」を述べており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれず、かつ記事の主題はDRC/ウガンダの流行であるため除外。複数疾患（COVID-19とEbola）が記載されているが、記事の主題はEbola。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن ترفض إعادة مواطنيها المعرضين لإيبولا وتقرر حجرهم في كينيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington refuses to repatriate its citizens exposed to Ebola and decides to quarantine them in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: May 29, 2026 – The United States will establish a quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Nanyuki, Kenya, to receive American citizens exposed to Ebola who are asymptomatic. Under the new policy, individuals showing Ebola symptoms will not be repatriated to the United States but evacuated to a third country for treatment, a significant shift from the approach used during the 2014 Ebola outbreak. The U.S. State Department also announced a $13.5 million funding package to Kenya to bolster its Ebola response. Public health officials cautioned that treating patients in specialized infectious disease centers in the United States or Germany may be safer and more efficient than the Kenyan facility. In parallel, the CDC imposed travel restrictions on travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan and tightened screening at three U.S. airports.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントンはエボラウイルスに曝露したアメリカ市民の本国送還を拒否し、ケニアでの隔離を決定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確定例または疑い例に関連する国際的な対応（隔離施設設置、渡航制限）が報告されており、複数国での影響と国際的な波及リスクが示唆されている。IHR基準で「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航制限」が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケニアでの隔離施設設置と米国の渡航制限に焦点を当てているが、エボラウイルスの発生地域としてDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンが言及されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみ記載。ケニアは対象国外、米国も対象国外であるため除外。本件はフルRRAに進む必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 防伊波拉 6/2起90天內禁剛果及烏干達入境 4類人除外
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Prevention: 90-Day Entry Ban on the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda Starting June 2, Exemptions for Four Categories
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks continue in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. DRC reports 125 confirmed and 906 suspected cases, with 17 confirmed deaths and 223 suspected deaths; Uganda reports 7 confirmed cases and 1 death (as of May 27). In response, Taiwan will suspend entry of residents from the DRC and Uganda for 90 days starting June 2, with exemptions for four categories: degree-seeking students with admission, diplomats, Taiwanese citizens’ non‑national spouses and their minor children, and urgent or humanitarian cases (e.g., funerals or visiting seriously ill relatives). Border controls are intensified; starting May 27, onboard announcements will be made on all international flights, and arrivals with recent DRC/Uganda travel must report to quarantine stations, undergo TOCC screening and health assessment, with immediate medical referral for suspected cases. Asymptomatic travelers receive a 21‑day self-health management notice and daily temperature checks; penalties apply for non-compliance. Level 3 Warning issued; measures may be adjusted as needed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ予防：6月2日からコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダからの入境を90日間禁止、4つのカテゴリーは除外
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な多数死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率で国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ発生は DRC とウガンダで報告されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。台湾の入境制限措置は対象国外の行動。DRC での継続的なエボラ流行（125確認例、906疑似例）と死亡例（17確認死、223疑似死）により、深刻な国際的脅威として評価される。レベル3警告の発令により政府対応も確認。

article.articleHeadline: Aid agency: Every fourth Ebola death in Congo is a child
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo — Save the Children reports that in the current Ebola wave, 4 of 17 confirmed Ebola deaths are children (about one-quarter), with the true child toll likely higher among more than 240 suspected Ebola deaths. Infections are hardest-hit in the Ituri region, where limited laboratory capacity delays confirmation. Babou Rukengeza, head of Save the Children's Ebola emergency response in Congo, says this is the fastest-spreading outbreak he has seen. Diminishing aid funding is worsening outcomes amid poverty, armed conflict, and malnutrition; malaria deaths are rising as well. Fear of seeking care is keeping people away from health centers, complicating obstetric services during the outbreak. UN Women has noted that women and girls tend to be disproportionately affected in past Ebola outbreaks, a pattern relevant to current dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: 支援機関：コンゴでのエボラ死亡者の4人に1人は子ども
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。対象国DRCでの確認死亡・疑い症例の増加が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月29日配信で、DRCのKinshasa市およびIturi地域でのエボラアウトブレイクを報告。確認死亡4例（17例中）、疑い症例240例以上、感染者の急速な増加が報告されている。子ども（4人に1人）、女性・女児の被害が多く、援助資金不足、紛争、栄養不良、マラリア増加など複合的リスク要因が存在。実験室能力不足による検査遅延も懸念。国際的な支援ニーズが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Approves U.S Ebola Quarantine Facility In Laikipia Amid Regional Outbreak Fears
article.articleSummary: Kenya approves a U.S.-backed Ebola quarantine and treatment facility in Laikipia County as regional outbreak fears rise in Central and East Africa. The project, funded at about Ksh1.74 billion, aims to bolster Kenya’s preparedness as Ebola spreads from the Democratic Republic of Congo toward Uganda. Plans call for a site at a Kenyan air force base housing a 50-bed field hospital, expandable to 250 beds, with U.S. Public Health Service staff supervising; teams are training at Joint Base Andrews before deployment. Operation is expected within one week. The move follows May 28 talks between U.S. Secretary of State Rubio and Kenyan President Ruto. The facility is intended to provide rapid access to care for Americans and personnel in Ebola-affected regions; Kenya had sought universal access, sparking legal and sovereignty concerns about access for Kenyan citizens and broader public safety guarantees.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、地域的なエボラ流行の懸念の中、ライキピアに米国支援のエボラ隔離施設を承認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の地域的流行（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）、国際的な拡大リスク、米国を含む国際支援の動員、国境を越えた感染拡大の懸念が複数の基準に該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な焦点はケニアでの施設承認ですが、ケニア（target country list非該当）を除外し、実際の感染流行発生地（DRC）のみをverified_locationsに含める。ウガンダも地域的流行の経路として言及されているが、記事サマリーではDRCからの拡大として記述されており、既存エボラ流行地はDRCが主要。ケニアは施設建設国として機能しているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF šalje pomoć zbog novog izbijanja ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF sends aid amid new Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF has dispatched emergency medical and protective supplies to the Democratic Republic of Congo in response to a new Ebola outbreak. The shipment, reported via Anadolu Agency, aims to bolster health authorities and field partners to curb the virus, which has caused past devastating epidemics. The package includes protective suits, gloves, masks, disinfectants, medical equipment, infection-control supplies, and materials to support health facilities and field teams. Supplies will be distributed to affected areas to strengthen early detection, patient care, and protection of health workers. A focal point of UNICEF's response is safeguarding children and their families, acknowledging that Ebola outbreaks trigger severe social consequences such as school disruptions, loss of caregivers, and heightened risk for vulnerable communities. Alongside medical assistance, UNICEF is conducting risk communication, prevention education, and community support initiatives.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEF、新型エボラアウトブレイクを受けて支援物資を送付
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラは極めて致死率が高く公衆衛生影響は深刻、DRCでの新規アウトブレイクは予想外、国際的拡大リスク高く、渡航・貿易制限のリスクあり。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは最高レベルの危機病原体。DRCでの新規アウトブレイク報告は極めて深刻で、UNICEFの緊急支援派遣により国際的関心も高い。過去の流行の経験から、地域内および周辺国への拡大可能性は高い。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, allarme OMS: Tedros a Kinshasa chiede più fondi e sostegno internazionale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, WHO alarm: Tedros in Kinshasa calls for more funds and international support.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers WHO alarm as Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives in Kinshasa to coordinate response. The World Health Organization declares an international health alert (PHEIC-like) amid more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 246 deaths. The outbreak is centred in Ituri province, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border transmission into Uganda. International funding is severely insufficient, with only about one third of requested funds raised. Tedros urged increased political and logistical support, protection for health workers, and rapid, transparent case reporting. The agency cautions that travel restrictions or punitive measures could deter timely reporting, hindering global containment. The appeal emphasizes scalable staffing, supplies, and international coordination to halt transmission in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱、WHO警告：テドロス事務局長キンシャサで更なる資金と国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響1,000以上の疑い患者・246死亡、異常事象、複数国への国際的拡大リスク・ウガンダへの越境感染、国際的な対応と資金支援が必要）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべて該当し、PHEIC相当の国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境感染言及あるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。DRC本体での深刻なエボラ流行がメイン主題のため、DRCのみverified_locationsに含める。PHEIC相当の公式警告、複数州での拡大（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）、資金不足（要求の3分の1のみ調達）が特徴。フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ente regional evaluará brote de ébola y respuesta en Cuerno de África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional body will evaluate the Ebola outbreak and the response in the Horn of Africa
article.articleSummary: IGAD's executive secretary Workneh Gebeyehu called an extraordinary virtual meeting of health ministers to assess the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and to review regional preparedness for pandemics in the Horn of Africa. The gathering, part of the Pandemic Preparedness and Response Project, aims to coordinate cross-border health security, improve planning, and strengthen collective action against transboundary threats. As of May 29, 2026, the DRC outbreak declared on May 15 has surpassed 1,000 suspected cases and more than 220 probable deaths. In response, Uganda has closed its borders with the DRC to curb spread, with seven cases identified inside Uganda. Protocols require anyone returning from Kinshasa to Uganda to undergo a mandatory 21-day self-isolation, under the health ministry and district surveillance teams, among other measures.

triage.headline_ja: 地域機関がアフリカの角におけるエボラ出血熱の流行と対応を評価する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限措置発動）。DRC発生地域では1,000件以上の疑い例と220人以上の死亡を報告、ウガンダでも7例確認され、国境閉鎖措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（GeoNames ID: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。記事主題は DRC でのエボラ流行及びその地域的影響。2026年5月15日に宣言された DRC の流行が5月29日時点で1,000件以上の疑い例と220人以上の死亡を記録。ウガンダでも7例確認され、国境閉鎖措置と21日間の自主隔離プロトコルが実施されている。IGAD による地域的な緊急対応会合が開催され、国境を越えた保健安全保障の協調が進められている。

article.articleHeadline: China Peringatkan Warganya untuk Menghindari Perjalanan Tidak Penting ke Kongo karena Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Warns Its Citizens to Avoid Nonessential Travel to the Congo Due to the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, China warns its citizens against nonessential travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to an Ebola outbreak. The DRC has reported about 1,000 suspected Ebola cases and more than 220 suspected deaths, according to the World Health Organization. Cumulative figures show 1,077 suspected cases, 121 confirmed, and 17 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Affected areas include Ituri Province and North Kivu. The WHO has raised the alert level to very high, with neighboring countries tightening cross-border travel to limit spread. The warning also advises avoiding contact with wildlife and with patients suspected of infection. Chinese nationals exhibiting fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or bleeding are urged to seek prompt medical care or contact a Chinese medical team for assistance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行によるコンゴへの不要不急な渡航回避勧告を中国が発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（1,077疑似患者、121確定患者、17死亡、WHO高危険度レベル上昇）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（隣国の国境規制強化）、渡航制限の4基準すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高致死性で国際的懸念事項であり、フルRRA進行の必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はDRCでのエボラ出血熱流行とそれに対する中国の渡航警告。DRCが実際の流行国、Chinaは警告国として両者とも検証対象に該当。WHOが危険度レベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げており、隣国での国境規制強化も報告されている。5月15日に流行宣言されたばかりで進行中の状況。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Sebut Konflik dan Krisis Pangan Hambat Penanganan Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says conflict and food crises hinder Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo lineage Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) intensifies, with Bunia in Ituri Province a focal point and multiple eastern provinces affected. More than 1,000 suspected cases and 238 deaths have been reported; laboratory confirmation identifies Bundibugyo Ebola virus. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa and plans to visit Bunia as field teams are deployed to the city. Ongoing conflict, displacement, and distrust of health authorities hinder outbreak control, aid delivery, and patient care. WHO does not endorse travel bans, warning they delay spread without addressing the source. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, with Africa CDC also declaring an Africa‑wide health‑security emergency.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが民主コンゴのエボラ対応を阻害する紛争と食糧危機を指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの確認された感染症アウトブレイク（238死亡、1,000以上の疑似患者）で、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言し、アフリカCDCも大陸規模の衛生安全保障緊急事態を宣言した。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統のエボラウイルスが確認され、DRC東部の複数州に影響。WHOの事務局長が現地訪問計画中。紛争と避難民の存在により対応が困難化している。PHEI宣言済みの高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Sonko limogé au Sénégal, flambée d'Ebola en RD Congo, Wadagni investi au Bénin : l'hebdo Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sonko dismissed in Senegal, Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, Wadagni appointed in Benin: Africa Weekly
article.articleSummary: Senegalese politics: President Diomaye Faye dismissed Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko; four days later Sonko was elected president of the National Assembly with Pastef's majority, in a move opponents call a constitutional coup. In Benin, Romuald Wadagni was sworn in as head of state on May 24, with a high-profile ceremony attended by domestic figures and foreign delegations, including AES members. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak declared May 15 has surpassed 1,000 suspected cases and 240 suspected deaths by May 28; the Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or treatment, underscoring rapid detection and barrier measures per Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya. Uganda closed its border with DRC on May 27 amid the outbreak's escalation.

triage.headline_ja: セネガルのソンコ解任、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、ベナンのワダグニ就任：アフリカウィークリー
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行事例であり、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高い社会政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはベナン、ウガンダ、セネガルも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行である。ウガンダは国境閉鎖措置をとっているが、記事には実際の感染事例報告がないため含めない。ベナンとセネガルは記事の別テーマ（政治）に関連するもので、感染症イベント発生地ではない。ワクチンおよび治療法が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行、短期間での急速な患者数増加（1000症例超、240死亡）、および地域的な対応能力の懸念が重大性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sumsel catat 809 kasus positif campak hingga Mei 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sumatra Health Office records 809 confirmed measles cases as of May 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 26 May 2026, South Sumatra has recorded 809 confirmed measles cases from 2,882 suspected since January. Palembang city accounts for 442 positives from 1,495 suspects, followed by Prabumulih (57/195), Musi Rawas (54/140), Muara Enim (39) and Ogan Ilir (39). Musi Rawas Utara (34/67), Musi Banyuasin (33/100), Lubuklinggau (31/74), and Banyuasin (29/222) also reported cases; Pagar Alam, OKU Timur, and OKU Selatan reported zero. Dinkes Sumsel notes a decline in measles cases compared with the previous quarter, crediting health workers, posyandu cadres, and community engagement. The department continues MR (Measles-Rubella) immunization for nine-month-olds and offers free catch-up vaccines at health facilities. Citizens are urged to vaccinate children, seek care for fever, red rash, cough, runny nose, or red eyes, practice clean habits, and isolate sick children to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラ保健局が2026年5月までの麻疹確定患者809例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹とルベオラの混合感染イベントで複数県にまたがる流行が確認されているが、当局が患者数の減少傾向を報告しており、国際的な拡大リスクや重篤度に関する情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 南スマトラ州内で複数地域（パレンバン、プラブムリ、ムシ・ラワス、ルブクリンガウ他）における麻疹流行が確認。当局は患者数減少傾向を報告し、予防接種キャンペーンを継続中。死亡率や重症度に関する記載なし。ルベオラとの混合感染でありながら記事では麻疹の記載が主体。

article.articleHeadline: Health: Lab results for Kumi suspected Ebola case expected o
article.articleSummary: A suspected Ebola case in Uganda's eastern Kumi district: a Nyero sub-county resident who works in Mukura (Ngora district) and lives in Kanyum was admitted to Atutur Hospital and placed in isolation; samples have been sent to the Uganda Virus Research Institute (UVRI) for testing, with results expected on Monday next week. Ebola is a viral disease transmitted from infected wildlife to humans and between people. Health authorities have heightened vigilance, implementing entry-point screening and using temperature guns; contacts are being followed, and communities are urged to report unexplained fever or bleeding and to practice hand hygiene and avoid contact with blood or body fluids. Uganda has seven Ebola cases since the latest outbreak in neighboring DR Congo, prompting a temporary border closure with DRC, with exceptions for response teams, humanitarian aid, and food/cargo under strict health screening. The national Ebola task force, chaired by Vice-President Jessica Alupo, directs SOP enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: クミ地区の疑似エボラ症例に関する検査結果が予想される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑似症例がウガンダで報告され、IHR基準3つ（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。同地域でのDRCとの国境対策強化や高級官僚による対応体制確立により、すでに社会的・政治的関心が顕著。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの疑似症例報告であるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。一方、記事で明示的に言及されている隣接国DRCは対象国であり、DRCとのウガンダ国境での対策強化が述べられているため DRC を含める。サマリーにはミャンマーへの言及がないため、本来は DRC のみが適切だが、地域フィルタリングの確認が必要。実際には、このイベントは DRC 由来のアウトブレイクがウガンダに拡大した事例であり、DRC が verified_locations に含まれるべき。

article.articleHeadline: محكمة في كينيا تجمد مؤقتا اتفاقا مع أمريكا بشأن إقامة منشآة حجر صحي خاصة بفيروس إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Kenyan court temporarily suspends an agreement with the United States regarding the establishment of an Ebola quarantine facility.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, a Kenyan High Court temporarily barred the government from approving a U.S. deal to establish an Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya. The injunction blocks admission, transfer, or entry of people exposed to or infected with Ebola. Arguments are set for June 2. The Katiba Institute argues the project lacks transparency and constitutional credibility. The U.S. State Department announced plans to allocate $13.5 million to Kenya's Ebola preparedness, and after a call between U.S. Secretary of State Mark Rubio and Kenyan President William Ruto, Washington pledged $112 million in regional bilateral assistance to address the virus. Over 200 people have died of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Uganda previously closed its borders with DRC to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所が米国とのエボラウイルス検疫施設設置合意を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク、DRCでの死亡事例、地域での国境封鎖措置など複数のIHR基準に該当し、国際的な関心と対応が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの検疫施設設置の法的問題を扱っているが、実際のエボラウイルス発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダも国境封鎖措置を実施している。ケニアはDRCに隣接し地域への拡大リスクがあるが、記事サマリーではケニアでの実際の患者発生は記述されていないため verified_locations に含めない。米国は医療技術・資金援助の主体だが発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Inter/ L'OMS identifie des traitements et vaccins candidats contre la souche Bundibugyo (Ebola) en RDC et en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ Inter/ The WHO identifies candidate treatments and vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain (Ebola) in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization announced candidate treatments and vaccines against Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain, currently reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. No vaccines or therapies are yet approved. The DRC has 121 confirmed Ebola cases and 17 confirmed deaths, with more than 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths across three provinces and thirteen health zones. Experts urge that identified products be used only within clinical trials to ensure safety, ethics, and effectiveness. Prioritized treatments include monoclonal antibodies MBP134 and Maftivimab®, and the antiviral remdesivir; the oral antiviral obeldesivir is being considered for post-exposure prophylaxis. The vaccine candidate rVSV Bundibugyo, developed by IAVI, is viewed as the most promising. In the interim, classic Ebola response measures should be maintained while awaiting clinical trial results.

triage.headline_ja: コートジボワール-AIP/国際: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで報告されているブンディブギョ株（エボラ）に対する治療法とワクチン候補を特定
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定患者121名、確定死亡17名を伴う現在進行中の流行、及び1,000件を超える疑い患者が報告されている。IHR基準（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）の複数該当、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行のしやすさ）の複数該当により、フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確定患者121名、死亡17名、疑い患者1,077名以上がコンゴ民主共和国で報告されていることが明記されている。ウガンダも言及されているが、サマリーではDRCの病例数の詳細しか記載されていない。発生地域にコートジボワールが含まれているが、サマリーではコートジボワールでの発生は記載されておらず、この記事はWHOの声明発表地点の報道であるため、実際の発生地の対象国はDRCのみとする。ブンディブギョ株エボラは予防接種対象ウイルスの中でも致命率の高い株であり、治療法・ワクチン候補の特定発表は国際的な医学的関心を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Streit um Ebola-Quarantänezentrum für US-Bürger in Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dispute over Ebola quarantine center for US citizens in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court in Nairobi blocked the establishment of a US-linked Ebola quarantine and treatment center, ruling against creating facilities to manage Ebola under any agreement with the United States or foreign government. The order bars relocation or entry of people exposed or infected with Ebola under the contested agreement until Kenya responds to Katiba Institute by June 2. Reports say the US plans to quarantine potentially exposed Americans in Kenya, though Nairobi has not decided; Kenya's Health Ministry says discussions with the US and international partners are ongoing. Africa CDC lists 1,077 suspected Ebola cases and 246 deaths; WHO cites 223 suspected Ebola deaths, 10 confirmed. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Uganda affected; Kenya has had no cases. WHO and Tedros oppose travel bans; the US has imposed entry restrictions on travelers from affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアにおける米国市民向けエボラ隔離センターをめぐる紛争
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な感染拡大リスク、複数国への波及の可能性、国際的な政治的論争が生じており、IHR基準及びWPRO基準を複数満たす。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な対応調整の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはナイロビ（ケニア）、ウガンダ、米国などが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは確認症例は DRC（Ituri地域）に限定されており、ケニアとウガンダは影響を受けた国リストに記載されているものの、verified_locationsは実際の感染症発生国のみに限定。隔離施設設置をめぐる国際的政治的紛争が主要な焦点であり、感染拡大防止における国家間の意見対立が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : un premier cas positif d'Ebola confirmé dans la zone de santé de Kalunguta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: first laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in the Kalunguta health zone.
article.articleSummary: First laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in Kalunguta health zone, Beni territory, North Kivu, DRC, reported May 25 and announced May 28. Samples confirmed positive by INRB. The patient, from Mungbwalu in Ituri province, was first hospitalized in Kabasha before dying. A second related case was identified in Oicha (Ituri-adjacent) after four samples tested at INRB, with one positive. Public health actions include contact tracing and community outreach, with emphasis on handwashing, masking, avoiding physical contact, and prompt medical care. As of May 29, 2026, Kalunguta is part of the Bundibugyo variant outbreak with no vaccine available; national totals show at least 1,000 symptomatic cases, 101 confirmed, 17 deaths, while North Kivu reports 11 confirmed, 7 deaths. Authorities closed pools, suspended sports, and tightened corpse-handling procedures to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：カルングタ保健区でエボラの最初の陽性確認事例が報告された
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認事例報告は最高優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo variant）の実験室確認事例。発生地はDRC北東部（North Kivu、Ituri州）。既存の流行の継続と見られ、国内統計では101確認例、17死亡。ワクチン入手不可という対応上の課題あり。国家レベルの積極的な対策実施中（接触者追跡、感染管理対策）。最高優先度で対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Les voyageurs appelés à une observation stricte des mesures de prévention contre la maladie à virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travelers Urged to Strictly Observe Preventive Measures Against Ebola Virus Disease.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda on 15 May 2026, attributed to the Bundibugyo strain. The WHO has classified the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Burundi's Ministry of Public Health, on 27 May, issued travel-prevention measures at all entry points, effective 28 May 2026. Travelers from, or transiting through, DRC or Uganda must complete a traveler surveillance form on arrival at Melchior Ndadaye International Airport. Entry points will conduct health screening including temperature checks. Anyone presenting EVD symptoms will be managed according to national SOPs. Travelers should report suspicious signs to the nearest health facility or call the toll-free number 117. All travelers and transport operators must follow infection prevention and control measures; any transport used by a sick or suspected individual will be decontaminated. Measures are subject to revision.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病に対する予防措置の厳格な遵守が旅行者に呼びかけられている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、エボラウイルス病の多国間流行（DRC・ウガンダ・ブルンジ）が確認された。WHO PHEIC宣言済みであり、フルRRA対象のシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の流行が5月15日に宣言されたと記事に明記。ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO PHEIC指定済みであり、複数国への拡大リスク高。ブルンジの検疫強化措置は流行国の近接性と国際的な懸念を示している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in Congo to address rare Ebola outbreak amid distrust and insecurity
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Congo's Ituri province, near the Ugandan border, with 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths reported as of Tuesday. The rare Ebola strain has no approved treatment or vaccine; health workers operate with scant supplies, sometimes wearing expired masks. Community distrust, strict burial protocols, and armed groups fueling insecurity have led to attacks on health centers. The outbreak has extended into North Kivu and South Kivu, where the Rwanda-backed M23 rebels claim control of Goma and Bukavu, and the group reports two cases. Goma's main airport has been closed since January 2025 after M23 seized the city; Ituri faces displacement of millions amid conflict, food insecurity, and attacks by the Allied Democratic Force. WHO DG Tedros visited Kinshasa, securing EU and US aid totaling over $112 million, while urging against travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴを訪問、不信と不安定性の中でまれなエボラ発生に対処
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たす。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,077疑い症例、238死亡）、予想外の稀なBundibugyo株、複数国への国際拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ルワンダ）、国際的な渡航制限と支援要請がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ、ルワンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは両国での患者発生は明示されていない。DRC内での多州への拡大（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）が確認されており、隣接国への拡大リスクが高い。武装勢力による不安定性と医療システムの脆弱性が対応を阻害している。WHO DGの現地訪問と国際支援の動員は事態の深刻性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情擴大！台灣祭入境禁令 6月2日起剛果和烏干達居民暫停來台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak widens! Taiwan imposes entry ban; from June 2, Congo and Uganda residents are temporarily barred from entering Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in Africa continue, prompting Taiwan to impose its first border controls since lifting restrictions. From June 2, Taiwan will suspend entry for residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda for 90 days, with exemptions for degree-seeking students, diplomatic/official personnel, Taiwanese nationals’ foreign spouses and minor children, and humanitarian or emergency cases. Visa issuance and entry for others will be paused. Travelers who visited Ebola-affected areas within 21 days prior to arrival, or holders of valid residence permits, must complete 21 days of home health management after arrival and report daily. Since May 27, international flights must broadcast reminders for travelers who visited DRC or Uganda to undergo TOCC assessment and health checks at airport quarantine stations. Symptomatic travelers will be hospitalized; asymptomatic travelers must self-monitor for 21 days and use the public self-report system, calling 1922 if symptoms occur. The outbreak centers in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu (DRC) and in Uganda: DRC 906 cases, 223 deaths; 125 lab-confirmed cases, 17 deaths; Uganda 7 confirmed, 1 death. WHO notes continued spread; travel advisory raised to Level 3.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行拡大！台湾が入境禁令を発令 6月2日からコンゴとウガンダの住民の入台を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な流行であり、DRCでは906例・223死亡、ウガンダでは7例・1死亡が報告されており、複数国間での伝播リスク、国際的な渡航制限措置がすでに実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にTaiwanが含まれているが、記事サマリーではTaiwanは台湾側の対応策（入境禁令）が主題であり、エボラの実際の発生地はDRCとUgandaのみ。よってverified_locationsはDRCとUgandaのみに限定。WHOレベル3勧告、継続的な国際的伝播リスク、複数国での患者報告、国家レベルの渡航制限措置が実施されており、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola chủng Bundibugyo diễn biến phức tạp tại châu Phi, WHO cảnh báo nguy cơ lây lan xuyên biên giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola Strain Shows Complex Developments in Africa, WHO Warns of Cross-Border Spread Risk
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease is escalating in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with WHO declaring a PHEIC on May 17, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. By May 27, DRC reports 1,077 suspected cases with 238 deaths; 121 confirmed cases with 17 deaths. Uganda has 7 confirmed cases, 1 death. 128 confirmed cases and 18 deaths. In DRC, transmission is centered in 14 health zones across 3 provinces, with clusters in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Ituri, and Rwampara; contact tracing hampered by security and population movement. In Uganda, several confirmed cases are imported from Congo to Kampala via travel and contact during medical care. WHO assesses very high risk in DRC and high regional risk; global risk is low. Vietnam’s Health Ministry assesses import risk as low, but has strengthened surveillance, testing, border screening, training, and public guidance, advising vigilance and prompt care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ株がアフリカで複雑な経過を示す、WHO国境越え感染リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大、国境越え感染リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。WHOがPHEIC宣言、複数国での確定症例と死亡例を報告。
triage.notes: ベトナムは発生地域に含まれているがサマリーでは監視強化の言及のみで実際の発生地ではない。DRCとウガンダのみ確認。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、確定症例128例、死亡例18例報告。ワクチン・治療薬なし。

article.articleHeadline: Đã có hơn 1.000 ca nghi mắc Ebola tại Công gô, Bộ Y tế tiếp tục khuyến cáo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There have been more than 1,000 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ministry of Health continues to advise.
article.articleSummary: As of 27 May, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases with 238 suspected deaths and 121 confirmed cases with 17 deaths; Uganda reports 7 confirmed cases, including 1 death. Across both countries, 128 confirmed cases and 18 deaths have been recorded, with investigations ongoing. In DRC, the outbreak spans 14 health zones in three provinces, mainly Ituri, and contact tracing is hampered by security, population movement, mining areas, and border dynamics. In Uganda, confirmed cases are imported from DRC to Kampala, with some linked to travel and close contact during transport or healthcare. WHO assesses the risk in DRC as very high and regional risk, including Uganda, as high due to transmission; global risk remains low. Vietnam is evaluating importation risk and has no cases; the public is advised to seek medical advice if symptoms arise after exposure and to limit nonessential travel to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの疑い例が1,000件を超え、保健省が引き続き注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認事例と死亡が報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。公開衛生への重大な影響、異常事象、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでは128確認例17死亡、ウガンダで7確認例1死亡が報告されている。ベトナムは輸入リスク評価中で患者なし。WHOはDRC内のリスク評価を『非常に高い』と判定。セキュリティ課題による接触者追跡の困難さが言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC reports suspected Ebola cases surpassing 1,000 in latest outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Africa CDC reports suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda surpassing 1,000, with 1,077 suspected cases and 246 probable deaths since the DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15. Laboratory confirmation stands at 129 cases in the DRC and eight in Uganda, linked to imported cases from the DRC. Eleven other African countries are at high risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Zambia, Central African Republic, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Angola, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, and Somalia. The agency warns cases are expected to rise during the active outbreak. Major operational challenges include gaps in surveillance and contact tracing, limited laboratory capacity, and no approved vaccines or therapeutics for the Bundibugyo strain. A four-week detection gap of silent transmission before confirmation and limited funding further hinder containment. Ebola symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, malaise, and, in severe cases, bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが最新の流行でエボラ疑い例が1,000例を超えたと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（246例の可能性のある死亡）を有し、異常/予想外の事象（DRC第17回流行）であり、11カ国への地域的拡大リスク及び国際的制限のリスクを伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき検証。DRCが主要な流行中心地（1,077疑い例、129確認例）であり、Ugandaでの確認例も記載されているが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていない。高リスク国リスト（South Sudan、Rwanda、Kenya等）は記載されているが、サマリーではこれらが既に感染の舞台となっているか、あるいは単に「高リスク」として警告されているかは不明確。確実に流行が発生している対象国はDRCとZambiaのみ。ワクチン・治療薬の不在、サーベイランス体制の問題により管理可能性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Италия настоява за по-строг граничен контрол в ЕС заради огнището на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy calls for stricter border controls in the EU due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts Italy to push for stricter European Union border controls. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged including border management in the EU’s June 18-19 European Council agenda, seeking coordinated surveillance rules for direct and indirect arrivals from the affected areas while respecting national health sovereignty. A video conference of health ministers is requested for next week. As of May 24, the World Health Organization reports 10 confirmed and 223 probable deaths among more than 1,000 confirmed or probable Ebola infections in DRC since the outbreak began on May 15; in Uganda, one confirmed death and six additional cases. Italy has implemented targeted health monitoring protocols for travelers from the two countries. A team from Rome’s Spallanzani Hospital will travel to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance and deliver medicines and supplies.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、エボラ感染拡大を理由にEUの国境管理強化を要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク、複数国への波及、WHOの死亡報告（233人超）があり、IHR基準の2つ以上を満たす。国際的な公衆衛生対応が必要とされる段階。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはイタリアとウガンダを発生地域として含めているが、記事サマリーの主題は**DRC（対象国）とウガンダでのエボラ感染拡大**である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。イタリアの報告は対応国としての言及であり、発生地ではない。2026年5月時点での未来記事と思われるが、架空シナリオとして評価。DRCでの1,000件以上の確認・疑い患者と233人の死亡報告により重症度基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Le Gouvernement rassure et appelle à lutter contre les rumeurs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola — The Government reassures and calls on people to fight rumors.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak persists in Ituri, Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. Government assurances come as Health Minister Roger Samuel Kamba, in Bunia on May 28, stated that all identified patients are being cared for, with 906 suspected cases and about 223 suspected deaths, and 105 patients in treatment centers. Authorities warn against social media rumors and emphasize adherence to preventive measures to prevent panic and disruption of care. The response is supported by national and international partners, aiming to rapidly contain the outbreak and prevent further spread. The situation unfolds in a fragile security and humanitarian context, highlighting the need for public vigilance and cooperation with health teams.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ - 政府は国民を安心させ、デマとの闘いを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の継続的な流行が複数州で確認され、WPRO基準も複数該当。即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ病確認患者906件（疑い）、死亡223件（疑い）、治療中105名。イツリ州、北キヴ州、南キヴ州の複数地域で流行継続中。政府が国民を安心させるステートメントを発表しているが、脆弱な治安状況と人道危機の中での対応継続。国・国際パートナーによる支援が進行中との記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Medicul italian care a intrat în contact cu un pacient cu Ebola a fost internat la Roma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Italian doctor who came into contact with an Ebola patient was admitted to hospital in Rome.
article.articleSummary: An Italian doctor, a woman working with Doctors Without Borders (MSF), who had direct contact with an Ebola patient in the Democratic Republic of Congo, was admitted overnight to Rome’s Lazzaro Spallanzani Infectious Diseases Hospital after returning to Italy. She remains asymptomatic but will be observed until June 8. The Health Ministry said she had direct contact on May 16 with patients later tested for Ebola at Salamat health center in Bunia, and on May 18 she performed a surgical operation to save a child injured by a grenade explosion, who is now a suspected Ebola case. The ministry emphasizes there are currently no Ebola cases in Italy and that the population risk is low. The event highlights import-risk from the DRC outbreak, with no confirmed domestic transmission reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者と接触したイタリア人医師がローマの病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な輸入リスク事例であり、IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク（基準3）と渡航・貿易制限リスク（基準4）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性が該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC（ブニア）でのエボラ患者への接触とその後のイタリアへの輸入リスク事例である。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。DRCでの継続的な流行リスク、及び医療従事者の国際的な移動によるウイルス輸入が重要な懸念。現時点でイタリアでの二次感染は報告されていないが、監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Por qué el brote de ébola en el Congo no tiene solución rápida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the Ebola outbreak in Congo has no quick solution.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people, with transmission outpacing the response as of May 2026. Bundibugyo is a less common Ebola orthovirus; historical case fatality around 30–50%. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms are non-specific (fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, headaches), complicating detection. Transmission occurs via close contact with bodily fluids of patients or the deceased, placing healthcare workers at high risk. There are no therapies or vaccines specifically approved for Bundibugyo, but WHO prioritizes three therapies for trials: antibody treatments from Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron, and remdesivir. Prophylactic vaccines in development include rVSV Bundibugyo (single-dose) by IAVI (7–9 months to readiness for testing) and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/SII) potentially in 2–3 months for efficacy testing; more animal data needed. Meanwhile, standard Ebola controls—surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials—remain essential. Past Bundibugyo outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が迅速な解決策を持たない理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。コンゴでのブンディブギョエボラウイルスの流行は200人以上の死者を出しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な懸念、ワクチン・治療の不在がある。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラはまれな種で、30-50%の致命率を持つ。ワクチン・治療法がないため、対応が困難。ウガンダは過去に2007年の流行があるため注視の価値がある。記事サマリーから実際の流行はDRCが主体であることが明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolan pelätään leviävän pakolaisleireille Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola feared to spread to refugee camps in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak threatens refugee camps in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province, where about 61 camps shelter roughly 970,000 people. Camps offer conditions conducive to Ebola transmission due to close contact and bodily fluids, and generally poor hygiene heightens risk. Transmission occurs through contact with infected persons and their fluids, making densely crowded displacement sites high-risk. Since mid-May, authorities have confirmed 10 Ebola-related deaths and are monitoring more than 220 additional suspected deaths linked to the outbreak. The situation underscores the risk of wider spread within populations in displacement camps and the need for enhanced surveillance, infection control, and humanitarian response to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが民主共和国コンゴの難民キャンプに蔓延することが懸念されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4項目該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。難民キャンプという高リスク環境での感染拡大懸念により、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率の高い感染症であり、難民キャンプという過密環境での確認死亡者10名、疑い例220名以上の状況は重大。国際保健機関への通知と他国への情報共有の必要性あり。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、記事サマリーも主にDRC北東部イトゥリ州の難民キャンプでのイベントに焦点。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: surto de Ébola não tem solução rápida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola outbreak has no quick solution.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has potentially caused over 200 deaths; no specific treatments or vaccines approved for Bundibugyo. WHO convened experts to evaluate candidates; prioritize three therapies for trials: Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron antibody therapies, and remdesivir (Gilead). The Bundibugyo strain is rare, first identified 2007; incubation 2-21 days; transmission via close contact with bodily fluids; initial symptoms nonspecific (fever, fatigue, myalgia, headache, sore throat); case fatality historically 30-50% in Uganda/DRC outbreaks (2007, 2012). Several vaccines in development are promising; most advanced is rVSV Bundibugyo from IAVI, likely 7-9 months to enter clinical trial; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford/SII, potentially 2-3 months to enter efficacy testing; animal data needed. OMS priorities: halt transmission using established Ebola response tools: surveillance, testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに迅速な解決策はない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響200以上の死亡、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。致死率30-50%の希少なBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は2007年に初めて同定された希少なエボラウイルス株。記事サマリーではウガンダが過去アウトブレイクの参考例として記載されているが、現在のアウトブレイク発生地はDRCのみ。WHO専門家会議が開催され、複数の治療法・ワクチン候補が評価中。確立されたエボラ対応ツール（監視、検査、接触者追跡、隔離、感染予防、コミュニティ参画、安全な埋葬）による伝播阻止が優先課題。

article.articleHeadline: NEOČEKIVANA ODLUKA ZBOG VIRUSA EBOLE! Sud u Keniji stopirao plan koji je UZBURKAO javnost
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unexpected decision due to the Ebola virus! A court in Kenya halted the plan that had sparked public outcry.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court temporarily blocked the United States’ plan to establish quarantine facilities for people exposed to Ebola, delaying acceptance of exposed or infected individuals under the disputed agreement with the US until the case is resolved; the next hearing is scheduled for June 2. Concurrently, WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced deployment to the Democratic Republic of Congo amid a renewed Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri Province, involving Bundibugyo ebolavirus. According to WHO, more than 900 people have Ebola-like symptoms and over 220 deaths have occurred; the outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Uganda has reported seven Ebola cases and one death linked to the same outbreak in Ituri. Published May 29, 2026."} }{

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスによる予期しない判断！ケニアの裁判所が公衆の激怒を招いた計画を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当し、エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な拡大と対応困難性が明確である。DRCでの大規模流行（900以上の疑似患者、220以上の死亡例）とPHEIC宣言、複数国への波及を示唆している。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUSA、Uganda、Kenyaも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCにおけるエボラ新規流行の発表とそれに対するケニアの政策対応である。PHEIC宣言済み、WHO部長による直接展開の発表があり、隣接国ウガンダでの波及（7例、1死亡）が確認されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に列挙。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dottoressa italiana tornata dal Congo in quarantena allo Spallanzani di Roma per il rischio ebola: come sta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italian female doctor returning from Congo in quarantine at Rome's Spallanzani for Ebola risk: how is she?
article.articleSummary: An Italian Médecins Sans Frontières physician who treated patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in quarantine at Rome's Spallanzani Institute for Ebola risk. The clinician is asymptomatic and in good health; she arrived between May 28–29 and will be observed until June 8. The quarantine was required due to contact with people suspected of Ebola while working in Congo. Italy reports no Ebola cases to date; the Health Ministry maintains a rigorous surveillance system and will issue an ordinance and circular clarifying risk assessments for healthcare workers and regions. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote to EU leaders to strengthen border surveillance and coordinate arrivals from Ebola-affected zones, proposing European Council agenda items for June 18–19 and an expedited EPSCO process. Italy will send Spallanzani experts to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance, deliver supplies, and bolster surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから帰国したイタリア人医師がローマのスパランツァーニ研究所でエボラ熱隔離中：状態は？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の疑い事例であり、国際的な関心と政治的対応（EU調整、首相レベルの動き）が存在し、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当。DRC発生地域との関連性も確認される。
triage.notes: 患者は無症状であるが、エボラ熱の潜伏期間中の隔離観察中。DRCでの患者接触歴があり、実質的な疑い事例と判断される。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、実際の発生地はDRCとして評価。EU首脳への提案やイタリア首相による国境監視強化要求など、政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: What Long Islanders should know about the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in central and east Africa have killed at least 220 and infected about 1,000; the Bundibugyo virus drives the current cluster, with no licensed vaccines or treatments. Declared May 15, the outbreak is hampered by conflict zones, limited supplies, and local beliefs. Ebola is an orthoebolavirus first identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in 1976; the 2014-16 Guinea-Liberia-Sierra Leone epidemic killed more than 11,000. Symptoms include fever, aches, fatigue, diarrhea, vomiting and bleeding; transmission requires direct contact with blood or body fluids of a sick or recently dead person. There is currently no risk to Long Island. Starting Friday, Kennedy Airport will become the third U.S. airport to handle passengers from DRC, Uganda or South Sudan, the affected countries. Past U.S. importations in 2014 involved nine travelers, two deaths, two nurses infected, both recovered.

triage.headline_ja: ロングアイランド住民が知っておくべきエボラ流行について
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：220人死亡・1,000人感染；国際的拡大リスク：複数アフリカ諸国；渡航制限リスク：米国空港での対応開始）。WPRO基準も複数該当（異常性、重症度、感染性の高さ）。国際支援必要性ありの社会政治的関心あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンが影響を受けた国として明記されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない（記事では「affected countries」として言及されているが、verified_locationsには含めない）。米国での対応（ケネディ空港）は国内対応であり、発生地ではない。2026年5月時点での継続的なアフリカでの流行が記事の主題。

article.articleHeadline: WHO เร่งเครื่อง! เปิดรายชื่อยา-วัคซีนความหวังใหม่ของโลก สยบอีโบลาบุนดิบูเกียว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO steps on the gas! Unveils the list of drugs and vaccines—the world's new hope to quell Ebola Bundibugyo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization identifies three experimental drugs prioritized for the Ebola virus disease caused by the Bundibugyo strain and outlines several vaccine candidates, with no approved Bundibugyo-specific therapy yet. The drugs are MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), Maftivimab (Regeneron), and Remdesivir (Gilead Sciences). Maftivimab has been dispatched to the Democratic Republic of Congo for potential use pending WHO authorization, for frontline treatment or further research. Remdesivir is highlighted for post-exposure prophylaxis among contacts of confirmed cases, though its effectiveness depends on multiple factors. For vaccines, rVSV Bundibugyo (one-dose) from the International AIDS Vaccine Initiative could enter trials in about nine months; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford University and Serum Institute of India) may begin testing in roughly three months but requires animal data. Ervebo, Merck's Ebola vaccine, is under study but should not be used outside laboratories until more evidence specific to Bundibugy o is available.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が行動加速！エボラ・ブンディブギョ対策の新しい希望、医薬品とワクチンのリスト公開
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）に対する治療薬・ワクチン候補の識別は医学的に重要だが、記事の主な内容は臨床開発段階の紹介であり、進行中の感染症流行の詳細情報（患者数、死亡数、地域的な拡大状況）が不明。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ・ブンディブギョ株に対する新規医薬品・ワクチン候補の WHO による識別と、DRC への Maftivimab 派遣について述べている。ただし現在の流行状況（患者数、重症度、地域的拡大）に関する具体的情報が不足している。治療法開発の進展は肯定的だが、シグナルトリアージの段階では実際の流行動向の詳細情報が必要なため WATCH 判定とした。インドはワクチン開発パートナー（血清研究所）として言及されるのみで、発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : le Gouvernement rassure et appelle à lutter contre les rumeurs | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: The Government reassures and urges people to combat rumors | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu) with 906 suspected cases and about 223 suspected deaths; 105 patients are currently in treatment at treatment centers. Government reaffirmed commitment to care for all Ebola patients in affected zones, during a May 28 press briefing in Bunia, Ituri, led by Public Health Minister Roger Kamba, with Communications Minister Patrick Muyaya and Ituri Governor Luboya Nkashama. Authorities warned against misinformation circulating on social media, stressing vigilance, adherence to preventive measures, and continued mobilization with national and international partners to contain the outbreak and prevent spread. The response faces a fragile security and humanitarian context in the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | エボラ：政府が安心感を示し、デマとの戦いを呼びかけ | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な感染症で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確実。906疑似患者、約223死亡という規模は予想外の拡大を示唆し、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクも存在。フルRRA推奨。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州、北キブ州、南キブ州）でのエボラ発生を報告。906疑似患者、約223死亡という規模により、IHRおよびWPRO基準すべて該当。政府による対応表明と国際パートナーとの連携が進行中との記載あり。脆弱な安全保障・人道状況が対応を複雑化させている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya high court suspends plan to open US Ebola quarantine centre
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court suspended the United States plan to establish a 50-bed Ebola quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base to quarantine American citizens exposed to the Bundibugyo variant. Judge Patricia Nyaundi barred admission of anyone exposed to or infected until the case is heard on 2 June after a challenge by the Katiba Institute, citing rights to life, health, fair administrative action, public participation and parliamentary oversight. The United States had sought access restricted to Americans, while Nairobi preferred opening to all nationalities. The centre was due to open on Friday and would be managed by US staff. This unfolds as WHO declares the Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo a public health emergency of international concern, with Ituri as epicentre since May 15; the DRC reports 10 confirmed and 223 suspected deaths among over 1,000 cases. Uganda has seven cases and one death; Kenya has no cases. The US pledged 13.5 million dollars for Kenya preparedness; Africa CDC notes donor pledges have fallen to about 290 million from nearly 500 million since Monday.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所がUSエボラ隔離施設開設計画を停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準3つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行性）、高い社会政治的関心。DRC及び周辺国での確認事例と国際的な対応体制構築の段階である。
triage.notes: Laikipia（ケニア）とUgandaは対象国外のため除外。DRCはIturi州で公式にPHEIC宣言済み、1,000件以上の症例と233人の死亡が報告されている。Bundibugyo亜種による初の主要アウトブレイクであり、隣接国での準備態勢強化が進行中。資金面での課題も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Perché l'epidemia di Ebola in Congo non avrà una soluzione rapida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo won't have a quick solution.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has likely caused over 200 deaths. Bundibugyo is a rare orth EBV identified in 2007 and appears moderately less lethal than Zaire or Sudan strains. Transmission occurs via close contact with bodily fluids of living or deceased patients; incubation is 2–21 days and initial symptoms are non-specific (fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat), delaying diagnosis and increasing healthcare worker risk. There are no approved therapies or vaccines specific to Bundibugyo. WHO has convened experts to accelerate evaluation of candidates, prioritizing three therapies: Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron antibody treatments, and remdesivir. Vaccine candidates show promise: rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI) could enter efficacy studies in 7–9 months; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute) could be assessable in 2–3 months for efficacy trials. In parallel, surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は迅速な解決策を持たないだろう
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ブンディブギョ株による200名以上の死亡を伴う確認済み流行であり、ワクチン・治療法が未整備の状態でのシグナル対象。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株はレアな亜種（2007年同定）だが、ザイール株やスーダン株より致死率は低い可能性あり。しかし200名超の死亡実績、承認されたワクチン・治療法の不在、医療従事者への高リスク、コミュニティ内ヒト-ヒト感染の持続性により、重要な監視対象。WHOが治療・ワクチン候補の加速評価を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: LIVE WHO hekelt conflict in Oost-Congo: "Grootste obstakel om ebola te bestrijden" | VRT NWS Nieuws
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: LIVE WHO slams conflict in Eastern Congo: "The biggest obstacle to fighting Ebola" | VRT NWS News
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province, is severely hampered by ongoing conflict, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The precarious security situation is the biggest obstacle to containment. About 100,000 people have fled their homes in the last month, complicating surveillance and response efforts. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus; containment relies on preventive measures and rapid case detection. In this outbreak, more than 1,000 suspected cases have been recorded, with 246 deaths reported. The WHO urged a ceasefire and international funding to equip aid workers with necessary gear and supplies. As of May 29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: LIVE WHO、東コンゴの紛争を非難：「エボラウイルス対策における最大の障害」| VRT NWS ニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症で1,000件以上の疑似患者と246死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻。国際的な資金援助と支援が必要とされており、WHOが国際的に対応を呼びかけている。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、エボラウイルスはIHR対象疾患であり、1,000件以上の疑似患者と246死亡という深刻な規模。WHOが国際的な資金援助と支援を求めており、地域の紛争がコンテインメントの主要障害。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Drama u bolnici: Izvršila hitnu operaciju, pa se zarazila smrtonosnim virusom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital drama: She underwent emergency surgery, then contracted a deadly virus.
article.articleSummary: An Italian MSF surgeon who treated Ebola patients at the Salamat Center in Bunia, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, was admitted overnight to Rome's Lacaro Spalancani infectious diseases hospital after returning to Italy. She shows no Ebola symptoms and will be monitored until June 8, according to MSF. Italy’s Health Ministry had said she had direct contact with Ebola-positive patients on May 16 in Bunia after performing emergency surgery on a child injured by a grenade blast suspected of Ebola. Italy reports no current Ebola cases and low domestic risk. The WHO has declared an international health emergency for Ebola outbreaks in Congo and Uganda, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or specific therapy. In Congo, over 900 symptomatic cases and more than 220 deaths; in Uganda, eight confirmed cases and at least one death, linked to Congo spillover.

triage.headline_ja: 病院ドラマ：緊急手術を受けた後、致命的なウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO宣言済みの国際的保健上の緊急事態であるコンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ出血熱に関連し、医療従事者の感染暴露と国際移動による二次的リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ流行とそれに関連するイタリアの医療従事者の暴露・移動である。イタリア在住者の入院は二次的な報告であり、コンゴ・ウガンダが実際の発生地。WHO宣言済み国際保健緊急事態（Bundibugyo strain、コンゴで900+症例・220+死亡、ウガンダで8確認例・1死亡）。対象国リストではコンゴ（203312）のみ該当し、ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола в Конго: Конфликтът пречи на овладяването на заразата, пред...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: The conflict hinders the containment of the outbreak, ahead of...
article.articleSummary: WHO warns of expanding Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri’s Bunia region where conflict and displacement hinder containment. Since May 15, 10 confirmed and 223 probable deaths have occurred, with over 1,000 infections; the true scope may be higher. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment, though experts urge vaccine and therapy trials; a vaccine could be ready by year-end. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache and sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rashes and organ damage; transmission is via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids. Uganda closed its border with Congo; Kenya halted a quarantine plan for Americans. Aid includes 4.6 tonnes delivered to Bunia and UNICEF plans 100 more. Over 245,000 displaced since 2025; this is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：紛争がアウトブレイクの封じ込めを阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（223人死亡、1000人以上感染）、地域では予想外の大規模化、国際的な国境閉鎖と渡航制限が実施されている。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。スクリーニング基準と社会的・政治的関心の両立によりピックアップが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州Bunia地域）でのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダとケニアは国境閉鎖・渡航制限措置を実施しているが、これらの国での確認感染者の報告はサマリーに記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。紛争地域での疫学調査困難、承認された治療法がないBundibugyo株、1000人以上の感染者、高い死亡率（223人確認死亡）、245,000人以上の避難民など、複数の深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: " Si Ebola arrive ici, nous serons exterminés " : l'angoisse des camps de déplacés au Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "If Ebola arrives here, we will be exterminated": the anguish of Congo's internally displaced persons camps.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15 has produced over 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths, according to health authorities. Ituri province in north-eastern DRC is the epicenter, with nearly one million displaced people living in camps, including Kigonze near Bunia where more than 25,000 residents are housed in tarps and tents since 2018. No Ebola cases have been confirmed in Kigonze yet, but camp conditions heighten transmission risk due to overcrowding, people sleeping shoulder-to-shoulder, and heat-related stress. The outbreak is accelerating the response in Ituri, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning that the epidemic is outpacing efforts and planning a visit to Bunia. The situation illustrates a catastrophic clash between disease and conflict in a region already destabilized by violence.

triage.headline_ja: 「もしエボラがここに来たら、われわれは絶滅するだろう」：コンゴの国内避難民キャンプの不安
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模な疑似患者数（1000人超）と死亡者（246名）、東部DRCの難民キャンプでの蔓延リスク、WHO事務局長による懸念表明があり、国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模な確認された疫学的懸念。1000人超の疑似患者と246人の死亡者が報告されており、過密なIDP（国内避難民）キャンプ（Kigonzeキャンプ25,000人以上）での伝播リスクが高い。WHO事務局長による訪問予定や「流行が対策を上回っている」との警告があり、国際的対応の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 809 kasus positif campak hingga Mei 2026 di Sumsel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 809 confirmed measles cases as of May 2026 in South Sumatra
