article.articleSummary: As of 26 May 2026, South Sumatra reported 809 confirmed measles cases from 2,882 suspected since January 2026. Palembang City accounted for 442 positives (1,495 suspects), with Prabumulih 57/195; Musi Rawas 54/140; Muara Enim and Ogan Ilir each 39; Musi Rawas Utara 34; Musi Banyuasin 33; Lubuklinggau 31; Banyuasin 29. Pagar Alam, OKU Timur, and OKU Selatan reported zero cases. Health authorities continue full Measles-Rubella (MR) immunization for nine-month-old children and urge families to seek catch-up immunization at community health centers (puskesmas) or posyandu, which remain free of charge. The figure shows a downtrend from the prior quarter after an early-2026 rise, reflecting ongoing work by health workers, cadre networks, and community participation.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年5月までにスマトラ南部で麻疹の確認症例809例
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹（および風疹）の多数確認症例（809例）と地域的な流行が報告され、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）に複数該当。インドネシアの対象国であり、継続的な公衆衛生対応が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月時点でインドネシア・スマトラ南部州における麻疹流行を報告。809の確認症例と2,882の疑い症例が報告されており、1月以降の流行。複数の地域にまたがる地理的拡散あり。当局が継続的なMR（麻疹・風疹）予防接種キャンペーンを実施中。下降トレンドが見られるが、依然として対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Botswana : contrôles renforcés aux frontières face au risque d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botswana: strengthened border controls amid Ebola risk.
article.articleSummary: On 29 May 2026, Botswana tightened health controls at all entry points to prevent introduction of Ebola virus disease due to Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The Ministry of Health announced border measures applied at airports and land borders to enable early detection and rapid isolation of suspected cases. Spokesperson Christopher Nyanga said precautionary steps protect citizens and prevent importation. With DRC and Uganda facing rising Ebola infections, authorities warn of high lethality and cross-border spread. New protocols require temperature checks and symptom screening on arrival, including fever, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and unexplained bleeding. Travelers must complete health forms and provide travel history for the past 21 days, especially if they visited affected areas. Suspected cases will be isolated and sent to health facilities for testing and care. Citizens are urged to avoid travel to DRC and Uganda, maintain hygiene, and report any suspected case.

triage.headline_ja: ボツワナ：エボラウイルスのリスクに直面し、国境での検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病という重篤な病原体が複数国で同時流行中であり、国際的な拡大防止措置が講じられている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はボツワナの国境強化措置を主題としているが、実際のエボラ流行はDRCとウガンダで確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。ボツワナも対象国リストに含まれていないが、DRCが対象国として含まれている。エボラウイルス病は IHR 通知対象疾患であり、複数国での同時流行、高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が全て該当する重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Gericht stoppt Quarantäneeinrichtung für US-Bürger in Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Court halts quarantine facility for U.S. citizens in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court in Nairobi halted the establishment of a quarantine and Ebola-treatment facility for U.S. citizens, pending a June 2 response to a Katiba Institute petition. The injunction also bars relocating or permitting entry of individuals exposed to or infected with Ebola under any agreement with the United States or another foreign government or body. US media report that Washington intends to quarantine exposed Americans in a Kenyan facility yet to be created, while Kenya has not made a final decision; the Health Ministry says discussions with international partners are ongoing. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Uganda also affected; Kenya has reported no cases. Africa CDC cites 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths; the WHO has cited 223 suspected Ebola deaths (10 confirmed), with the true scale likely larger. Tedros visits Ituri and reiterates opposition to travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ケニアの米国市民検疫施設を裁判所が停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生（DRC）は IHR 4基準中3つ以上に該当する重大なシグナルであり、国際的な対応（米国との検疫施設設置）が関与することで国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが顕著。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ出血熱の発生地は DRC（イトゥリ州）が主流であり、ウガンダでも影響を受けている。ケニアは症例報告なし。Bluedot API の発生地域にはナイロビ（ケニア）が含まれるが、サマリーではケニアでの発生ではなく、米国市民の検疫施設受け入れをめぐる裁判が主題であるため verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。WHO および Africa CDC による死亡例（確定10、疑い223以上）の報告があり、重大な公衆衛生影響を確認。

article.articleHeadline: Miért nincs gyors megoldás a kongói Ebola-járványra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why There Is No Quick Solution to the Congolese Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a Bundibugyo virus outbreak, a rare Ebola orthoebolavirus, with more than 200 deaths. Transmission occurs via close contact with the body fluids of patients or the deceased, placing health workers at high risk. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms are non-specific: fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat. No approved therapies or vaccines exist specifically for Bundibugyo virus. WHO convened experts, prioritizing three therapies for trials: Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron antibody treatments, and remdesivir. Mapp’s antibody therapy, developed for Sudan virus, may work. Vaccines include the rVSV Bundibugyo single-dose vaccine by IAVI (7–9 months to evaluation) and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo by Oxford/Serum Institute (2–3 months to trial), with more animal data needed. Core Ebola measures—surveillance, rapid testing/diagnosis, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials—remain essential. Uganda reported Bundibugyo outbreaks in 2007 and 2012, with ~30–50% fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行に迅速な解決策がない理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ感染症（Bundibugyo virus）の多数死亡例（200人以上）、予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus（エボラウイルス科の稀な亜種）による大規模流行。ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが対象国ではないため verified_locations に含めず。サマリーからはコンゴでの明確な流行が主題。ワクチン開発段階にあり、承認済み治療法がない深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Italy asks EU for more border controls amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts Italy to seek stricter EU border controls. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni asked EU leaders to place border management on the agenda for the June 18–19 council and requested a videoconference of EU health ministers as early as next week. Italy has already activated targeted health surveillance and monitoring for travelers arriving from Uganda and DRC. WHO data up to May 24 show 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected Ebola deaths in the DRC, among more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases; Uganda reports 1 confirmed death and six additional cases, with the agency warning the true spread is likely wider. A team from Rome's Spallanzani Hospital will travel to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance and deliver medicines and supplies.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアがエボラ流行の中でEUに国境管理強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、複数国への波及、国際的な公衆衛生対応の発動により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。EU域内での医療対応・国境管理措置の検討が開始されている。
triage.notes: DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行が記事の主題。イタリア・ローマは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。ただし、EU域内での国際的対応と国境管理強化の動きが確認されており、地域的影響は重大。WHO警告により、実際の感染規模は報告数より広い可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Corte de Kenia suspende plan de EEUU para un centro de cuarentena por ébola para estadounidenses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court suspends US plan for an Ebola quarantine center for Americans.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, Kenya's High Court temporarily blocked any US plan to establish an Ebola quarantine center for Americans exposed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, pending arguments set for Tuesday. The plan, disclosed by a US official, would have housed exposed individuals in Kenya rather than repatriating them and included $13.5 million for Ebola preparedness. The Kenyan government had only disclosed talks on preparedness support, not the installation. Katiba Institute and the Kenyan Law Society challenged any Ebola-linked facility, citing public health risks and lack of public participation, with concerns about Kenya's need for high-containment infrastructure. Separately, a Kenyan doctors' union warned of a 48-hour strike if the arrangement proceeds. In DR Congo's northeast, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has produced over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since May 15; Uganda has 7 cases and 1 death; no approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO suspects underreporting.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所、米国によるエボラ出血熱隔離センター設立計画を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規アウトブレイク（Bundibugyo型）がDRC北東部で1,000件超の疑い症例と220死亡を記録。ウガンダへの波及、国際的な隔離施設設立計画をめぐる政治的紛争が発生。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: サマリーではDRC北東部での1,000超の疑い症例と220死亡が記載される。ウガンダでの7症例、ケニアでの隔離施設設立計画をめぐる法的紛争も言及されているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ウガンダは対象外）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は既知だが致命的であり、ワクチン・治療法がない。WHO による過少報告の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Africa centrale, l'Italia chiede coordinamento Ue rafforzato sulle frontiere
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Central Africa, Italy calls for strengthened EU coordination on borders.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-29, Italy urged EU leadership to coordinate border health measures for flows from Ebola-affected areas in Central Africa (Congo and Uganda). Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote to EU Council President Ursula von der Leyen and others proposing common border rules to manage direct and indirect arrivals from Ebola zones, while respecting national public health competences. Italy asked to place the issue on the European Council agenda for 18-19 June 2026 and to convene Health Ministers by videoconference next week and EPSCO Council on 16 June to set operational priorities. Domestically, the Health Ministry, with Civil Protection, issued circulars to monitor travelers returning from affected areas and bolster surveillance protocols. A technical mission to Kinshasa by experts from the Lazzaro Spallanzani Institute, coordinated by Farnesina, Health, Civil Protection, and AISE, will provide on-ground support, medical supplies, and bolster epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカのエボラ、イタリアがEU国境における調整強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高致死率・重篤）による中央アフリカでの発生に対し、EUレベルでの国境衛生措置調整が要請されている。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク該当。WPROスクリーニングでは重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い（EU首脳・保健大臣会議の議題化）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）およびウガンダでのエボラ発生が言及されているが、ウガンダ（id: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。イタリアおよびEU機関の対応は発生地ではなく、政治的反応である。2026年5月の記事であり、複数国での確定的なエボラ流行を前提としている。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : pourquoi il n'existe pas de solution rapide
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: why there is no quick solution.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with suspected more than 200 deaths. Transmission occurs via close contact with infected bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms are non-specific, hindering rapid diagnosis. There are no approved treatments or vaccines specifically for Bundibugyo. WHO convened experts to evaluate candidates and prioritized three therapies for trials: antibody treatments developed by Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron, and the antiviral remdesivir (Gilead). Vaccine candidates include the rVSV Bundibugyo (single-dose) by IAVI and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford and the Serum Institute of India, with assessments expected in 7–9 months and 2–3 months respectively, though further animal data are needed. Meanwhile, control relies on surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention/control, community engagement, and safe burials. WHO Director-General Tedros urged clarity and action with DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行：なぜ迅速な解決策がないのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症（特にBundibugyo株）の流行で200名超の死亡が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な病原体株、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダでも確認）、国際的な懸念により基準を満たす。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国で確認されたEbolavirus Bundibugyo株による流行。記事ではウガンダへの言及があるがWHO事務局長の呼びかけ文脈のみで、実際の発生はDRCが主体。対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当。ワクチン・治療法が確立されておらず管理困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: le patron de l'OMS à Kinshasa, avant une visite à l'épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the WHO chief in Kinshasa, ahead of a visit to the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, with Ituri province at the epicenter and spread to North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports seven confirmed infections, including one death. Since the May 15 outbreak declaration, DRC totals exceed 1,000 suspected cases and 246 fatalities; the WHO has raised the Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The armed conflict in Ituri and border closures with Uganda and Rwanda complicate response. Historically, most DRC outbreaks are Zaïre Ebola; Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though WHO advisory bodies urged clinical trials of candidates. Africa CDC pledges vaccine and treatment development by end-2026. WHO Chief Tedros arrived in Kinshasa May 29 ahead of a possible Ituri visit and a meeting with President Félix Tshisekedi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO事務局長がキンシャサに到着、流行中心地への訪問を予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus）による深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（1,000件以上の疑い患者、246人の死亡）、予想外の病原体型、複数国への国際的な拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）、WHO PHEIC宣言による渡航・貿易制限リスク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virusによる17番目の流行。DRC以外の発生地域（ウガンダ、ルワンダ）は記事サマリーで確認されたが、対象国リストにはウガンダ・ルワンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。PHEIC宣言済み。武力紛争による対応困難が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Мелони призова ЕС да засили бдителността по границите заради рисковете от ебола,
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meloni urged the EU to strengthen border vigilance due to the risks of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged the EU to strengthen border vigilance amid Ebola risks linked to Central Africa outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. She called for the issue to be on the June EU summit agenda and for a videoconference of health ministers. The epidemiological situation in Central Africa underpins concern about Ebola spread, linked to the Congo outbreak and cross-border transmission to Uganda. An Italian doctor who worked with Doctors Without Borders in the DRC and who had direct contact with Ebola patients is under observation at Rome’s Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases. She is asymptomatic and will be monitored until June 8, after direct contact on May 16 with patients later testing positive at Samalat Hospital in Bunia, DRC; on May 18 she performed emergency surgery on a child in the DRC suspected of Ebola. Italy reports no current Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: メローニ首相、エボラのリスクに関連して国境警戒強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラの国際的拡大リスク、重症度の高い病原体、イタリアでの疑わしい接触者監視など複数のWPRO基準に該当し、EU圏での政治的関心も高い。DRCとウガンダでの継続的な流行に加え、国際的な渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。
triage.notes: イタリアとEU圏での報道であるが、実際の感染イベント発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストはDRCのみ該当。イタリアでの接触者監視は予防的措置であり、確認症例ではない。Bluedot APIが検出した「Central Africa」「Uganda」「Italy」は記事サマリー上の背景情報であり、主たるイベント発生地はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: Γιατί η επιδημία Έμπολα στο Κονγκό δεν έχει εύκολη λύση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the Ebola outbreak in Congo has no easy solution.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed over 200 people. Bundibugyo is a rarer Ebola strain with lower fatality than Zaire or Sudan, but remains deadly. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms are non-specific (fever, fatigue, myalgia, headache, sore throat). Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids of patients or corpses; health workers are at high risk. No approved therapies or vaccines exist specifically for Bundibugyo. WHO prioritizes three candidates for trials: antibody therapies from Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron, and remdesivir from Gilead. Vaccine candidates include a single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo by IAVI (7–9 months to trial readiness) and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo by Oxford/Serum Institute (2–3 months to trial readiness, pending animal data). WHO stresses traditional measures: surveillance, rapid testing and diagnosis, contact tracing, isolation, infection control, community engagement, and safe burials. Previous outbreaks occurred in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012).

triage.headline_ja: なぜコンゴのエボラ流行は簡単な解決策がないのか
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による流行で200人以上の死亡が報告され、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株はZaire株やSudan株より致死率は低いが、200人以上の死亡が確認されており深刻。記事ではワクチンや治療法の不在が強調されている。DRCが対象国に含まれるためピックアップ。Ugandaは過去の発生地として言及されているが、現在の流行はDRCが主体であるため。

article.articleHeadline: Кина ги предупреди своите граѓани да не патуваат во Конго поради епидемијата на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China Warns Its Citizens Not to Travel to Congo Due to the Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts a Chinese travel advisory on 2026-05-29. The World Health Organization reports about 1,077 suspected Ebola cases since the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, with 121 laboratory-confirmed infections and 17 deaths. WHO has raised the alert level to 'Very High,' and several neighboring countries have tightened travel measures, including Congo-related restrictions. China instructs its citizens to avoid travel to DRC unless essential; those already in Congo or nearby should avoid regions affected by Ebola, notably Ituri and North Kivu, and to refrain from contact with wildlife and anyone suspected of infection. Chinese nationals displaying fever, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or bleeding should seek medical care immediately or contact Chinese medical teams. The notice reflects growing international concern over Ebola’s spread in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、エボラ流行に伴いコンゴへの渡航を国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生に深刻な影響を及ぼし、DRCでの確認は異常かつ国際的拡大リスクが高く、各国が渡航制限を実施している。WHOがアラートレベルを『Very High』に引き上げており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ発生を主題としており、中国の渡航警告はこのDRCイベントに対する国家レベルの対応を示している。発生地域にChinaが含まれているが、サマリーではChinaは政策応答国であり、ウイルス発生地ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。2026年5月15日の公式宣言以降、1,077の疑似症例、121の確定例、17死亡報告。複数隣接国による渡航制限措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya court suspends opening of US Ebola quarantine centre
article.articleSummary: Kenya's judiciary on Friday temporarily halted the opening of a 50-bed Ebola quarantine centre for US nationals at Laikipia Air Base, about 200 kilometres from Nairobi, amid a petition by the Katiba Institute. US officials had planned to quarantine arrivals from the Democratic Republic of Congo, which is grappling with a major Ebola outbreak. Kenya has been testing arrivals and has not reported any Ebola cases. The conservatory order bars establishing any Ebola exposure, quarantine, isolation or treatment facility in Kenya; a June 2 hearing was set after Kenya’s government 48-hour response window. The facility is tied to a December health deal with the US that is being challenged in court, drawing criticism from the Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union, which accused authorities of trading citizens’ lives for foreign aid. Doctors threaten industrial action if negotiations aren’t public.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所がUS国民向けエボラ隔離センターの開設を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高リスク疾患であり、DRCでの流行との関連性があるが、本記事の主要な内容は施設開設の法的・政治的延期であり、ケニアでのエボラ症例報告はなく、国際的な公衆衛生リスク評価には情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主要なテーマはケニアにおけるエボラ隔離施設開設の法的延期であり、ケニア自体ではエボラ症例が報告されていない。DRCのエボラ流行が背景にあるが、本記事はケニアの裁判所判断と米ケニア間の政治的紛争が中心。施設計画の一時停止は公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威ではなく、むしろ予防的措置である可能性がある。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak 2026: Questions and Answers with Direct Relief's Dr. Jeffrey Samuel
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with Direct Relief dispatching US$2.5 million in emergency medical support to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Dr. Jeffrey Samuel notes that routine health-system strengthening in Uganda and East Africa underpins outbreak response and containment. Ebola spreads through direct contact with body fluids of the sick or deceased, contaminated equipment, or unsafe burial practices; it is not airborne. Incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms mimic malaria or typhoid (fever, fatigue, muscle aches, headaches); progression can include vomiting, diarrhea, dehydration, organ failure, and later hemorrhaging. Prevention hinges on early case identification, isolation, infection prevention and control (PPE, hand hygiene), contact tracing, and safe burials, with strong community engagement to build trust. Treatment is supportive (IV fluids, electrolyte replacement, oxygen, infection management, blood pressure, nutrition, monitoring). Vaccines/monoclonal antibodies have been developed for Zaire, not specifically for Bundibugyo, underscoring the need for robust health systems and adaptable responses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイク2026年：Direct ReliefのDr. Jeffrey Samuelへの質問と回答
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。DRC発生のBundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行で、ウガンダなど周辺国への拡大懸念があり、早期のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは主にDRCのエボラ発生が主題であり、ウガンダについては「定期的な保健システム強化」という支援・対策の文脈のみで言及されている。モザンビークは全く記述されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。2026年という将来日付は注記対象だが、シミュレーション/シナリオベースの記事の可能性がある。Bundibugyo型エボラは比較的稀な亜種（Zaire型のワクチンが開発されているが本亜種向けではない点を指摘）であり、対応策の適応性に関する懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths from Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, WHO says
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, including 223 suspected deaths that are under investigation. The Bundibugyo strain is driving the outbreak in DRC, with additional cases reported in Uganda. There are no vaccines or therapies specifically approved for Bundibugyo virus disease. The report underlines ongoing spread and the lack of targeted medical countermeasures, with investigations continuing into the cases. The article mentions Uganda involvement but does not provide details on infection sources or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）の疑い事例906件、疑い死亡223件、WHOが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（906疑い事例、死亡率24.7%）は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の病原体株の流行、複数国への国際的拡大、ワクチン・治療薬不在による管理困難性を示す。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Uganda は発生地域に記載されているが、記事サマリーでは『additional cases reported in Uganda』と簡潔に述べられているのみで、詳細な感染源や検査確認の情報が欠如している。対象国リストに Uganda は含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRC は対象国（GeoNames ID 203312）に含まれ、明確に主流行地として記載されているため含める。ブンディブギョ株は過去の大流行（2007-2008年、死亡率37-50%）に比べると低い死亡率だが、ワクチン・治療薬の欠如は深刻な管理リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan High Court Blocks U.S. Ebola Quarantine Facility Agreement
article.articleSummary: Kenyan High Court has temporarily blocked the government from proceeding with a U.S. plan to establish an Ebola quarantine facility on Kenyan soil for Americans exposed during the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. Justice Patricia Nyaundi barred admission, transfer, or reception of persons exposed to or infected with Ebola under the arrangement. The Katiba Institute and the Law Society of Kenya challenged terms they described as unfavourable. The plan would have authorized land at an air force base in Laikipia, central Kenya, about 125 miles north of Nairobi, for a 50-bed quarantine unit staffed by the U.S. Public Health Service. Kenyan doctors’ union and the Law Society argued it could import Ebola into a country with no confirmed cases; CDC officials reportedly advised against it. The facility was to be open to all nationalities; evacuations included an American doctor infected evacuated to Germany and others to the Czech Republic. The deal accompanies a broader bilateral health agreement totaling $1.6 billion to Kenya for 2026–2030, down about $423 million from prior levels.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア高等裁判所、米国のエボラ隔離施設協定をブロック
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病に関する異常・予想外の司法判断イベントであり、ケニアを含む複数国での関心がある。ただし、実際の感染症の流行や患者発生ではなく、政策・施設合意に関する法的決定であるため、医学的リスク評価よりも外交・政治的性質が強く、情報不足の要素が多い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの司法判断（米国施設合意のブロック）であり、DRC由来の現在の流行への対応的性質。ケニア自体は確認患者ゼロと明記されており、基準上の対象国リストにはケニアが含まれないため verified_locations は DRC のみ。実際のエボラ症例発生や流行ではなく、政策決定に関するイベント。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、公衆衛生の直接的な脅威としてのリスクは限定的。継続した情報収集推奨。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 7 إصابات بـ' إيبولا' في أوغندا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 7 Ebola cases in Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 7 confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda. Uganda has closed its border with the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a rise in suspected cases linked to a rare Ebola virus strain. The infections follow Ugandan healthcare workers being exposed to patients from Congo, with confirmed cases arising within Uganda. The situation underscores cross-border transmission risk and the need for intensified surveillance along adjacent areas. Authorities emphasise laboratory-confirmed cases and ongoing investigations into the infection source and transmission dynamics. The border closure is described as a containment measure to limit cross-border movement while health authorities scale up testing, contact tracing, and infection prevention and control in healthcare settings. No death count is provided in the briefing.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：ウガンダでエボラウイルス病7例確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当、またWPRO基準でも5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認例、国際的な越境伝播リスク、国境閉鎖措置、社会的・政治的関心が高い緊急性の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの7例確認が報告されているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（226074）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。ただしDRCとウガンダの越境伝播が主な懸念であり、DRC発の感染症シグナルとして捉えられるため、pickup判定は維持。稀なエボラウイルス株によるアウトブレイク、ヘルスケアワーカーの暴露、国境閉鎖措置など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RD Congo : première guérison en Ituri, l'UNICEF envoie 100 tonnes d'aide
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: first recovery in Ituri, UNICEF sends 100 tonnes of aid.
article.articleSummary: First recovery reported in Ituri as Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a surging response. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, more than 1,000 suspected cases and over 240 suspected deaths have been recorded. The World Health Organization says the epidemic is outpacing the response. Government officials arrived in Bunia to assess the situation. UNICEF has dispatched 100 tonnes of aid to support relief efforts in Ituri and surrounding areas. The piece features a report by Aurélie Bazzara-Kibangula for France 24 in Kinshasa, with comments from Gilles Fagninou, UNICEF regional director for West and Central Africa. Dated May 29, 2026, the report underscores rapid international mobilization to address the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：イトゥリで初の回復、ユニセフが100トンの支援物資を送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の急速な感染拡大（5月15日以降1,000件以上の疑い患者、240人以上の死亡）、WHO による「流行が対応を上回っている」との警告、国際的な支援動員など、IHR基準4項目すべてと WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当する重大な公衆衛生上の危機的シグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は非常に高い致命率を持つ危険な病原体。発生地域はキンシャサとイトゥリの2地域。UNICEF および WHOが既に積極的に対応を開始している。初の回復事例報告は治療成功の可能性を示唆するが、全体的には急速な流行拡大が確認されており、地域を超えた国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。フルRRA(Rapid Risk Assessment)への即座の進展が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉蔓延欧洲 意大利敦促欧盟强化边境管控 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola's spread to Europe; Italy urges the EU to strengthen border controls - International - Real-time International
article.articleSummary: Italy urges the EU to bolster border controls to prevent Ebola virus disease from Congo and Uganda reaching Europe. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has written to EU leaders, proposing border-management coordination be on the June EU summit agenda and calling for an urgent video conference of health ministers next week to discuss emergency actions. The World Health Organization designated the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and warned that neighboring countries remain at high risk. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain described as more transmissible than Zaire ebolavirus. With the World Cup opening on June 11 in the United States, Canada, and Mexico, three countries said health and safety are a top priority for travelers, without detailing specific measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの欧州への蔓延を防ぐ。イタリアがEUに国境管理の強化を促促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準も3つ以上該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心あり。エボラウイルス病の国際的脅威として迅速なフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでの発生が主題。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみ含める。イタリアやEUの政策対応は二次的な内容。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（より感染力が高い株）による発生という重要な特性あり。6月のワールドカップ開催（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）との関連で国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: MISAU confirma zero casos de Ébola e reforça medidas de prevenção no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MISAU confirms zero Ebola cases and reinforces prevention measures in the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Mozambique reports zero confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with the Ministry of Health (MISAU) reinforcing prevention measures. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo on 15 May and rapidly extended to Uganda; the World Health Organization declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. Mozambique remains classified as a low-risk country, though health authorities stress preparedness. The National Institute of Health in Maputo has full laboratory capacity to test, confirm infections, and isolate the virus, supporting surveillance and containment. The Mozambican statement was released 28 May in Maputo, underscoring ongoing vigilance amid global alerts.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ症例ゼロを確認し、国内の予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的なPHEIC宣言（WHO、2026年5月17日）に基づき、対象国（DRC）での確認事例があり、隣接国（ザンビア外だが、モザンビークは対象国外）での対応が報道されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的影響度が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はモザンビークでのゼロ症例確認を報道していますが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみです。DRCでエボラアウトブレイク開始（2026年5月15日）が報告されており、ウガンダへの拡大も言及されています。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみです。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la République centrafricaine renforce ses dispositifs de préventions
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The Central African Republic strengthens its prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: Ebola: Central African Republic tightens prevention to avert cross-border spread. In the Central African Republic, authorities strengthen measures to prevent any propagation of the Ebola virus on national soil. On May 28, 2026, the Health Minister visited Bangui Community Hospital and held an emergency meeting with healthcare staff to assess threats linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. France 24 correspondent Cyrille Jefferson Yapendé, reporting from Bangui, notes that authorities are boosting surveillance, infection prevention, and response readiness to deter spillover from the DRC epidemic and protect key urban and border areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：中央アフリカ共和国が予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの隣国DRCからの越境流入リスクに対応するため、中央アフリカ共和国が緊急対応を強化している重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は中央アフリカ共和国（対象国外）の予防措置強化であるが、実際のエボラウイルス流行の発生地はDRC（対象国）である。地域検証に基づきDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。DRCでの進行中の流行から隣国への越境感染リスクが高い状況が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する極めて懸念の高いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: EEUU destinará 13,5 millones de dólares a la preparación de Kenia contra el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US will allocate $13.5 million to Kenya's Ebola outbreak preparedness.
article.articleSummary: US to allocate $13.5 million to Kenya for Ebola outbreak preparedness, as Washington aims to bolster East Africa's readiness amid an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo that has spread to Uganda and threatens 11 regional countries. In a State Department statement, Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke with Kenyan President William Ruto, outlining $13.5 million in Kenyan preparedness funding and noting $112 million in bilateral regional assistance already committed. The two leaders emphasized coordinating to secure vital medical supplies and strengthen Kenya's health system, with ongoing collaboration to prevent the outbreak from reaching US soil. The report notes that the briefing preceded a Kenyan High Court ruling blocking a quarantine center for potentially exposed Americans; the case was brought by the Katiba Institute following New York Times reports about negotiations to divert exposed individuals to Kenya's Laikipia air base.

triage.headline_ja: 米国がケニアのエボラ流行への準備態勢強化に1,350万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域流行がコンゴ民主共和国の東部から周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア）に拡大し、11カ国に脅威を及ぼしている。国際的な支援体制が構築されており、IHR基準3項目とWPRO基準複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際の流行発生地はコンゴ民主共和国東部であり、ウガンダに既に拡大している。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。ラビピア県（Laikipia）はケニア領域で、対象国外のため除外。米国は流行地区ではなく対応地であるため除外。モザンビークは記事で言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: PROPOSED US-KENYA EBOLA QUARANTINE PROTOCOL TRIGGERS REGIONAL BIOSECURITY ALARMS FOR SOMALIA
article.articleSummary: Kenya proposes an Ebola quarantine and treatment facility for American personnel, triggering regional biosecurity alarms as Africa CDC warns of cross-border spill risks amid the Bundibugjo Ebola outbreak. International funding for outbreak response has collapsed from $498 million to $219 million, widening Africa-wide resource gaps. The Bundibugyo strain lacks a proven vaccine or therapeutic; existing vaccines target the Zaire variant. Somalia (Mogadishu) and Kenya face heightened cross-border vulnerability as East African Community integration progresses. Misdiagnosis in the Democratic Republic of Congo accelerated early transmission among healthcare workers after a May 5 testing failure. A Nairobi lawsuit by the Katiba Institute seeks to halt the bilateral arrangement, while Kenyan officials insist the country can manage the center safely and uphold global health-security obligations. Mogadishu experts warn that any failure or breach could cascade across Nairobi–Somalia airspace and land borders, disrupting trade and security.

triage.headline_ja: 提案されたUS-ケニア間エボラ隔離プロトコルがソマリアの地域的バイオセキュリティアラームを引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス（特にBundibugyo株）の発生、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、資金不足による対応能力低下、医療従事者への感染、国境を越えたリスク、および政治的紛争が存在し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーはケニアでの隔離施設提案とソマリアの懸念を述べているが、実際のエボラ発生地（Bundibugyo株の流行）の記載は明示されていない。DRCは診断失敗による初期感染伝播が記述されており、検証対象国リストに含まれるため検証地点に含めた。ケニアはWHO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ソマリアはリストに含まれないため除外。国際的影響の大きさ、資金不足（$498M→$219M）、医療従事者への感染、ワクチン・治療法の欠如、政治的紛争（Katiba Instituteによる訴訟）が複合的に存在する重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱｜過去七日錄得一宗輸入個案　病人潛伏期內曾訪星洲、大馬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever | One imported case recorded in the past seven days; patient had visited Singapore and Malaysia during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: One imported dengue fever case was recorded in Hong Kong from May 22–28; the patient had traveled to Singapore and Malaysia during the incubation period. Hong Kong’s year-to-date total reaches 20 dengue cases, with 19 imported and 1 locally acquired. Last year saw 59 cases, while 2024 recorded 161 (156 imported, 5 local). The Centre for Health Protection notes dengue is widespread in nearby travel destinations: Indonesia, India, and Vietnam each reported over 120,000 cases last year; Malaysia and Thailand over 50,000; Singapore over 4,000. Guangdong Province, China, had 97 cases as of May 10, including 8 locally transmitted. The centre emphasizes that rising temperatures and humidity favor mosquito breeding and urges preventive measures for residents and travelers to reduce bite risk and dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱｜過去七日錄得一宗輸入個案　病人潛伏期內曾訪星洲、大馬
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。デング熱は東南アジア全域で広く流行中であり、香港への輸入症例増加と周辺地域での活発な流行が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインド、インドネシア、ベトナムで各12万件以上、マレーシアとタイで5万件以上、シンガポールで4千件以上の症例が報告されている。広東省（中国）でも97件確認。香港への輸入症例は流行地との旅行リスクを示唆しており、WPRo地域での流行状況との関連が明確。対象国リスト内の確認地域のみを verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, hantavirus outbreaks raise questions about Trump's health agency cuts
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of hantavirus aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship and Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda spur criticism of the Trump administration’s public-health cuts. Hondius, with about 150 aboard, saw earliest cases reported to WHO on May 2; 3 of 11 infected passengers have died; Andes virus can spread person-to-person; quarantines and exposure monitoring are under way. Ebola, Bundibugyo strain with no proven vaccines or treatments, has grown to over 1,000 suspected cases in DRC and Uganda; seven Americans were evacuated to Germany. No U.S. cases confirmed. The CDC and State Department are deploying rapid testing and resources to Congo and Uganda. Democrats urge rejoining WHO and restoring CDC/FDA funding; Republicans defend the response amid DOGE-driven cuts that critics say have strained outbreak readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱とハンタウイルス感染症の流行がトランプ政権の保健機関予算削減に関する疑問を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の複数疾患同時流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラは1,000件超の疑い患者、ハンタウイルスは船舶での人間感染と死亡報告がある。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: 警告: 記事サマリー上、エボラはDRCおよびウガンダで流行し、ハンタウイルスはMV Hondius客船（現在地不明）での発生。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事には米国およびドイツへの患者移送が言及されているが、これらは対象国ではないため除外。なお、verified_locations にIndiaが表示されているのはBluedot APIの誤出力である可能性がある。実際の発生地は記事サマリーに基づくとDRCが最大である。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: Prohibir Viajeros del Congo No Detiene el Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Banning Travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo Does Not Stop Ebola
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says banning travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo does not stop Ebola. In Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976 continues, centered in Ituri (Bunia) and North Kivu and South Kivu. The African Union health agency reports 246 suspected Ebola deaths in Congo. Uganda confirms eight Ebola infections, including one death from a case imported from the Congo. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a case fatality about 30–50% and no vaccine authorized or specific treatment for this strain, according to the WHO. Tedros plans to visit Bunia to support communities and stressed that travel bans could hamper transparency. Several countries have imposed restrictions, but WHO advocates strengthening outbreak response at the source, amid ongoing conflict and distrust in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴからの渡航者の入国禁止ではエボラは止まらない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模発生であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）の4つすべてに該当。複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認、高い致死率（30-50%）、確認死亡例あり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが示す発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認は限定的（8例、1死亡）であり、主発生地はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。第17次エボラ発生（1976年以来）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus、ワクチンなし、高い致死率であり、WHOトップが対応表明するなど国際的に重大な関心事。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Monkeypox case: 5 Singapore residents among those quarantined
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Singapore: Five of 23 identified close contacts are Singapore residents; others are from Britain, India, Ireland, Malaysia, Nigeria and Vietnam, most having attended the same workshop. As of May 14, all close contacts were asymptomatic. The first imported case is a 38-year-old Nigerian who attended a workshop in Singapore; MOH says he likely contracted the virus from bush meat eaten at a wedding in Nigeria before traveling. He remains in an isolation ward at the National Centre for Infectious Diseases and is stable; discharge will follow recovery and confirmation of non-infectious status. Monkeypox spreads via close contact with blood, bodily fluids or lesions of infected animals, or by eating improperly cooked meat; human-to-human transmission occurs through close contact or contaminated objects. The Nigerian patient developed symptoms on Apr 30, was admitted May 7 and tested positive May 8. Outside Africa, cases have been reported in the United States, Britain and Israel.

triage.headline_ja: サルグアムトル症患者：シンガポール住民5人を含む隔離者
triage.triage_reason: Mpox（Clade I/II）の国際的拡大を示す複数国での感染確認、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、及び対象国（Vietnam, India）での曝露/接触者リンクが確認されており、IHR基準2つ以上該当かつWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はシンガポール発の事例を報じているが、シンガポールは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ただしワークショップ共有により Vietnam と India の住民が接触/曝露しており、これらは対象国として含める。Mpox Clade I/II の国際的拡大（アフリカ由来→シンガポール→複数国への波及）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、及び動物由来の二次的リスク要因（bush meat）が確認される。IHR基準4つ全て、WPRO基準5つ全て該当。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в Африке: Минздрав Беларуси принимает защитные меры на границе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Africa: Belarus' Ministry of Health takes protective measures at the border.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola fever persists in Africa, with Congo reporting about 220 deaths and up to 1,000 infected as of 2026-05-29. Belarus' Ministry of Health has tightened sanitary-quarantine controls at border checkpoints, prioritizing travelers and cargo from Congo and Uganda where cases have been reported. Authorities say the risk of entry into Belarus is minimal, but precautionary measures are taken. Health experts advise postponing travel to Africa and seeking medical care at first symptoms. Key signs include headache, weakness, abdominal pain, muscle pains, and diarrhea; late-stage features include coughing and chest pain. Ebola spreads by close contact with blood or other fluids from an infected person or animal. Across African countries there are hundreds of suspected cases, with about 60% of patients being women.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ熱流行：ベラルーシ保健省が国境での防護措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の確認流行で、220人の死亡と約1,000人の感染報告がある。IHR基準で重大な公衆衛生への影響（Yes）と国際的拡大リスク（Yes）の2基準以上に該当し、国連機関への通知対象。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ熱流行と、ウガンダでの症例報告及びベラルーシの防疫措置を述べている。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれない。ベラルーシ（630336）は防疫実施国であり、発生地は含めない。全5つのWPRO基準に該当し、極めて高リスクのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Италијанска докторка хитно пребачена у болницу због контакта са еболом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italian female doctor urgently transported to hospital due to contact with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: An Italian surgeon who treated Ebola patients in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) was urgently transported to Rome after returning to Italy. She had direct contact on May 16 with Ebola-positive patients at the Salamat center in Bunia, in northeastern DRC, where she performed emergency surgery on a child suspected of Ebola following a grenade blast. She shows no symptoms and is under observation at Rome's Lazzaro Spallanzani Infectious Diseases Institute until June 8. Italy reports no current Ebola cases and very low risk. The World Health Organization has declared an international health emergency over the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. In Congo: over 900 symptomatic cases and more than 220 deaths; in Uganda, eight cases and at least one death; outbreak spreading from Congo to Uganda. MSF provided details.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア人女性医師がエボラウイルス接触のため病院に緊急搬送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの確認感染者が複数国に広がり、医療従事者への曝露を含むため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCでのエボラ集団発生（900症例以上、220死亡以上）及びウガンダへの拡大が述べられている。イタリアの医師はDRCで曝露し、イタリア帰国後観察中だが、WHOが国際的健康上の緊急事態を宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株、有効ワクチンなし。イタリアとウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 本港再添一宗外地傳入登革熱個案　患者曾到星洲及馬來西亞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong reports another imported dengue fever case; the patient had been to Singapore and Malaysia.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports another imported dengue fever case; the patient had traveled to Singapore and Malaysia during the incubation period. Hong Kong's year-to-date dengue total reaches 20 cases, with 19 imported and 1 locally transmitted. In neighboring Guangdong Province, the Guangdong Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention reported 97 cases this year as of May 10, including 8 locally transmitted infections; last year the province recorded more than 3,500 locally transmitted cases. April’s average temperature and rainfall were higher than the same period last year, promoting Aedes mosquito breeding and causing an earlier rise in the mosquito-trap index. With increased rainfall in May, the index is expected to rise further. Editor: Tam Pui-chin; original publication on RTHK (Hong Kong Radio Television).

triage.headline_ja: 香港が外来輸入デング熱の別の症例を報告：患者はシンガポールとマレーシアを訪問
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の輸入症例報告だが、現時点では限定的な規模（香港20例、広東省97例）。ただし蚊媒介ベクターの活動増加傾向と域内複数国への拡散の可能性があるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはシンガポール、マレーシアが含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。記事は香港（China に含める）と広東省での流行状況が主題。蚊のトラップ指数上昇とさらなる上昇予測は夏季に向けての懸念材料。WPROスクリーニング基準では「prolonged_exposure（ベクター活動の継続）」と「epidemic_prone（デング熱の流行しやすさ）」に該当するが、現在の症例数は限定的で PICKUP 基準には達しないため WATCH に判定。

article.articleHeadline: Врачи в ДРК утверждают, что вспышка Эболы в стране вышла из-под контроля
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors in the DRC say that the Ebola outbreak in the country has gotten out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has spiraled out of control, with transmission described as geometric progression by doctors in Ituri province. In Mongbvalu hospital, director Richard Lokudi said seven patients with suspected Ebola recently escaped, creating additional transmission chains complicating the response. As of May 29, 2026, the DRC reports 221 deaths among people with suspected Ebola; the previous outbreak ended in October 2025. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda an emergency and a risk to other countries. Russia has tightened border controls in response to the outbreak in Africa. The article does not detail laboratory confirmation. The situation underscores rapid spread and hospital breaches driving ongoing transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRCの医師がエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能になったと主張
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への重大な影響、幾何学的な拡大速度、ウガンダへの越境感染、国際的な渡航・貿易制限措置（ロシアの国境管理強化）が認識されており、WHOが緊急事態宣言をしている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイツリ州でのエボラ出血熱の流行を主題としており、DRCが実際の発生地である。ウガンダは越境感染リスクとして言及されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行制御不能状況である。ロシアは対策国として登場するが発生国ではないため、verified_locationsに含めない。221人の死亡者、院内における患者逃亡による二次感染、WHO緊急事態宣言、幾何学的な感染拡大が報告されており、全てのWPRO基準も満たす重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Световното първенство - идеалната среда за разпространение на вируси
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Championship - the ideal environment for the spread of viruses.
article.articleSummary: Massive World Cup in the United States, Canada, and Mexico (16 cities) over 39 days will draw about 6 million attendees from every inhabited continent, creating a hospitable environment for virus spread. Canadian firm BlueDot warned in December of a dangerous hantavirus strain in Argentina; months later, cases emerged on a cruise ship off Cabo Verde, killing three. Now, even greater cruise-ship-like risk is anticipated. In May, an Ebola outbreak erupted in the Democratic Republic of Congo, a nation whose team is in the tournament. Dengue, Zika, and chikungunya are rising in South America; in the United States, measles and pertussis are resurging amid vaccination declines. Epidemiologists warn the biggest threat is an unknown pathogen. Wastewater surveillance by Biobot Analytics and Verily Health, plus AI from BlueDot, aims to detect signals early; Kansas City organizers are using these data to prepare hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ - ウイルス拡散の理想的な環境
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（エボラ、デング、ジカ、チクングニア等）が同時に複数国で発生・懸念される中、国際的な大規模イベント（ワールドカップ）による急速な国際拡散リスクが極めて高い。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国の感染症発生を言及しているが、対象国リスト内で実際に検証可能な発生地域はDRCのみ（エボラアウトブレイク）。米国・カナダ・メキシコはワールドカップの開催地として記事の主題だが、対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Argentina, Cabo Verde, その他地域での事例も記述されているが対象国外のため除外。本件はDRCのエボラ発生と国際的な大規模イベント開催という組み合わせにおいて、極めて高い公衆衛生リスク。

article.articleHeadline: En el epicentro del brote de ébola en Congo: 'También hay otras enfermedades con potencial epidémico'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 'There are also other diseases with epidemic potential'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province (Bunia as epicenter). As of May 29, 2026, the WHO reports about 900 Ebola cases and 200 suspected deaths. Violence and displacement hinder contact tracing, with Bunia (population ~693,000) showing distrust toward the outbreak, especially among less educated groups. Médecins Sans Frontières is reinforcing with about fifty international staff alongside roughly 480 local workers, distributing PPE (3,000 items) to Bunia on May 19 and 60,000 PPE items from Europe expected by week’s end. The response includes opening a new Ebola Treatment Center in Mongbwalu and rehabilitating Munigi CTE in Goma (North Kivu) with capacity for 80 patients; adding an isolation ward at Kyeshero hospital. MSF is strengthening logistics, water and sanitation, waste management, and staff training to restore patient flow and revive facilities used during the last outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の震源地：『流行の可能性のある他の疾患も存在する』
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当する。進行中の大規模エボラウイルス病流行であり、死亡者が報告されており、国際的な対応が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 2026年5月29日時点で約900例のエボラ確定症例と200例の疑い死亡が報告されている。武力紛争と住民移動が接触者追跡を阻害しており、管理可能性に課題がある。国際NGO（MSF）が既に大規模対応を展開中。ウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは確認症例がDRC内に限定されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Should You Travel?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak concentrated in Northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of 28 May 2026, over 1,000 suspected cases and more than 240 suspected deaths; Uganda reports seven cases and one death, triggering a 27 May 2026 border closure with DRC. WHO indicates the epidemic may be spreading more rapidly, but the risk to travellers from non-affected countries remains extremely low. Canada and the United States have imposed travel restrictions, though LSHTM experts say travel bans are not the most effective way to support outbreak response and can divert critical resources. Core control measures include rapid case identification, isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention in healthcare settings, safe burial practices, and supportive care; air travel is not considered a high-risk route. Ebola incubation can be up to 21 days, with initial flu-like symptoms progressing to diarrhoea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Travellers from affected areas should monitor 21 days and seek care if symptoms develop; targeted restrictions for high-risk contacts may be warranted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生：渡航すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限）。対象国DRCで1,000件以上の患者および240件以上の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのコンゴ民主共和国東北部における主要な発生を記述しており、ウガンダへの越境拡大も言及している。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。米国とカナダの渡航制限は言及されているが、発生地はDRCである。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、高い死亡率（240+死亡）、越境拡大、複数国による渡航制限措置がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Director-General Visits Congo to Tackle Uncommon Ebola Outbreak Amidst Challenges of Distrust and Insecurity - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province near the Ugandan border, with cases also reported in North Kivu and South Kivu. As of Tuesday, 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths. No approved cure or vaccine for Bundibugyo Ebola. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Kinshasa to assess response amid equipment shortages, public distrust, and armed-group violence; health workers report using expired masks in some facilities. EU delivered vital medical supplies to Ituri; the United States pledged an additional $80 million, bringing total aid to over $112 million. Attacks on health centers are linked to burial protocols, while displacement reaches about 7 million in eastern Congo amid ongoing conflict with ADF and M23. Goma airport has been closed since Jan 2025, complicating relief efforts; WHO discourages travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、不信感と不安定性の課題の中でコンゴの珍しいエボラアウトブレイクに対処するために訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス（治療法・ワクチンなし）による重大なアウトブレイク、1,077疑似症例および238疑似死亡を伴う公衆衛生危機として、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）進行の判定。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラは致死率が高く、ワクチン・治療法が存在しない。記事はIturi州での新規アウトブレイク中心と記述。北キビュ州・南キビュ州での追加症例報告あり。ウガンダとの国境近接により国際的な拡大リスクが存在。武装勢力による暴力、保健センター攻撃、700万人規模の避難民という悪化要因が複合。Goma空港の1月2025年以来の閉鎖により人道支援活動が複雑化。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、米国による8000万ドル追加支援誓約、EU供給などから国際的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus Disease Emerging Global Health Challenge
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) originated near the Ebola River in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 1976, and is also referred to as Sudan Virus. Historically confined to African countries, the article portrays it as a new global pandemic. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids (blood, saliva, urine, sweat) and via contaminated needles, medical equipment, or clothing; it is not spread by airborne droplets. Fruit bats are natural hosts. Incubation is 2–21 days. Early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, and weakness, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, rashes, and bleeding; progression can lead to multi-organ failure and death. There is no cure, but early diagnosis with supportive care improves survival. Vaccines exist; prevention relies on hand hygiene, protective equipment, isolation, safe burial practices, and public awareness. Global cooperation and preparedness are essential to prevent and manage outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病：世界的保健課題として浮上
triage.triage_reason: エボラ病に関する一般的な情報記事であり、具体的な新規発生事例や流行が報告されていない。歴史的背景と予防知識の提供がメインで、緊急性を示す新規イベント情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラウイルス病の背景、症状、伝播経路、予防法に関する一般的な情報を提供しているが、具体的な現在の発生事例、症例数、または新規の流行情報を含んでいない。1976年のコンゴでの初発例が言及されているのみで、進行中のイベントとして確認できない。フルRRAの前段階の監視対象として継続追跡が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／伊波拉疫情升溫！疾管署：90天內禁止剛果、烏干達居民入境 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News / Ebola outbreak intensifies! CDC: 90-day entry ban for residents of Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Starting 2026-06-02 00:00, Taiwan will suspend visa issuance to residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda for 90 days, with existing visas not granting entry; four exceptions apply (admitted degree students, diplomats/civil servants, non-national spouses and their minor children of Taiwanese citizens, and urgent humanitarian cases like funerals or visiting gravely ill relatives). Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda have intensified; WHO on May 22 raised the regional risk to the highest level and declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). As of May 27, DRC reported 906 cases and 223 deaths, plus 125 additional confirmed cases with 17 deaths; Uganda reported 7 confirmed cases and 1 death, with hotspots in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Taiwan’s travel advisory reached Level 3; travelers with relevant travel history should report to quarantine stations and observe 21 days of self-health management. Port and border surveillance are strengthened under the Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Act.

triage.headline_ja: 速報／エボラ出血熱の流行が激化！疾病管理庁：90日間のコンゴ・ウガンダ国民の入国禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国での確定患者報告、死亡事例の確認、国際的な渡航制限実施されているため、フルRRA対象のシグナルと判定。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはウガンダ（226074）も含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは7確定患者・1死亡の報告があり、DRCと並んで言及されている。ただし対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。台湾（1668284）は対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月22日）、台湾による90日入国禁止、レベル3渡航警告など、公式な対応が確認されており、緊急度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief lands in Congo to address rare Ebola outbreak amid distrust and insecurity
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola strain with no approved treatment or vaccine, drives an outbreak centered in Ituri province, northeastern Congo near the Ugandan border. As of Tuesday, 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths have been reported. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to bolster response amid equipment shortages, distrust among residents, and attacks on health centers by armed groups. The conflict and mass displacement strain containment, with burial protocols clashing with local rites. Ituri’s insecurity, plus spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu where the Rwanda‑backed M23 controls key towns, complicates efforts; Goma airport has been closed since January 2025. Europe and the United States have pledged aid (EU supplies; US total over $112 million). The U.S. also announced temporary travel restrictions for people who had visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴを訪問し、不信と不安定な治安の中で稀なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対処
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo病毒による稀なエボラ株の発生で1,077例の疑い症例と238例の死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が現実化している。WHO事務局長の現地訪問により最高レベルの国際的関心が喚起されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo病毒は稀なエボラ株で承認済みの治療法やワクチンなし。武装勢力による保健センター攻撃、地域住民の不信、埋葬慣行との葛藤が対応を複雑化。Goma空港は2025年1月以降閉鎖。米国は200万ドル超の支援を約束し、コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダン訪問者への一時的渡航制限を発表。WHO事務局長による現地訪問は最高レベルの政治的関心を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الاشتباه بوفاة 223 شخصاً بـ "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 223 people suspected to have died from Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization reports an ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. There are 906 suspected Ebola cases, including 223 suspected deaths (roughly 24.6% of suspected cases). The country has 125 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, including 17 deaths, with 16 of the confirmed cases occurring in healthcare workers (12.8% of confirmed). These figures illustrate substantial transmission pressure and notable healthcare worker involvement, underscoring the continuing public health challenge posed by Ebola in the DRC. Both confirmed and suspected case counts reflect ongoing surveillance and testing efforts, with data underscoring the need for sustained public health interventions and infection prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴでエボラによる223人の死亡が疑われている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、エボラウイルス病は極めて重篤な感染症であり、DRCにおける継続的な流行は国際的な公衆衛生脅威である。深刻な死亡率（24.6%）と医療従事者への高い感染率が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を有する感染症であり、DRCにおける906件の疑い症例と223件の疑い死亡は重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示唆している。医療従事者への16件の確認感染（確認症例の12.8%）は、病院内感染制御の課題を浮き彫りにしている。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : une femme présentant des symptômes compatibles au choléra décédée à Kinseso - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: a woman presenting with symptoms compatible with cholera who died in Kinseso - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, DRC – A 39-year-old woman, Melengi Kafuti, died May 28, 2026 in Kisenso with symptoms compatible with cholera, notably persistent acute diarrhea. She had been treated at a local health centre; transfer to a better-equipped facility was advised but the family refused, and she returned home where, after prayers from a pastor who did not appear, she died in the evening. Because the death was potentially infectious, the mayor was informed and health authorities sent a team to assess the case and limit exposure. Urgent measures included a rapid burial at Lunda Cemetery in Kisenso to prevent any spread of the disease.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ：コレラと一致する症状を示して死亡した女性がキンセソで発見 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コレラ疑似症例の死亡報告。DRCの脆弱な保健システムでの発生は国際的拡大リスク、公開衛生上の重大性（IHR基準2つ以上該当）、およびスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 症例は疑似（symptoms compatible with cholera）であり、微生物学的確認待ちの状態。DRCは過去に複数のコレラ流行を経験しており、当該地域の衛生・保健基盤の脆弱性から感染拡大リスクが高い。家族が治療を拒否した経緯から、公衆衛生上のアクセス制限や情報提供に関する課題が存在する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Súd zablokoval americké karanténne centrum pre občanov s ebolou. V Keni hrozí štrajk lekárov
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A court blocked the American quarantine center for citizens with Ebola. In Kenya, a doctors' strike looms.
article.articleSummary: Kenyan court in Nairobi halted Washington's plan to establish a quarantine center in Kenya for Americans exposed to the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola from northeast DRC. The court blocked the agreement until a hearing on June 2, after objections. The United States had proposed housing exposed individuals outside the U.S., sending symptomatic patients to a third country; the exact Kenyan site was not disclosed, and Kenyan government involvement remained unclear. Washington offered $13.5 million. The challenge came from Katiba Institute and the Kenyan Bar Association, citing concerns over Kenya's capacity to safely operate such a facility. The Kenya Medical Association warned of a strike if the deal proceeds, arguing Kenya should not become a 'dumping ground' since the U.S. would not admit Ebola patients. In the DRC's northeast, Bundibugyo Ebola has more than 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths; Uganda reports seven cases and one death.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所がエボラ患者受け入れのための米国の隔離センター設立を阻止。ケニアでは医師のストライキの危機が迫る
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な感染拡大リスク、複数国での患者確認（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア）、国際的な感染症対応措置の失敗による公衆衛生上の懸念があり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。DRC北東部では1,000件以上の疑い患者と220以上の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRC北東部でBundibugyo株エボラが流行中（1,000+疑い患者、220+死亡）。ウガンダでも7例、1死亡確認。ケニアでは隔離施設計画が司法判断で阻止され、医療従事者のストライキリスクが生じている。記事の主題はケニア・DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行に関するもの。verified_locationsにはDRCとリスト上の対象国のみを記載し、ケニア（対象国リストにない）は除外した。

article.articleHeadline: لماذا لا يملك تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو حلا سريعا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the Ebola outbreak in Congo does not have a quick solution.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with suspected over 200 deaths; Uganda has faced prior outbreaks in 2007 and 2012. This rare Ebola species is less deadly than Zaire or Sudan ebolaviruses, and transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids of patients or the deceased, risking health workers. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms are non-specific (fever, fatigue, muscle pains, sore throat), complicating diagnosis. No approved treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo, though WHO prioritizes trials of three candidates: antibody therapies from Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron, and the antiviral remdesivir from Gilead. Vaccine candidates include the single-dose rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI) and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute of India), with readiness timelines of 7–9 months and 2–3 months, respectively, though animal data remain needed. Core measures include surveillance, testing, contact tracing, isolation, patient care, infection prevention in health facilities, community engagement, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: なぜコンゴのエボラ流行に迅速な解決策がないのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による200以上の死亡者が報告され、治療法・ワクチンが存在しないため管理困難性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀なエボラ種だが、200以上の死亡者が確認されており、承認済みの治療法やワクチンが存在しない。ウガンダは過去のアウトブレイク歴があるが、記事サマリーではコンゴでのみ現在のアウトブレイクが記述されている。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、主題は DRC の流行である。

article.articleHeadline: УНИЦЕФ испрати хуманитарна помош во Конго за да помогне во спречување на ширењето на еболата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF sent humanitarian aid to Congo to help prevent the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF delivered humanitarian aid to the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb the spread of Ebola, with European Union support, via an airlift transporting over 100 tons of medicines, medical supplies, hygiene items and PPE for frontline health workers. The relief, flown from UNICEF’s Copenhagen logistics hub and coordinated with the EU Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations, targets communities affected by displacement, conflict and limited access to basic services, benefiting nearly 100,000 people including children and families. As of 29 May 2026, Congo’s health ministry reports over 1,000 suspected Ebola cases in the eastern provinces. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the country to bolster containment efforts, emphasizing community involvement amid ongoing insecurity in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: UNICEFがコンゴへの人道支援物資を送付、エボラの拡大防止を支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の1,000件以上の疑い患者が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク（WHO事務局長による現地訪問）が認められる。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴの東部州で1,000件以上のエボラ疑い患者が報告されていることを述べており、WHO事務局長の現地訪問も確認できる。コペンハーゲンはUNICEF物流ハブの所在地であり、発生地域ではない。対象国リストに含まれる唯一の検証地点はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Мелони призова ЕС за координирани мерки срещу разпространението на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meloni urged the EU to take coordinated measures to curb the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Italy urged a coordinated EU response to Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote to EU leaders Ursula von der Leyen, Charles Michel, and Nikos Christodoulides calling for tighter border controls and harmonized health surveillance for travelers from affected regions, while respecting national public health powers. She proposed including Ebola border management on the EU Council summit agenda for 18–19 June 2026 and organizing a health ministers' video conference next week, with EPSCO discussions on 16 June to define concrete operational measures. Italy's Ministry of Health and Civil Protection has activated special protocols for arrivals from affected regions. It will also deploy a Spallanzani Institute team to Kinshasa to assist local authorities with technical support, medical supplies, and enhanced epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: メローニ首相がEU加盟国にエボラウイルス感染症の拡大抑制のための協調措置を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの拡大が確認されている。IHR基準では深刻な影響（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）が該当し、2基準以上を満たす。WPROスクリーニングでも重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさが示唆され、国際的な政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラの拡大がDRCとウガンダで発生していることを述べているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。イタリアがDRCのキンシャサにSpallanzani Institute チームを派遣する計画を示しており、国際的な関与度が高い。EU加盟国レベルでの協調対応が進行中であることが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: PIALA DUNIA FIFA 2026: Amerika, Mexico, Kanada umum langkah tangani risiko Ebola jelang kejohanan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA World Cup 2026: United States, Mexico, and Canada announce steps to address Ebola risk ahead of the tournament.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the United States, Canada, and Mexico announced aligned public-health travel measures to mitigate Ebola risk for travelers from high-risk African regions ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026. The joint statement from Global Affairs Canada says the coordinated approach aims to protect residents and the millions of fans, athletes, and tourists expected in North America, while preserving cross-border travel and trade. Canada is banning entry for residents of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan for 90 days, starting May 28, with arrivals from those countries subject to a 21-day quarantine. The World Cup will be hosted jointly by the United States, Mexico, and Canada from June 11, 2026. The article focuses on travel restrictions rather than detailing Ebola cases or outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: FIFA ワールドカップ 2026：米国、メキシコ、カナダがトーナメント前のエボラウイルス病リスク対策を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な懸念を示す連携措置が発表されているが、実際の患者発生やアウトブレイクの報告がなく、主に予防的な渡航制限措置の発表である。情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに米国、カナダ、メキシコ、スーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリーの詳細な読解に基づけば、エボラ患者の実際の発生が報告されているのはアフリカ地域（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）であり、北米諸国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）では予防的な公衆衛生措置の発表のみ。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。実際のアウトブレイク情報がないため段階は抑制的。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, hantavirus outbreaks raise questions about Trump's health agency cuts - AOL
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda has grown to more than 1,000 suspected cases, with seven Americans evacuated to Germany; no confirmed U.S. cases. The Bundibugyo strain has no proven vaccines or treatments. Meanwhile, a hantavirus outbreak linked to the MV Hondius expedition cruise ship—with almost 150 onboard—began with cases reported May 2; three of 11 infected passengers have died. The U.S. has imposed quarantines and tightened travel controls in response, while federal public health cuts under DOGE and layoffs at the CDC and FDA have drawn Democratic criticism urging a return to the World Health Organization and restoration of funding (including USAID). Officials insist the interagency response is ongoing and effective, with rapid testing and deployment in Congo and Uganda, though concerns persist about the outbreak’s scale and speed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ハンタウイルスの流行がトランプの保健当局削減について疑問を提起 - AOL
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ流行が1,000件超の疑似症例に達し、複数国への影響と国際的な対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ流行の主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダと明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsから除外。ハンタウイルス流行は米国の客船に関連しており、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。深刻度、蔓延可能性、管理可能性について評価が高く、複数の感染症イベントが同時に報告されている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Angola registra 13 casos de Mpox en dos provincias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola reports 13 Mpox cases in two provinces
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Angola reports 13 laboratory-confirmed Mpox cases in Cabinda and Uíge provinces, prompting border measures with the Democratic Republic of the Congo to curb cross-border spread. Health Minister Sílvia Lutucuta said Mpox cases have been diagnosed in Cabinda since last year and urged strict adherence to preventive practices. The Ministry is providing Mpox vaccine doses in border-adjacent districts and tightening epidemiological surveillance for Mpox and Ebola; no suspected Ebola cases have been reported, and border controls have been reinforced to identify potential cases and strengthen preventive actions. The situation underscores the need for vaccination, vigilant screening at entry points, and ongoing monitoring in the affected regions to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ、2つの州でMpox（痘そう）13症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。DRC との国境措置が発動され、国際的な関心と対応が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は主にアンゴラでのMpox発生について述べているが、Angora（ID: 3351879）は対象国リストに含まれていない。しかし、DRCとの国境措置が明記されており、DRC（対象国）も感染拡大リスクの文脈で言及されているため verified_locations に DRC を含める。Ebola共同監視についても言及されているが、疑い例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Pleads for Ceasefire in Eastern DRC as Ebola Outbreak Nears 1,000 Suspected Case - Ben Television | Breaking - Nigeria, Africa and World Top News.
article.articleSummary: WHO urged a temporary ceasefire in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo to allow safe access for Ebola response teams as a Bundibugjo-strain outbreak nears 1,000 suspected cases. The appeal targets armed groups to pause fighting amid ongoing conflict, displacement, and repeated attacks on health facilities in eastern Congo, including Beni and Ituri. As of May 27, the outbreak had about 1,000 suspected infections and at least 220 suspected deaths. Bundibugyo is a rarer Ebola variant with no approved vaccines or targeted treatments, complicating containment compared with Zaire-strain outbreaks. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged action to save lives. Health workers face threats; contact tracing and safe burials are hindered by distrust. International partners are boosting surveillance, treatment capacity, and cross-border monitoring, emphasizing community engagement to rebuild trust.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、東部DRC でのエボラ感染が1,000疑い例に近づく中、休戦を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株（Bundibugyo）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全基準該当。確認死亡220例を含む大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は珍しい亜種でワクチン非対応、治療法がない。紛争地域での発生により対応が複雑化。WHOが停戦を直接要請する異例の対応。DRC内17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。国際機関による監視強化と越境対策が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Director de la OMS llega al Congo para abordar brote de ébola entre desconfianza e inseguridad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General arrives in Congo to address an Ebola outbreak amid distrust and insecurity.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to witness firsthand efforts to fight an outbreak of a rare form of Ebola. Medical teams are contending with equipment shortages, public distrust, and the presence of armed groups in the region, factors that complicate response operations. Armed-group presence raises security risks for health workers and disrupts logistics, undermining containment measures. The visit highlights ongoing challenges in surveillance, case management, and protection of healthcare workers amid insecurity and constrained resources. The article does not provide outbreak size or case counts, but underscores international attention and the need for safe, timely interventions to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴにエボラ対策で到着、不信感と不安定性の中で
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生であり、IHR基準では深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク（4基準中3つ）に該当。WPROスクリーニングでは異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が確認でき、WHO事務局長の現地訪問という強い国際的関心・政治的関心が存在するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際的に極めて高い懸念疾患であり、WHO事務局長の直接訪問は国際的な対応が本格化していることを示唆。記事はケース数を示さないが、「稀な形態」との記述があり、特定の株に関する関心の可能性。武装勢力の存在による治療チームへのセキュリティリスク、医療機器不足、公的不信が対応を複雑化させている。全IHR基準とWPROスクリーニング基準に該当する最優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Teejan Bai Hospitalised at AIIMS Raipur: Renowned Folk Singer Critical After Lung Infection, Sepsis and Acute Kidney Injury
article.articleSummary: Padma Vibhushan awardee and Pandwani maestro Teejan Bai, 69, is critically ill and hospitalised in the Medical Intensive Care Unit at AIIMS Raipur, Chhattisgarh. She was admitted late on May 27 after a sudden health decline. Medical updates describe a constellation of life-threatening conditions: severe lung infection, bloodstream infection (sepsis), and acute kidney injury, with persistent hypotension. A multidisciplinary team—critical care specialists, pulmonologists, haematologists—has been coordinating round-the-clock treatment, and doctors have managed to stabilise her to some extent, though systemic infections and organ dysfunction continue to pose major risk. The report does not provide laboratory confirmation details or a clear infection source. As of May 29, 2026, government and AIIMS Raipur officials are offering full medical support to the veteran singer while prayers for her recovery circulate across Chhattisgarh and the cultural community.

triage.headline_ja: テージャン・バイがAIIMS ラージプルに入院：著名な民族歌手が肺感染、敗血症および急性腎障害で重篤状態
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者の重篤な健康状態の報告であり、公衆衛生的な感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。感染症のシグナルとしてのIHR基準およびWPRO基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は著名な民族歌手の個人の健康危機についての報道である。複数の感染症状（肺感染、敗血症）が記載されているが、感染源が特定されず、集団発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆する情報がない。医学的に重篤な個別症例であるが、感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外として判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat Ebola Scare: Congo Traveller's Fever Triggers Surveillance, 4 Quarantined As Tests Awaited - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: Gujarat quarantined four people after a Congo-returned businessman developed fever in Vadodara, prompting Ebola precautions amid outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. The 37-year-old Amori Lokola traveled from Africa to Mumbai before arriving in Gujarat, was admitted to Banker Hospital and shifted to Ahmedabad Civil Hospital’s Ebola isolation ward. Two co-travellers and a treating doctor were quarantined. Blood and diagnostic samples were sent for testing to determine Ebola or a similar infection; contact tracing and heightened surveillance at airports and hospitals are underway. The case centers on the Bundibugyo strain, a rare Ebola variant with no widely available vaccine, currently under WHO monitoring in Central and East Africa. India reports no confirmed Ebola case; the DGCA has advised airlines on passenger screening and onboard isolation. Officials have urged calm while tests are conducted.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州エボラ警戒：コンゴ帰りの旅行者の発熱が監視を引き起こし、検査待機中に4人が隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目中4項目該当。エボラウイルス疑い症例で対象国インドでの隔離・監視が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の感染症イベントというより『エボラ警戒事例』として報道されている。コンゴから帰国した旅行者が発熱し、エボラ疑いで隔離・検査中だが、現時点では確定症例ではない。しかし、アフリカでのエボラ流行（DRC、ウガンダ）との関連、国際的な旅行との連関、公式な監視体制の発動、検査結果待機中という点で、シグナル認識の優先度は高い。DRC、Uganda、Mozambique は発生地域に含まれているが、記事の主題は『インドでの警戒事例』であるため、verified_locations にはインドのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Pavojingas virusas gali pasiekti Europą: skausmas toks stiprus, kad žmonės nebegali išsitiesti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dangerous virus could reach Europe: the pain is so severe that people can no longer lie down.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya virus could reach Europe and North America as climate change expands the range of the Asian tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus). Zhejiang Chinese Medical University researchers warn that warming temperatures create ideal northward migration of this vector, raising the risk of local chikungunya transmission in major European and North American cities. Currently, chikungunya circulates mainly in Latin America, Africa, and Southeast Asia, with 139 countries listed as risk zones; the virus is seldom fatal but causes sudden fever and excruciating joint pain, sometimes so severe that patients cannot lie down. The pain can persist for months and cause temporary or permanent disability. Projections suggest central and northern Europe and northeast North America could become new epicenters by century’s end. Public health measures include vector surveillance, clinician training, and enhanced disinfection in large cities. No specific outbreak counts in the article.

triage.headline_ja: 危険なウイルスがヨーロッパに到達する可能性：痛みが非常に強く、人々はもはや横になることができない
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱のヨーロッパ・北米への潜在的な地理的拡大に関する警告記事。現在のアフリカ・東南アジアでの流行は記述されているが、具体的な患者数やアウトブレイク件数がなく、対象国内での実際の発生事例が明確でない。気候変動に伴う将来的なリスク警告が主要内容であるため、現時点では確定的なシグナルとはいえないが、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はZhejiang大学の研究者による将来的なリスク予測が主体であり、対象国内での現在の具体的なアウトブレイク事例は記載されていない。Chinaは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではアフリカ・東南アジアでの現在の流行とヨーロッパ・北米への将来的な拡大リスクが焦点であり、中国国内での具体的な感染事例は不明。アウトブレイク確認よりも気候変動に伴う疫学的リスク評価が主要内容のため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: 906 ύποπτα κρούσματα Έμπολα στο Κονγκό - Εξετάζονται 223 θάνατοι
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — 223 deaths under investigation.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, the World Health Organization reports 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 223 suspected deaths under investigation, linked to the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. The outbreak continues in the DRC, with further cases reported in neighboring Uganda. There are currently no vaccines or treatments approved specifically for Bundibugyo Ebola, according to WHO. Cross-border transmission risks complicate containment, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and rapid response measures. The figures reflect suspected cases and deaths under investigation, highlighting the ongoing public health challenge posed by this Ebola strain in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い患者906人 - 223人の死亡が調査中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は対象国（DRC）での大規模発生であり、フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模発生。906件の疑い症例、223件の死亡が報告されている。隣国ウガンダでも症例報告あり。特定の医学的対抗手段（ワクチン・治療薬）がないため管理困難性が高い。国際的な支援と監視体制が緊急に必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в ДРК осложняется конфликтом и отсутствием безопасности -- глава ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC is being complicated by conflict and lack of security — WHO chief
