article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) remains highly challenging due to conflict and security gaps, displacement, food shortages, and public distrust. More than 1,000 suspected cases and 238 deaths have been reported in eastern DRC, with the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain confirmed. The current outbreak is the 17th in DRC; the WHO and African CDC have designated it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, initially declared on May 17 for DRC and Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, arriving in Kinshasa, said support would be provided and plans to assess Bunia, capital of Ituri province. He opposed travel bans, urging strengthened on-site measures and a ceasefire in areas hit by armed attacks. Bunia is one of the affected areas where WHO teams are operating.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ発生は紛争と安全保障の欠如により複雑化 — WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的懸念が指定されており、WHOが公式に国際的関心の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は対象国リスト外のウガンダにも言及されているが、記事の主題はDRCでの発生であり、ウガンダは二次的な言及のため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、事務局長が現地訪問するなど国際的対応が活発化している。1,000件以上の疑い例と238名の死亡が報告されており、重症度と管理可能性の課題が顕著である。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل نحو 1130 حالة وفاة وإصابة بـ"إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية - شفق نيوز | آخر الأخبار العاجلة في العراق وكوردستان والعالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Around 1,130 deaths and Ebola infections recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Shafaq News | Latest breaking news in Iraq, Kurdistan and the world.
article.articleSummary: WHO reported about 1,130 Ebola-related deaths and infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and seven confirmed Ebola cases in Uganda, three of which originated from the DRC. In the DRC, 906 suspected Ebola cases have been identified, including 223 deaths under investigation to confirm whether Ebola is the cause. Among the infections, 125 have been laboratory-confirmed as Ebola, resulting in 17 deaths and 16 confirmed infections among health-care workers. Uganda’s seven confirmed Ebola cases include three cases that came from the DRC. The information underscores ongoing transmission across borders and the need for continued surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and infection-control efforts to limit further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による約1,130人の死者・感染者を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な集団発生で、IHR基準の複数該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）および死亡と確認症例が多く、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの症例は全てDRCからの越境感染であり、主要な流行地はDRCである。対象国リスト内にはDRCのみが含まれるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙した。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率と感染性を有し、越境感染が確認された状況は国際的な感染症危機管理の最優先事項。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths from Bundibugyo strain of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths under investigation, per WHO on 2026-05-29. There have been 125 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC, with 17 confirmed deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In Uganda, seven confirmed cases have been reported, three of which were imported from the DRC, and one death; no community transmission has been reported. The case fatality rate among confirmed infections is estimated at 30%–50%, though data are preliminary. There are currently no approved vaccines or therapies specifically for Bundibugyo virus disease, making early care potentially important to reduce fatalities. The outbreak features cross-border transmission between the DRC and Uganda, with ongoing laboratory confirmation and surveillance. Keywords: outbreak, cross-border, vaccination, Uganda, DRC, Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが、ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスによる疑い例906件と疑い死亡223件を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラの大規模流行で、DRCとウガンダ間の国境越え感染、高い致死率（30-50%）、ワクチン・治療法なしの状況は国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも記載されているが、サマリーではウガンダでの確認事例は輸入例（DRC由来）として言及されており、主流行地はDRC。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。ブンディブギョ株の大規模流行、国境越え伝播、高い致死率、ワクチン・治療法の欠如はすべて深刻な公衆衛生脅威。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы в ДРК вышла из-под контроля, признали местные врачи
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC got out of control, local doctors admit.
article.articleSummary: Doctors fighting Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo say the outbreak has spiraled out of control. Ituri Province authorities warned of a catastrophe if the response remains delayed or inadequate. Dr. Richard Kodjan of Ituri says the epidemic is 'completely out of control,' while Mongbvalu's chief hospital director Richard Lokudi says the disease is spreading in geometric progression. He also reported seven patients with suspected Ebola escaped from his hospital, creating transmission chains that complicate efforts to stop the spread. The WHO had previously deemed the Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. In DRC, as of 2026-05-29, 221 people have died with suspected Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能になった、現地医師が認める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目すべて満たし、WPRO基準も5項目すべて満たす。重大な公衆衛生上の脅威として国際的対応が必要な段階。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能状態にあることが現地医師により公式に認められた。221人の疑い死亡者、患者の逃亡による二次感染リスク、幾何学的な感染拡大が報告されている。WHOは既にこの流行を国際的懸念事項とする公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）に指定している。記事ではウガンダも言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCの流行である。

article.articleHeadline: Federal Government lists Lagos, Abuja, 19 states at high risk as Ebola outbreak spreads in Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Nigeria places Lagos, the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), and 19 states on high alert for potential Ebola importation as renewed outbreaks spread in East and Central Africa. Although no confirmed Nigerian cases yet, the NCDC warns risk is high due to international travel, porous borders, and trade. Outbreak currently in the DRC and Uganda (Bundibugyo strain), for which there are currently no approved vaccines or specific treatments, with 1,077 suspected cases and 247 deaths, predominately ages 14–45. Symptoms mimic malaria and Lassa fever early on, necessitating rapid detection; Ebola is not airborne and spreads via direct contact with infected blood, body fluids, contaminated surfaces, or animals. WHO has declared PHEIC, prompting Nigeria to strengthen preparedness: airport/border surveillance, isolation centres, PPE for frontline workers, and 72-hour readiness reporting. Nigeria previously faced an imported 2014 Lagos Ebola case that was contained through aggressive contact tracing and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱が広がる中、連邦政府がラゴス、アブジャ、19州を高リスク地域に指定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4項目全て満たし、WHOがPHEICを宣言しているエボラ出血熱の地域的脅威。ナイジェリアは準備段階ながら、DRC・ウガンダの現在の流行から国際的拡大リスクが高く、予防可能な疾患制御が困難な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはナイジェリアの準備状況と警戒を報じていますが、実際の進行中の流行はDRCとウガンダにあり、ナイジェリアはまだ確認された症例がない状態。ただしDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙。ナイジェリア自体は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言により国際的関心・支援需要は高い。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ για Έμπολα: Στα 906 τα ύποπτα κρούσματα στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO on Ebola: 906 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization reports 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 223 suspected deaths under investigation potentially linked to the illness. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain and continues to spread within DRC, with additional cases detected in neighboring Uganda, raising regional concern. There are no approved vaccines or specific therapies for infections caused by this Bundibugyo lineage. Health authorities are maintaining epidemiological surveillance and situational assessment to understand transmission dynamics, confirm cases, and evaluate cross-border risk. The article cites Reuters as its information source.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラについて報告：コンゴ民主共和国での疑い例906件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の本格的な地域流行であり、WHOによる公式報告として信頼度が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、サマリーでは「neighboring Uganda」と記述されており、主な発生地がDRCで、ウガンダは隣国での追加例検出という二次的な言及であるため、対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないことと合わせて、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo株の出現、治療法不在、223件の死亡が疑われるなど、重症度・管理可能性の指標が高い。

article.articleHeadline: İtalya, AB'den "Ebola'ya karşı sınır güvenliğinde güçlendirilmiş koordinasyon" istedi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy asks the EU for "enhanced coordination in border security against Ebola."
article.articleSummary: Italy appeals to the EU for enhanced border-security coordination amid Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. In the DRC’s Ituri province, the outbreak has 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; authorities declared the outbreak on May 15, and WHO declared an international health emergency on May 17. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatment or vaccine. Italy’s response includes targeted health surveillance and entry screening for travelers from affected areas, coordinated by the Health Ministry and Civil Protection. Rome is sending a specialist team from the Spallanzani Institute to Kinshasa to provide technical support and supply medicines and equipment. In DRC, an Italian MSF doctor who operated on an Ebola-infected child and a female doctor who tested positive yesterday were placed under 21-day quarantine. Meloni urged that border-management be on the European Council agenda for June 18–19, 2026, with EPSCO on June 16 and a Health Ministers’ video conference next week to set operational priorities.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア、EBOLAに対する国境警備強化で欧州連合に調整協力を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（DRCで246疑い例、65死亡）、WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、複数国での確認（DRC・ウガンダ・イタリアへの波及リスク）、国境管理・渡航制限措置が既に実施中。国家・EU首脳部の政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はイタリアとウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーで明確に発生が確認されているのはDRCのイトゥリ州のみ。イタリアはWHO国際保健上の緊急事態に応じた対応国であり、ウガンダは『outbreaks in...Uganda』と記載されているが詳細が不明。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定した。Bundibugyo株は治療法・ワクチンが承認されていない点、WHO緊急宣言が発令済みである点も重要な危機シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya court suspends opening of US Ebola quarantine centre
article.articleSummary: Kenya on 29 May 2026 temporarily halted the planned opening of a US Ebola quarantine centre for Americans arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo, amid a major Ebola outbreak there. The Laikipia Air Base facility would host 50 isolation beds and be operated by US medical staff about 200 km from Nairobi. A conservatory court order restrains establishing any Ebola exposure, quarantine, isolation or treatment facility in Kenya; the government must respond within 48 hours, with a June 2 hearing set. Kenya has no reported Ebola cases and has been screening arrivals from DRC. The December health deal with the US is challenged by Katiba Institute over secrecy and constitutional concerns; Kenyan doctors threaten industrial action if negotiations are not public. Africa-wide, about $498.8 million has been pledged to combat what has rapidly become the second-largest Ebola outbreak yet, with 12 countries imposing travel restrictions and Africa CDC warning of potential regional spillover.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所、米国のエボラ隔離施設の開設を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴでの大規模エボラ流行に伴い、12カ国が渡航制限を実施し、Africa CDC が地域的流出の警告を発出。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはケニア（Nairobi、Laikipia）も含まれているが、サマリーの主題は DRC での大規模エボラ流行であり、ケニアでは報告症例なし。対象国リストに DRC のみ含まれるため verified_locations は DRC のみとした。ケニアは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Taliansko žiada EÚ o prísnejšie hraničné kontroly v dôsledku epidémie eboly
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy asks the EU for stricter border controls due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Europe calls for tighter border controls as Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Italy asks the EU to strengthen border surveillance and direct/indirect arrivals from affected areas, with a Spallanzani Institute in Rome dispatched to Kinshasa to provide aid and medicines. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni sent a letter to EU leaders urging coordination under the European Council's June 18–19 meeting, and requested a video conference of health ministers next week. The World Health Organization reports, since May 15, at least 10 confirmed and 223 suspected deaths from over 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases. Uganda reports one death and six additional cases; the true extent is likely larger. Italy has activated health surveillance and monitoring protocols for travelers returning from these two African nations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に伴い、イタリアがEUに厳格な国境管理を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。社会的・政治的関心が高く、国際的支援・調整の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が記事の主題。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはイタリア・ローマが含まれているが、サマリー上ではイタリアは支援提供国・対応国であり、実際の流行発生地はDRCおよびウガンダ。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。WHOが5月15日以降1,000件以上の確定・疑い例、少なくとも233名の死亡を報告しており、深刻な流行が進行中。EU各国レベルでの政治的対応・調整が高まっており、国際的な懸念が明確。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果再爆伊波拉疫情 無國界醫生：衝突與援助縮減恐加劇擴散
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Doctors Without Borders warns that conflict and reduced aid could worsen the spread.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with case fatality estimated at 25–40%. Officially declared May 15, the virus had circulated in communities for weeks, highlighting a fragile health system amid ongoing armed conflict and humanitarian crisis. Security-related incidents include May 22 arson at a hospital tent in Mongwalu and May 23 the death of a religious leader infected with Ebola amid burial disputes. MSF warns that reductions in donor aid, including US support, are curtailing vaccination, malaria control, HIV/TB treatment, and child-nutrition programs, hindering surveillance and containment. Eastern DRC hosts over 5 million internally displaced people, mainly in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri, with 96% displaced by conflict and many lacking safe water and basic care. MSF has set up a 60-bed Ebola treatment center in Mongwalu, supports local services, and collaborates with MoH/WHO, urging international support to sustain routine health services during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が再び流行 国境なき医師団：紛争と援助削減が感染拡大を悪化させる恐れがあると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による確定的なエボラ出血熱の流行が公式に宣言され、致命率25-40%、複数の死亡例、武装紛争による医療施設への攻撃、国際的な援助削減によるサーベイランス低下など、国際的な懸念事項が複合している。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus の確定的な検出、公式宣言（2026年5月15日）、複数の死亡例、医療施設への武装グループによる攻撃、550万人以上の国内避難民が居住する脆弱な環境が確認されている。国際的な支援削減がワクチン接種やHIV/TB治療にも影響。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Италия на крак! Мелони иска спешни мерки заради разпростране...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy on its feet! Meloni seeks urgent measures due to the spread...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts urgent EU and Italian measures. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged stricter border controls on arrivals from affected areas and called for an EU health-ministers' emergency videoconference to discuss risks and preventive actions ahead of the June EU summit. Since May, WHO reports over 1,000 confirmed and suspected Ebola cases across DRC and Uganda, with 10 confirmed deaths and more than 220 suspected deaths in the DRC; Uganda has one confirmed death and several infections. Italy has activated health surveillance protocols for travelers from affected African regions; a team from Rome's Spallanzani Hospital will travel to Kinshasa to assist local authorities with expertise, medicines, and equipment. WHO cautions that the true extent is likely larger, underscoring early measures and strict border controls.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアが危機的状況に！メローニ首相がエボラの拡大に対する緊急措置を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の対象国での確認例、死亡例、既存死亡者の報告により、フルRRA対象のシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでエボラの発生が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。イタリアはキンシャサへの医療支援チーム派遣を計画しており、国際的な対応体制が構築されている。WHO報告では5月以来1,000例以上の確認・疑い例（DRC：10死亡確認、220以上疑い死亡；ウガンダ：1死亡確認、複数感染）が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, allo Spallanzani la dottoressa (negativa al virus) a contatto coi malati in Congo. La premier Meloni alla Ue: "Coordinare la vigilanza alle frontiere"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, at Spallanzani the doctor (virus-negative) in contact with patients in Congo. Prime Minister Meloni to the EU: "Coordinate border surveillance."
article.articleSummary: Ebola-related update as of 29 May 2026: a virus-negative Ebola doctor who had contact with patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (and linked to the Bundibugyo virus, Bvd) was flown on a biocontainment flight to Rome, immediately taken to the Spallanzani Institute and placed in isolation and observation at the Portuense facility. The notification follows the Bundibugyo outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, via Palazzo Chigi, urged the European Union to coordinate stronger border surveillance with common rules for managing direct and indirect arrivals from affected zones. A task force of Italian physicians is ready to depart with medical supplies if needed. The government emphasizes heightened epidemiological vigilance in central Africa and seeks reinforced border controls while respecting national health prerogatives.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、スパランツァーニ研究所でコンゴの患者と接触した医師（ウイルス陰性）が治療中。メローニ首相がEUに「国境監視の調整」を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス関連の国際的イベント（DRC・ウガンダでの発生、イタリアへの患者輸送・隔離）であり、IHR基準において「異常性」「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限リスク」に該当。政府・国際機関レベルの対応が既に開始されており、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのBundibugyo virus（エボラの亜種）の発生状況を主題としており、DRC内での継続的な曝露・拡大リスクが明確。ウガンダでの確認報告もあるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。イタリアへの患者輸送は管理下での医療対応であり、コミュニティ内での拡大リスクは低い。ただし国際的警戒態勢（EU国境監視の強化要請）が発動されていることは社会政治的関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo người dân hạn chế đến vùng dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health advises the public to limit travel to Ebola-affected regions.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; no approved vaccine or treatment. As of May 27, 2026, Congo: 1,077 suspected cases, 238 suspected deaths; 121 confirmed, 17 deaths. Uganda: 7 confirmed, 1 death. Combined: 128 confirmed, 18 deaths. In Congo, transmission across 14 health zones in 3 provinces, mainly Ituri; hotspots Rwampara, Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde. Contact tracing hampered by insecurity and mobility, especially mining areas and near borders. Some Uganda cases are importations from Congo to Kampala through travel and close contact. WHO: very high national risk in Congo, high regional risk (including Uganda), low global risk. Vietnam’s Department of Preventive Medicine coordinates with WHO and US CDC, advising the public to limit travel to affected regions, seek medical care after exposure, and maintain surveillance and border controls.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省はエボラウイルス感染地域への渡航制限を国民に勧告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク、128確認例・18死亡例、複数国への国際拡大リスク、国境近くの鉱山地域での感染制御困難により、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。フルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー内でウガンダ（Uganda）への波及も言及されているが、発生地域リストのGeoNames IDではウガンダが対象国リスト外（226074）のため、verified_locationsには含めない。コンゴは対象国リスト内（203312）。ベトナム記事はコンゴでのアウトブレイク対応としての渡航勧告であり、ベトナム国内での発症例は記載されていないが、ベトナムの公衆衛生当局が公式対応を発表しており、シグナル対象国として含める。

article.articleHeadline: Church leaders fight misinformation in DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) escalates: officially declared May 15, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. About 250 people have died and over 1,000 suspected cases have been reported. Affected areas include North Kivu and Goma amid ongoing conflict with government forces, the M23 militant group, and Islamist militants. Faith leaders voice concern and are central to risk communication, countering misinformation. Churches are distributing posters and implementing prevention measures such as disinfectants, face coverings, social distancing, and handwashing. Tearfund is collaborating with over 500 faith leaders across districts to disseminate prevention messages, aiming to reach thousands to curb transmission. The situation highlights the intersection of public health and security, and the vital role of community leaders in outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCエボラ発生でコミュニティ指導者らが誤情報と闘う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO PHEIC宣言、250人の死亡、1000人以上の疑い例報告により、シグナルとして識別。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 配信日時が2026年5月となっており、記事の年号が不自然だが、記事内容の疫学的データと公開情報の照合が必要。サマリーに記載されたWHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、死亡数250人、疑い例1000人以上、北キブ州とゴマでの発生という情報が、実際のエボラ危機と一致するか確認を要する。北キブ州での紛争状況（M23、イスラム過激派）が危機管理の複雑性を増しており、セキュリティリスクも高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Quénia bloqueia centro de quarentena para norte-americanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya blocks quarantine center for Americans.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court blocked plans to establish any Ebola quarantine or exposure facility for Americans or other foreign governments, and barred entry of exposed or infected individuals, in response to a reported US–Kenya arrangement linked to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. Judge Patricia Mande issued the injunction, with a next hearing set for Tuesday. The Katiba Institute NGO sued the attorney general and health minister, accusing the talks of lacking transparency and constitutional accountability after The New York Times reported discussions about relocating exposed Americans to Kenya’s Laikipia base. US officials described a two-phase plan: first, a quarantine unit for 50 people on Kenyan soil; then biocontainment/isolation facilities and transfers to specialized hospitals. The AU reports 246 suspected Ebola deaths in DRC and eight confirmed Ugandan cases, including one death. Ebola transmission involves contact with blood or body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニアが米国人の検疫センター設置をブロック
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的取り組み、渡航制限リスク）該当。DRCとウガンダでの確認事例、ケニアでの国家レベルの司法判断を伴う政治的緊張が存在。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの検疫施設ブロックであるが、実際のエボラ発生はDRC（246人の疑い死亡）とウガンダ（8確認事例、1死亡）で報告されている。ケニア（Laikipia）は曝露者の隔離予定地であり、発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。同様にケニアも対象国リストにないため除外。国際的な政治的緊張と感染症危機管理の関連が高く、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : الصحة العالمية: الاشتباه في 906 إصابات و223 وفاة بسلالة من إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: WHO: 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths from an Ebola strain.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 906 suspected Ebola cases and 223 deaths currently under investigation, according to the World Health Organization on May 29, 2026. The outbreak remains active in the DRC, with additional cases reported in Uganda. The report notes that there are no vaccines or therapies specifically approved for this Bundibugyo strain. The available information indicates ongoing surveillance and evaluation of suspected infections and fatalities; no further laboratory-confirmed results are detailed in the article. The cross-border dimension underscores regional public health concerns between the DRC and Uganda, highlighting the need for vigilant monitoring and rapid response measures to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サラヤ通信社：WHO：エボラ出血熱の一種で906人の感染疑い例と223人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の国境を超えた拡大、死亡者を伴う重篤な公衆衛生事象として、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるアウトブレイク。記事にウガンダへの症例報告も言及されているが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの活動中のアウトブレイク、ワクチン・治療法未承認という重大な公衆衛生リスク。国際的関心が高い事象。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief in capital of Ebola-hit DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reaches its 17th outbreak, centered in Ituri with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. Declared May 15, the outbreak has at least 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths (Africa CDC, as of May 28); the true reach may be wider as laboratory capacity is limited. The Bundibugyo strain drives this outbreak; no vaccine or specific treatment exists, though a vaccine could be ready by year-end and WHO advisory groups have recommended clinical trials for vaccines and therapies. Ituri is insecure due to militants and militias, with nearly a million displaced in camps, raising transmission risks. Uganda has seven confirmed infections (one death) and Rwanda has closed its border. The DRC’s capital Kinshasa hosts WHO chief Tedros, who planned to visit Ituri but pushed back a day while Congolese authorities coordinate response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に見舞われたコンゴ民主共和国の首都を訪問するWH事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス疾患は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、複数国への国際的拡大が既に発生しており、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダとルワンダが含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダが7例の確認感染者を報告し、ルワンダが国境を閉鎖したと述べられている。これらは国境を接する近隣国への拡大の報告であり、主たる発生地はDRCである。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。17番目の勃発、限定的なラボ検査体制、不安定な治安、大規模な避難民キャンプなど、管理可能性に関する懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat: 8 Lion Cubs Die in Gir in Suspected Babesiosis Cases; No New Deaths in 48 Hours
article.articleSummary: Eight lion cub deaths in Gujarat's Gir landscape are suspected to be due to babesiosis, with no fresh deaths in the last 48 hours. Deaths occurred in cubs from revenue areas outside the protected Gir sanctuary, notably Gir Gadhada taluka and Babarkot in Amreli district. Laboratory samples from the deceased have been sent to the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre; results are expected in 3–4 days to confirm babesiosis as the cause. Forest officials say the situation is under control and have intensified surveillance, vaccination, treatment, and de-ticking drives. Lions within a 10-km radius of affected zones have been isolated and observed. Teams from the forest department and Junagadh Veterinary College are deployed; expert assistance from the Union government or wildlife specialists may be sought if needed. The Gir ecosystem remains under scrutiny as part of ongoing wildlife disease management.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：ギール地域で8頭のライオンの子が疑い性バベシア症で死亡；過去48時間で新たな死亡なし
triage.triage_reason: 動物での疑い性バベシア症の集団死であり、公衆衛生への直接的な影響は不明だが、同定の不確実性と環境監視の需要から経過観察が適切。人への感染リスク情報がないため、現時点ではフルRRA対象外。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物（ライオンの子）での疑い性バベシア症の集団死であり、記事に人への感染例・リスク、国際的な拡大の懸念がない。バベシア症の確定診断は未確認（3-4日で結果待ち）。グジャラート州ギール地域の野生動物疾病管理の継続的な監視が行われている。人獣共通感染症としてのリスク潜在性があるため継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: В ДР Конго зарегистрировано свыше 900 предполагаемых случаев заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases registered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: 906 suspected Ebola cases have been registered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, including 223 deaths, with figures currently under verification by health authorities. The World Health Organization reports an ongoing outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with isolated cases also detected in Uganda. The WHO emphasizes that there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for this strain at present. The information is conveyed by WHO via Report, which cites Reuters for the update. The data are current as of May 29, 2026, reflecting that Uganda has reported additional cases alongside the Congolese outbreak. No further vaccine or treatment details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの疑い例が900例以上報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生（906例、死亡223例）であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。国際的な公衆衛生の脅威であり、ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも症例が報告されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での発生であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）であり、ワクチン・治療法の不在が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola : " Même si la situation est complexe, je pense qu'on peut arrêter cette chose ", assure le chef de l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: "Even if the situation is complex, I think we can stop this thing," assures the WHO chief.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, centered in Ituri with spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu. The affected areas are among world's poorest and are hard to access due to armed violence by ADF rebels linked to Islamic State and militias; large areas are controlled by M23, along borders with Rwanda. There is no specific treatment or vaccine for Bundibugyo; by contrast the historical Zaire (Zaïre) Ebola variant has a licensed vaccine. Africa CDC pledges to have a vaccine and a therapeutic by end-2026. WHO advisory groups have recommended clinical trials for several vaccines and treatments against Bundibugyo. WHO Director-General Tedros visited Kinshasa to assess the situation and offer support, stressing that it can be stopped. Border closures by Uganda and Rwanda are not recommended; such measures hinder surveillance. The US reportedly plans to open a quarantine center in Kenya for suspected/confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行：「状況は複雑だが、これを止めることができると思う」とWHO事務局長が確言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異株による新規エボラ流行は国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク高く、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異株は既知ワクチン非対応で、Ituri・North Kivu・South Kivu州での流行確認。隣接国（ウガンダ・ルワンダ）でも監視強化が必要。米国のケニア隔離施設整備計画は国際的対応の深刻さを反映。2026年のワクチン/治療薬開発予定だが現時点では対応手段限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch bệnh Ebola tiếp tục diễn biến phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak continues to evolve in a complex manner.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to evolve, with rising case numbers and transmission risk; no vaccine or approved treatment is available. As of 27 May the DRC reported 1,077 suspected cases (238 deaths suspected) and 121 confirmed cases (17 deaths). Uganda reported 7 confirmed cases (1 death). Total: 128 confirmed cases and 18 deaths; figures may be updated as investigations and testing proceed. In DRC, transmission has been detected in 14 health zones across three provinces, concentrated in Ituri, with Rwampara, Bunia, Mongbwalu, and Nyankunde among the high areas. Uganda’s confirmed cases are Congo-imports to Kampala, linked to travel and close contact via transport and medical care. WHO assessment: very high regional risk in DRC and high regionally, including Uganda; global risk is low. MOH measures include surveillance, updated guidelines, border controls, infection prevention, risk communication, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行が複雑に推移を続ける
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は重度で予想外の国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ・ルワンダ）であり、IHR基準4項目中3項目以上該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、WHO評価による地域的高リスク判定も加わる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCが主要発生地であり、ウガンダへの輸入症例が報告されている。ルワンダはBluedot APIが推定していますが、記事サマリーではルワンダについて具体的な症例報告はなく、発生地として明記されていないため verified_locations から除外しました。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行であり、WHOが地域的高リスク（DRC・ウガンダ）と評価している点が重要。フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 906 Suspected Cases and 223 Suspected Deaths From Bundibugyo Strain of Ebola, WHO Says
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization reported 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 223 suspected deaths under investigation, as the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola drives ongoing transmission. The outbreak also has reported cases in Uganda, underscoring cross-border risk between DRC and neighboring countries. There are currently no approved vaccines or therapies specifically for Bundibugyo virus disease, limiting targeted medical countermeasures and leaving management reliant on general outbreak response measures. The WHO statement emphasizes that the infections are still under investigation and that no strain-specific treatments exist, complicating containment across affected regions. The report highlights the global health significance of this Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak and the health system challenges it poses for the DRC and Uganda as of May 29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 906例の疑い患者と223人の疑い死者がブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスから報告、WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、異常な病原体株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、エボラウイルスの国際的流行としてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ブンディブギョ株は稀な株で承認された特異的治療法やワクチンがない点が管理困難性を増す。DRCは対象国であり、クロスボーダーリスクが明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF hitno šalje pomoć Kongu zbog širenja epidemije ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF urgently sends aid to the Congo due to the spread of the Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF urgently sends aid to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to curb the spreading Ebola epidemic. More than 100 metric tons of relief items—personal protective equipment for frontline health workers, medicines, hygiene supplies and medical commodities—were airlifted with EU support to bolster the outbreak response. The shipment is expected to sustain nearly 100,000 people, including children and families in communities already dealing with displacement, conflict, and limited access to essential services. Items were flown from UNICEF's supply hub in Copenhagen via a specialized humanitarian air service backed by the EU's Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations. A health ministry report said suspected Ebola cases in the DRC surpassed 1,000 amid rising transmission in eastern provinces. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus arrived to bolster containment, highlighting challenges from displacement and insecurity and urging community preventive measures, as of May 29, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフがエボラ流行拡大に対するコンゴへの支援を緊急送付
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（疑い例1,000件超）で深刻な公衆衛生影響あり。IHR基準3項目該当（重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO事務局長が現地入りするほどの国際的関心の高さから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はハイインパクト疾患。DRCでの発生が記事の主題。疑い例1,000件超、東部州での感染拡大、国連事務局長の現地訪問、EU支援による大規模人道支援展開など複数の高リスク指標が認められた。デンマーク・コペンハーゲンはUNICEFの支援物資ハブの所在地であり、発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Court Blocks US-Backed Ebola Quarantine Facility in Kenya - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: Kenya's High Court, presided by Justice Patricia Nyaundi, temporarily blocked the United States' plan to establish an Ebola quarantine facility in Kenya, ordering that anyone exposed to or infected with Ebola not be admitted under the proposed arrangement until the court resolves the case. The injunction followed a constitutional challenge by the Katiba Institute, which labeled the deal secretive and unilateral and raised concerns about public health, citizens' rights, and government transparency. The White House had confirmed plans to quarantine Ebola-exposed American citizens in Kenya rather than repatriating them after symptom onset. A hearing is set for June 2. The ruling comes amid heightened concern over the latest Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with neighboring countries on alert; the Kenyan case centers on procedural public participation and parliamentary oversight for the agreement.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所が米国支援のエボラ隔離施設をブロック - ディアスポラ・デジタル・メディア（DDMニュース）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生脅威だが、本記事の主題はケニアにおける隔離施設の法的問題であり、実際の患者発生イベントではない。DRCにおけるアウトブレイク継続の可能性と米国のバイオセキュリティ対応動向に注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの法廷による隔離施設計画のブロックであり、ケニア自体でのエボラ患者発生ではない。DRCでのアウトブレイク継続が背景にあり、国際的な感染症対応・バイオセキュリティの政治的側面を示唆している。サマリーでDRCのアウトブレイク状況が言及されているため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : le gouverneur militaire rassure sur la sécurité des centres de traitement d'Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: the military governor reassures about the security of Ebola treatment centers | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, military governor General Johnny Luboya Nkashama announced reinforced security measures to protect Ebola treatment centers and response teams during the ongoing outbreak, delivered at Bunia in a joint press briefing with health and communications ministers. He attributed recent incidents in the Rwampara and Mongbwalu health zones to misinformation and rumors rather than targeted attacks on medical facilities. Security services remain mobilized to safeguard treatment centers and support field teams. Nkashama lauded community leaders for their role in awareness campaigns, noting growing adherence to preventive measures. Authorities urged residents to collaborate with response teams and to curb false information that could jeopardize the Ebola response. No case or death counts are provided in the brief.

triage.headline_ja: Ituri: 軍事知事がエボラ治療センターの安全性について安心感を示唆
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行が確認されており、IHR基準の重大な公衆衛生影響（Yes）と異常性（Yes）の2つ以上に該当。対象国DRCでの活動中の流行イベントとして、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州でのエボラ流行の継続と、政府当局による治療センター保護対策の発表を報道している。Rwandaは発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリー上ではDRCが主題であり、ルワンダでの発生確認は記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。症例数・死亡数が記事に明示されていないため、重症度については'不明'と判定。ただし、進行中の流行イベントとしての社会的・政治的関心は明確に高い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о 906 возможных случаях заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported 906 possible cases of Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization reports an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo with 906 suspected cases and 223 deaths. WHO official Anais Lega told a Geneva briefing that investigations are ongoing and the case count will change as testing capacity expands, indicating these figures are preliminary and subject to laboratory confirmation. The update highlights the evolving nature of the outbreak amid ongoing surveillance, rather than finalized diagnoses. The briefing follows earlier remarks from WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus about traveling to the DRC in response to the flare-up. No district-level details, transmission sources, or specific containment measures are provided in the report beyond noting expanding testing capacity. The information reflects continued international attention and the dynamic status of the Ebola situation in the DRC as of the published date.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ感染の可能性のある906件の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は最高レベルの危機管理対象病であり、確認された地域は対象国DRCである。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはGenève（スイス）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではエボラ発生は民主共和国コンゴで発生しており、ジュネーブはWHOブリーフィングの開催地であるため、実際の感染発生地はDRCのみと判定。906件の疑い症例と223人の死亡が報告されており、重症度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports 906 suspected Ebola cases, 223 deaths from Bundibugyo strain
article.articleSummary: 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 223 suspected deaths and cases also detected in Uganda, are linked to the Bundibugyo strain; investigations are ongoing. No approved vaccines or treatments exist specifically for Bundibugyo. Three experimental treatments are identified as potential options: MBP134 (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), maftivimab (Regeneron), and remdesivir (Gilead), all requiring clinical trials to establish efficacy. Regeneron reports maftivimab supplies available in Congo for rapid inclusion in studies if WHO approves. For post-exposure prevention, obeldesivir (Gilead) is noted as a possible option, contingent on rapid contact tracing. Vaccine candidates reviewed include rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI), potentially entering human trials in 7–9 months; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute) could be ready for testing in 2–3 months; Merck’s Ervebo remains unproven for Bundibugyo and should be used only in research. Combination trials of antibody therapies with remdesivir are under consideration.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがBundibugyo株由来の疑い例906件、死亡223件を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の株、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理性で該当。既知の治療法がなく、複数国での発生。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIで発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「cases also detected in Uganda」と二次的に記載されており、主要な発生地はDRCである。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。Bundibugyo株は稀で予想外の株系統。既承認の特異的ワクチン・治療法がなく、研究段階の治療候補のみ。
