article.articleHeadline: Hotter Days and Tiny Plastics: Unexpected Forces Accelerating the Superbug Crisis
article.articleSummary: From 480,000 Salmonella genomes (1940–2023) across 139 countries, antimicrobial-resistance (AMR) genes rose 10% worldwide, with 82 of 100 countries detailed showing increases. Climate warming accounts for about 25% of the 38% rise in resistant Salmonella since 2010, hitting hotter regions—Latin America, the Caribbean, and parts of Asia and the Pacific—most strongly, and intensifying after 2010. Extreme precipitation, via flooding, spreads resistance through aquatic systems; drought concentrates antibiotic residues, creating transmission hotspots. Insecticide overuse adds selective pressure. Published in The Lancet Planetary Health, the Tobit-model study argues climate mitigation should accompany antimicrobial stewardship. Separately, microplastics provide surfaces for dense biofilms and horizontal gene transfer; Escherichia coli exposed to plastics developed multi-drug resistance with thicker, more protective biofilms. Earlier work (2018 in Germany, Costa Rica, the U.K.; a March study; Xiamen Bay findings) also links plastics to higher resistance and gene transfer.

triage.headline_ja: より暑い日々と微小プラスチック：スーパーバグ危機を加速させる予期しない要因
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性菌（Salmonella、E. coli）の世界的な増加傾向に関する大規模疫学研究が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（予想外性、長期的曝露リスク、管理可能性）に該当するが、具体的な流行アウトブレイク事象ではなく、科学論文に基づく疫学分析であるため情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事はThe Lancet Planetary Healthに掲載された薬剤耐性に関する大規模国際研究を報告している。対象国リストではChina（厦門湾）のみが該当する具体的なロケーションとして言及されている。米国（Missouri）、ドイツ、コスタリカ、英国は対象国リストに含まれていない。本事象は特定のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、全世界的な薬剤耐性菌増加の傾向分析であり、気候変動とマイクロプラスチックとの関連性を示唆している点で科学的に重要である。

article.articleHeadline: Why the Congo Ebola outbreak has no quick fix
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, the rare orthoebolavirus strain suspected to have killed more than 200 people, has no licensed treatments or vaccines. WHO gathered experts to prioritize candidate therapies for trials: Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron's antibody treatments, and Gilead's remdesivir; Mapp's antibody was developed for Sudan virus but may be usable against Bundibugyo. On vaccines, several candidates show promise but none is ready. The most advanced, rVSV Bundibugyo from IAVI, would require seven to nine months before clinical trial assessment; ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford/Serum Institute of India could reach efficacy testing in two to three months, though further animal data are needed. Incubation is two to 21 days; transmission occurs via close contact with sick or deceased patients' bodily fluids, putting health workers at high risk. The outbreak response relies on decades-old tools: surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ爆発に迅速な解決策はない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（200人以上の死亡）、予想外の稀なオルソエボラウイルス株、および国際的懸念を満たす。WPRO基準でも重症度（高い致命率）と管理可能性（治療法・ワクチンなし）が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）におけるブンディブギョウイルスアウトブレイクに焦点を当てている。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはIndiaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではIndiaはワクチン開発（ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo from Oxford/Serum Institute of India）の背景的な言及に過ぎず、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではないため除外した。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: El director de la OMS visita el Congo para enfrentar el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO director visits the Congo to tackle the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to oversee the Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo near the Uganda border. As of Tuesday, 1,077 suspected cases and 238 deaths have been reported. Health workers face severe supply shortages and have used expired masks; outbreaks are exacerbated by community distrust and attacks on health centers over body-management protocols. Ituri is the epicenter, with cases also detected in North and South Kivu, where M23 rebels control major towns including Goma and Bukavu and have reported two Ebola cases. Goma’s main airport has been closed since January 2025 due to M23 control. The conflict has displaced more than 7 million people. EU aid reached Ituri the same day; the United States has pledged over $112 million, including an extra $80 million. Tedros urged a ceasefire and criticized travel bans on affected nationals.

triage.headline_ja: WHOのテドロス事務局長、エボラ出血熱の流行に対処するためコンゴを訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、また複数のWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に該当。現在進行中の大規模エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（1,077疑いケース、238死亡）であり、国際的な支援（米国、EU）も動員されており、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak（ブンディブギョウエボラウイルス病）。イトゥリ州が震源地で、北キブ州・南キブ州にも拡大。武装勢力M23による支配地域での症例報告あり。Goma空港は2025年1月から閉鎖。武装紛争により710万人以上が避難。WHO事務局長による現地訪問、米国（1億1200万ドル以上の援助）とEUの支援実施。地域的に不安定であり、医療従事者の供給不足、期限切れマスク使用、保健センターへの攻撃などの課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: 防堵伊波拉！ 2地居民禁來台「4類對象除外」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola! Residents of two areas barred from entering Taiwan; four categories exempt.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC announced entry restrictions due to Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. From June 2, 2026 at 00:00, visa issuance to DRC/Uganda residents is suspended for 90 days, and entries with existing visas are paused, with four exemptions: (1) degree-seeking students admitted to Taiwan, (2) diplomatic/official trips, (3) non-Taiwanese spouses and minor children of Taiwanese nationals, (4) emergency or humanitarian cases (e.g., funerals, visiting seriously ill relatives). Those with recent travel to affected areas within 21 days or with valid residence permits may still enter but must undergo airport quarantine and follow 21 days of self-health management, reporting symptoms via 1922. WHO data as of May 27 show the DRC outbreak spreading in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu: 906 cases and 223 deaths; 125 confirmed cases and 17 deaths. Uganda: 7 confirmed cases, 1 death. Travel advisory: Level 3 Warning; avoid nonessential travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱を防止！2地域の住民の台湾入国を禁止「4類の対象者は除外」
triage.triage_reason: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC：906例、223死亡；ウガンダ：7例、1死亡）は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、国際的な懸念から台湾が入国制限を発令している。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクを主題としているが、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。台湾は発生国ではなく対応国であるため除外。DRC内の具体的な発生地域はSouth Kivu Province、Ituri Provinceで確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique Centrale: Ebola - Les restrictions à la frontière ougandaise avec la RDC inquiètent les milieux des affaires
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa: Ebola — Restrictions at the Ugandan border with the DRC worry the business community.
article.articleSummary: Ebola-driven border restrictions between Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) were announced by Uganda to curb the outbreak, triggering concerns among business circles. Kampala says trade will continue under strict sanitary controls, but industry and transporters fear major logistical disruptions and delays for goods, especially perishables. The DRC is a key Ugandan export market, with estimates that shipments to Congo exceed $2 billion annually. Ezra Muhumuza, executive director of the Uganda Manufacturers Association, urges the two governments to create 'safe zones' where drivers can park until the situation stabilizes to prevent spoilage, arson, or vandalism of in-transit goods. Uganda’s government contends that trucks may still move, provided they avoid crowds and comply with health measures; perishable shipments might be held for a few days if needed. Officials say the measures will stay until the health situation is resolved.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ: エボラ - ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国の国境制限がビジネス界を懸念させる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に拡大するリスクが極めて高く、国境制限による渡航・貿易への影響も確認されている。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準でも複数該当するため、フルRRA対象イベント。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCにおけるエボラ発生が主題であり、ウガンダはDRCとの国境制限導入国として言及されている。ウガンダ（対象国外）はこのイベントの直接発生地ではなく、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率と国際的懸念を持つ疾患であり、国境制限の実施は深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Face à la circulation d'Ebola en Afrique centrale, l'Italie réclame que l'UE renforce la surveillance de ses frontières
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In response to the spread of Ebola in Central Africa, Italy calls on the EU to strengthen its border surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa prompts Italy to urge the EU to strengthen border surveillance. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni asked the European Union to coordinate stricter surveillance of travelers arriving from Ebola-affected areas in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, proposing common rules for direct and indirect arrivals. In a letter to Ursula von der Leyen, Antonio Costa, and Nikos Christodoulidis, Meloni said border management should be on the agenda of the next European Council (June 18–19). A video conference of EU health ministers is being planned for next week. Since the DRC declared an Ebola outbreak on May 15, authorities report more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths; Uganda reports seven confirmed infections, including one death. Italy has implemented targeted traveler screening and dispatched an Institute Spallanzani team to Kinshasa to assist with technical support and medical supplies.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカにおけるエボラウイルスの流行に対応して、イタリアはEUに国境監視の強化を求めている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCとウガンダでの確認は予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクをすべて示唆している。
triage.notes: DRCでの発生（5月15日宣言、1000件超の疑い例、246人の死亡）とウガンダでの感染確認（7件の確認例）が記事の主題。イタリアはDRCで技術支援と医療物資の提供を開始し、EUレベルでの国境監視強化と調整が求められている。WPRアフリカ地域ではなく西ヨーロッパの政治的対応が強調されているが、シグナル検知はDRCの発生に基づく。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地として確認される。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths from Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in Congo
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, WHO reported 906 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 223 suspected deaths under investigation from the Bundibugyo strain, while 125 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC include 17 confirmed deaths across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. In Uganda, seven confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, three imported from the DRC, and one death; no community transmission has been reported there. The case fatality rate among confirmed infections is estimated at 30–50 percent, per Anais Legand of WHO's High Threat Pathogens Team; data are preliminary and under investigation. There are no approved vaccines or therapies specifically for Bundibugyo virus disease. Early care is emphasized as a potential factor in reducing fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴでブンディブギョ株エボラの疑い例906件、疑い死亡223件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。ブンディブギョ株エボラの大規模発生で、DRC及びウガンダで確認症例あり。CFR 30-50%で致命的。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は発生地域として示されているが、記事サマリーでは3件が輸入症例で地域内伝播がないとされているため、現在の主発生地はDRCのみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。ブンディブギョ株は重篤度が高く、承認済みワクチン/治療薬がない点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค รณรงค์กำจัดโรคพิษสุนัขบ้า ฉีดวัคซีน-ทำหมันฟรี ตั้งเป้าคนไทยปลอดเสียชีวิต
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control campaigns to eradicate rabies, offers free vaccination and neutering, aims for zero rabies-related deaths among Thais.
article.articleSummary: May 29, 2026, at Suranaree Monument, Nakhon Ratchasima Province, Thailand, the Department of Disease Control led a rabies elimination campaign aiming for zero rabies deaths and eradication of the disease nationwide. Activities included free rabies vaccination for humans and animals, and free neutering of dogs and cats, with exhibitions and information to promote correct post-exposure practices. The effort reinforces Thailand’s goal to eliminate rabies, noting 5 rabies deaths recorded in 2026. Nakhon Ratchasima was selected as a model rabies-free area, with coordinated support from local government, village health volunteers, and civil society to sustain progress. The provincial deputy governor joined as co-host, underscoring collaboration to achieve the target: a rabies-free country, with healthy animals and safe people under the banner “rabies-free animals, safe people.”

triage.headline_ja: タイ疾病管理局、狂犬病根絶キャンペーン実施 ワクチン接種と避妊手術を無料提供、タイ国民の狂犬病死亡ゼロを目指す
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は狂犬病根絶のための予防的キャンペーンの報告であり、新規の流行やアウトブレイク、危機的状況を示す内容ではない。タイは既に狂犬病対策を組織的に実施している状況の紹介であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月29日のタイ政府による狂犬病根絶キャンペーンの開催報告。2026年の狂犬病死亡は5件と記載されているが、これは既知の統計情報であり、新規の流行事象ではない。予防的な公衆衛生施策の実施であり、危機的なシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat: Eight Gir Lion Cubs Die In Suspected Babesiosis Cases; No New Deaths In 48 Hours
article.articleSummary: Eight Gir lion cubs in Gujarat's Gir landscape have died in suspected babesiosis, with cases reported from outer-revenue areas—Gir Gadhada taluka and Babarkot in Amreli district—while no fresh suspected Babesia deaths were reported in the last 48 hours. Samples from the cubs have been sent to the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre; results are expected in 3–4 days. Whether these deaths are due to Babesia will be confirmed only after medical reports. Forest department teams have been deployed; lions within a 10-km radius are isolated and under observation; de-ticking drives, vaccination and treatment are being carried out to prevent spread. Expert assistance from the Union government or wildlife specialists such as Vantara may be sought. The operation follows intensified round-the-clock surveillance; the 2025 census recorded 891 Asiatic lions in Gujarat, with many in the Greater Gir landscape.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：ギール・ライオンの子ども8頭がバベシア症の疑いで死亡、過去48時間に新規死亡例なし
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（ライオン）における集団死亡事例であり、バベシア症の疑いが報告されている。ただし、人間への感染リスクが直接的には記述されておらず、また確定診断がまだ完了していないため、追加情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: このイベントは野生動物（ギール・ライオン）における感染症疑い例である。記事サマリーに基づき、人間への感染リスクに関する具体的な情報はない。確定診断の結果待ちの段階であり、検査結果（3～4日で判明予定）の確認が重要。バベシア症は蜘蛛による媒介が中心であり、野生動物集団における流行は公衆衛生上の懸念となる可能性がある。森林部局による対応と感染症予防措置が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 手足口病活躍度近日顯著上升　本周5天錄17宗逾90%屬幼園小學個案
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Significant rise in hand-foot-and-mouth disease activity recently; 17 cases recorded in five days this week, with more than 90% from preschools and primary schools.
article.articleSummary: Hand-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD) activity is rising in Hong Kong, with outbreaks concentrated in schools and care homes. For the five days of May 24–28, 2026, the Centre for Health Protection logged 17 HFMD outbreaks affecting 48 people, with over 90% of cases in kindergartens, preschools, or primary schools. Earlier weekly data show: May 3–9 (5 outbreaks; 42 people), May 10–16 (12 outbreaks; 44 people), and May 17–23 (11 outbreaks; 46 people). The CHP has issued alerts to doctors and schools and urged prompt outbreak reporting; citizens should maintain personal and environmental hygiene. Private clinic sentinel surveillance indicates rising activity, and public hospital emergency departments have seen increasing HFMD presentations in recent weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の活動が最近顕著に上昇　今週5日間で17例を記録、90%以上が幼稚園・小学校のケース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外性、国際拡大リスク）。学校・保育施設での集団発生、急速な増加傾向が確認され、香港（中国）における手足口病の活動上昇は感染症監視の優先課題に該当する。
triage.notes: 香港はChina(1814991)に含めて記録。過去4週間での段階的な増加傾向（5→12→11→17件）が認められ、90%以上が学校・保育施設での集団発生という特性から、高い感染伝播性と管理上の課題が示唆される。EV71検出率や重症化事例の有無に関する情報は記事サマリーには含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ce que vous avez manqué cette nuit | Ebola, protection des enfants, Bluesky
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What you missed last night | Ebola, child protection, Bluesky
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with Ituri province as the epicentre, in what authorities describe as the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. The DRC declared a new outbreak on May 15, and the World Health Organization has issued an international health alert. The virus has been detected in three provinces within the DRC and has crossed into Uganda, which has seven laboratory-confirmed infections, including one death. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa and was to meet Congolese authorities, with a planned trip to Ituri and a possible meeting with the president; Saturday visits aimed at stepping up response efforts. The cross-border spread underscores the seriousness of the outbreak and the ongoing international containment effort.

triage.headline_ja: 今夜あなたが見落としたもの | エボラ、子どもの保護、Bluesky
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国境越え流行は極度に懸念される感染症であり、即座にフルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）が含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加していない。ただし、サマリー上でウガンダへの越境拡大が明記されており、国際的脅威の重要な要素である。DRC内ではイツーリ州が震源地とされており、キンシャサではWHO事務局長が直接対応に当たっている。5月15日のアウトブレイク宣言以降の急速な対応と国際保健上の警告発出が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: محكمة كينية تمنع التعاون مع الولايات المتحدة لإنشاء مركز حجر لمرضى إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court blocks cooperation with the United States to establish a quarantine center for Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s High Court in Nairobi blocked plans under a US-Kenya agreement to establish an Ebola quarantine center, issuing an order prohibiting any Ebola detection, quarantine, isolation, or treatment facility in Kenya. The May 28, 2026 order, reported May 29, 2026, followed a petition by the Katiba Institute for Human Rights. Activists argued the center could threaten public security and sought to prevent such facilities under international agreements. Kenya had previously approved a quarantine center in Laikipia County to begin within a week, initially with 50 beds and potential expansion to 250. The center would be staffed by US medical personnel trained at Andrews Air Force Base. The Ituri region in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the Ebola outbreak epicenter, with about 1,000 suspected cases and around 220 suspected deaths in DRC; Uganda nearby reported one death and seven suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの裁判所、エボラ患者の隔離センター設立に向けた米国との協力をブロック
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（IHR基準の高リスク疾患）の既知の流行がDRCのイトゥーリ地域で継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な状況（裁判所の決定による施設建設の中止）が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。地域検証上、DRCでの実際の流行とケニアでの政治的対応が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事の主要イベントはケニアの裁判所決定だが、実際の感染症流行はDRC（イトゥーリ地域）で継続中（約1,000疑い例、220死亡）。ウガンダでも1死亡・7疑い例報告あり。しかし、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCに限定。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, dottoressa Msf ricoverata allo Spallanzani
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, MSF doctor hospitalized at Spallanzani.
article.articleSummary: An MSF doctor returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo, exposed to Ebola patients, was admitted to Rome’s Lazzaro Spallanzani National Institute for Infectious Diseases. The clinician is asymptomatic and under precautionary observation; transport to Italy occurred in biocontainment with Usmaf and the Italian Red Cross. Monitoring will continue until June 8 in line with international protocols for individuals exposed to Ebola. The physician had direct contact with confirmed or suspected Ebola cases during field work in the DRC. Italian authorities report no confirmed Ebola cases in Italy and emphasize ongoing scientific surveillance and strict safety. Government actions include a forthcoming circular and ordinance to strengthen risk management and guidance for healthcare workers and Regions. Italy also plans a Spallanzani expert mission to Kinshasa to support surveillance and medical deliveries amid ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda. Separately, Kenya halted a US-backed quarantine center near Nairobi due to a legal challenge.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、MSF医師がスパランツァーニで入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。エボラウイルス暴露による医療従事者の症例報告は、イタリアを含む非流行国への輸入ケースとして重大。予防的監視中だが、確定患者との直接接触歴があり、国際的な感染症動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ暴露事例を報道しており、イタリアは暴露後の輸入ケース管理の文脈での言及。Kenya（Nairobi）は隔離施設の法的問題での言及のため主題外として除外。Uganda は記事本文に「Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda」と記載されているが、当該医師の具体的な暴露地域がDRCであり、Ugandaでの発生状況言及のみのため verified_locations に含めない。イタリア（Rome, Spallanzani）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: چرا مهار شیوع ابولا در کنگو راه‌حل فوری ندارد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is there no immediate solution to containing the Ebola outbreak in Congo?
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization is evaluating promising therapies and vaccines for a Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where more than 200 people have died. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola species with a 2–21 day incubation; early symptoms are nonspecific (fever, fatigue, myalgia, headache, sore throat), hindering timely diagnosis. Transmission occurs via close contact with body fluids of the sick or deceased, with healthcare workers at higher risk. No licensed treatments or vaccines exist for Bundibugyo, but three antibody therapies are prioritized for trials: products from Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron, and remdesivir from Gilead. Vaccine candidates include rVSV Bundibugyo by IAVI (single-dose), likely 7–9 months to trial readiness, and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo by Oxford/Serum Institute of India, potentially ready in 2–3 months for efficacy testing, pending animal data. Meanwhile, standard Ebola control measures—surveillance, testing, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, community engagement, and safe burials—remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行抑制に即座の解決策がない理由
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの集団発生で200人以上の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当。現地での治療法やワクチンが確立していない状況下での流行管理という深刻な状況。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ・エボラは稀なエボラ種で、200人以上の死亡が既に報告されている。治療薬やワクチンが未承認であることが懸念される。WHOが複数の治療法とワクチン候補を評価中であるが、即座の解決策がない状況。記事の焦点はDRCでの発生であり、他国への拡大についての具体的記述はないため international_spread および travel_trade_restriction は「不明」としている。

article.articleHeadline: Ja pse po përhapet Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Here's why Ebola is spreading.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak persists in Ituri and North Kivu, with 900 suspected cases confirmed and 220 deaths. WHO warns the deadly fever could spread further in an underdeveloped Congo. Funding shortfalls—US withdrawal last year and German BMZ cuts—hamper response, prompting CARE and Caritas to call for more support. In Goma, Diakonie reports only about 30% of needs met as hospitals remain damaged by conflict and equipment is scarce. BMZ says Congo will receive about €160 million in development aid for 2026–2027, down from previous years, with prevention funding emphasized. Germany plans to deploy expert help to Congo. Bread for the World notes 500 protective suits are insufficient; calls for stronger health‑global funding. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant is circulating; no vaccine or cure yet, with limited rapid tests and laboratory capacity; vaccine development could take at least nine months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡散している理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクは900例の疑い例と220人の死亡を記録し、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。WPRO基準（重症度、流行のしやすさ）も満たし、国際的な資金支援の必要性が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にドイツ（Federal Republic of Germany）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではドイツでの実際の発生は述べられておらず、ドイツは資金援助と専門家派遣の側面のみで言及されているため、verified_locationsから除外した。Bundibugyo Ebolasvariantが流行中で、ワクチンが未開発（開発には最低9ヶ月要するとのこと）である点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Talianska premiérka žiada Európsku úniu o prísnejšie hraničné kontroly kvôli ebole v Afrike
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italian prime minister urges the EU to implement stricter border controls due to Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda drives Italy to press the EU for stricter border controls and tighter cross-border surveillance. WHO data (since May 15) show at least 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola deaths among more than 1,000 confirmed or suspected cases, with Uganda reporting one death and six additional cases. In response, Italy has activated health-surveillance protocols for travelers returning from the affected countries and will deploy a Spallanzani Institute infectious-disease team to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance and medical supplies. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni sent EU leaders a letter urging border-management coordination at the June European Council (June 18–19) and requested a video conference of EU health ministers next week to coordinate direct and indirect arrivals from affected areas. WHO cautions the actual scale is likely larger.

triage.headline_ja: イタリア首相がアフリカのエボラ対策でEUに厳格な国境管理を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCとウガンダでの大規模アウトブレイク（1000件以上の疑似患者を含む、223人以上の死亡）であり、複数国への拡大の可能性が示唆されている。高い社会政治的関心あり。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが記事の主題。イタリアおよびEUは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。2026年5月29日時点で1000件以上の確定または疑似患者、223人以上の死亡が報告されている。WHO懸念により実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限・国境管理強化の動きが見られる。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 90% من حالات الإيبولا تتركز في إيتورى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 90% of Ebola cases are concentrated in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus addressed communities in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, amid an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. As of May 29, 2026, more than 90% of reported cases are in Ituri, with a limited number in North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak involves a new Ebola virus strain and currently lacks vaccines or approved therapeutics to prevent spread. Tedros called for ceasefires by armed groups to allow health workers to reach affected communities and stressed the importance of early detection and supportive care to save lives. The response is led by the Congolese government with partners, with ongoing international support urged.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラ患者の90％がイトゥリに集中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で懸念あり。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による新規エボラ outbreak、ワクチン・治療薬不在、国際的支援の緊急性が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は稀な亜種であり、ワクチン・治療薬が利用不可な状態での outbreak。記事ではIturi Province（North Kivu, South Kivu周辺地域）が主な発生地として明記。武装集団による不安定な治安環境が response を大きく阻害。WHOトップによる直接の現地関与と国際支援要請が明記されており、極めて高優先度の案件。

article.articleHeadline: La expansión de mosquitos por el cambio climático amenaza a Europa: el virus chikungunya acecha al continente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The spread of mosquitoes due to climate change threatens Europe: the chikungunya virus lurks on the continent.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya, a viral disease transmitted mainly by Aedes mosquitoes, causes high fever and severe joint pain. A mutation expanded transmission from Aedes aegypti to Aedes albopictus after outbreaks in Réunion, Mauritius, Comoros and India (2005–2006). In Spain, Aedes albopictus—detected in Sant Cugat del Vallès (Barcelona) two decades ago—heightens local risk; in August last year the Basque Government activated surveillance after the first autochthonous chikungunya case in Hendaye near the French border. Spain is highly exposed due to travel and hosts many imported chikungunya cases, while a chikungunya vaccine arrived in December for those over 12. Climate modeling by Ye Xu and colleagues links warming to the spread into temperate regions by 2100, with Aedes albopictus tolerating cooler climates; central Europe, northeast North America, and east Asia are identified future risk areas. Preventive measures: continuous vector monitoring, clinician training, urban/rural vector control, and rapid-response plans before 2040.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動による蚊の拡散がヨーロッパを脅かす：チクングニアウイルスが大陸を脅かしている
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの自家感染例がスペインで確認され、IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が明確。国際的な流行リスク、温暖化による拡大予測、複数国での歴史的流行背景により、フルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではスペイン、フランス、インドでチクングニアの発生・歴史的流行を言及。対象国リストはインドのみ該当。スペイン・フランスでの自家感染は対象国外だが、インドでの過去の大規模流行（2005-2006）とその後の遺伝的変異の拡大が国際的なリスク増加の背景として述べられている。気候変動による将来の流行リスク予測も含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情升溫！疾管署：90天內禁止剛果、烏干達居民入境
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak intensifies! Taiwan CDC: 90-day entry ban for residents of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda intensifies; WHO raised the risk to the highest level and declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 22. DRC: 906 cases, 223 deaths; 125 confirmed cases, 17 deaths. Uganda: 7 confirmed cases, 1 death. Outbreak centered in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Taiwan’s CDC announced a 90-day entry ban for residents of DRC and Uganda starting 2026-06-02, with four exemptions: degree-seeking students with admission, diplomats and civil servants, and Taiwanese citizens’ non-national spouses and their minor children under emergency humanitarian programs (bereavement, visiting gravely ill relatives). Those with visas already issued will have entry suspended. Travel advisory raised to Level 3; travelers with travel history must report to quarantine stations and observe 21 days of self-health management. Beginning June 2, onboard announcements and port surveillance will be strengthened; violations may incur penalties under the Infectious Disease Control Act.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が加熱！台湾疾病管制署：90日以内にコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダの住民の入国を禁止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施済み）。WHO PHEICとして既に認定された高優先度のエボラ流行。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの症例報告を言及しているが、主題となる公衆衛生対応（台湾のCDC渡航制限）はDRCとウガンダ両国に関連。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。WHO PHeIC宣言（2026-05-22）済み。DRC側では906症例・223死亡、ウガンダ側では7確認症例・1死亡が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Почему вспышку Эболы в Конго нельзя быстро остановить
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why can't the Ebola outbreak in Congo be stopped quickly?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people as transmission outpaces response. Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola strain, spreads via close contact with bodily fluids of sick or deceased individuals; incubation is 2–21 days, with early symptoms including fever, weakness, myalgia, headache, and sore throat, complicating timely diagnosis. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for Bundibugyo yet, but WHO regards several experimental options as promising. Priority therapies under evaluation are monoclonal antibodies from Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron, and the antiviral remdesivir from Gilead. Vaccine candidates include rVSV Bundibugyo (IAVI) and ChAdOx1 Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute of India); preparations for clinical testing are expected in about 7–9 months and 2–3 months, respectively, contingent on animal data. In the meantime, outbreak controls—surveillance, rapid diagnostics, contact tracing, isolation, infection prevention, safe burials, and community engagement—remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行はなぜ迅速に止められないのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。死亡者200名超のBundibugyo ebolavirus流行で、治療法・ワクチンが未承認の状態。直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なエボラ亜種）による流行。200名超の死亡、治療法・ワクチン未承認、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高。WHO実験的治療・ワクチン候補進行中（7-9ヶ月・2-3ヶ月単位）。地域検証：記事主題はDRC流行に限定。

article.articleHeadline: 【社説】エボラ出血熱の緊急事態宣言　国際連携で支援強化を：朝日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Editorial: State of emergency for Ebola virus disease—Strengthen support through international cooperation
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern as of May 27, with 132 confirmed cases, 18 deaths, and over 900 suspected. The editorial warns that the outbreak’s speed is outpacing response, making this Africa’s third PHEIC. Unlike the 2014–2016 epidemic, this event involves a less common Ebola strain with delayed detection. Key measures call for aggressive contact tracing, expanded testing and healthcare capacity, and accelerated development of therapeutics and vaccines; a long, multinational effort under WHO coordination is required. Security concerns include unstable local conditions and attacks on hospital tents, underscoring the need for community engagement. The piece notes broader zoonotic threats (e.g., a hantavirus cluster on an Atlantic cruise) and critiques U.S. withdrawal from WHO funding and stalled pandemic-treaty negotiations, urging sustained international cooperation. Japan’s role is limited but supporting precedents exist.

triage.headline_ja: 【社説】エボラ出血熱の緊急事態宣言　国際連携で支援強化を：朝日新聞
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の新規感染、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。即座にフルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラ出血熱の発生地としてDRC（Democratic Republic of the Congo）とウガンダが明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。USA、Japanは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言（2026年5月27日）により公式に国際的懸念事項として認定済み。記事中の「ハンタウイルス」言及は船上クラスタで副次的内容であり、主題はエボラ出血熱。

article.articleHeadline: 抵刚果（金）监督抗疫　世卫总干事：埃博拉可被阻断
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to oversee the anti-epidemic effort; WHO Director-General says Ebola can be contained.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa to oversee the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, focusing on the eastern Ituri Province where the outbreak is centered. As of May 24 (since the outbreak was declared on May 15), there are 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected Ebola deaths, with total confirmed and suspected cases exceeding 1,000. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no vaccine or treatment. Africa CDC head projects vaccines and therapeutics for Bundibugyo by year-end 2026, with clinical trials planned. Aid includes 4.6 tons delivered to Bunia airport and 100 tons from UNICEF. Neighbor Uganda reports 1 confirmed Ebola death and 6 new cases and has closed its border; the United States will not admit infected persons, while Kenya hosts a quarantine center for Americans. WHO emphasizes coordinated trials and response with DRC and Uganda. Ebola in Africa has caused over 15,000 deaths in 50 years; the 2018–2020 DRC outbreak was particularly deadly.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国に到着し防疫活動を監督　WHO事務局長：エボラは阻止可能
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の高い死亡数、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。緊急の国際的対応が必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模アウトブレイク。5月15日宣言時点で1,000件を超える患者数、10例の確定死亡と223例の疑い死亡。ウガンダでも波及確認（1例確定死亡、6例新規症例）。ワクチン・治療薬がまだ利用不可。WHO事務局長による現地対応監督は国際的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Италия просит ЕС усилить пограничный контроль из-за угрозы лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy urges the EU to strengthen border controls amid the Ebola fever threat.
article.articleSummary: Italy urged the European Union to tighten border controls with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda amid the Ebola outbreak in Central Africa. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni sent a letter to EU leadership proposing this issue be placed on the European Council agenda for June 18–19, 2026, stressing the epidemiological situation linked to the recent Ebola flare in DRC and Uganda and calling for strengthened border-control coordination. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), while noting that its spread does not yet meet criteria for a broader emergency or pandemic. As of now, more than 900 Ebola cases have been reported with over 200 deaths; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected people or animals. No details on imported or exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の脅威をめぐりイタリアがEUに国境管理の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い公衆衛生影響を持ち、DRCとウガンダでの集団発生は異常/予想外、EU加盟国イタリアが強い関心を示し国際的な対応が必要とされている。WHO-PHEICも宣言済み。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）はBluedot発生地域に含まれているが、対象国リストに属していないため除外。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国でのエボラ集団発生が述べられているが、検証対象国はDRCのみ。イタリアの国境管理強化要請とWHO-PHEIC宣言により、国際的な懸念は明確。既に900例以上、200以上の死亡が報告されており重症度は著しく高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia frustra el intento de Trump de abrir un centro en el país para estadounidenses expuestos al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Foils Trump's Attempt to Open a Center in the Country for Americans Exposed to Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-29, Kenya’s High Court blocked the establishment of a quarantine center for United States citizens potentially exposed to Ebola, prohibiting any Ebola exposure, quarantine, isolation, or treatment facility in Kenya and barring entry of exposed or infected individuals. Judge Patricia Mande issued a temporary injunction nullifying any accord with the United States or other governments. The NGO Katiba had challenged the plan as non-transparent and lacking constitutional/parliamentary oversight. The move follows a regional Ebola concern, with more than 200 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and heightened health alerts in Africa. The United States had proposed $13.5 million to Kenya and $112 million in bilateral assistance to support regional response and prevent spread, with talks between Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Kenya’s President William Ruto now suspended, impacting cross-border medical supplies and public health readiness.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラに曝露したアメリカ国民向けの施設開設というトランプの試みを阻止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCで200人以上の死亡が報告されており、地域的なエボラ懸念が存在。国際的な公衆衛生対応と二国間支援に影響を与える重要な政治的事象。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの司法決定とアメリカの地域支援計画ですが、感染症イベントの実際の発生地はDRCです。ケニアは政治的対応の舞台ですが、感染症の活動地ではありません。DRCでのエボラ流行（200人以上の死亡報告）が本件の背景となっています。アフリカ地域での急速な拡大リスクと国際的な医療対応上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OMS desaconselha restrição de entrada a viajantes da RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO discourages entry restrictions for travelers from the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus discouraged entry restrictions on travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an Ebola outbreak, saying travel bans rarely help and may hinder transparent reporting. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola epidemic in the DRC since 1976, centered in Ituri’s Bunia and affecting North Kivu and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo strain has a case fatality of about 30–50% and currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In the DRC, 246 suspected deaths have been reported; Uganda has eight confirmed cases, including one death from a Congolese-imported case. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other bodily fluids of infected people or animals. Ongoing conflict, displacement and food insecurity complicate control. Several countries—including Uganda, Rwanda, the United States, Canada, Mexico, Bahamas, Jordan and Bahrain—have imposed travel restrictions or border closures, but WHO urges stronger measures at the source and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：WHOはコンゴ民主共和国の旅行者の入国制限を勧めない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行は公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示し、複数国への拡大が確認されており、国際的な渡航制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数の国を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーを精査すると、エボラ流行の主な発生地はDRCの北キブ州・南キブ州・イツリ州である。ウガンダの8例（1例は死亡）はコンゴ民主共和国からの輸入症例であり、その他の国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ、バハマ、ヨルダン、バーレーン、ルワンダ）は渡航制限を実施している国として言及されているが、実際の流行地ではない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says 223 suspected deaths from new Ebola strain
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, the WHO reports an ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths under investigation. There are 125 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC, including 17 confirmed deaths in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda has seven confirmed cases, three imported from the DRC, and one death. No community transmission has been reported. The case-fatality rate among confirmed infections ranges 30%–50%, according to Anais Legand of WHO’s High Threat Pathogens Team, though data are preliminary. There are no approved vaccines or therapies specifically for Bundibugyo virus disease.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、新型エボラ株による223人の疑い死亡例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な拡大リスク、および高い致死率を示す新型エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo）の多国間発生。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドではUgandaが含まれているが、サマリーでは「7例のうち3例がDRCからの輸入例」と記載されており、ウガンダは限定的な輸入例を示すにとどまる。地域検証の厳密性に基づき、主要な発生国はDRCのみとして verified_locations に DRC を掲載。ただし、ウガンダでの確認例が存在するため、国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準3）および管理可能性（WPRO基準5）評価には該当国の確認も含めて実施が推奨される。新型Bundibugyo EVDで承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、30-50%の高い致死率は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam chưa ghi nhận ca bệnh Ebola, tăng cường giám sát người nhập cảnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam has not yet recorded an Ebola case, and is strengthening surveillance of incoming travelers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) remains unrecorded in Vietnam, where risk is assessed as low; the Ministry of Health urges heightened surveillance of entrants, especially travelers from areas with active transmission, and strengthens border screening, hospital readiness, infection control, and contact tracing, advising the public to avoid unnecessary travel to affected zones. Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks are ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 27 May 2026, DRC reports 1,077 suspected cases with 238 suspected deaths and 121 confirmed cases (17 deaths); Uganda reports 7 confirmed cases (1 death). Total: 128 confirmed, 18 deaths. Outbreaks span 14 health zones across three DRC provinces, mainly Ituri, with notable sites including Rwampara, Bunia, Mongbwalu, and Nyankunde. Some contact tracing is hampered by security issues and population movement; cross-border transmission risk exists. WHO considers regional risk high; a PHEIC was declared on 17 May 2026, with vaccine/treatment trials being explored for Bundibugyo Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムはエボラ出血熱の患者を記録していないが、入国者の監視を強化している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）がDRCとウガンダで複数の州にわたり拡大しており、確認患者128名・死亡18名の多数の重症患者が報告されている。WHOが地域リスクを高と評価し、2026年5月17日にPHEICが宣言されている。DRCは対象国であり、IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な影響・異常・国際的拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはベトナムが含まれているが、記事サマリーではベトナムでのエボラ患者は「記録されていない」と明示されている。実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダであり、ベトナムは感染症対策強化の対応国として言及されているのみ。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ（対象国外）での発生も記事に明示されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）とBundibugyo ebolavirus の新規ワクチン・治療試験の検討が進行中であり、高いシグナル性を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Ο επικεφαλής του ΠΟΥ έφτασε στο Κονγκό και υπόσχεται ότι η επιδημία "μπορεί να αναχαιτιστεί"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The WHO chief arrived in Congo and promises that the outbreak "can be contained."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists as WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrives in Kinshasa and heads to Ituri, the outbreak epicenter. Since May 15, the WHO records 10 confirmed and 223 suspected Ebola-related deaths among more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases. The disease presents with fever, fatigue, muscle pains, sore throat, followed by vomiting, diarrhea and organ dysfunction; transmission is via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals. The current case fatality rate is about 24.6%; no approved therapy for the Bundibugyo strain exists, though vaccine and therapeutic trials are being considered with a vaccine possibly ready by year-end. Conflict in eastern DRC hampers response, with over 245,000 displaced since January 2025; Uganda closed its border with DRC amid the outbreak. WHO has delivered aid to Bunia; UNICEF plans additional shipments.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO事務局長がコンゴに到着し、感染症の流行は「抑え込むことができる」と約束
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、死亡者多数、国際的に極めて高いリスク、既に隣国ウガンダが国境閉鎖を実施している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病Bundibugyo株による現在進行中の大規模流行。確定症例・疑い例合計1,000件以上、233人の死亡（致命率24.6%）。東部DRC紛争により対応が阻害、約245,000人が国内避難民化。ウガンダが既に国境閉鎖を実施し、地域的な国際的蔓延リスク高い。WHO事務局長の現地訪問は事態の深刻性を示唆。ワクチン・治療薬試験も検討段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola/RDC: Combater os ''rumores'' é quase tão importante como derrotar o vírus - Director-geral da OMS a caminho do leste congolês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola/DRC: Combating the 'rumors' is almost as important as defeating the virus - WHO Director-General en route to eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 29 May 2026, Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has crossed borders to Uganda, with eight laboratory-confirmed cases and one death; Rwanda has suspected cases. The epicenter includes Ituri Province (Bunia) and North/South Kivu. Since 1976 this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC. Unlike Ebola Zaire, Bundibugyo has no vaccine or treatment; transmission is mainly via contact with body fluids, intensified by traditional burial rituals. Rumors about external origins and reliance on traditional healers hamper containment; attacks on health facilities, including a burned isolation center, have occurred. More than 140 deaths, hundreds of suspected deaths, and nearly 1,000 infections confirmed or awaiting laboratory confirmation. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus travels to Bunia to bolster responders; UN appeals for truces to allow access amid security threats from M23 in Kivu and ADF/IS in Ituri. The outbreak is drawing international attention.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ/DRC: 『デマ』と戦うことはウイルスに勝つことほど重要である - WHO事務局長がコンゴ東部に向かう
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ・ブンディブギョウウイルスの複数国境越え流行（DRC→ウガンダ、ルワンダ疑い例）、140以上の死亡、ワクチン/治療なし、国際的対応が急務。WHO事務局長による現地訪問や国連アピールは国際的関心の高さを示す。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ・ルワンダが含まれるが、記事サマリーでは『DRCから国境越え』『ウガンダで8例確認』『ルワンダで疑い例』との記載。対象国リスト上はDRCのみが該当。DRCでの流行が主題であり、国際的な重要シグナル。セキュリティ脅威（M23、ADF/IS）により対応が複雑化。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC warns healthcare workers of 'high' importation risk despite no confirmed case
article.articleSummary: Ebola importation risk into Nigeria is assessed as high due to ongoing transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; as of 28 May, Nigeria has no confirmed Ebola case linked to outbreak. The NCDC advisory cites delayed detection and healthcare-associated transmission as concerns, given workers' vulnerability if the virus enters Nigeria. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; it is a Risk Group 4 pathogen with no approved vaccines or antivirals. Ebola is not airborne; transmission occurs through direct contact with infected blood, body fluids, secretions, contaminated materials, or infected animals. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, weakness, headache, muscle pain, sore throat, vomiting, and diarrhoea; severe illness can include bleeding, organ dysfunction, shock. No vaccines exist; response relies on surveillance, laboratory capability, response teams, EOCs, and outbreak experience, including the 2014 Lagos containment. Facilities should strengthen triage, isolation, and travel history assessment, maintaining suspicion for cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：NCDC、確認症例がないにもかかわらず「高い」輸入リスクについてヘルスケアワーカーに警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの輸入リスクが「高い」と評価され、DRC及びウガンダでの継続的な伝播があり、ナイジェリアでの早期検出及び医療施設での感染制御が懸念される。
triage.notes: ナイジェリアはWHO対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみ該当する対象国。Bundibugyo株はリスクグループ4、ワクチンなし。ナイジェリアは過去2014年のラゴス封じ込め経験あり。医療施設での感染制御が重要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: MPs summon Health CS Duale over reported Ebola quarantine arrangement involving U.S. citizens
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale and Ministry of Health officials were summoned by the National Assembly's Health Committee to explain reports that Ebola-exposed United States citizens would be quarantined in Kenya. Duale will brief lawmakers on June 2, detailing the arrangement, the legal/public-health framework, and the government's preparedness for potential exposure cases. The move follows a High Court ruling on May 28 halting establishment or operation of any Ebola quarantine, isolation or treatment facilities in Kenya under arrangements with the United States pending a Katiba Institute petition, which argues constitutional concerns. The court order also bars entry of exposed individuals under disputed arrangements. U.S. Secretary of State Rubio spoke with President Ruto about Ebola preparedness, with US$13.5 million for Kenya and US$112 million for regional response, as the outbreak centers in the Democratic Republic of Congo and reports emerge of a US-backed quarantine facility in Laikipia County.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応隔離施設めぐり、ケニア保健閣僚が議会に召喚――米国民の隔離受け入れ報道で
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク（DRC発生、米国との関連）、国内政治的対立による管理可能性の懸念、および社会的関心の高さからWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアの政治的対立（隔離施設受け入れめぐる議会召喚）だが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのエボラ流行である。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リスト内で含める。米国への接触リスク（米国民の隔離計画）はあるが米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。国際的なリスク拡大とシグナル検知の必要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: 906 предполагаеми случая и 223 предполагаеми смъртни случая вследствие на щама Бундибуджо
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: 906 probable cases and 223 probable deaths due to the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports 906 probable Ebola cases and 223 probable deaths under investigation in the Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to the Bundibugyo strain, with cases also in Uganda. In DRC, 125 confirmed infections have been recorded, including 17 confirmed deaths in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Uganda has seven confirmed cases, three imported from Congo, with one death; no sustained community transmission has been established. Case fatality among confirmed infections is estimated at 30–50%, per WHO's Emergency Health Situations Programme. Early treatment may reduce mortality. There are currently no vaccines or therapies specifically approved for Bundibugyo Ebola. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak persists with cross-border transmission to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラ感染の疑い例906件、疑い死亡223件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ株エボラの国境を越えた感染伝播は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）が記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ含める。DRC での確定症例125件（死亡17件）、ウガンダでの確定症例7件、ブンディブギョ株による致死率30-50%は極めて懸念高い。ワクチン・治療薬がない状況での国境越え感染伝播はフルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'daki Ebola salgını neden kolayca kontrol altına alınamıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why can't the Ebola outbreak in the Congo be easily brought under control?
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo faces a Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak with over 200 deaths suspected. Bundibugyo is a rare Ebola virus species first identified in 2007; past Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012) outbreaks showed case fatality around 30–50%. Incubation is 2–21 days; initial symptoms are non-specific (fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat), hindering early diagnosis. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals, heightening risk for health workers. There is no licensed treatment or vaccine yet, but several candidates are prioritized: antibody therapies from Mapp Biopharmaceutical and Regeneron, and remdesivir from Gilead. Vaccine candidates include rVSV-Bundibugyo (single-dose, IAVI) and ChAdOx1-Bundibugyo (Oxford/Serum Institute), potentially evaluable in 2–9 months, pending animal data. WHO advocates continued surveillance, rapid testing, contact tracing, isolation, safe burials, and community engagement while vaccines become available.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行がなぜ簡単に制御できないのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な病原体、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。稀なBundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる200名以上の死亡が疑われる大規模流行。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは稀な種で、過去の類似アウトブレイク（ウガンダ2007年、DRC2012年）では致命率30-50%。現在200名以上の死亡が疑われており、ワクチン候補も検討中だが市販化にはまだ2-9ヶ月要する。ウガンダへの波及リスクも隣国として存在するが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であるため verified_locations はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: 20 Hewan Kurban di Batang Terinfeksi Cacing Hati, Dispaperta Pastikan Bebas PMK dan Antraks
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 20 Sacrificial Animals in Batang Regency Infected with Liver Flukes, Dispaperta Ensures They Are Free of Foot-and-Mouth Disease and Anthrax
article.articleSummary: Post-mortem inspections of sacrificial animals in Batang Regency, Indonesia, after Eid al-Adha 1447 H, identified about 20 Fasciola hepatica (liver fluke) infections across Batang, Wonotunggal, Limpung, Tersono, and Subah as of May 29, 2026. Pneumonia-related lung lesions were also found in animals from Gringsing and Batang. Dispaperta Batang officials, led by Ambar Puspitaningrum, state that infected livers must be destroyed to prevent consumption; if portions remain usable, damaged parts are discarded or buried. Lung lesions from pneumonia are not always cause for total meat destruction if properly prepared. Fasciola hepatica is the dominant finding this year; infections were detected via post-mortem examination after liver dissection. The article notes ongoing inspections and emphasizes safe meat handling, with no explicit confirmation of foot-and-mouth disease or anthrax in the article body.

triage.headline_ja: バタン県で20頭の犠牲獣が肝吸虫に感染、ディスパペルタは口蹄疫と炭疽病は検出されていないことを保証
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は動物の肝吸虫症（Fascioliasis）が主要な懸念であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし、WPROスクリーニング基準も1つ以上の該当なし。公開健康上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低い。社会的・政治的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容は家畜の肝吸虫症（ファシオラ・ヘパティカ）感染に関するもの。見出しでは炭疽病とPMK（口蹄疫）が言及されているが、記事本文では「感染が明示的に確認されていない」と記述されている。これらは疾患リストに含まれているものの、実際の感染事例ではなく、安全性確認の陰性結果である。ゾーノティック疾患ではあるが、動物限定の案件であり公衆衛生上の直接的なリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы вышла из-под контроля в Демократической Республике Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spiraled out of control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled out of control, per ABC and Dr. Richard Kodjan of a Mongbvalu hospital in Ituri Province. He reports the disease spreading geometrically and notes seven suspected patients escaped, adding transmission chains and complicating containment. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola situation in the DRC and neighboring Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. WHO records 906 probable or suspected cases and 223 deaths in the DRC, with the previous outbreak ending in October 2025. Ituri authorities warned of catastrophe if response is delayed. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has issued an urgent staffing request to strengthen traveler screening at airports, with four major U.S. airports already conducting health checks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で制御不能に陥る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが国際的関心の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、死亡事例・国際的拡大リスク・対策の複雑化が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主要な発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）Ituri州。ウガンダは隣接国として言及されるが、記事の主題は当該国での発生そのものではなく、DRCの状況。米国も付与されているが、これはスクリーニング点の報告地であり、発生地ではないため除外。WHO/CDCの対応があり、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Страх Эболы в Европе: Италия призывает ЕС срочно принять меры
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola in Europe: Italy urges the EU to take urgent measures.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-29, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged the European Union to strengthen border controls in response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In a letter to EU leaders, she called for tighter border measures to be discussed at the European Council meeting on 18 June. The report provides no details on case counts or deaths. Meloni’s appeal highlights concerns about cross-border transmission into Europe and pushes for rapid, coordinated action among member states. The request emphasizes EU-level discussion ahead of the June 18 council session.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパでのエボラ熱への懸念：イタリアがEUに緊急措置を求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング5項目全て該当、かつ欧州での高い政治的関心により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ熱発生を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。イタリアはDRCでの発生に対応する欧州のリーダーシップを示す政治的側面が強調されている。ウガンダ（対象国外）での発生状況の詳細が記事に不足しているため verified_locations には含めない。具体的な症例数や死亡報告がないため、重症度評価は「Yes」ながら、実際の影響規模は現段階では不明。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand on high alert after Centre issues Ebola advisory
article.articleSummary: Jharkhand moved to high alert after a Central government Ebola advisory. Health Minister Irfan Ansari directed RIMS and Ranchi Sadar Hospital to stay prepared for Ebola treatment, with a six-bed isolation ward established at RIMS and beds kept vacant for immediate care of suspected cases. Jharkhand currently lacks an Ebola testing laboratory; suspected samples will be transported to the National Institute of Virology for confirmation. The Union Health Ministry held a virtual review with District Surveillance Departments to assess preparedness and preventive measures. Districts were instructed to maintain strict surveillance of travellers from Ebola-affected nations in Central and West Africa, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. India has issued travel advisories for Congo, Uganda and South Sudan urging vigilance and prompt symptom reporting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱に関する警告後、ジャールカンド州が高度の警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高リスク病原体であり、中央政府からのアドバイザリーにより準備態勢が強化されている。しかしインド国内でのエボラ症例報告はなく、現時点では予防的な警戒措置と旅行警告の段階である。記事から IHR 基準 2 つ以上の該当は明確でなく、確認が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot API が DRC、ウガンダ、スーダンを発生地域として提示しているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国でのエボラ症例発生の直接的な報告がなく、インドからの旅行警告と予防的警戒の文脈である。記事の主題はインド国内（ジャールカンド州）の準備態勢強化であり、verified_locations はインドのみとした。IHR 基準では国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限が該当するが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は記事に記載されていない。フルRRAで詳細な確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Why Africa - and the World - Remain Dangerously Unprepared for the Next Pandemic
article.articleSummary: Mid-May 2026 Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, as the world confronts ongoing pandemic risk despite past events. The WHO Global Preparedness Monitoring Board’s report, A World on the Edge, argues that Africa—and the world—remain dangerously unprepared a decade after Ebola and six years after COVID-19, with investments not keeping pace with rising risk. The piece calls for Africa to build trust in its own capacity and centers on five priorities: independent pandemic risk monitoring, health workforce capability and retention, equitable access to countermeasures (vaccine, diagnostics, PPE) with fair technology transfer and regional manufacturing, sustainable financing (including domestic investment and blended public-private funding), and sustained political attention. Key recommendations include local data sovereignty managed by African institutions (WHO Africa Region and Africa CDC) and centralized disease control, scorecards, and funding through the African Epidemic Fund (launched 2025) to enable rapid, locally led responses, reducing reliance on external donors and data sharing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：アフリカと世界が次のパンデミックに対して危険なほど準備不足である理由
triage.triage_reason: 2026年5月中旬のコンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ症例がWHOによって国際的に重要な公衆衛生上の緊急事態と宣言されたもので、IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）の複数に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2026年5月17日にWHOが公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言したエボラ症例が記事の中心。記事はアフリカ全域の準備体制の課題に焦点を当てているが、実際の感染症イベント（outbreak）はコンゴ民主共和国での発生に限定されている。verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Chief lands in Congo to address rare Ebola outbreak amid distrust and insecurity
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province near the Ugandan border, with 1,077 suspected cases and 238 suspected deaths as of May 26, 2026. Bundibugyo virus has no approved treatment or vaccine; AU pledges a vaccine by end-2026. WHO Director-General Tedros arrived in Kinshasa on May 28, 2026 to support containment amid distrust, insecurity, and scarce supplies; health workers report using expired masks and burial-protocol tensions triggering attacks on centers. The outbreak also involves North Kivu and South Kivu; Goma airport has been closed since Jan 2025 as M23 rebels control areas, with two rebel-reported cases. About 7 million people displaced in eastern Congo. India has sent emergency medical supplies; the United States added $80 million, bringing total aid to over $112 million. WHO advises against travel bans; the U.S. imposes a temporary entry ban for travelers who visited Congo/Uganda/S. Sudan in the past 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴのエボラ出血熱の稀な流行に対応するため訪問、不信と治安不安の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：238人の死亡、1,077疑い例；予想外：稀なBundibugyo型；国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダ国境近接；渡航制限既実施）。WPRO基準も全て該当。社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い（WHO事務局長の現地派遣、複数国の支援、米国の入国禁止措置）。フルRRA進捗必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラは承認済み治療法およびワクチンがない。WHO事務局長の現地派遣、複数国からの支援（インド・米国）、米国による渡航禁止措置など、国際的な対応レベルが極めて高い。東部コンゴで700万人が国内避難民となっており、拡大リスクは著しい。M23反乱勢力による治安不安が封じ込めを困難にしている。
