article.articleHeadline: Director de OMS realiza visita a zonas afectadas por ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits Ebola-affected areas in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of May 29, 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo centers on Ituri province, with North Kivu and South Kivu also affected. The outbreak was declared on May 15, and WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Kinshasa and set to travel to Ituri to meet response teams, partners, and affected communities. The aim is to assess operational needs, strengthen coordination, and mobilize greater support to contain the epidemic, though only about one-third of the required resources have been secured amid security constraints. He is accompanied by WHO Africa regional director Mohammed Janabi and WHO Emergencies Programme head Chikwe Ihekweazu. The United Kingdom announced emergency aid of £20 million during discussions with President Félix Tshisekedi, underscoring international support for containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の影響を受けた地域を訪問
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規流行（5月15日宣言）で、IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WHOトップレベルの対応、国際支援動員、セキュリティ上の制約下での限定的資源確保という深刻な管理課題を示唆している。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明記されたエボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国（イトゥリ州、北キヴ州、南キヴ州）に限定されている。英国のみが国際支援を表明。資源確保率が3分の1にとどまり、セキュリティ上の制約がある点は重要な懸念。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、英国（UKの記載あるも対象外）は除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC espera contener epidemia de ébola en al menos seis meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC expects to contain the Ebola outbreak within six months at the earliest.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo aims to contain its current Ebola outbreak within four to six months, according to Public Health Minister Roger Kamba. Speaking in Bunia, Ituri province, the minister noted that three provinces are currently reporting Ebola patients, and that DRC's experience with past epidemics should shorten response time. He warned that official counts may vary and that no one can predict the number of cases or deaths, but resources are being mobilized to minimize the toll. He recalled the 2018 outbreak eventually extending to 2020, underscoring that six months represents accelerated action. The government pledges to provide care to all patients in affected areas and praises frontline health workers, while dismissing rumors and promising transparency in reporting numbers to avoid panic. He stressed the need to detect and contain together.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染症の流行を少なくとも6ヶ月以内に抑制することを期待
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高リスク感染症としてフルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラは高い致命率と国際的な懸念を持つ重症感染症。複数州（3州）での患者報告、政府の公式対応声明、および過去流行からの経験言及がある。2018-2020年流行との比較から継続的リスクが示唆される。対象国DRCはWHO通知義務の基準を完全に満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, l'Oms ha annunciato il primo caso di guarigione in Rdc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the WHO has announced the first patient to recover in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak updates in Central Africa: The World Health Organization provided an update on the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; separately, the Republic of the Congo announced that on May 27 a patient had recovered and was discharged—the first reported recovery in this outbreak, according to WHO spokesperson Anais Legand. No additional case counts are specified in the report. In Kenya, a court temporarily blocked the government's plan to open a quarantine center for U.S.-bound citizens who may have been exposed to Ebola, a proposal that sparked protests. The piece underscores ongoing cross-border concerns and containment measures as of 2026-05-29, with the situation focusing on disease progression, hospital discharge, and related public health actions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、WHOがDRCでの最初の回復患者を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクを満たす。DRCでの流行継続と複数国への関心（ケニア）がWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのエボラ流行を主題としており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。ケニアの隔離センター計画はDRCでの流行に関連する二次的な施策であり、エボラの実際の発生地はDRCのみ。回復患者の報告は流行の継続と進行中の事例があることを示唆しており、IHR及びWPRO基準の双方で複数項目該当。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tribunal de Kenia suspende plan de EEUU para instalar centro de cuarentena por ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenyan court suspends U.S. plan to set up an Ebola quarantine center.
article.articleSummary: May 29, 2026 – Nairobi, Kenya: A Kenyan High Court temporarily suspended a U.S. plan to establish a quarantine center for Americans suspected of Ebola exposure. Judge Patricia Nyaundi issued the injunction after the Katiba Institute, a local rights group, challenged the initiative as secret and unilateral, citing constitutional rights to life, health, and due process. The ruling bars entry into Kenya of people suspected of infection or exposure to Ebola under the proposed U.S.–Kenya arrangement. Washington had announced a facility to isolate U.S. citizens suspected of exposure rather than repatriating them if symptoms develop, with potential transfers to a third country. The decision follows regional concerns about an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Kenyan medical and civil groups opposing the plan over health risks and the lack of public consultation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア裁判所がエボラ出血熱検疫センター設置のための米国計画を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関するシグナルであるが、記事の主要内容は米国がケニアに検疫センターを設置する計画を巡る法的紛争であり、現在のエボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国で発生している。ケニアでの実際の感染症イベント発生は報道されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアの法廷での訴訟中心で、実際のエボラ流行はコンゴ民主共和国で発生している。ケニアは検疫センター設置計画の対象国だが、感染症イベント発生地ではない。コンゴ民主共和国が対象国のため verified_locations に含めた。社会政治的関心は高いが、ケニアでの実際の感染症イベント発生がないため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola v Itálii? V římské nemocnici izolovali lékařku, která se vrátila z Konga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Italy? In a Rome hospital, a doctor who had returned from Congo was isolated.
article.articleSummary: Potential Ebola case in Italy: A physician in a Rome hospital is isolated after returning from Congo, raising questions about Ebola exposure in Italy. The doctor’s travel from Congo and subsequent isolation at the Rome facility are described, with no confirmation of infection reported. The situation highlights infection-control vigilance for travelers returning from Ebola-affected regions. While the framing suggests a possible imported case, the article provides no details on clinical symptoms, laboratory testing, outbreak status, exposure source, contacts, or patient outcome. Published 2026-05-29, the report underscores precautionary measures by healthcare workers and authorities in Rome to prevent potential importation of Ebola from Central Africa. No further information about exposure source or downstream actions is included.

triage.headline_ja: イタリアのエボラ？ローマの病院でコンゴから帰国した医師が隔離された
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の潜在的な輸入症例であり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）で複数該当の可能性があるが、臨床確認や検査結果の情報が完全に不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴからの帰国医師の隔離を報告しているが、臨床症状、検査結果、感染確認の有無については一切記載されていない。イタリア国内の患者隔離は記事の主題ではなく、あくまでコンゴでのエボラ流行に関連した予防措置である。現時点では推測的な懸念報告であり、検査結果確認後の確定情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 世衛秘書長訪民主剛果稱伊波拉疫情「可獲控制」　美國計畫將染疫公民擋在肯亞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General visits the Democratic Republic of the Congo, says the Ebola outbreak could be brought under control; United States plans to strand infected citizens in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, with 10 confirmed deaths since May 15 and 223 suspected deaths; total confirmed and suspected cases exceed 1,000 as of May 29, 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in DRC on May 28 and planned to visit the outbreak center on May 29, urging ceasefires among armed groups to enable containment and noting that travel bans are not effective. The WHO cautioned the true scale may be larger and that transmission may have occurred before detection. Separately, the United States plans to establish quarantine facilities in Kenya (Nanyuki, Laikipia Air Base) to isolate exposed or infected U.S. citizens, with symptomatic individuals treated abroad; Kenya halted the facility’s construction via court order on May 29, citing health concerns, with about $13.5 million in aid anticipated.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が民主共和国コンゴを訪問、エボラ疫情は「抑制可能」と述べる；米国がケニアで感染国民を隔離する計画
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確認死者10名、疑い死者223名、総患者数1,000人超の急速な拡大状況。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、複数国関与により国際的な関心と対応が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要イベントはDRCのエボラ流行（イトゥリ州中心）。ケニア（ナニュキ、ライキピア）は米国の隔離施設設置計画の場所として言及されているが、実際の疫病発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。Bluedot APIが提示したKenyaおよびUSAは、施設・計画の所在地であり疫病発生地ではない。WHOによる事務局長現地訪問、武装勢力との停戦交渉必要性の言及などから、管理可能性についても深刻な懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports 906 suspected Ebola cases, including over 200 deaths
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization data from a Geneva briefing on May 29, 2026, report 906 suspected Ebola cases linked to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 223 deaths. The cases are under investigation, with authorities noting that the figure will change as testing capacities are scaled up. WHO expert Anais Legand emphasized that investigations are ongoing. The report provides current counts of suspected cases and deaths without confirmation of cases; no details are given on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or imported/exported cases. The update highlights the scaling up of testing capacity as a key factor in refining the outbreak's scope. Location focus remains the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with no additional locations cited.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラの疑い患者906人を報告、死者200人以上を含む
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（疑い患者906人、死者223人）が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHO公式発表であり社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは発生地としてスイス（ジュネーブ）を地域情報に含めているが、これはWHO本部の所在地であり、アウトブレイク発生地ではない。実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみ。エボラウイルス病は極度に危険な病原体で、高い致死率（約25%）を示している。対象国ではないスイスの記者会見での発表という形式だが、実イベントはDRCに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: African health authorities insist Ebola outbreak can be stopped
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo has recorded more than 200 deaths and nearly 1,000 cases, though the World Health Organization says the figures are likely undercounted. African health authorities insist the outbreak can be stopped and say a vaccine will be ready by year-end. The virus strain is new, complicating response efforts. The outbreak epicenter in the DRC is the site of fighting between multiple groups, hindering surveillance and containment. A former US health security official warned the epidemic could be as bad as, or worse than, the 2014 West Africa Ebola outbreak, underscoring concerns about the outbreak's potential scale despite assurances from health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの保健当局はエボラ感染症の拡大は阻止できると主張している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示し、新種ウイルス株は異常かつ予想外、国際的拡大リスク（米国が発生地域に含まれる）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ感染症の爆発中心地は民主共和国コンゴと明記されている。米国は発生地域リストに含まれるが、サマリー上では具体的な米国内での発症事例の記述がなく、前US保健当局官による警告言及のみのため、verified_locationsからは除外した。新種ウイルス株、闘争地域における監視困難、2014年西アフリカエボラ流行との比較言及から、極めて高いリスク評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS lucha contrarreloj para frenar el brote mortal de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO races against the clock to halt the deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province in the northeast, is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country. The Bundibugyo strain has a 30–50% case-fatality rate; there is no approved vaccine and no specific treatment. As of 29 May 2026, transmission appears larger than initially estimated, with the virus circulating undetected for some time. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived to assess the situation, criticizing travel bans as ineffective and calling for enhanced cross-border collaboration. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, with eight confirmed cases and one death linked to a Congolese-imported case. Armed conflict complicates response efforts, and while the global risk remains low, the regional risk in sub-Saharan Africa is high.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国の致命的エボラ熱流行を阻止するため時間との戦いを繰り広げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、重篤度および国際的拡大リスクが明確である。エボラ熱は致死率30～50%で確認死亡例があり、既に隣国ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUganda（226074）も含まれているが、サマリーではウガンダは越境感染の受け入れ地域として言及されており、主要な流行発生地はDRCのIturi州である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO事務局長の現地訪問やメディア報道からも高い社会的・政治的関心が認められる。

article.articleHeadline: Страх от ебола в Европа: Италия настоява за спешни мерки по границите - Свят -- Новини Стандарт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola in Europe: Italy calls for urgent border measures - World -- Standard News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda triggers European concern; Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni urged EU border controls and coordination for direct and indirect arrivals from affected regions; she asked for a June European Council agenda inclusion and a health ministers videoconference next week. WHO data by May 24: 10 confirmed deaths and 223 probable deaths, among over 1,000 confirmed or probable cases in the DRC; Uganda reports 1 confirmed death and 6 additional infections; the agency warns the true scale is likely higher. Austria also voices alarm. Canada announced a temporary entry ban for residents of three African countries linked to the outbreak; the Bahamas is considering similar measures. The situation has spurred fears it could become the most deadly Ebola outbreak in history, prompting calls for strengthened border surveillance while respecting national health sovereignty.

triage.headline_ja: ヨーロッパでのエボラ懸念：イタリアが国境対策の緊急措置を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（1,000件以上の確認/疑い患者、230人以上の死亡）、国際的拡大のリスク（複数地域への言及、欧州の警戒）、渡航制限のリスク（カナダとバハマの入国禁止措置）が明確に該当し、同時にWPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、管理可能性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ウガンダも患者報告の対象地域として言及されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsに追加していない。DRCのみ対象国リストに該当。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはオーストリア、イタリア、カナダ、バハマが含まれているが、これらは懸念・対応地域であり、実際の発生地域はDRCとウガンダ（ウガンダは対象国外）である。

article.articleHeadline: Гендиректор ВОЗ выступил против закрытия границ из-за вспышки лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General spoke out against closing borders due to an Ebola fever outbreak
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged against travel bans in response to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, saying entry restrictions would have limited impact and only delay spread by a few days. He emphasized tackling the outbreak's root causes and delivering critical support. Countries including Bahamas, Bahrain, Jordan, Canada, Mexico, Rwanda, the United States, and Uganda have imposed entry bans on travelers from the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. WHO had previously raised the outbreak's global risk from high to very high; regionally, risk remains high in sub-Saharan Africa, while the global risk is considered low. The report notes ongoing risk assessments and border measures, but provides no specific case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、エボラ熱の流行に対する国境閉鎖に反対の声を上げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での渡航禁止が実施され、WHO が世界的リスクを「極めて高い」に引き上げた主要な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 発生地域に多数の国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの精読により、エボラ熱の実発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）及びウガンダ・南スーダンが主体。他国（バハマ、バーレーン、ヨルダン、カナダ、メキシコ、ルワンダ、米国など）は渡航禁止を実施した側であり、発生地ではない。対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHO世界的リスクが「極めて高い」に引き上げられており、国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ опубликовала новые данные о количестве случаев заражения вирусом Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has published new data on the number of Ebola virus infection cases.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization reported 906 suspected Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, including 223 deaths among the suspected, with investigations ongoing. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, with additional cases in Uganda. In Congo, 125 laboratory-confirmed cases; Uganda has seven confirmed cases, three of which were imported from the DRC. WHO spokesperson Anais Legand said mortality among confirmed cases is 30%–50%, noting these are preliminary and could be reduced with earlier intervention. No vaccines or treatments are currently approved for this Ebola outbreak. Data reflect ongoing transmission in the DRC, with cross-border transmission to Uganda being monitored.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラウイルス感染症の症例数に関する新たなデータを公表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、死亡率30-50%の重症度、国際的な越境感染（DRC→ウガンダ）、WHOの公式報告による国際的懸念があり、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラウイルス病の進行中の流行報告である。ウガンダに関しても記載されているが、対象国リストには含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの906例（疑い例）、125例（確定例）、223例の死亡が報告されており、Bundibugyo株が関与している。確定例における死亡率30-50%は極めて高い。現在利用可能なワクチンまたは治療法がないことが記載されている。WHOからの公式報告であるため信頼性が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : Londres injecte 20 millions de livres pour stopper la propagation
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: London injects 20 million pounds to halt the spread.
article.articleSummary: UK pledges emergency funding of 20 million pounds to the Democratic Republic of Congo to curb Ebola transmission. Announced by Jenny Chapman, UK Minister for International Development and Africa, after talks with President Félix Tshisekedi at the African Union complex. Funds are earmarked for on-the-ground actions: patient care (treatment centers and medical equipment), hospital strengthening (staff training, isolation capacity), surveillance (rapid case detection), and coordination (logistical support to response teams in affected foci). The goal is to interrupt transmission and prevent cross-border spread, with the UK aligning with WHO, AU, EU, and NGOs already mobilized. This move signals a durable partnership with the DRC, emphasizing health-system resilience and rapid first-response funding to curb Ebola at its outbreak sites in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：ロンドンが20億ポンドを投入して蔓延を阻止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクに該当（3基準）。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と国際的関心を有し、英国からの緊急資金投入というハイレベルな国際対応が発動されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率（50～90%）を有する出血熱。DRCで発生している複数焦点の流行に対し、UK政府から緊急資金投入が決定された。記事は英国の対応のみを記述しており、実際の流行状況の詳細情報は限定的だが、国際的な警戒と資源配置の段階へ既に移行している点が重要。DRCはシグナル対象国、英国（GeoNames 2635167）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تعلن عن أول حالة شفاء من الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization announces first recovery from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: First recovery from Ebola reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo amid an ongoing Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak that has crossed borders to Uganda. WHO data show 906 suspected Ebola cases in DRC, with 223 deaths under investigation. Confirmed infections total 125 in DRC; 7 confirmed in Uganda, three of them returning from DRC, including one death. No reports of community transmission to date. Case fatality rate among confirmed cases is estimated at 30–50%, and early care can reduce fatalities. There are no vaccines or therapies approved specifically for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Security challenges in eastern DRC, especially Ituri province and Bunia, remain the biggest obstacle to containment; about 100,000 people were displaced in the past month due to fighting. Dense mining communities and difficulties isolating contacts raise transmission risk. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus appeals for ceasefire and increased international funding and support for health workers.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関がエボラウイルスからの最初の回復例を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）の多国間での確認例、死亡者、国際的な拡大、およびセキュリティ課題による対応の複雑性により、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。フルRRAに進める。
triage.notes: DRCでの確認例125件、死亡者あり、ウガンダへの国境越え事例7件報告。Bundibugyo ebolavirus特異的なワクチン/治療法なし。東部DRC（イトゥリ州）での治安悪化による避難民発生が対応の大きな障害。WHOが停戦と国際的支援を呼びかけている。ウガンダ（226074）は記事では言及されているが、確認例数が少なく（7件、1件死亡）、DRCが主要な流行地であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports 906 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 906 suspected Ebola cases, including 223 suspected deaths under investigation, linked to the Bundibugyo strain; cases also reported in Uganda. In DRC, 125 confirmed Ebola cases with 17 confirmed deaths across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda has seven confirmed cases, three imported from DRC, and one death. WHO says no community transmission yet. Case fatality among confirmed infections estimated at 30–50% (preliminary). There are no approved vaccines or therapies for Bundibugyo virus disease. Aid efforts are rushing supplies to Bunia in Ituri as health workers cope with limited equipment, distrust, and armed-group threats. EU-donated items include masks, gloves, boots, medications; transport by UN forklifts. Health workers face attacks on centres and pressure from burial practices. The outbreak was declared a public health emergency of international concern. DR Congo reports over 1,000 suspected cases and at least 220 deaths since May 15.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い例906件を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間発生であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO公式声明に基づく確定情報、死亡率30～50%の高い重症度、DRC・ウガンダ間での国際的拡大、公式な国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダはAPI発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは二次的な言及（DRCからの輸入例）であり、主要な流行地はDRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州。DRCが対象国のため verified_locations に含める。WHO公式の国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。Bundibugyo株は致死率が高く、ワクチン・治療法なし。医療従事者への攻撃、信頼欠如など対応の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dėl Ebolos protrūkio Italija prašo ES griežtesnės sienų kontrolės
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Italy calls for stricter EU border controls due to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On May 29, 2026, Italy urged the EU to tighten border controls amid Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni asked EU leaders to add border management to the June 18–19 council agenda and to coordinate surveillance for arrivals from affected areas, while respecting national health prerogatives. An EU health ministers’ video conference is planned for next week. Since the outbreak was declared in the DRC on May 15, the World Health Organization reported 10 confirmed Ebola deaths and 223 suspected deaths among more than 1,000 confirmed and suspected cases as of May 24. In Uganda, one confirmed death and six additional cases have been recorded. Italy has activated targeted health surveillance for travelers returning from the two African countries. A Spallanzani Hospital team will travel to Kinshasa to provide technical assistance and deliver medicines and supplies this weekend.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行を受けてイタリアがEUに厳格な国境管理を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCでの大規模患者発生（1,000件以上の確認・疑い例、死亡233件）とウガンダでの確認例、イタリアを含む国際的関心の高まりが確認される。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域フィールドにはイタリアとウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ流行と、イタリアが対応を要求していることであり、実際の感染症流行の発生地はDRCのみ。ウガンダは流行地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため、検証済み地域にはDRCのみを記載。イタリアは対象国でない。

article.articleHeadline: "Si Ebola arrive, nous serons exterminés" : en RDC, la crainte d'une contamination massive dans les camps des déplacés ayant fui les conflits
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "If Ebola arrives, we will be exterminated": in the DRC, the fear of a massive outbreak in camps for internally displaced people who fled the conflicts
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province has caused 246 deaths and around 1,000 suspected cases, driven by the Bundibugyo variant with a case-fatality rate up to 50%. Ituri’s conflict-affected camps shelter nearly 970,000 displaced people across about 61 sites, including Kigonze camp where over 25,000 live in overcrowded, unsanitary conditions, raising fears of rapid spread. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo to date, and protective materials have not reached Kigonze. Gov. Johnny Luboya Nkashama urged rapid deployment of equipment and qualified health personnel. Congolese authorities suspended flights to/from Bunia; only humanitarian flights are allowed. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Bunia on May 29–30 to bolster the response, optimistic that transmission can be halted despite access and security challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラが到来すれば、我々は絶滅する」：DRCで、紛争から逃れた避難民キャンプでの大規模感染の懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。致死率50%のBundibugyo型エボラで246死亡・1000疑い例、避難民キャンプ97万人の感染リスク、ワクチン未対応。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州で報告されたエボラ（Bundibugyo型）。紛争と重なった避難民キャンプでの大規模流行リスク。WHO事務局長の現地訪問、フニア発着便の運航停止など、国家的・国際的対応が既に開始。ワクチン未対応という重大な制限要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: WHO chief Tedros in capital of Ebola-hit DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, declared May 15, centers on Ituri with spillover to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of May 28, there are 1,077 suspected cases and 246 deaths; transmission is likely broader than detected, with limited lab confirmation capacity in DRC. Uganda reports seven confirmed infections, including one death, indicating cross-border risk; Uganda and Rwanda have closed borders. Ituri hosts nearly a million displaced people in camps, raising transmission risk amid insecurity and poor hygiene. WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus arrived in Kinshasa May 28 to meet authorities on May 29, then to visit Ituri on May 30 (trip delayed by a day). No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo; a vaccine could be ready by end-2026, and WHO advisory groups have recommended clinical trials for vaccines and treatments.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長テドロスがエボラ流行の中心地コンゴ民主共和国の首都を訪問
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による深刻な国際的拡大リスク、複数国への越境感染、限定的な検査能力下での高い死亡率、国際的な関心の急速な高まり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱は第17番目の流行。2026年5月15日に宣言され、Ituri州を中心にNorth KivuおよびSouth Kivu州への波及を確認。5月28日時点で疑い症例1,077例、死亡246例。ウガンダで確認感染7例（死亡1例）により越境リスク顕在化。ウガンダとルワンダが国境閉鎖。Ituri州には難民キャンプに約100万人が滞在中で感染リスク高い。WHO事務局長の現地視察は国際的関心の高さと緊急対応の姿勢を示唆。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチンは2026年末までに準備される見通し。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО обяви първия излекуван пациент от настоящото огнище на ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announced the first recovered patient from the current Ebola outbreak in Congo.
article.articleSummary: as of May 29, 2026, the World Health Organization confirmed the first recovered patient from the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. On May 27, the patient recovered, left hospital, and was discharged back into the community, according to WHO spokesperson Anais Legan. The development marks the first confirmed recovery in this outbreak. Humanitarian aid for the Ebola response has arrived in Congo to support containment and care efforts as authorities and international partners work to curb transmission in Central Africa. No additional clinical details are provided in the report. The announcement highlights progress in patient management amid ongoing containment and support operations to control the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴの現在のエボラ流行における最初の回復患者を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高いリスク疾患の確定患者が発生しており、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確定患者と回復者が報告されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。記事サマリーから実際の発生地は Democratic Republic of Congo（DRC）であることが明確。国際的な人道支援が既に到着し、封じ込め対応が進行中。フルのRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola nguy cơ lan rộng, Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo hạn chế đi lại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of Ebola spreading; Ministry of Health advises restricting travel.
article.articleSummary: As of May 27, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 1,077 suspected Ebola cases (238 deaths) with 121 confirmed (17 deaths); Uganda reports 7 cases (1 death). Total confirmed Ebola: 128 cases and 18 deaths. WHO assigns Congo risk as very high and regional risk (including Uganda) as high, due to community transmission, potential missed transmission chains, and cross-border movement; Ugandan cases are linked to import from Congo into Kampala. The outbreak spans 14 health zones across three provinces, mainly Ituri, with contact tracing hampered by insecurity, displacement, and mining activity near the border. Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Vietnam has no cases; risk remains low but importation is possible. Vietnam MOH has strengthened border, facility, and community surveillance, prepared isolation capacity, staffing, supplies, and updated diagnostic and treatment guidelines (adding six strains). Common symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, conjunctivitis, and rash; CFR ~50% (25–90%); incubation 2–21 days. Advise limiting nonessential travel to outbreak areas and seeking care if exposed or symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の拡大リスク、保健省が渡航制限を勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認例および地域的な高リスク評価により、フルRRAへの進行が必要。
triage.notes: DRCおよびウガンダでの確認事例（DRC：1,077疑い例、238死亡；ウガンダ：7例、1死亡）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、ワクチンなし、致死率約50%。DRCではコミュニティ感染が継続中で接触者追跡が困難。ウガンダの事例はDRCからの輸入。ベトナムは現在症例なしも、国境監視強化および準備体制の記載あり。Bluedot APIでベトナムが列挙されているのは、本記事がベトナムメディアソースであり、ベトナムの対応状況を報道しているため。ウガンダはGeoNames IDの対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Rodolfo Montero confirmó que la "súper gripe" saturó guardias y puso bajo estrés al sistema en Mendoza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rodolfo Montero confirmed that the "super flu" overwhelmed the emergency departments and put the health system under strain in Mendoza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A(H3N2), nicknamed the 'super flu', strained Mendoza, Argentina's health system in early 2026. In weeks 1–18 of 2026, 90 influenza cases were studied in Cuyo, 82 in Mendoza, the majority identified as influenza A(H3N2). Genomic sequencing found 56 Mendoza cases of subclade J.2.4.1/(K), among the region’s highest circulation. Nationwide, 91% of positive samples were influenza A and 98% of those were H3N2. The surge began in week 10 and accelerated in weeks 16–18. 1,144 influenza hospitalizations nationwide this year, with 5 deaths; children under 10 accounted for 45% of studied cases, and those over 65 were also affected. Mendoza reported overwhelming demand at Hospital Notti, stressing primary care and ER; authorities are reinforcing services and reviewing guard shifts. SARS-CoV-2 and RSV circulation remains low.

triage.headline_ja: ロドルフォ・モンテロが確認：メンドーサでの「スーパーフル」が救急外来を圧倒し保健システムに負荷をかけた
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA(H3N2)の異常な流行により保健システムが過負荷となり、全国で1,144件の入院と5件の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たす。また、スクリーニング基準でも重症度と長期曝露リスクが該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではアルゼンチン（メンドーサ州）が主な発生地として説明されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations にはアルゼンチンを含めない。フィリピンがBluedotの発生地域に含まれており、記事内でCuyo（フィリピン）でも90例の流行が報告されているため、対象国フィリピンを verified_locations に含める。ただし、記事の主題はメンドーサ（アルゼンチン）の状況説明が中心であることに注意。
